reviews.subject: ECON-315 (Economics)
reviews.review: This is a hard course in general. I have taken and dropped this course with other professors and he is by far the best one on campus. Only teaches you what you need to know for exams, and ties a lot of real life examples back to the course. he provides mock exams before every test, and i would go to the tutoring sessions .

reviews.subject: ECON-315 (Economics)
reviews.review: Attendance isn't mandatory but I highly recommend going to every class, it makes a huge difference. The course is math heavy and he teaches exactly what you need to know for the exams. No cheat sheet is allowed. Homework has multiple attempts with the highest score counting.Take notes and put in the effort. One of the best professors at CSUF.

reviews.subject: ECON-315 (Economics)
reviews.review: Professor Mummery is one of my all time favorite professors. He's very detail oriented and organized with a very clear criteria for grading. His lectures are exactly what you need for him exams (show up to class!) and provides a study guides. He is very caring and patient overall great professor who wants your to succeed. I recommend!!!

reviews.subject: ECON-315 (Economics)
reviews.review: Amazing professor! He explains concepts well, and if you do decent enough on the exams and do all the hw, you will pass! However make sure to study all the time as the material is challenging. Also, get 100% on every hw to get 10 extra points for hw grade!

reviews.subject: ECON-315 (Economics)
reviews.review: The best professor I've had, his lectures aren't boring and you can see he loves what he does. If you need help he is always willing to help you understand. Would of loved to have taken him for other Econ classes. Be ready to take notes.

reviews.subject: ECON-315 (Economics)
reviews.review: Professor Mummery is hands down the best professor I have ever had. Just go to class. Take notes in class as he lectures, don't copy them later unless you have to. Homework assignments are easy and not too time consuming. Exams are set up exactly how he teaches the problems. He sets you up for success.

reviews.subject: HIST101 (History)
reviews.review: This class was pretty difficult because it was based only on tests, but if you pay attention, you can pass! I got around a 70% on my first exam, and I ended up failing my second one, but I locked in for my third one and passed with a C. Attendance is mandatory to pass the class to be honest, but hes not boring he's funny, and he teaches pretty well

reviews.subject: HIST180 (History)
reviews.review: ONLY TAKE THIS CLASS IF YOU WANT TO BE GRADED ON 3 EXAMS. he does not give homework or points on anything else, so if you aren't a good test taker, then you probably won't do well in this class. very lecture heavy class and if you miss 1 lecture, you're probably done for. very harsh grader and barely uses canvas.

reviews.subject: 110A (History)
reviews.review: If you want to take a history class that isn't analysis heavy of historical figures or events, with the focus instead being on memorization and storytelling, Mark is your professor. He honestly taught me a lot more life and social skills than about history since his lectures were so easy to follow; just show up and write down every word he says.

reviews.subject: HIS180 (History)
reviews.review: Miss one lecture you won't pass. ONLY has 4 exams. No homework at all. LECTURE AND TEST HEAVY. Even if you write so much on the topic, he won't give you more than a 20% it has to be EXACTLY what he wants. If you fail the first exam you won't pass no matter what.

reviews.subject: HIS180 (History)
reviews.review: Although I passed with an A-, he is a very hard grader. He doesn't follow a clear rubric and often grades based on how he feels- doesn't grade based on numbers. He doesn't hesitate to give F's - on the first exam, half the class failed. If you take this class, memorize everything and write a lot. Make each essay 3 pages and ID ?s atleast 1/2 page.

reviews.subject: HIST170A (History)
reviews.review: Don't be fooled by the history majors here. The professor had a good sense of humor at first, but he started to weird me out. He writes lectures on the board, so attending class and taking notes is important. Despite attending most classes, the exams were challenging. He's knowledgeable, but his teaching style is traditional and demanding.

reviews.subject: 101 (Geology)
reviews.review: So I graduated five years ago this summer and Henderson is the only professor I had outside of my major that I remember. He really cares about each student and gave me advice going to grad school that was really helpful for my masters. Class is pretty straightforward with homework problems become test questions. Loved the optional trip.

reviews.subject: 201 (Geology)
reviews.review: Definitely go on the field trips with Henderson they are awesome got to crawl through a lava tube collect fossils cross rivers in the desert etc

reviews.subject: GEO101L (Geology)
reviews.review: Took summer lab with Henderson   He will always meet you on zoom if ask to explain things good instructor

reviews.subject: GEO101L (Geology)
reviews.review: Took the summer online lab, he has videos explaining whatbtomdonfor the labs so it looks like a lot of people here do not watch them. Class is online so if you send him picture of what you have done he will show you if it is right or not and how to fix it if it isn't

reviews.subject: GEO101L (Geology)
reviews.review: Seriously yk what this guy. Grades a 1 unit lab like its a graduate level law class. Steer away.

reviews.subject: GEOL101 (Geology)
reviews.review: Very hard for a GE class, long homework that followed hour long videos weekly, Lecture slides were very hard to follow, mostly pictures with verbal commentary that weren't on slides. Likes to go off topic on long tangents. Very nitpicky and focuses on hyper specific examples and niche questions on exams that you wouldn't think to write down. AVOID!

reviews.subject: 201A (Accounting)
reviews.review: i don't think i actually learned anything from his class. ik more about his personal life (ex-wife and children) than i do about the subject itself. the only reason i even passed this class was because for the final i literally had to learn from a professor on yt. a lot of homework and doesn't really teach the subject. attendance is mandatory lol

reviews.subject: ACCT201B (Accounting)
reviews.review: Great dude, people who dont like him probably just didnt do well in the class. The thing with accounting is you get it or you dont. there are people who use ChatGPT for their hw. When it comes to test time they dont do well cause they havent learned anything. Hoffman is entertaining and hates liberal arts majors doesnt get much better than that

reviews.subject: 201A (Accounting)
reviews.review: Great Professor! If you do the homework and reading you should do well in this class. Dont try to cheat yourself in this class by using ChatGPT. You don't learn and it doesn't help you in the long run. Just do the homework yourself and try to learn how to do it. :)

reviews.subject: ACCT201B (Accounting)
reviews.review: ACCT itself is so much hw due every other night. Seems like he actually wants to help his students. He has a TA who takes attendance, and they will dock pts if you're not in your assigned seat. (Beware of the Discord users for this class. try-hards and will snitch on you and talk shit on Discord about people in class.)

reviews.subject: ACCT201A (Accounting)
reviews.review: front+back cheat sheet for all exams w/ detailed study guides. Has EC + drops lowest scores. a lot of people use chatGPT and it shows in the low test scores. great professor that wants you to succeed, very easy to approach if you have questions

reviews.subject: ACCT201B (Accounting)
reviews.review: I took Hoffman for 201A and 201B and they were VERY different experiences. He's very nice, but was often confused and didn't seem as confident in 201B as he did in 201A. It's the same structure as his 201A class. He allows cheat sheets/provides a thorough study guide for each exam. He wants everyone to succeed, but wasn't the best prof for 201B.

reviews.subject: 361A (Information Systems)
reviews.review: This class is pretty much statistics but with the usage of Excel. His lectures are great and provide us with the material needed to remember the commands and better understand Excel. You'll be finished with the material by week 10 and there's hw and excel quizzes. This is an easy A, take him.

reviews.subject: ISDS361A (Information Systems)
reviews.review: Was a great professor for the first 2 months of having him before the class was taken over by a different prof. Luckily we got to keep his class structure. Class was "online" but exams were proctored in person by a TA. Great organization to the class, sets you up to pass if you put the effort in but still not an easy A. Allows cheat sheet front/bck

reviews.subject: ISDS361A (Information Systems)
reviews.review: Prof. Skordi was great! He was very knowledgeable and genuinely cares for his students. We finished all material before break, giving us ample time to review for the final. He went over each exam beforehand and let us know exactly what to expect. He definitely sets you up for success, and he's very kind.

reviews.subject: 361A (Information Systems)
reviews.review: This was an online class, but the content was fairly simple. Overall, he was a good professor and knowledgable.

reviews.subject: ISDS361A (Information Systems)
reviews.review: I feel bad because Professor had a small majority of his class show up to zoom lectures because they were not mandatory. Besides that he is a nice and chill guy. Exams are easy to prep for with the mock exams and sample questions. I just wish more people came to the zoom so he felt more were participating.

reviews.subject: ISDS361A (Information Systems)
reviews.review: Class structure is clear and easy to follow. He makes it like an async class and his exams are easy! Gives practice exams and outlines that correlate to the real thing! Gives extra resources and ec. Main thing is that if you don't attend then you'll miss a lot of content

reviews.subject: CAS494 (Psychology)
reviews.review: I truly write this review hoping that Prof. Stout reads this and takes it as feedback for future courses. 494 as a practicum class already requires students to put in several hours at their internship site. On top of this Prof Stout requires an absurd amount of busy work. I wish I could write more regarding her class because I have so much to say.

reviews.subject: COUNS562 (Psychology)
reviews.review: The class was counseling 560. It was truly impossible to learn anything in this class. Lectures were poorly delivered and not organized.She would confuse us more than anything. Feedback was literally AI generated and the same for every student. And the attitude when she was confronted by students for the lack of effort was insane.

reviews.subject: CAS394 (Psychology)
reviews.review: She is overall a good professor however due dates are set in stone. Tough grader no room for error especially with practicum assigments.

reviews.subject: CAS394 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Dr. Stout made it clear that she was there to support you during the placement process, however when it came to culmination, she seemed to have tapped out. She also assigns a lot of additional work, which was very stressful at times, since the main focus of the course is the internship. Final exam is 15% of grade too, which I thought was wild.

reviews.subject: CAS310 (Psychology)
reviews.review: She is pretty good at lectures, although most of the content is taken straight from the textbook. Exams are very textbook heavy and she will curve is the average is low. There aren't a ton of opportunities to earn extra assignment points, and she grades hard on the bigger observations. Prepare to read every page of the textbook and review HEAVILY.

reviews.subject: CAS301 (Psychology)
reviews.review: read the textbook for the exams

reviews.subject: MGMT246 (Business)
reviews.review:
HERE IS HOW TO PASS THIS CLASS IF YOU CANNOT ATTEND EVERY SESSION: 
- attend every single session until the first pop quiz
- believe that once a quiz grade has been inputted in canvas, then the next pop quiz is coming very soon
This class consists of only 9 things: 1 syllabus assignment, 5 pop quizzes, and 3 exams (the last one is noncumulative).

reviews.subject: MGMT445 (Business)
reviews.review: He will spend 2/3 weeks on one chapter because he's just rambling and talking about himself. He makes very inappropriate comments and thinks he's funny. No one is engaged in his class, people don't even show up anymore or leave in the middle of class. The class itself is not difficult. He knows a lot about his profession.

reviews.subject: MGMNT246 (Business)
reviews.review: Attendance is not mandatory in the sense that it's graded but he does do random pop quizzes which are open book and you can collaborate with other students. The class is not hard at all as long as you pay attention. He tells stories which help a lot with understanding the concepts even if you don't understand how. Very funny guy too

reviews.subject: MGMT246 (Business)
reviews.review: try ur best to attend class (even if ur late) just bc he does pop quizzes to try to get kids to go to class. u miss 2 quizzes & ur grade will fall bad. so go to class just for quizzes. in-class notes > lecture slides! he wont accept any exceptions for pop quizzes AT ALL. just trust that he does curve at end of sem bc he doesnt like ppl asking him

reviews.subject: MGMT246 (Business)
reviews.review: typical chill white professor that sometimes says questionable jokes. u can survive off of lecture slides if ur rlly not up for class! dont skip majority of classes cuz then those ppl did bad on exams & blamed him. for EXAMS, study PRACTICE EXAM (UNDERSTAND WHY THE CORRECT ANSWER IS CORRECT/WRONG!) +TERMINOLOGY +addit. things he said; PS does curve

reviews.subject: MGMT246 (Business)
reviews.review: Graded only on pop quizzes and 3 exams. I'm not good with heavy lectures and worse with tests, for me it was quite hard. Doesn't take attendance but miss a quiz, good luck. He goes into long stories that are examples of the law but will mix in personal stuff. This REALLY made it hard to focus on what im trying to learn. Did curve my final grade tho

reviews.subject: ECO315 (Economics)
reviews.review: Just take ECON 315 for the second time with Professor Morteza this Spring semester. It hit me so hard. The exams, quizzes are very heavy. Even though the HW, and Smartbook assignments is simple but complicated. Planning to repeat it for a third attempt next Fall. Do not take this Professor. Planning to get some tutoring and find a good Professor.

reviews.subject: ECON201 (Economics)
reviews.review: Took him in spring 2025, and he's a nice guy who knows his stuff. Had him in the morning, but I still went often since he used scenarios/examples to make the material easier to digest. Exams weren't hard. Easy to reach through email for feedback or help.

reviews.subject: ECO315 (Economics)
reviews.review: make sure you go to SI meetings for this class. everything they go over will be on quizzes and tests. if you go to the meetings, you will pass. additionally professor gave us a lot of extra credit points and curved for students who were failing.

reviews.subject: ECO315 (Economics)
reviews.review: Honestly a good professor, 4 quizzes (lowest is dropped), midterm, homework but not a ton and he offers extra credit (for my session it was 13 possible points). Records all lectures and posts a ton of resource videos (but ur better off going to SI). The only real knock is that his TAs are God awful and so annoying. They hawk over you during exams.

reviews.subject: ECO315 (Economics)
reviews.review: A very dear dear professor. 2 midterms (mc + 2 frqs), 4 quizzes, & weekly homework assignments. Must buy textbook to do the hw. Offers extra credit for in-person attendance & drops 1 lowest quiz grade. Makes review videos for every quiz & exam. Gives clear lectures & is a silly goosie. Only downside is no cheat sheet.

reviews.subject: ECO315 (Economics)
reviews.review: Not too tough of a class at all. SI sessions are amazing for this class definitely recommend. uploads his zoom lectures and records good quiz and exam prep. drops lowest quiz and gives EC randomly in class. i couldve gotten a better grade but messed up first 2 quizzes. Lecture heavy but if you take notes and listen he explains concepts very well.

reviews.subject: MAKT351 (Marketing)
reviews.review: Chris is such a great guy. He has had over 25 years of experience in the corporate world and illustrates his experience through lecture. The tests are really hard, but as long as you do the paper and simulation properly you should get a C+ and if you excel on participation and the assignments a B. I learned a lot in his class.

reviews.subject: MKTG351 (Marketing)
reviews.review: The test for all marketing exams are scenario based, but the professor makes it as easy as possible. He tells you when there will be a pop quiz and on what chapter. His instructions for the semester are clear and concise. There is simulation that you need pay $15 for and an essay. He grades very easy, just do the assignments.

reviews.subject: MKTG351 (Marketing)
reviews.review: Get ready to read the book and take careful notes in class if you want to do well in Exams as they are tough. Grades mainly comes from there. If Marketing is not your major and looking to fulfill this class for requirement I'd avoid. Take another professor.

reviews.subject: MAKT351 (Marketing)
reviews.review: Love him!!! His lessons are from the book, but adds his personal experience to drive it home. His humor is not for everyone, but had me laughing EVERY class. There are 4 pop quizzes that he gives info about ahead of time. There is a simulation, paper and certificate that are easy assignments and 3 exams. He is one of the best professors at CSUF!

reviews.subject: MARK351 (Marketing)
reviews.review: You need to read every single chapter in order to do well in exams. He's really nice and willing to help students. Lectures based on textbook, and his real experiences. Long personal project but he gives clear instruction. Highly recommend if 351 is the one you must take.

reviews.subject: MKTG351 (Marketing)
reviews.review: Chris is a funny professor, his class lectures are based on life stories and similar to the book. His exams can be hard so get ready to work hard for that A or B. The project is on the topic of your choice & fairly easy if you look at his samples. You get easy points from the simulation & Lynda so do them! You will never have hw besides reading.

reviews.subject: WGST100 (Women's Studies)
reviews.review: Professor Christian if you're reading this please come back to CSUF.

reviews.subject: WGST100 (Women's Studies)
reviews.review: I wish he could teach every class ever.

reviews.subject: WGST100 (Women's Studies)
reviews.review: I cried in the bathroom the last day of school because I was gonna miss his class so much

reviews.subject: WGST100 (Women's Studies)
reviews.review: Professor Christian isn't your average professor. He's someone who loves his career, and you can feel it through his lectures. Be prepared to question your understanding and perspectives on specific issues. The workload is manageable, but his class was challenging because it made me acknowledge more than I have in my other upper-level courses.

reviews.subject: WGST100 (Women's Studies)
reviews.review: His lectures are so interesting, he talks about gender issues but he deepens it so much more talking about societal issues. I never missed a class except for the last one which I deeply regret but I was sick. The books he assigns are pretty easy to read and the homework is not too much. He really is a great teacher and his lectures are so good!

reviews.subject: WGST100 (Women's Studies)
reviews.review: Professor Christian is an awesome professor! He always has me leaving class all curious after every lecture. His class is simple as long you just do the work and go to class and you'll pass. He has you read books but they're comic books which are very interesting. Definitely recommend him if you like to be inspired.

reviews.subject: 201A (Accounting)
reviews.review: i was lucky enough to pass the class, despite all the effort i put in the class. he makes you read lectures before class but does not teach the subject. instead he talks about his life or other irrelevant accounting things. dont ask questions because hes just going to make fun of you in class. you need to teach yourself because he wont teach you

reviews.subject: 201A (Accounting)
reviews.review: The worst professor you'll ever have as he doesn't teach absolutely anything. He openly says that most people don't pass his class & tries to shame you for asking any type of question. Aside from this, his sense of humor is just bizarre. Take this class at a JC or wherever you can because you'll definitely regret choosing him & wasting your time.

reviews.subject: 201A (Accounting)
reviews.review: This guy is the only professor for this class at CSUF. Do yourself a favor and take it online or at a JC. Wasted 2 semesters on this guy who openly admits most people dont pass his class the first try. Im sure its incredibly difficult to get rid of teachers in the CSU system so do it for yourself and take somewhere else. Just read the reviews...

reviews.subject: 201A (Accounting)
reviews.review: Absolutely horrific and also made me reconsider life. I genuinely considered ending my life because of how stupid and unintelligent this fool made me feel. Literally the worst professor and person I've ever met. He's literally the only choice so gl if u take this class.

reviews.subject: ACCT201A (Accounting)
reviews.review: Basically have to teach the material to yourself. He loves to make students feel stupid for asking questions/getting answers wrong. He doesn't explain the material well, but expects students to understand it right away. Do the readings and go to SI

reviews.subject: 201A (Accounting)
reviews.review: Awful class. Have to teach yourself all the material.

reviews.subject: ART101 (Art)
reviews.review: Very funny, but it can come off as rude at times. The midterm and final are difficult so study for them as they have a big impact on your grade. Overall, this class isn't hard. Just doing your best will very likely get you an A.

reviews.subject: ART101 (Art)
reviews.review: This professor was OK. His lectures were fine and he had a clear understanding of everything. However, he was just rude. I asked him for help because I had been sick and he just laughed in my face and rolled his eyes. He also has no empathy whatsoever. At the beginning, I thought he was fine but later into the semester, he changed

reviews.subject: ART101 (Art)
reviews.review: He is a really good teacher and the lectures are super simple. Make sure you pay attention and do the journals!

reviews.subject: ART101 (Art)
reviews.review: Made learning about art very interesting and easy, even if you weren't originally interested. I enjoyed going to his lectures, however I would recommend not buying his textbook- we didn't even use it since it's the same as the lectures. Midterm and final are harder than expected, but all the other assignments are easy, so it's easy to get an A.

reviews.subject: ART101 (Art)
reviews.review: Professor Plouffe is super chill! His lectures are very informative and you don't need to purchase the textbook, only just coloring pencils and the sketch pad for the art journals. The class is graded on 3 DB posts, 2 GEWR, midterm, final, and 14 art journals. The art journals are the only lengthy assignment so make sure to alot time for them.

reviews.subject: ART101 (Art)
reviews.review: Took Art 101 online with Professor Plouffe and loved it. The lectures are really interesting and fast-paced, even online. There are a lot of assignments, but they aren't hard, and the biggest assignment isn't due until the end of the semester. As long as you keep up with the assignments, the class is super easy & interesting!

reviews.subject: MUS355 (Music)
reviews.review: He is very passionate and experienced in this subject. His lectures were also very entertaining and showcased old videos of composers. If buying the book is not a problem for you, I'd definitely recommend taking him if you need an elective. One of the easiest yet entertaining classes I have taken at Fullerton!

reviews.subject: MUS355 (Music)
reviews.review: You can tell this guy is very passionate about his knowledge of film music. Had to buy a new edition textbook which had homework in it (mandatory), but doable. Video lectures were incredibly long. One midterm and one final.

reviews.subject: MUS355 (Music)
reviews.review: Very caring and knowledgeable professor. The workload was very light in this course which was a huge plus. We had workbook questions, a midterm, and a final. The lectures were amazing but long. The content in this course was very engaging. I learned many new aspects of film music. Overall, this course was fantastic.

reviews.subject: 355MUS (Music)
reviews.review: His passion, knowledge, and experience within cinema and film music are beyond inspiring. I can listen to his lectures forever. His workbook is an absolute delight. I'm proud to own it and excited to learn more about film music even after this course. That's how inspiring he is.

reviews.subject: FILM335 (Music)
reviews.review: TAKE THIS CLASS!!! The prof. is extremely passionate and knowledgeable. The work (takes about 1hr to complete for the week), midterm, and exam are super easy. It honestly doesn't even feel like a class, it just feels like you're speaking with a friend and learning about cool content. (you do have to buy a textbook $120)

reviews.subject: MUS355 (Music)
reviews.review: Honestly, I really liked class/lectures but it can get heavy with the amount you need to watch. You have to buy the book unfortunately to do the homework but other than that you are graded by the midterm and final which aren't too bad another downside is you don't know you're grade for certain. Other than that great and interesting lectures.

reviews.subject: ISDS301B (Business Administration)
reviews.review: She is the worst professor for an ISDS course or any course. Her grading scale is to fail as many students as she can. She is not a caring professor; she dislikes helping students understand stats. You will have little interaction with her only through a series of long boring videos. You will be teaching yourself. Discord helped me pass this class.

reviews.subject: IDSDS361B (Business Administration)
reviews.review: This online class was all recorded lectures from last semester and a zoom class before each exam. Certainly was not a fun class.

reviews.subject: 361B (Business Administration)
reviews.review: very bad teacher, she wants everything the old school. she doesn't involve technology with her teachings, you have to do most of the calculations by hand. she's also always talking about politics, she hates males and calls them pigs. very disrespectful teacher and I find it funny that no one ever complained or mined her demeanor against males.

reviews.subject: ISDS361AB (Business Administration)
reviews.review: Professor does not care about her students. She will avoid office hours and email replies are very vague. Practice exams are NOTHING like the actual exams. FIND ANOTHER PROFESSOR TO TAKE.

reviews.subject: IDSDS361B (Business Administration)
reviews.review: After all the good reviews this professor had, I was so happy to be in her class. Little I knew of the hell my life was about to be. The countless hours of video lectures and no support and no help from her at all, as others have pointed out. For your own sanity, choose another professor to help you succeed in this class. You have been warned.

reviews.subject: ISDS361B (Business Administration)
reviews.review: I STRONGLY do not recommend this professor. I saw she had a 4.3 and was like okay cool; however, her online format is the absolute WORST. You are expected to watch around 10 hours of video each week and the exams are poorly timed giving you inadequate amount of time to finish. I am an A student I got over 100% in my past ISDS class, do not take her

reviews.subject: POSC300 (Political Science)
reviews.review: She does not have lecture slides and you really have to pay attention to what she says especially since what she is saying will be in the exams. It's not as bad as it seems especially by how funny and how interesting she makes the topics sometimes. The only things she grades are exams which can be good or bad depending if you actually study well.

reviews.subject: POLISCI100 (Political Science)
reviews.review: Prof. Stambaugh was an amazing lecturer and made an 8:30 class survivable. She's passionate about what she teaches and is more than willing to explain something to you if you don't understand. She doesn't use powerpoint but I found that to help me pay attention, especially since your exams and quizzes determine your grade. I learned a lot!

reviews.subject: PLSCI100 (Political Science)
reviews.review: My favorite professor I've ever had. Makes lectures so entertaining and interesting. I learned so much in this class and would recommend her to anybody who has to take that class. Tests are sometimes difficult but she drops your lowest test grade.

reviews.subject: POSC100 (Political Science)
reviews.review: Attendance isn't mandatory but if you want a good grade you need to show up since she doesn't post lectures. 3 exams drops lowest score, 2 quizzes, and 1 in-class writing assignment. Gives study guide for textbook sections on exam. Lecture heavy but I thought her lectures were interesting and the outlines made it easy to follow. Overall good prof!

reviews.subject: POLSC100 (Political Science)
reviews.review: Overall she was okay. She makes up her own exams which can be tricky. You do need a textbook, I recommend downloading it from Anna's Archive. She is super lecture heavy and does make it interesting but you have to really, I mean really, read the long textbook chapters to understand what she's talking about.

reviews.subject: POS100 (Political Science)
reviews.review: Though attendence not mandatory, all things on exams and quizzes only given in person. No slide shows for notes, no study guides, all in lecture that she reads off paper. Only thing graded for class is your exams and quizzes. And no extra credit at all.

reviews.subject: COM407 (Communications)
reviews.review: Great teacher, STAY ON THOSE ASSIGNMENTS! Comm law is tough, pay attention and put in the work or you won't learn anything. At least 2 video/quiz/practice assignments per week, short answer and multiple choice tests a few times throughout the semester. She's the best, but good luck anyway.

reviews.subject: COM233 (Communications)
reviews.review: best professor out there, super hilarious and relatable, 10/10 take her class again

reviews.subject: COMM407 (Communications)
reviews.review: Comm law sounds absolutely terrifying but it ended up being one of my favorite classes because of Erickson. She's knowledgeable/passionate about the material and will bring up current events and talk on how they apply to the topics. Super funny and has a great classroom environment. There is a lot of flowcharts but they get easier towards the end!

reviews.subject: COMM407 (Communications)
reviews.review: EE is a great professor, her lectures are funny and engaging. Homework is also super easy as long as you follow directions properly. Sometimes her lectures could be a bit shorter, but she's great whatsoever. She also allows a cheatsheet for the midterm!!

reviews.subject: COM407 (Communications)
reviews.review: I felt intimidated taking this class (Spring 2025) due to the overload of information. At times, the prof's teaching felt a bit all over the place. The key is to take good, organized notes to help when doing assignments & preparing for tests. Other than that, this prof is fantastic. You'll be in good hands, trust :) It gets easier towards the end

reviews.subject: COMMLAW (Communications)
reviews.review: EE was very funny and I expected to hate my life in COMM LAW due to the workload but she made it fun and manageable. Gets A LOT easier in the 2nd half of semester. Lowkey the lecture could be 20 min but there is a lot of small talk which makes the class longer than it needs to be. Overall a nice experience.

reviews.subject: 100 (Human Communication Studies)
reviews.review: He laughs at his own jokes, which is his way of bringing engagement to the class. We've only had a few assignments, which are the speeches and exams. It's lecture-based and easy to follow, but it can get a bit boring if no one responds.

reviews.subject: HCOM304 (Human Communication Studies)
reviews.review: Dr. Teven truly cares about teaching communication and about his students. My main qualm with his class was the amount of assigned reading (450+ pages). If your other classes have minimal readings, take 304 w/ Teven; he's very kind with his grading. However, be prepared to go over the textbook in detail for the midterm/final.

reviews.subject: HCOM100 (Human Communication Studies)
reviews.review: Dr. Teven's class is really easy. You take notes on the lessons from the book, which he normally presents slides during class. The speeches are fun and easy as well, not a thought greater at all. You are guaranteed to pass the exams if you pay attention during class, but you don't necessarily have to take notes since it's all just common sense.

reviews.subject: HCOM100 (Human Communication Studies)
reviews.review: Dr. Teven is a really good lecturer. Participating in class and discussions gets you recognition. He's friendly and funny. You need to study for the exams, otherwise you should be good if you follow the guidelines for the speeches you have. The course could be structured a little better, but it's not bad.

reviews.subject: HCOM318 (Human Communication Studies)
reviews.review: Dr. Teven is a great professor. To do well engaged in class discussions and take notes of the lecture slides. The work load was average. He is very understanding and cares about the well being of his students. There is one group project and presentation but it was a simple assignment and he gives you plenty of time to complete it.

reviews.subject: HCOM200 (Human Communication Studies)
reviews.review: One of my favorite professors. I can't wait to take more classes with him in the future. He knows his stuff and is very relatable on a personal level. Take him! Awesome class all around.

reviews.subject: Hist330 (History)
reviews.review: he would love the odyssey movie

reviews.subject: 110A (History)
reviews.review: omg this class was miserable. prof lectures about nothing for the full 75 mins. no slides, just speaking. easy weekly assignments based on readings. i recommend showing up to the first class of the week and skipping the second one. midterm and final is based on his lectures so it's good to show up at least once a week, but you will dread this class

reviews.subject: 110A (History)
reviews.review: This was such an easy class, attendance wasn't mandatory and he wasn't strict on homework at all. Every week we'd have to turn in an assignment, but if you turned it in later, he wouldn't make your grade down at all. He was a relaxed professor and really took a more philosophical approach to the topics we went over.

reviews.subject: HIST110A (History)
reviews.review: He's an extremely insightful professor. His lectures truly made me think deeply about the content he was teaching and you can tell his goal was to teach you and actually let his students learn rather than give them work to do for a class. I think about his lectures outside of class and have deep respect for him. The work is easy if you go to class.

reviews.subject: 110A (History)
reviews.review: Professor Papandreu is one of the most relaxed professors at CSUF. He's calm and lectures are slow-paced, he can be quite hilarious at times. Very easy class, only 2-3 essays, and there's some nice insight to be gained from the writings analyzed in the lectures. Attendance is not mandatory, most students stop showing up and still pass easily.

reviews.subject: 110A (History)
reviews.review: Hated it, although this class was easy, the professor was obnoxious. He told me to leave the class because I was tapping my foot. His class was disorganized and to be frank I didn't learn a thing and history has been one of my favorites for years. If you need a class for GE credit take this class. we've done 2 easy assignments the whole semester

reviews.subject: 250B (Mathematics)

reviews.subject: 250B (Mathematics)

reviews.subject: CALC150B (Mathematics)

reviews.subject: BIO101 (Biology)
reviews.review: Professor Duong was an overall great professor. Gives A LOT of extra credit opportunities. Make sure to take notes and its a lot of information to retain.

reviews.subject: BIOL101 (Biology)
reviews.review: Professor Duong provides insanely helpful study guides for each unit. She is incredibly passionate and clearly loves her job. Participation is encouraged with extra credit opportunities as incentives, which sort of make up for what everyone is talking about regarding "trick" questions. The questions aren't that bad imo

reviews.subject: BIO101 (Biology)
reviews.review: I have nothing bad to say about Professor Duong. By far my favorite professor so far here at csuf and I cannot recommend her enough. She makes passing her class insanely easy by providing prepared study guides for you to take notes on, study schedules for her exams, and quizzes are all online. She is very sweet and wants all her students to pass.

reviews.subject: BIO101 (Biology)
reviews.review: This class was honestly a breath of fresh air. The other comments stating she is trying to trick you is simply a question method Duong uses. It is not challenging and she provides support to help you understand those “trick” questions. Very caring. Takes her job seriously. Lectures are very helpful but you have to listen and take thorough notes.

reviews.subject: 101 (Biology)
reviews.review: just no. one time she was trauma dumping about her ed and RECOMMENDING it to US. LIKE HELLO?!

reviews.subject: BIOL101 (Biology)
reviews.review: Professor Duong is one of the most helpful professors I've had. She explains all the material in a way that's really accessible and easy to understand, even if science is something you struggle with. She provides clear study guides for every lecture/test, so studying for her exams isn't stressful at all. Definitely take her for BIOL101 if you can!!

reviews.subject: 361B (Business)
reviews.review: He goes on and on about the theory and hardly goes over an example. He is not practical at all, and his questions for the homework, quizzes, and exams have so many trick questions. Also, he's condescending and says, "ahh, you mean something more elementary" to students asking questions. I got A's in 361a and Bus. Calc...

reviews.subject: 361B (Business)
reviews.review: It is impossible to get an A in his class. He refuses to give A's but if you want to get the most brutal B or C in your life, take Goldstein. He doesn't give anyone a fair grade.

reviews.subject: 361B (Business)
reviews.review: His lectures consist of rambling for over an hour, and you barely understand anything he's saying. He doesn't care about comprehension and is looking to retire. Stay away and choose a different professor.

reviews.subject: 361B (Business)
reviews.review: Don't do it. He's one of the worst professors in all of Cal State Fullerton.

reviews.subject: ISDS361B (Business)
reviews.review: A nice professor but in general this course is meant to be hard You are graded on 3 assignments, 3 quizzes, and 3 exams. No final. Attend SI regularly and go to the tutoring center for assignments & you should be able to pass. All exams were open notes and partial credit is given however the questions can be tricky. Recorded lectures available.

reviews.subject: ISDD361B (Business)
reviews.review:
This class had the most incredibly difficult exams I have ever taken throughout college. His exams seem like they are for graduate level students with work experience in the field of analytics. Highest grade in the class was an 86%. Current average grade for my class is a 64%...

My Background: Senior year student 3.78 GPA, Finance concentration.

reviews.subject: MGMT348 (Management)
reviews.review: You will have hwk every single week. I took him for 348, 349, 445 and every class is the same setup. Make sure you take notes of the PPT lectures. However, if you don't perform well on his exams (I averaged 60s), you will still get a C to pass the class if you do all his assignments and turn them in on time. Very nice, professor!

reviews.subject: MGMT445 (Management)
reviews.review: Professor pentis was an incredibly caring and supportive professor who truly wants their students to succeed. Always helpful, patient, flexible, and understanding. One of the best professors I've had—highly recommend.

reviews.subject: MGMT349 (Management)
reviews.review: One of the best at CSUF. Not an easy class, but willing to work with students. Very accessible. If you're going into business law or legal studies, he is a must take.

reviews.subject: MGMT348 (Management)
reviews.review: requires you to submit homework assignments whenever class is scheduled. Fairly graded, easy, and straightforward. Any questions or confusions, he is always happy and available to provide help. I was a bit concerned i would face challenges as it is not really my strong subject, but i did good. I would definitely recommended him to other students.

reviews.subject: MGMT348 (Management)
reviews.review: This professor is one of the best professor's I've ever taken. He's nice and explains the material really well! 10/10 TAKE HIM!!!

reviews.subject: MGMT518 (Management)
reviews.review: I took MGMT 518 with Professor Carl in Spring semester. I am an international student and leaning US law was a challenge but he made the learning so easy. His lectures are full of knowledge, examples are relevant and real life scenarios. His experience speaks. He is approachable. Reading book & all the cases, making notes helped me a lot too.

reviews.subject: MGMT340 (Management)
reviews.review: I did the study abroad in France for this class and had the best experience. The curriculum isn't too tough and the work load is moderate. All of the tests are taken in groups and there is a lot of groupwork activities. Overall he is passionate about the subject and cares about the student's success.

reviews.subject: MGMT340 (Management)
reviews.review: Dr. T is an amazing professor who is extremely caring about the program and his students, as well as very knowledgeable in the course material. He is very personable and makes the class and time abroad enjoyable. I highly encourage you to take his class for the France study abroad trip because it was an experience I will always cherish.

reviews.subject: MGMT340 (Management)
reviews.review:
pros: intelligent professor, interesting class discussions. 

cons: condescending attitude. grading is subjective and unclear. in-class lectures and/or activities are often pointless and a waste of time. has repeatedly given expired lattes (those who know). 

do not trust the 4.9 star reviews.

reviews.subject: MGMT464 (Management)
reviews.review: Professor Atul runs a great class, though the consulting project is quite intensive. Utilize resources like Unstuck ai alongside the free textbook to manage the workload. Overall, a rewarding course that prepares you well for the professional world.

reviews.subject: MGMT340 (Management)
reviews.review: Dr. T was an amazing professor to learn from. During the study abroad program, he was very caring towards his students and gave us a well-structured course. I would definitely take him for this class as he holds a lot of knowledge and made sure students would succeed in the class.

reviews.subject: 340 (Management)
reviews.review: Dr. T was an amazing professor and genuinely cared about his students. I took this class as study abroad and he was very helpful whenever I had questions about at assignment. The only thing is that he is a tough grader, so make sure you are thorough with your answers. I would 100% take him again and he is my favorite by far.

reviews.subject: BUAD301 (Business)
reviews.review:
They've removed previous statements I've made about Dr. Franklin.

Please don't fall for the trap - this professor is easily a 1 star or even lower if it was possible.
Won't even explain how horrific my semester went with her, just read all her reviews.

I didn't pass by about .7% and wouldn't return emails on last week of school on why my grading.

reviews.subject: BAUD301 (Business)
reviews.review: Be ready to spend a few hours a week reading academic journals and answering questions based on them. Exams are based on entire modules and notes are encouraged. Take good notes. Class was a ton of writing and she's a pretty tough grader. The assignments weren't too difficult, just very time consuming.

reviews.subject: BAUD301 (Business)
reviews.review: Sometimes the class was a little unorganized and a lot of work. If you can stay organized and do the work it is very easy. The first week there are so many assignments but they are easy to complete. Start them early. She is really nice and easy to reach just text her. If you need help for sure go to office hours. Class has a lot of assignments.

reviews.subject: BAUD301 (Business)
reviews.review: Professor Franklin assigns a lot of homework at the beginning of the semester which can be a bit overwhelming. We had 3 case analyses, one research project, and 1 group project. However, she is really good at communicating with students attend her office hours and ask questions and you'll be good.

reviews.subject: BUAD301 (Business)
reviews.review: Professor Franklin gives a whole lot of assignments. She is one of those professors that thinks this is the only course being taken. I am a straight A student and still ended up with a B+ in this class. Avoid taking her if you lack organization or if you want a flexible and easy-going course.

reviews.subject: 301 (Business)
reviews.review: HWK doesn't take long to complete, but there are ALOT! These assignments prepare u for the exam tho so be sure to do them. Professor literally gives u the prompts for the exams and all u have to do is go back into previous assignments and write down quotes to help ur argument. Bad reviews are from disgruntled students who don't put in the effort.

reviews.subject: 240 (Computer Science)
reviews.review: Refuses to use Canvas, Discord is the only way students can find grades and assignments. Insults students over minor flaws in their programs. Teaching is questionable, with only about 30 minutes used out of a 2-hour lecture. Exams have ZERO correlation with lecture material. Students practically need SI to pass the class.

reviews.subject: 240 (Computer Science)
reviews.review: One of the best professors at the university deserves incredible recognition for his teaching. The course material is definitely challenging, but if you adapt to his lecture style and put in the work, you will pass the class

reviews.subject: CPSC315 (Computer Science)
reviews.review: He admitted he had no idea how to teach the subject. We spent the entire semester making up our own projects and presenting them. He taught nothing, and was actively hostile to the students. He realized we didn't care so he literally started bribing people with cash to participate. It was an easy A but every day felt like a gigantic waste of time.

reviews.subject: CPSC223J (Computer Science)
reviews.review: Seriously hard to recommend CSUF's Computer Science Program while this professor is still working here. He is far too old, has no idea what's going on half the time, and sends conflicting emails and messages about due dates and assignment specifications. If your assignment doesn't run on his computer you get a zero, with no chance to troubleshoot.

reviews.subject: 240 (Computer Science)
reviews.review: Did not use canvas the whole semester, if you are not in the class discord expect to be extremely lost.

reviews.subject: 240 (Computer Science)

When code breaks, his response is “that just happens.” He offers no real help or explanations, so the same problems keep coming up. Avoid this class if you can.

reviews.subject: PSY101 (Psychology)
reviews.review: He had some very outdated political takes, and some genuinely offensive depictions of neurodivergent people, and even said the R slur during class, which was wild. He was a tough grader, and would have many questions on the exams from hyper specific tiny details from the textbook that were not mentioned in the study guide.

reviews.subject: PSYCH101 (Psychology)
reviews.review: The class is really easy as long as you attend and take notes. He gives you a grade/extra credit for attendance by assigning small in-class activities that aren't graded. He is really caring and funny, which made the class fun. The essays are also really easy (1-2 pages), and they're just based on your own experience/knowledge of concepts.

reviews.subject: PSY201 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Attendance is not mandatory for this class, but I wouldn't recommend missing any lectures because he covers a lot in each one. There is a decent amount of homework, but he isn't a harsh grader. There are 3 major exams, but they are fairly simple if you study and he allows a cheat sheet for half of them. Overall, this class is pretty manageable.

reviews.subject: PSYC101 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Enthusiastic professor, not a harsh grader, and not much homework. The majority of your grade will depend on three non-cumulative exams, prepare to study.

reviews.subject: PSY101 (Psychology)
reviews.review: He doesn't let people use their computers, but I have an accommodation that requires one and I talked to him and he was very understanding! He seems nice and he's really funny but he talks about whatever he wants during class, and a lot of the material on the tests doesn't come from his lectures and I had to teach myself like 40% of the material.

reviews.subject: PSY101 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Awesome teacher.  Love the corny dad jokes.  He really cares about his students. Very enthusiastic about psychology.  My favorite teacher this semester.

reviews.subject: DANC101 (Fine Arts)
reviews.review: Professor Shay is super chill! This course is beginner friendly, and Shay gives clear instructions/directions.

reviews.subject: DANC101 (Fine Arts)
reviews.review: A great professor and taught different levels very well. I love his energy and enthusiasm. Attendance mandatory.

reviews.subject: DANC101 (Fine Arts)
reviews.review: Took dance101 with no prior experience before this class and still enjoyed it. Try your best to be present everyday of class as each class compounds off the previous. Passing this class is almost guaranteed as long as you show up and put in some sort of effort.

reviews.subject: DANC101 (Fine Arts)
reviews.review: For DANC101, Professor Layman was straightforward and respectful, and overall a great teacher. In this course, PARTICIPATION matters!!! In fact, participation points count more towards your grade than the final project. In the class, expect 2 essays, 1 choreographed dance midterm, 1 group dance final, and 1 theater performance-watching assignment.

reviews.subject: DANC101 (Fine Arts)
reviews.review: Great professor, graded by few things but attendance is mandatory of course and if you miss several days it tanks your grade. Very easy g.e with a very nice professor, highly recommend

reviews.subject: DANC101 (Fine Arts)
reviews.review: If you show up to class, you will pass. There was never a question as to what was expected in his class. The 2 papers are so easy, and this is coming from a non-writer. He literally does not care about the format. I took his class for an easy elective, and it was perfect for the senior in me who is ready to graduate.

reviews.subject: ABNORMAL (Psychology)
reviews.review: Hardest professor I've probably ever had. Her class is only an 1 hour and 15 minutes long and she has about 100 powerpoint slides she has to get too and doesn't even get through 1/5 of the slides most of the time. You have to dedicate a lot of time to this class, a lot of memorization is required.

reviews.subject: PSYC341 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Currently take Professor Mori, and regretting my decision. The amount of time that is wasted in class doing non productive things is insane. The amount of slides and lecture material that is not gone over in class is also insane. Get ready to teach yourself because she doesn't teach you anything. Way to much material for the amount of time given.

reviews.subject: ABNORMALPSYCH (Psychology)
reviews.review: I took Dr. Mori's class in the height of the pandemic and it was my favorite class. There was an incredible amount of information, all of which you MUST know in order to do well on the exams. I love reading so that wasn't an issue. I love the way she lectures and interacts with the class. I got a 94% in her class. Would love to take it again!

reviews.subject: ABNORMALPSY (Psychology)
reviews.review: She was the hard professor I ever had. You have to be there on time or else she doesn't let you take exams or quizzes never finished slides and exams are 100 questions. Only interesting part of class when she wouldn't teach and have special guest. Only C I have ever got in a psych class. If you value your sanity don't take this class.

reviews.subject: PSYC341 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Very hard but very interesting. Requires a LOT of studying but I got a lot out of it. She is not the most clear instructor. She gives chances to up your scores on the exams. And offers bonus points/extra credit. This course is hard in general I've heard a lot of other professors don't give chances to improve your grade like she does.

reviews.subject: 341 (Psychology)
reviews.review: I am a straight A student, this professor is so hard. She gives out too much information! There's about over 500 slides you have to memorize on your own, and she only goes through about 5 slides in class, most likely less. Please do not take this professor unless you are willing to put your whole week in this one class. Assignments aren't worth it.

reviews.subject: BIOL101 (Biology)
reviews.review: Extremely straight forward class, you show up take notes, and for the love of god buy the supplement that goes with the class. The study questions are literally word for word the questions on the exam. 1 Paper as well, pretty simple. Easy A if you study the supplement

reviews.subject: BIO101 (Biology)
reviews.review: two words: U PREP  this is teacher is just wowe

reviews.subject: BIO101 (Biology)
reviews.review: She is horrible. She doesn't even write her own tests so expert her not to help you at all when you need it. Not empathetic what so ever. I told her I wasn't doing well in the class and she told me "oh, that sucks." She is now retiring after this semester so don't worry about getting stuck with her. She just didn't want to be here anymore.

reviews.subject: BIOL101 (Biology)
reviews.review: she's incredibly knowledgeable about the topic. she's there to help, but you definitely need to study for an A. use prep-u and you will get an A like I did. 4 exams and 1 essay. she's nice, funny, and sweet. would take her over the other professors even though the class was a little boring. I did well, but again, you need to study.

reviews.subject: BIO101 (Biology)
reviews.review: Professor Hanlon is the sweetest! Super kind and makes lectures less painful by throwing a joke in here and there. Tests are multiple choice and easy as long as you study, definitely recommend prep-u. Overall your typical biology class.

reviews.subject: BIO101 (Biology)
reviews.review: Class was okay, just your typical biology class. You get three midterms, a paper, and a final exam. Lecture slides are useless for studying and you rarely use the book. Do yourself a favor and get Prep-U because that's your true study guide. Nearly all of the exam questions are pulled from Prep-U.

reviews.subject: 490T (Psychology)
reviews.review: He's a good professor, but he has a hero complex. His assignments weren't very clear, and when I pointed that out, he couldn't accept feedback even when I wasn't asking for a grade change. He also has us write about something personal, and when I used first person, I got marked down 10% off because he said it shouldn't have been in first person.

reviews.subject: CAS327 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Reading is mandatory and your test/discussion grades heavily depend on it.  However, the material is so engaging/interesting that you won't even mind it!  The due dates were unique (Tues, Thurs, Sat), but it honestly helped me from procrastinating and kept me on track.  The professor clearly cares about his students and the material!  I recommend!

reviews.subject: CAS325B (Psychology)
reviews.review: He told us on the 1st day of class that if we did well enough in his class that we would not have to take the final & he kept his word. Many of us worked hard & did not need to take the final! That alone was just cool. Good lectures. Interacts with class. Answers emails & texts quickly. Clearly cares about his students. Very fair. Recommended!

reviews.subject: CAS325B (Psychology)
reviews.review: Although he has rubrics for his writing assignments it felt more like his mood. He also graded the final which was an essay on a "modified curve" where he compared it to other classmates' essays and decided which one was an A. Study guides weren't helpful, assigned readings every week.

reviews.subject: 494 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Absolutely the best Professor I had in 4+ years at CSUF. He responds to email faster than anyone else. I had an issue at my site one day & had to call him. He actually answered the phone & helped me out! His lectures transcend class content and focus on life/professional skills. He's a tough prof but also kind, down to Earth, funny, & approachable

reviews.subject: CAS325B (Psychology)
reviews.review: I learned so much from this class. He is a very student centered Professor who really cares. Exams are hard but he gives study guides. Uses an online text with weekly reading quizzes. 2 short papers & a letter. Easy to see why everyone says to take him! I hope to be able to take him again in the future.

reviews.subject: BIO101HYBRID (Biological Sciences)
reviews.review: If you are taking BIO101 LAB, she was a great professor. Majority of the labs did NOT take the full three hours, and you really just had to show up 8 times total because it was hybrid. The async assignments could be a bit time consuming but you just have to manage them well and you'll be pretty set for the lab.

reviews.subject: BIO101 (Biological Sciences)
reviews.review: Don't let the other ratings fool you IF you're planning to take her for the lab. She's honestly really nice. Typically, the labs are meant to be 3 hours long, but the activities are fairly short, so they don't take up much time. The class only meets once every other week, and there are asynchronous assignments in the weeks we don't meet.

reviews.subject: BIOL360 (Biological Sciences)
reviews.review: I meet via zoom explained to me my corrections I followed the rubric to a T and she “Failed” me on the assignment. She is the only professor to wait til last minute to submit grades leaving no time for corrections. Unfair grader.

reviews.subject: BIO101ONLINE (Biological Sciences)
reviews.review: NEVER take this Professor. She somehow manages to use so many words yet still can't clearly convey instructions. She grades like we're all training to be doctors and her feedback is vague. Assignments are abundant and tedious and her grading is SO late. Do everything possible to avoid this professor. Worst one ever.

reviews.subject: BIO305 (Biological Sciences)
reviews.review: As others have mentioned, the writing part will tank your overall grade. I have no words.

reviews.subject: BIO101ONLINE (Biological Sciences)
reviews.review: She is the most harsh grader ever, your grade is mainly based off a couple of writing assignments in a BIOLOGY CLASS and she expects perfection. She is a danger to the 7 seas, a menace to society, a hazard to the nation, and a threat to the 9 realms. If you're religious or even if you're not you will be by the end of this class.

reviews.subject: BUAD301 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: Professor Gordon is great! He's a very practical and logical professor and his teaching style was very effective. Very straight forward and respects his students. He gives constructive criticism and wants all of his students to pass.

reviews.subject: BAUD201 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: Professor G is the best professor I have ever had. He cares, he's genuine, and if you want help he always says yes. It's a shame he is leaving as the college needs more professors with real world experience like Gordon. Go to office hours, let him know you need help, he will. Getting up for a 7am class wasn't bad as he made a boring class useful

reviews.subject: BUAD201 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: Took Gordon for 201 and actually ended up trying to pay 301 kids to drop his class when I was waitlisted. By far best professor I've ever had. There are regular weekly homework assignments online that don't take more than 30 min. Lots of big writing assignments in class, but he prepares us well. Go to office hours as much as you possibly can!

reviews.subject: BUAD301 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: Professor Gordon is one of the best professors I've ever had. He is SO awesome. Genuinely cares about his students. We were super tight by the end of the semester! He is a really tough grader but that's only because he wants you to improve. Group project is TOUGH. Overall a really enjoyable class. Highly recommend him! Super sweet and funny!

reviews.subject: BUAD301 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: Professor Gordon was the most down to earth professor I have ever had. He truly does care about his students. His grading is a little on the rough side and it is hard to get above a C+ on the cases. Do good on the project and go to his office hours every week so he can go over it and you will be good! Also, sit next to the right people on 1st day.

reviews.subject: BUAD301 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: G is the best professor I have ever had. I typically don't like professors as many do not reply to emails and seem to be bothered. Professor G is always available, funny, and always has some kind of answer to my questions. There is a reason his classes are full and office hours packed - why he isn't full time tenured I have no idea. TAKE HIM

reviews.subject: 170B (History)
reviews.review: Lot's of lectures which can feel long, don't skip too much class.

reviews.subject: HIST170B (History)
reviews.review: I enjoyed taking Dr. Myers' class. The only stressful part was the two 8-page essays he assigned. He gives the prompt for the midterm and final ahead of time so you know what to study! He does lecture all of class and sometimes takes attendance randomly which will be 20% of your grade. but is very caring, funny and passionate about what he does.

reviews.subject: 170B (History)
reviews.review: great guy he is passionate about what he does, pretty funny and chill, based off two 8 page papers, midterm and paper, only bad thing in my opinion is he doesn't input grades into canvas so you have to email him about your grade, lecture heavy and attendance isn't mandatory but says he will do a pop quiz if people dont show but never has

reviews.subject: 170B (History)
reviews.review: pretty chill. 2 papers, 8 pages long. timed midterm. talks a lot and usually reads off some papers and SOMETIMES powerpoints. talks fast and is hard to keep up when taking notes. he just doesnt stop. he is nice tho. just wasnt a right fit for me. he is very passionate about history and you can tell he likes what he does.

reviews.subject: 170B (History)
reviews.review: Boys and girls of history land (ifykyk)I took his 8:30 class, and you'll love it if you really like history! He's lecture-heavy but super engaging with his stories and connections. He's clearly passionate. The class is mostly lectures two 8-page essays, and a midterm that's a timed write, he gives you the prompt ahead of time so you can prepare!

reviews.subject: HIST170B (History)
reviews.review: A very old-school teacher, he lectures heavily as he talks about his own experiences. Two midterm research papers, 8 pages long, in Chicago style. Two different essay questions "exams" were handwritten in class, but he gives you the topic beforehand, so you know what to write about. Didn't really read the readings he provided; it was an easy class.

reviews.subject: PHIL (Philosophy)
reviews.review: This "professor" only takes about himself which is why he wants us all to read and purchase his book.

reviews.subject: PH105 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: You'll get the hang of the class a few weeks in. Lot's of vocab and concepts to memorize.

reviews.subject: PHIL (Philosophy)
reviews.review: His class and teaching style revolved mostly around himself. He lectures were wordy to the point of incredibly boring and his thoughts and principles seems grossly skewed. I walked away from his class feeling like the course work and description of the class was not met.

reviews.subject: PHIL105 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: HW is 15 q mc quizzes but a LOT per week. 3 exams, all 50 q mc that are exactly like the hw. Choices r very similar and confusing somehow all answers sound right. But there are practice problems (tutorials). Must buy his textbook, he does practice problems from them. Others who have taken the same course aren't learning the same things I am. Curves

reviews.subject: PHIL105 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: The class is lecture heavy and attendance is VERY important if you miss class your grade is affected drastically. His personal textbook is required by him but I did fine without it! Overall, it's an okay class. Only thing that was confusing is he infers subjects using examples of political events and if you're not into that you can find it boring.

reviews.subject: PHIL105 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: Literally made you buy the textbook he made, and homework was just online quizzes. His lectures were so boring I could barely stay awake. There's two exams and one ge writing requirement, but like he never checked if you were cheating...

reviews.subject: POSC310 (Political Science)
reviews.review: I really enjoyed his class! I was excited to take another of his classes next semester. It is deeply saddening that he passed away. The school lost one of their best political science professors.

reviews.subject: POSC100 (Political Science)
reviews.review: He was an amazing teacher, really funny guy, his lectures were enjoyable, he was pretty straight forward and his tests were fairly easy if you studied I would take his class again but sadly he is gone. May he rest in peace ive never met someone as passionate about politics then him you will be missed William Julius.

reviews.subject: POSC310 (Political Science)
reviews.review: The lecture was all talk, no powerpoints which means you really have to follow along. out of the 3 "mandatory books", i read half of two of them and didnt crack open on of them. He's very kind and responds to emails super quick. A midterm, final, and 5-8 page election analysis paper.  Tests are 25 short answers and two essays so major hand cramp

reviews.subject: POSC100 (Political Science)
reviews.review: Two tests (midterm and final) and one major paper. Pay attention during lectures, a lot of it is on his tests. He also tends to pick on people to participate.

reviews.subject: POSC100 (Political Science)
reviews.review: I'm glad I took this class! He doesn't use powerpoint when he lectures so I recommend buying a compostion book or using a laptop. Be sure to take good notes and don't be afraid to ask him questions. Don't buy any of the textbooks. His tests are based on the notes. Midterm & the final are both 25 short answer questions and 2 essays & a policy paper.

reviews.subject: POLISCI100 (Political Science)
reviews.review: Great Class! Very straight forward. Some pressure because there are only four assignments the whole semester. I have lots of respect for Dr Julius and would take another class of his if I could. Textbooks not needed if you pay attention in class and participate here and there.

reviews.subject: CJ330 (Criminal Justice)
reviews.review: I will forever be a Professor Lovell defender. YOU NEED TO BUY HIS TEXTBOOK, that is a non-negotiable to pass his class. The concepts he's teaching can be difficult to understand so don't slack on it and STUDY BEFORE CLASS. He's very knowledgeable about the material so if you're stuck, DO NOT hesitate to ask. A bit intimidating but he's awesome.

reviews.subject: CRJU434 (Criminal Justice)
reviews.review: Do NOT take this Professor or this class!! Was graded by a few things, the exams were ridiculously difficult. We all struggled in this course. He has an attitude and is not approachable at all when it comes to speaking to him during office hours. If all your students are struggling, it should be a reflection of your teaching skills.

reviews.subject: 330 (Criminal Justice)
reviews.review: First and foremost, over-hated. Lovell is undoubtedly difficult, but prevails as one of the most engaging and worthwhile professors I have studied under in all my days of education. He may not care if you pass, but he cares about teaching you if you want to learn. He's got a big heart, loves music, and loves Durkheim. Couldn't recommend more.

reviews.subject: CJ330 (Criminal Justice)
reviews.review: By far the worst CJ professor at CSUF. It's a shame the university has not done anything to have this joke of a teacher removed. Not only is he pompous and condescending when he speaks to his students, but he really has no idea what criminal justice and police work is like outside of a textbook. Please do yourself a huge favor and DO NOT TAKE HIM!

reviews.subject: CJ330 (Criminal Justice)
reviews.review: WHATEVER YOU DO, RUN! i was warned by others about him, but had to take his class. he is biased and cold calls you like crazy. if you want a good grade, just agree with what he says. if you can choose from him and another cj prof., whatever you do just take the other prof. if you have no choice then gg bro good luck to you...

reviews.subject: 330 (Criminal Justice)
reviews.review: not clear instrutions, doesnt teach from the book

reviews.subject: MATH150A (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Greatest Math Professor OAT!! Straightforward lectures, always answers questions, simple quizzes, and accessible outside of class. He cares about his students and is very funny! For a 2-hour class, it only felt like 45 minutes. I highly recommend taking him! Homework isn't graded, but I recommend keeping up with that and asking questions!

reviews.subject: MATH130 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: he's super chill! he's willing to help you pass and more importantly HE WANTS YOU TO PASS HIS CLASS!!!! I def take a class with him again. he gives dad vibes especially with his jokes he tells to the class lol

reviews.subject: MATH150A (Mathematics)
reviews.review: THIS IS MY GOAT! I'm taking him for calc150b as well because of how good his teaching is. He's very funny, cares about his students and their grades, and if he sees you participating in class, he's willing to help you out. His weekly quizzes were very easy (like two questions each), but you have to go to every lecture, or else you won't get it.

reviews.subject: 150A (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Great lecturer and professor, really wants you to succeed. Fast paced lectures. Weekly quizzes and is easy to reach out to for help. Very fair grader. However, he doesn't use Canvas for grades, and does biweekly grade updates using a printout. Homework/review sheets very helpful as well, though you need to attend class to know what they are.

reviews.subject: MATH150A (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Great Professor, take him if you can, there is homework but it isn't graded and there is one test every week. If you go to this guys office hours he helps out alot. He wants you to pass his class but you have to put in effort. Take Him!

reviews.subject: MATH150A (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Although my grade was poor in his class he did an amazing job at teaching the whole class. He always has time for questions and is caring about his students as he bonds with the entire class. He makes the subject easy and simplifies it by not being overly smart to where it makes you feel dumb.

reviews.subject: MGMT449 (Management)
reviews.review: Definitely not a good prof for 449, I don't know about other classes but avoid him for 449.

reviews.subject: MAGT449 (Management)
reviews.review: He is good professor, I recommend him to my friends.

reviews.subject: MGMT449 (Management)
reviews.review: Dr. T is good capstone for an easy pass but definitely not an easy A!!

reviews.subject: MGMT449 (Management)
reviews.review: Funny guy but not a good professor. I would say take someone else and do it over the summer to get it over with instead of taking the whole semester like I did.

reviews.subject: MGMT449 (Management)
reviews.review: Good for an easy A if youre in a good group

reviews.subject: MAGT449 (Management)
reviews.review: WHEN I TOOK MGMT-449, I KNEW AS A CAPSTONE COURSE, IT WILL  BE A DIFFICULT TASK;  FORTUNATELY, I HAD DR. TAVAKOLIAN AS MY INSTRUCTOR.   TWO EXAMS AND ONE COMPREHENSIVE CASE ANALYSIS.

reviews.subject: ECGR3131 (Accounting)
reviews.review: Professor doesn't put much effort into teaching. Slides are low-quality, and class is often canceled. With some self-study using resources like unstuck ai, it's possible to get a good grade without much work.

reviews.subject: ECGR3131 (Accounting)
reviews.review:
"Lazy Engineers" is his motto

does not teach, just reads off of slides. Cancels class alot. Don't need to learn or show up to get an A. Hope he gets fired before

reviews.subject: 302420 (Accounting)
reviews.review: Professor Hassan gets a bad rap because his test are incredibly challenging. With that being said welcome to college slackers.  He challenges you to push your potential and genuinely cares about the knowledge he passes down to the students. His exams are tough but if you go to his lectures, do the practice problems (more than 1 time) you'll do fine

reviews.subject: ACCT302 (Accounting)
reviews.review: I agree with those who say to sit near the front and pay attention. Don't be on a laptop, it will not do you any favors. The class consists of two exams and one final, so make sure to study for those.   Do the practice problems and past exams he gives out, and you should have a good handle for the exams and final. And read the textbook cases.

reviews.subject: ACC302 (Accounting)
reviews.review: Dr. Hassan was very hard to understand and any time we asked a question he got upset rather than responding to our questions.  He was very demanding and hrad grader.  I wish he would have applied the same standards to himself.  He was my worst teacher.

reviews.subject: ACCT302 (Accounting)
reviews.review: Professor chooses only the most important chapters to cover, although semester was not balanced well: we spent too much time on the 1st part of the class, and, hence, needed to run over the remaining 2 parts very quickly, so the preparation for the finals was a bit stressful. To succeed you need to attend the lectures and make good notes.

reviews.subject: HISTHIST (History)
reviews.review: I took his online asynchronous class and it wasn't until I had to email him regarding some issues I had with the last few exams. I sent him an email but he just ghosted me. He didn't really teach the class and just had us read through the textbook and some articles off a website.

reviews.subject: HISTORY110B (History)
reviews.review: super super easy. had him fall '24 for 170B and we were literally only graded on three tests and that was it. tests were mcq and two short answer and you knew what you were writing about ahead of time. anyone looking for an easy history class this is your guy, you don't even need the textbook.

reviews.subject: HISTHIST (History)
reviews.review: Horrible teacher. I was in asynch and had a Canvas issue for exam 2 and I couldn't access it. He blamed me for it and ghosted me. Went to advisors and he ghosted them too! I received two zeros (one for objective and one for writing) and never got fixed. He doesn't care about his students at ALL. Horrible class. Horrible teacher. Never again.

reviews.subject: HIST395 (History)
reviews.review:
Loves coffee, tangents, does not care about you, and it's hard to detect passion except for Winston Churchill. Or maybe the 7 pm classes were too late...
He was not there when I needed him during office hours. I learned he likes exams to be 2 pages long for short answers and 4 pages long for long answers.

reviews.subject: HIST395 (History)
reviews.review: Easy and funny professor. Wish he was more passionate about the topic. Grade is mostly defined by exams. Also graded on book reports and presentation. Lectures but sometimes fails to cover all terms on exam so may need to rely on book or Google search. May occasionally get off topic. As real as can be. Loves coffee, operas, and Winston Churchill.

reviews.subject: HIST110B (History)
reviews.review: he is great take his history class, his lectures are fun

reviews.subject: ISDS361A (Business)
reviews.review: Professor Laura is such a caring and inspirational professor. I was very nervous to take this class since I, myself struggle with statistics. But with professor Marcoulides' help, I was able to improve and understand better. Attendance isn't mandatory instead she gives extra credits. I really recommend her she made the class really fun!

reviews.subject: ISDS361A (Business)
reviews.review: She is the BEST Professor for this course. 2 midterms and 1 final but she provides a practice test for each exam and they are similar to the real test. But you need to watch and understand her posted video to get a good score. Attendance is not mandatory but it counts for extra credit.

reviews.subject: ISDS361A (Business)
reviews.review: Professor Laura is a great professor! I definitely recommend her. I found her class to be pretty easy, although her video lectures can pile up at times. The lectures are fairly easy to understand, and she allows a cheat sheet for exams. I would definitely take her again!

reviews.subject: ISDS361A (Business)
reviews.review: She may be the best professor I have taken at Cal State Fullerton. She is fair, student friendly and goes the extra mile. Truly a great professor!!

reviews.subject: ISDS361A (Business)
reviews.review: She is an amazing professor! Her lectures are very clear and helpful.

reviews.subject: ISDS361A (Business)
