reviews.review: If you get the chance to take her class, DO IT. She is very organized and communicated clearly. Her teaching style is great and to the point! As long as you put in some work, you will pass.

reviews.subject: FIN432 (Finance)
reviews.review: Genuinely the worst professor I've ever had. In person, he makes you put away your phone/laptop and if he catches you on it, he will kick you out of the class and drop you from the class. He saw me on my phone twice and dropped me instantly. He's also incredibly boring. I would never recommend him to anyone.

reviews.subject: fin370 (Finance)
reviews.review: Do not take him in a summer or online class unless you're confident in your finance skills. He he uses zoom in an unorthodox way to check on you while you're taking your exam. If he suspects cheating, it's an automatic fail.

reviews.subject: FIN432 (Finance)
reviews.review: A great professor who wants you to learn. Only allowed to handwrite notes, but it helps with comprehension of the material incredibly. Group projects are homework assignments in a group format, very doable. Exams are hard, but all 400-level exams are. Pay attention, put in the time to study, and be present during class, and you will do great!

reviews.subject: fin370 (Finance)
reviews.review: Great proefssor, pretty straight forward on what you have to do. Mock exams are like actual exams and lets u know what math questions will be asked. Great prof overall, would take again.

reviews.subject: fin370 (Finance)
reviews.review: Class consisted of three test done in person. One cheat sheet. Multiple choice and fill in the blank. Fill in the blank are similar to the sample exams (write on cheat sheet). Must watch lecture videos. Weekly homework and quiz on finance lab due every Sunday.

reviews.subject: fin370 (Finance)
reviews.review: He is an okay professor. His online course consisted of watching lecture videos. Make sure to watch because he checks if you do and gives you a grade. Three test in total. Work out problems were similar to the sample test. For multiple choice felt like you had to read the text. Not very lenient.

reviews.subject: MGMT246 (Management)
reviews.review: Show up and say something everyday. Study hard for the exams and the curve will be your friend. They are meant to be difficult, he is aware of that. You can fail the exam but still get an A. He is a fun professor and was enjoyable.

reviews.subject: MGMT246 (Management)
reviews.review: When I say I never understood what he was trying to talk about during lectures, I mean I have never been so confused in my life. Class average was always a failing grade. Only saving grace was the prof having to heavily curve every exam. Grade fully depends on exams and participation.

reviews.subject: MGMT246 (Management)
reviews.review: You have to say something every class or your not getting participation points doesn't matter if you showed up. His exams are hard but he provides a very generous curve. Tries to make a rather boring subject interesting

reviews.subject: MGT246 (Management)
reviews.review: This professor is based on just exams and participation. No assignments or extra credit. He would always talk about personal cases. Tests were not the same as the lecture PowerPoint. No study guides.

reviews.subject: MGMT246 (Management)
reviews.review: Participation in class lectures is mandatory in every single class, or else you will lose points. The professor occasionally calls on students to summarize court cases in the textbook. Exams are challenging, and some of the questions are quite subjective; however, the professor provides a generous curve. 60%+ = A, 50-59% = B, 40-49% = C, 30-39% = D

reviews.subject: BUAD246 (Management)
reviews.review: Professor Parry is ok; his class is all lecture (which don't really go anywhere or apply to the content of the class much). He requires you to participate in class every single meeting to get attendance points so ask questions. His exams are tough, but he curves HEAVILY. No one would pass without the exam curve...Gives no homework or papers either.

reviews.subject: ISDS361B (Business)
reviews.review: Professor Minh retired this year but I figured I would show him some love anyway. His course is not in line with the rest of the department. He makes his own study sheets that go along with the lectures that he recorded 4 years ago... kind of hilarious to be honest. Allows notes and cheat sheet on his exams. 4 exams and homework make up the course.

reviews.subject: ISDS361B (Business)
reviews.review: Could care less about teaching or his students and even outright said so early in the semester. He plays pre-recorded lectures from years ago, doesn't answer questions, and gives zero leeway to students despite his own consistent mistakes throughout the semester. Steer clear of this professor as I believe he has only kept his job because of tenure.

reviews.subject: ISDS361B (Business)
reviews.review: I would rather say DO NOT TRUST other bad feedbacks because he is straight forward and makes the lecture easy to understand. Show up w.o the camera on is okay too, follow the pre-recorded videos that he spent time editing for us, and ace the exam. His sharings are real, not making up just to let you excited. Take him! Respected and nice & kind prof

reviews.subject: ISDS361B (Business)
reviews.review: This is a really good professor despite what the other reviews might say. He has great knowledge of ISDS and has a clear criteria for grading (Everything has been straightforward since the beginning).

reviews.subject: 361B (Business)
reviews.review: He is not interested in teaching his students. Show up to class, cant even ask questions because he says its unnecessary . Plays videos he pre recorded and lets them play while he goes off to do who knows what. Just dropped the class because its a waste of my time.

reviews.subject: 361B (Business)
reviews.review: Overall great teacher, with an excellent ability to formulate targeted test questions. His notes are comprehensive, and are good preparation for exams. Although he does not assist, he is still a great teacher!

reviews.subject: MGMT340 (Management)
reviews.review: Fast-paced summer course, so don't miss any of the online meetings. He gives three exam answers during the sessions. He doesn't record the meetings, so find out how to transcribe or record, because most of what will be on the exam comes from them. 70-79% is a C. He doesn't give C- or C+. About half of the class passed with a B

reviews.subject: 343 (Management)
reviews.review: The exams are just like the lectures and the readings. The summer course does go fast, but he is willing to help you and answer any questions. Ask as many questions as you can, he will answer them all. The group project is straightforward and not complicated, it reflects the lectures. Amazing professor, would recommend for future classes.

reviews.subject: 343 (Management)
reviews.review: Great professor! This was a fast-paced summer course, but he was always willing to help students succeed. He offered extra meetings, responded quickly to emails, and answered questions thoroughly. If you put in the effort and ask questions, you'll do well. Highly recommend!

reviews.subject: MGMT343 (Management)
reviews.review: definitely one of the better professors for this class. theres three exams and a project and no homework assignments or stuff like that to do so its a good workload. hes a very nice guy and tries to help his students and everyone passes the class and most ppl get like a B grade. the project is not easy to best to do work early and not wait.

reviews.subject: 343 (Management)
reviews.review: The syllabus stated exams were openbook, but on the first day he changed them to closed-book with Proctorio. The online course layout was confusing and hard to follow, especially in a fastpaced summer class. With only 7 days to prepare for the first exam, the workload felt overwhelming.

reviews.subject: 343 (Management)
reviews.review: The professor is nice and flexible. The class is straightforward watch videos, read the textbook he provides, and work on the study guide. There are exams, but they are not proctored with Proctorio. There is a final group project at the end of the semester, and extra credit is offered. MUST TAKE HIM!

reviews.subject: 341 (Psychology)
reviews.review: This class was pretty straightforward. She has a few ways to earn extra credit. The test are more applied than just definitions so make sure you take good notes and review them. Stay on top of dates and it won't be a hard class at all, just a lot of information is covered.

reviews.subject: PSY341 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Few assignments given over the course of the semester. Four exams total, last one is cumulative. Lectures were alright and helped my understanding on certain topics.

reviews.subject: ABNOR341 (Psychology)
reviews.review: pretty much TA'S do all the grading

reviews.subject: PSYC341 (Psychology)
reviews.review:
This course was pretty straightforward. 4 Exams, (the lowest grade is dropped & final is cumulative) 6 written assignments. I pretty much did one to two pages (double spaced) per assignment and got full credit, not hard at all. 1 extra credit opportunity. 
CP (course packet) is NEEDED. If you put the work in you'll do great.

reviews.subject: PSY341 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Her tests were strictly scheduled and her assignment due dates were random with no order or warning. TA's do most grading, but when she does get to grading she is really strict. She's inconsiderate of personal lives claiming school should be a priority despite outside issues. Also, HER textbook is required and pricy. Do not recommend AT all.

reviews.subject: PSYC341 (Psychology)
reviews.review: AVOID AT ALL COST! I enrolled in her class because of her high rating on here, but she's the absolute worst. Asynchronous course yet there were scheduled exams, like what? Not accommodating at all, especially for someone who teaches abnormal psych. Has multiple TAs grading our work without a clear rubric. Each assignment was a hit or miss

reviews.subject: HCOM320 (Human Communication Studies)
reviews.review: he's okay. he would simply read off his slides which seemed copy and pasted from the textbook (very tiny font), first 30 min of class was usually him rambling about random topics or repeating the same instructions over and over again, and his participation score is based on how much HE thinks you participated. his assignments are easy tho.

reviews.subject: HCOM320 (Human Communication Studies)
reviews.review: Your grade in this class will be strongly tied to reading the textbook and participating in class. Prof tells anecdotes that are on the test, and there are assignments where you lose points if you were absent for lecture. If you study the textbook this is an easy pass. However, prof can come off as rude/harsh sometimes, and can be hard to reach.

reviews.subject: HCOM320 (Human Communication Studies)
reviews.review: His lectures are funny and he gives real world examples/tells stories related to the lesson. He's chill in class but kind of rude in email. HW is few but pretty easy if you attend since it's just an extension of what you've done there. But the exams are book heavy, multiple choice, scenario-based. His canvas uploads are a bit disorganized/outdated.

reviews.subject: HCOM320 (Human Communication Studies)
reviews.review: Took his online class, he takes attendance by ZOOM. His lectures can be a little boring cus he keeps jumping from one thing to another but he's very hilarious. Pretty easygoing. Very less assignments but there are pop assignments in class which he doesn't announce to keep attendance high. As long as you participate, you should be good

reviews.subject: HCOM320 (Human Communication Studies)
reviews.review: Amazing Professor and would take him again! Coursework is structured and easy to follow. Pay attention in lectures and review the study guide for exams. Professor Lee is accessible for any questions and is easy to communicate with. This course is fun and would highly recommend.

reviews.subject: HIS180 (History)
reviews.review: Nope, never AGAIN! For an intro GE class it is insane how much he makes you memorize for a simple history course.. He takes forever to grade your assignments and posts long, monotone lectures. On top of dealing with bad mental health, this for sure made it worse. PLEASE PLEASE... if you can take literally any other prof.

reviews.subject: HST180 (History)
reviews.review: Not even done with the semester yet and I already don't like this guy, he expects you to somehow memorize a sh1t ton for the exams and takes forever to grade and when he does he'll come up with some excuse to not give full points. Just do yourself a favor and take literally anyone else if possible.

reviews.subject: HIST170A (History)
reviews.review: Dave Hall has a very special place In he11! I would rather watch paint dry, than sit through his lectures. I would pray to my lord and savior to end my suffering everyday. To whoever ran his fade during finals I praise you. A true hero. nevertheless, IF YOU WANNA FIND YOUR 13TH REASON TAKE THIS COURSE. ONG IF I SEE HIM AGAIN, HES CATCHING THIS FADE

reviews.subject: HIST170A (History)
reviews.review: DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. if you are able to please take any other professor other than him! you will not know your grade until the transcripts come out (no grades on canvas). His tests are hard and you don't even get your final back to see your score. If you want to have a good semester and actually pass a class do not take his class!

reviews.subject: HONR201A (History)
reviews.review: If you're not a history major, you probably will suffer. His slide shows are very traditional, it only provides a few words and it's mainly him lecturing. Attendance matters & his exams, quiz are graded VERY heavy. He provides study guides & expects you to know EVERY lil things about what he lectures. Just take another professor for honr201a!

reviews.subject: HIST170A (History)
reviews.review:
I recommend this professor if you're good at memorizing facts and dates. I ended with a B because he would give 80 question study guides and found them on quizlet. There are three tests; all of them are 80 mpc questions and 2 short paragraph questions. You can tell the professor is very passionate about history!
He also drops the lowest midterm!

reviews.subject: 100 (Music)
reviews.review: He relates the class to things that the students would know and like. Fun and easy class.

reviews.subject: MUS100 (Music)
reviews.review: He's funny, I took mus 100 online you just have to attend 3 concerts in campus and write discussion for ur final I actually liked this class, we just had a couple listening tests during class with our cameras on, but other than that you can have it off  and yeah he's chill and funny he makes a lot of funny jokes and will work with you to help you.

reviews.subject: MUS100 (Music)
reviews.review: DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS, unless you want to suffer from all the discussions/homework/in person group projects/group discussions and listening exams.

reviews.subject: MUS350 (Music)
reviews.review: The class itself is just very boring, I am a COMM major so taking this class felt just very slow. He is super nice and easy to talk to so thats that. Book required but I didn't buy it you can get past without it. the class itself is literally just him talking and listening to samples.

reviews.subject: MUS100 (Music)
reviews.review: Very good professor. Took class as a fluke looking for something easy to fill out my GE, class was pretty interesting, music is fun to learn. I did however get lazy and end up with a D+ so don't do that.

reviews.subject: MUS100 (Music)
reviews.review: He gave a lot of tedious homework, which took some time. He has this thing with academic dishonesty and will assume that you were dishonest in your work, not through trackers but through his opinion. If he assumes that you were dishonest in your work he says he will report it to the dean of students to investigate it. Not worth it.

reviews.subject: ISDS351 (Business)
reviews.review: Lots of these reviews are very accurate, in that she isn't responsive, and strange class structure. Quiz a week isn't to bad, and normal with online classes, but was a bit of mess when proctorio was broken. I still like online courses overall but things like the MS Project assignment was a bit messy, had to do it on school computers, very ok class

reviews.subject: ISDS351 (Business)
reviews.review: Prof. K online ISDS 351 class was a difficult class to navigate but not hard to pass. Her class was made up of 1 quiz per week, 4 exams, and a MS project which was a nightmare to figure out. She was not responsive to her students when it came to issues with the course material or proctorio. Would definitely recommended another teacher if possible

reviews.subject: ISDS351 (Business)
reviews.review: Professor Malini can be a mixed bag - lectures can meander, but she wants you to succeed. Quizzes and exams are challenging, so studying with unstuck study and the textbook is key. Group projects can be disorganized, but overall the class is manageable with effort.

reviews.subject: ISDS351 (Business)
reviews.review: Quizzes have 2 attempts, WP & ET were easy just hit the word count, lectures don't cover much & rambles a lot of nothing so get ready to read, doesn't answer emails, uploads last min, had a difficult time saving the project files, first exam was a disaster but some of the ?s on the quizzes were on there & gets angry sometimes when asking ?s

reviews.subject: ISDS351 (Business)
reviews.review: This professor makes the content for the course unnecessarily difficult to access and unorganized. Grading is not very clear and the midterms have a high amount of question on them with a very short amount of time to answer. I could not make in person classes due to my work schedule and she was my only choice. Her low rating is accurate.

reviews.subject: ISDS351 (Business)
reviews.review: Lecture videos are provided, which can be helpful. There are 20 question weekly quizzes that are closed note/closed book which can be a bit daunting if you don't study or keep up with the material. Exams were proctored on zoom also closed note/closed book. One project on MS project but she walks you through them in recorded videos.

reviews.subject: AMST201 (American Studies)
reviews.review: She was a really nice and sweet prof and enjoys having conversations with students. Stuff was pretty easy but a lot of homework. One thing is that she doesn't let you google things for any assignment or else you will get a zero... Honestly I didn't like that because sometimes her lectures aren't enough :P Besides that she was great!

reviews.subject: AMST201 (American Studies)
reviews.review: No quizzes or exams! Also the sweetest teacher you'll ever meet, and is very understanding. Lenient about giving extra days to work.

reviews.subject: AMST101 (American Studies)
reviews.review: Video lectures and assignments each week. She gives you a week to do everything but a lot was up early. she gives extensions if you ask.

reviews.subject: AMST201 (American Studies)
reviews.review: Chill class. Weekly assignments. She's nice.

reviews.subject: AMST201 (American Studies)
reviews.review: Engaging lectures, weekly assignments (based on lectures so take good notes! lectures not posted), weekly readings, NO TESTS, fun group projects, instructions are clear (through assignments and explains them in class too!), reachable, cares about student feedback, gives feedback on all work, gives due date extensions, drops assignments. Great prof!

reviews.subject: AMST201 (American Studies)
reviews.review: Every week there is a lecture and an assignment. 4 big assignments in the semester, but you only need to submit 2. Can do a third to drop one. She drops other assignments. Super nice and answers emails quickly.

reviews.subject: HEALTH101 (Health Science)
reviews.review: The nicest professor ever! I had this class in 2021 (it's 2026) and I'm writing this because I remembered how much I loved this class! This was my intro to public health and solidified my choices in my major. At the time I was a nervous 17 year old but she made me feel confident in my future in public health! Miss this class!

reviews.subject: PUBH101 (Health Science)
reviews.review: It it June 1st, and grades were due May 22. Professor Just hasn't submitted my final grade. Multiple attempts to contact her failed and department doesn't want to do anything. If you don't want to know how you're doing in the course and have issues with grading and communication, take her.

reviews.subject: PUBH101 (Health Science)
reviews.review: Professor Just has never responded to any emails I sent all semester and waits until the last day when grades are due to grade assignments/homework which make up a sizable percentage of the overall grade. She also brought her grandson to proctor us which felt odd.

reviews.subject: PUBH101 (Health Science)
reviews.review: does not take late work no matter what and is very strict. besides that sweet person but lectures were super boring.

reviews.subject: PUBH101 (Health Science)
reviews.review: She gives good lectures and overall the class is very easy as long as you pay attention.

reviews.subject: PUBH101 (Health Science)
reviews.review: Unorganized professor who doesn't grade until the last day grades are due. Don't be fooled by the other reviews. Seems like an easy A, but she's sloppy at her own job.

reviews.subject: AMST101 (American Studies)
reviews.review: Good professor really enjoyed his class. Make sure your attendance is good, very lecture heavy.

reviews.subject: AMST201 (American Studies)
reviews.review: The majority of your grade relies on his two essays that act as mid term and final (Around 80% total). Make sure to go to his office hours to help clarify on what to do and what he's looking for. Overall, not a hard class, prof seems nice, provides free textbooks but if you're not the best essay writer, maybe consider taking another prof instead.

reviews.subject: AMST101 (American Studies)
reviews.review: 10/10 professor, such a caring and genuine guy. 4 books you gotta read but if you dont youre gonna be pretty lost so read them. Ask questions, seriously this professor is so kind and genuine when it comes to answering them. Amazing thoughtful lectures too. Do the readings, ask questions, go over slides and you'll be just fine. Real funny guy too!!!

reviews.subject: AMST201 (American Studies)
reviews.review: it was a breeze taking amst201 through Professor Haskins. although his lectures were mostly boring, he would crack some jokes (some cringe but others were actually funny). he has a written midterm + final that is solely based on the readings/lectures so go to class and read the assigned chapters if you want a perfect grade. overall, a chill class.

reviews.subject: AMST201 (American Studies)
reviews.review: We had weekly discussion posts (only had to be three sentences) and reply to a classmate. There were two papers (minimum three pages) based off the video lectures. The feedback and grading for the papers was confusing; however, if you attend his office hour he will clear everything up and give you feedback before submission. Would take again

reviews.subject: AMST201 (American Studies)
reviews.review: The professor was very lecture-heavy and talked a lot during his lectures, Assignments are simple, just 1 discussion post per week talking about the topic related to that week. Overall he isnt a bad professor just listen to his lectures and take notes, Reading isnt mandatory but he does say to read them

reviews.subject: MKTG351 (Marketing)
reviews.review: I'm reading this professor after not having him for two years, but all I remember are the good memories of a teacher really wanting his students to learn. Would take again!

reviews.subject: MKT462 (Marketing)
reviews.review: Professor Sorrell is the only professor I have actually benefited from at CSUF. He's tough, and the class is pretty hefty, BUT if you actually want to learn skills that you can use forever and feel accomplished please take this class. Cares A LOT about his students and gives you real world marketing experience. Outstanding professor.

reviews.subject: MKTG462 (Marketing)
reviews.review: Passionate professor. Makes time to meet outside of office hours if needed. Has high expectations of his students and he'll push you to achieve your potential maybe surpass it too. Can see the transformation in your confidence, negotiation skills, entrepreneurial skills and marketing skills will sky rocket. Class becomes close knit. 10/10recommend

reviews.subject: MKT462 (Marketing)
reviews.review: Easily one of the most beneficial courses I've ever taken. I took this course as a 37-year-old going back to school and having been in the professional world for almost 20 years already, I found this course to be extremely valuable to those interested in sales of any kind. This course is demanding and the Professor expects your utmost attention.

reviews.subject: MKTG351 (Marketing)
reviews.review: My biggest problem with his is that if you miss a class and inform he why he'll share it with the class even if its something embaring he told us how someons family member died while they where in class and the person was viably upset. The gorup project isnt hard but he doesnt give much instruction and just throws you into it. doesn't use canvas.

reviews.subject: MKT462 (Marketing)
reviews.review: The class includes a large amount of work with little to no feedback. Minor issues, such as dress code or missed assignments, affect grades. Bathroom breaks are restricted, and email responses are limited. Overall, the course felt more focused on rules and penalties than on learning.

reviews.subject: MKTG442 (Marketing)
reviews.review: Professor Medina does an excellent job preparing students for real-world careers. Everything he teaches is practical, relevant, and applicable beyond the classroom. I absolutely recommend his marketing courses—I really enjoyed taking his class.

reviews.subject: MKTG353 (Marketing)
reviews.review: DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR!! Out of all four years at CSUF, this professor is by far the WORST I have ever had. He is always 15-20 minutes late to class and zoom meetings, barely taught anything, and never grades anything. The day of the final he arrived 10 minutes before the assigned time ended. Literally take anyone else!!!

reviews.subject: MKTG442 (Marketing)
reviews.review: He was consistently late and never apologetic about it, including an hour late on the first day and to the final. He provided no feedback or clear grading criteria, and many Canvas assignments and exams were left ungraded, making final grades unclear. He claimed to teach “real skills,” but I strongly disagree. Also uses AI for announcements.

reviews.subject: MKTG442 (Marketing)
reviews.review: He is constantly late to lectures and very disorganized. He was an hour late to my final. If you don't care about learning the class material this class is great, attendance is not mandatory and barely any homework.

reviews.subject: MKTG379 (Marketing)
reviews.review: The class itself is easy, but good luck learning anything. He teaches you using his own work, like confidential numbers that should probably get him fired from his real job. He is always at least 15-45 minutes late to class, and randomly makes up assignments. If you get lucky, he feels bad enough to make the exams a group project.

reviews.subject: MKTG442 (Marketing)
reviews.review: I am writing this while he is 45 minutes late to our final exam and still has not shown up. So much more, to explain, just read the other posts for details. I have a feeling that looking at these ratings won't matter because he will be fired. If not, good luck in his class.

reviews.subject: MGMT339 (Business)
reviews.review: Tbh I think he has dementia. Don't take.

reviews.subject: MANAGEMENT339 (Business)
reviews.review: Gives pop quizzes but you cant keep them to study. same with the exams. VERY DULL lecture. reads off of slides and his slides are vague compared to concepts of exams. Not tech-savvy at all so the lecture has been delayed many times. The concepts of the course themselves arent too bad just consider someone else his age is starting to show. gives EC

reviews.subject: MGMT339 (Business)
reviews.review: Early class and he's always late. No practice exams, no study guide and isn't accessible outside of class. Surprise quizzes on chapters u've not learnt & does not drop. Self taught everything as he only reads word for word off the slides. Always behind schedule making it difficult to learn the material last minute before exams. Go for others.

reviews.subject: MGMT339 (Business)
reviews.review: I would not recommend this class if you actually want to learn. The professor reads his slides word for word every week and once in a while teaches something. He is a nice guy and offers extra credit and curves every exam, but you will suffer. Read the textbook because otherwise, you won't understand.

reviews.subject: 339 (Business)
reviews.review: This professor knew he was making the exams a lot harder than others. Lectures were really boring , he would just read over the slides. The exams include multiple choice questions plus fill in the blanks or solving problems. He was just a hard professor. I would recommend taking someone else

reviews.subject: MGMT339 (Business)
reviews.review: While Gus' teaching style takes some adjustment, the workload is manageable if you stay on top of the readings. unstuck AI was a lifesaver for exam prep, complementing the textbook and lecture slides.

reviews.subject: CJ300 (Criminal Justice)
reviews.review: Professor Lasley is a great professor. Attendance is not mandatory, but go! There was no homework, projects, or quizzes. There are only three exams. Please study!! If you study and attend all the lectures, you will pass with an easy A.

reviews.subject: 300 (Criminal Justice)
reviews.review: The course was pretty straight forward, no HW or quizzes. 3 exams that are based on the lectures and some questions are basically a given if you attend his lectures on a regular basis. He gave great depth in the information given even when the info itself could be dull. As long as you're taking notes and studying, it's an easy pass!

reviews.subject: CRJU345 (Criminal Justice)
reviews.review: Very chill and easy class, basically you just go in and listen to his lectures and take notes. Of those lectures you'll take 3 exams on them (all multiple choice and true or false) and they'll make up your entire grade, no homework or anything else. Attendance not mandatory but recommended to do better on exams.

reviews.subject: CJ300 (Criminal Justice)
reviews.review: Although attendance is not mandatory,  knowledge needed for exams is told in lectures. Students were annoying they'd get up and pack 5 minutes before class ended and I'd feel so bad for him YALL STOP SILENCING THE MAN the class is already 50 minutes.Also he lets student choose turning in a workbook or do a paper thats due at the end of semester.

reviews.subject: CJ300 (Criminal Justice)
reviews.review: Prof lasley is the best at csuf hands down, he's been doing this for years so he is a bit old school but he does not want his students to fail. He is soooo knowledgeable and gives us a lot of opportunities but you do need to study which I'm not sure why is a problem for many students, but if you put in the work you will pass

reviews.subject: CRJU345 (Criminal Justice)
reviews.review: James Lasley gives opportunities for extra credit, I literally failed all my exams and Got a F but I completed the extra credit and got a B. He lectures by power points and doesn't upload the lectures and it is mandatory to attend lectures because are exams are based on lectures.

reviews.subject: MKTG351 (Marketing)
reviews.review: Took the class in the summer. It was online and pretty easy to get the work done. One group project and lots of individual work. Professor assigns group.  Hopefully you get a good group. Pretty chill prof.

reviews.subject: MKTG351 (Marketing)
reviews.review: Not much work. I like the extra credit. Group project is easy. He assigns groups so you hope to get good group.

reviews.subject: MKTG351 (Marketing)
reviews.review: Shows interesting movies. Group work and pop quizzes. Makes marketing sound good.

reviews.subject: MKTG351 (Marketing)
reviews.review: Funny and lots of extra credit.

reviews.subject: MKTG351 (Marketing)
reviews.review: I'm sure he's a nice guy and prob has decent intentions but he's the type of prof who is doing this for the check. Doesn't really put much effort into making marketing engaging. Exams have nothing to do with what he provides for study guide and his Canvas and class is so unstructured. You have to teach yourself everything and get lucky.

reviews.subject: MKT351 (Marketing)
reviews.review: Workload of the class and assignments are relatively easy but the exams are impossible. I am usually a straight A student and dedicate a lot of time to study but he asks the most insane niche questions on exams that have nothing to do with marketing knowledge which prob make up 25% of the exam questions. Do NOT take.

reviews.subject: PSYC312 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Lectures online were short and you have to take notes and write weekly summaries and they have to be descriptive and long. She had so many TA's as well and they are tough graders. Group project towards the end but she gives enough time. In class lectures were funny and a lot of people participate. Take her class it is interesting

reviews.subject: PSYC110 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Lectures were slightly disorganized but interesting. Quizzes were timed, and you weren't able to see the questions you missed after submitting which sucks. She says to come to office hours to find out what problems you got wrong, which is really inconvenient. This class was pretty easy though. She's pretty funny too.

reviews.subject: PSY331 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Her lectures are super detailed, and so are her tests. she let us use our notes though for all of them.

reviews.subject: PSYC495 (Psychology)
reviews.review: A great communicator. She was very understanding when it came to situations involving internships. I love that she always gives feedback for each assignment.

reviews.subject: PSY331 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Impossible to get full credit. Runs everything through an AI detector and will automatically give you partial to 0 credit for AI detected. Have to meet with her or exchange emails back and forth to get grade changed. Myself and classmates have never dealt with this issue before. Save yourself the headache and find literally any other processor.

reviews.subject: PSYC312 (Psychology)
reviews.review: It's mediocre at best. Lectures are fully online and easy to understand. "One page requirement," but you can write 4 pages on the topic and still be told it's not descriptive enough. Promotes open-mindedness but lacks in practice. Easy A if you show up, but don't try to change their mind

reviews.subject: MATH170B (Mathematics)
reviews.review: YO!!! Mr. Hall!!  That's slay!  I followed your suggestions and turned my F to a C!!  Mad respect.  Never give up fam!!  All I can say is listen to what he is telling you and you got this!

reviews.subject: MATH170B (Mathematics)
reviews.review: A challenging course, but if you put in the work you will probably have the success that I did.  So many of my classmates hardly showed up and it cost them big time because they had no idea what was going to be on the quizzes or exams.  I showed up every day and knew exactly what to expect.  GO TO CLASS and ask questions!

reviews.subject: MATH170B (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Just be prepared for lots and lots of hours on studying since the professor would essentially riddle clues for what's to be ahead . Very demoralizing when it comes to his in person lectures after results are not what professor might expect as he lowers students how in having a better chance for the future.

reviews.subject: MATH170B (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Leaves u guessing on what's going to be on his quizzes and exams if you ask him what's going to be on them. quizzes and exams are not comprehensive to the homework or lectures. Expects u to learn the more complicated questions on your own. No study guides, no review sessions. We were still learning new content on the week before finals.

reviews.subject: MATH115 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Super nice, caring, gentle-spoken person. My class used to talk the entire time and he just let them. I talked to him and he will help you if you ask! One of the best professors here. 10/10

reviews.subject: MATH170B (Mathematics)
reviews.review:
Hes a nice prof just like many said there.
This class is basically 250B but without the calculus part so if you already passed 250B for whatever reason, this class will be a cakewalk. 
Btw, given how this course isn't designed for math majors but compsci/compeng majors, I don't really think the syllabus should include set proofs.

reviews.subject: ENG101P (English)
reviews.review: Overall, pretty chill class. It is small so she will know who you are. Attendance is mandatory, 4 essays are from 1 small paragraph to 3 pages. 2 in class essays, MUST do 2 writing center appointments and 1 presentation (very easy to do). Professor does get a little confused so just ask for help/clarification and your good! easy A!

reviews.subject: ENG101P (English)
reviews.review: If you put in the work and she notices, she'll help you out even if you forget an assignment. It's clear she appreciates the people who try and put in effort. The class is small, (so she knows who you are) with lots of in-class writing and eBook work. Overall, a good teacher if you show effort and stay consistent.

reviews.subject: ENG301 (English)
reviews.review: I was scared to take this class, however, she was a sweet caring professor. I hate and am terrible at english so I would never take it again. I worked my butt off and got an A. 4 writing projects, 1 in class timed essay, and minior assignments.

reviews.subject: ENG305 (English)
reviews.review: Unfortunately not a great professor. Seems like EVERYONE struggled in her class. Not clear about what would be on tests at all. 2 midterms. 2 quizzes. Group presentation. Cumulative final. Said she didn't want us memorizing but docked points for answers not being the exact phrasing. Avoid.

reviews.subject: ENGL305 (English)
reviews.review: Grading based on two midterms, two quizzes, a group project, and a cumulative final. Does not specify what she wants on the exams, terrible presenter, very content heavy. One of the worst professors I've had.

reviews.subject: ENGL305 (English)
reviews.review: Literally the worst professor I've ever had at CSUF and thats saying A LOT. All she does is ramble and more than half the time theres no clear point. She also assigns projects/ tests back to back, we came back from Easter weekend and had 2 tests and one project for 3 weeks after. Also condescending even though you ask a simple question. BEWARE.

reviews.subject: HIS110A (History)
reviews.review: Dr. Parsa is a very interesting fellow. You will not learn anything from his lectures. You must complete his study guides using his book there is really no other way. His tendency to go on tangents makes it really hard to learn anything. I highly recommend bringing his book and study guide to class and just working on that every week.

reviews.subject: 110A (History)
reviews.review: One of my favorite professors I will probably ever have! Yes, he does talk a lot but U dont need to pay attention. I completed the study guide using his book and then completely memoried it. I got above 85% on all his tests. Attend all his classes so you dont miss the 10% for attendance. Very generous grader. Got an A- even thoe I deserved a B.

reviews.subject: 110A (History)
reviews.review: Grade out of 3 exams. Study guide is basically the exam. M/C is easy as long as you read his book. His lecture are VERY long /boring, but he is funny at times so not too bad. 10% of your grade is attendance so that's free points. He gives out points during class sometimes so read ahead. No HW and its a really easy class if you study for exams

reviews.subject: HIST110A (History)
reviews.review: Prof Parsa is a unique individual. I had him for the once a week 3 hours classes and 70% was just rambling. I can see how many people wouldn't mind but it just drove me crazy and was honestly frustrating. We fall behind each section and don't finish the material. Having said that, he is a lenient grader and a caring & nice guy. Definitely passable.

reviews.subject: 110A (History)
reviews.review: A lot of studying and memorizing.

reviews.subject: 110A (History)
reviews.review: One of the best professors I have had as a freshman at cal state fullerton.

reviews.subject: 315 (Economics)
reviews.review: Summer online course. Two in person exams. We had to watch her lecture videos that she graded. Exams was 3 problem solving 50% of the exam and 25 multiple choice. If you did good on the problem solving you will pass! Curves a lot on the first one and a bit on the second one. Would definitely take her again.

reviews.subject: ECON315 (Economics)
reviews.review: To pass the class watch ALL the lectures, do all hwk try to get 100% and do the extra credit. I religiously studied her 3 problem-solving extra-credit assignments and got a 50/50 on that part of the exam. Then somewhat focused on the multiple choice. I got a B for her summer course, which I found easier if you're only taking 1 summer class.

reviews.subject: ECON315 (Economics)
reviews.review: I don't know why she is rated so low; she teaches well, and you actually learn from her. You can get away with just having the lectures autoplay in the background and the week of the test study. She doesn't make her own exams, but her study guides are super similar. Overall, she's excellent.

reviews.subject: ECON315 (Economics)
reviews.review: Most overwhelming class I've taken. Expect 20+ hrs of lectures a week—7–15 videos per chapter, 3 chapters due weekly. It's exhausting and hard to keep up, especially with other classes or a job. If you want to actually learn without burning out, take someone else. Farka is not a summer professor

reviews.subject: ECON315 (Economics)
reviews.review: I took her for the Summer semester and maybe that's why it was so difficult. But my classes average on the first exam was in the 20% range... She grades you on whether or not you actually watch her lecture videos, she hosts review sessions but when you don't understand something, she gets rude and makes you feel dumb. TESTS ARE HARD.

reviews.subject: ECON315 (Economics)
reviews.review: This is not an easy class. But, Dr. Farka goes out of her way to ensure you pass. Her lectures are very well organized and she offers extra credits, multiple review sessions, study guides, and generous curves. Her communication is one of the best I've seen. If you put in the effort, you have nothing to worry about. If you fail, that's all on you.

reviews.subject: ECON201 (Economics)
reviews.review: Class was very straightforward as prof went over concepts thoroughly. Most important thing is to just do ungraded problem sets and know main concepts. He does grade strict on the essay and math parts so show every single step even if its basic math but still a good class overall.

reviews.subject: ECON332 (Economics)
reviews.review: The lectures are important, and that means your notes are important. Otherwise it'll be fairly difficult if writing is not a strong skill. Though I found the class interesting and the professor knowledgeable.

reviews.subject: 332 (Economics)
reviews.review: Yeah, stay away. Tests are not multiple choice. It's the type of test where if you know it, you know it. I was told it was supposed to be an easy class, but it's not. Not with him, at least. He makes the class harder than it's supposed to be. You won't pass this class if you don't come to class and read the 2 books that he assigned.

reviews.subject: 201 (Economics)
reviews.review: Quiz every week. Lectures are pretty boring and if you read the textbook you don't have to attend them. Makes you go to 4 decimal places on quizzes and exams so you don't get lucky. Would not take again. Try to stay away if possible.

reviews.subject: 201 (Economics)
reviews.review: His lectures were pretty helpful. If you want to do well, go to class and practice the ungraded problem sets.

reviews.subject: 332 (Economics)
reviews.review: Really good guy, very knowledgeable. Exams and Quizzes are all Reading and Lecture specific though, so attend classes regularly and take good notes.

reviews.subject: 351 (Marketing)
reviews.review: Took online over the summer, zoom calls weren't mandatory. Simulation is pretty easy but takes a while to do. All other work is GRL and discussion boards. Quick to respond to emails, understanding of emergencies and does his best to accommodate.

reviews.subject: MKTG351 (Marketing)
reviews.review: Prof Kohli was very nice and his lectures were entertaining. He doesn't make attendance mandatory but there are 5 pop quizzes that are taken in class. Make sure to keep up with the online textbook that you need to purchase for around $35 and you should be okay. The exams can be hard mainly because the wording of questions can be tricky.

reviews.subject: MKTG404 (Marketing)
reviews.review: Professor is very nice! No exams, just a weekly one page report. Class makes you think philosophically, very interesting class.

reviews.subject: 351 (Marketing)
reviews.review: This professor is an amazing energy and is very helpful and will answer any questions. If you like lectures that are high energy, funny jokes, and participation then you'll love this professor. He does do pop quizzes but it's never too hard and if you keep up with the class it will be easy. The grades are fair.

reviews.subject: 351 (Marketing)
reviews.review: This online class is perfect for people with busy schedules. Class work due every 3 weeks or so. Clear expectations, easy to follow, and responsive. Subject isn't the easiest, but it is an interesting subject, much deeper than just marketing. Take this professor!

reviews.subject: POSC375 (Political Science)
reviews.review: Dr. Fiber-Ostrow was very very knowledgeable and taught me a lot, she does however grade by maybe 5 or 6 things, half of which are participation and exams. Lots of reading and class discussion but its very interesting stuff and she is friendly and encouraging!

reviews.subject: 375 (Political Science)
reviews.review: As most people have already said, she is a tough grader. HOWEVER, she is not a unfair grader. Yes, you need to understand the material AND be a great writer. But, if you're willing to go the extra step and grow as a student there are few, if any, professors better than Dr. Fiber-Ostrow to learn from.

reviews.subject: POSC473 (Political Science)
reviews.review: Fiber is a tough but great professor! I had her both 375 and 473 and I recommend you take her 400 level before her 375 class. Textbooks are required cause most of your court cases do come from the textbook. She will teach out how to analyze court cases to set you up success for her exams and papers. Opinionated, but I was able to move past that!

reviews.subject: POSC375 (Political Science)
reviews.review: Her classes are vital if you are prepping or law school. She ses you up for success in the field.

reviews.subject: POL375 (Political Science)
reviews.review: This course was extremely difficult for me, however, I would be lying if I said Professor Fiber-Ostrow was not a great professor. The coursework requires great attention with lots of reading. Time passes by fast inside the classroom because of how interesting she makes her lectures. Be prepared to read a lot and read everything!

reviews.subject: POSC375 (Political Science)
reviews.review: Tough class with an unforgiving professor. Lots of planning for assignments, but unstuckstudy proved helpful for study prep. Attendance is mandatory, so be prepared for a real challenge.

reviews.subject: POL100 (Political Science)
reviews.review: I would say for an online course, this class structure was so disorganized. There are three exams, and you must cram everything- her podcast lectures, the textbook, and videos to take the test. Also, she constantly tells students that she has spies on our discords and canvas watching us.

reviews.subject: POSC100 (Political Science)
reviews.review: Apparently my rating was taken down. BOOOOOO. Point is: Missed class a lot for other job. Too boring. Doesn't answer emails too often. Tests were too hard. News assignment was eh. 3 exams. First and last exams were pretty easy. Mid term not so much. Believed about 10 or so classes were cancelled.

reviews.subject: POL100 (Political Science)
reviews.review: extremely rude, unprofessional, disorganized, and unqualified to teach. this class was an absolute waste of time. i came out of this class knowing less about polysci than when i came into it. i dont even know why she gets paid to do this

reviews.subject: POSC100 (Political Science)
reviews.review: claims that this class will be life changing but made me dislike politics even more. 3 exams + writing assignment (single-spaced) lectures are terrible, spends most time rambling about unnecessary details and she admits to it but continues. class is passable if you do the long readings, learned more there then prof. class was a waste of time

reviews.subject: POSC100 (Political Science)
reviews.review: This professor lacks organization and communication. Lectures are heavy and could have taken less time if she would have stayed on task. Prioritizes her prison job and her talking about her job is what takes up lecture time. Notes that could take a day to fill out in that hour and a half we had her actually take two weeks to get finished.

reviews.subject: POSC100 (Political Science)
reviews.review: shes nice and passionate about polsci but maybe a bit excessive cus her tangents take up half of the class time. 3 tests, an online quiz for each, gives easy extra credit, 1 writing assignment that consists of 3 papers, and the final is accumulative. she canceled like 10 classes & some were last minute which is frustrating for commuters

reviews.subject: MATH430 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Dr. Annin is great. He is an amazing lecturer and this class was very interesting. He does assign a lot of HW so that can be a bit much. He gives a lot of resources for his two test and final, which can feel like too many at times. All in all, he is a great instructor and this was a fun class

reviews.subject: 250B (Mathematics)
reviews.review: LOTS of homework, gives extra credit for midterms. Super patient and offers a ton of office hours, but frankly I wouldn't retake 250B with him because he gives the most brutal tests I've ever seen. If you're scatter-brained like me and are thinking of taking this alongside a full semester workload, you'd be better off doing so with someone else.

reviews.subject: MATH471 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: I took Combinatorics Fall25. This was one of my most enjoyed and fulfilling mathematics classes I've taken! Dr. Annin's explanations will give you a greater understanding of the problem solving process through various methods! He gets excited very easily and exams may be long (but you can take Qs home!), but he is very open to help!

reviews.subject: 471 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: This professor is not good. He gives too much homeworks and he grades so harsh. You need to be very good at Math to take this class. If not, do not take. Take another professor

reviews.subject: 250B (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Hard class with very challenging exams, but the lectures are actually clear and useful. Attendance isn't required and all lectures are recorded. He also offers up to 7 extra credit points per exam if you complete the EC assignments. It a class you need to focused on to do well.

reviews.subject: 250B (Mathematics)
reviews.review: LOVE THIS GUY. Nothing but passionated and love for students. He stays at school until 12 am for students to ask questions. Just overall amazing. But his exams are difficult, so make sure to study and come to the office hours.

reviews.subject: FIN310 (Finance)
reviews.review: Professor Milligan keeps the class engaging with his hilarious anecdotes, though he can be a bit strict on attendance. The material is challenging, but with the help of resources like Unstuck AI, the exams are manageable. Overall, an enjoyable and rewarding experience.

reviews.subject: FIN310 (Finance)
reviews.review: For a finance class, idk why we should be paying 75 bucks to do homework... as well a test should not be worth so much of our grade, he can not even make a proper study guide and is pretty rude to students at times, like were paying to be here and have things going on in our life, his lectures are all over the place too, wont even answer questions

reviews.subject: FIN310 (Finance)
reviews.review: Favorite. Professor. Ever. He's hilarious and I honestly enjoyed coming to class even though attendance isn't mandatory but you should still go for the lecture! He gives you cheat sheets, a study guide, and alot of time to prepare for exams (only 3 exams) he may call you out for being late but its all in good fun you need to be able to take a joke.

reviews.subject: FIN342 (Finance)
reviews.review: All he does is read off the slides. He tells stories that relate to what is being taught but doesn't teach. Avoid him at all costs because he is very vague about what he wants when you write reports on movies. waste of time/money. i felt lost, yes he allows a cheat sheet but it is not much help as test are vague. good luck to his next victims

reviews.subject: FIN310 (Finance)
reviews.review: First day of class, I walked in 10 mins late because I was lost. Amidst me sitting down, he stops lecturing to call me and a few others out and proceeds to point at me and say, "I wish I could take a picture of your face, seriously, you look like you have no idea what is going on". Wants respect through attendance but doesn't dish out respect back.

reviews.subject: FIN310 (Finance)
reviews.review: This class was honestly very helpful, though the material may be difficult and confusing for students at times. The tests felt messy and hard to study for, but in the end, the things I learned were SO beneficial. Milligan is entertaining and friendly! I took away things from this class that well help me for the rest of my life, no joke.

reviews.subject: PSY312 (Psychology)
reviews.review: The professor & class was so-so. If youre looking for a prof to lecture/teach you about the subject keep looking! He only assigns chapters and a quiz to take each week. Youll also need to do book reviews every other week from a choice of 3 books. No lectures, audios, PPs, or extra credit given. Not a hard class but youll need to teach yourself

reviews.subject: PSY312 (Psychology)
reviews.review: DON'T take his class online. It really is a waste of money. He doesn't provide any kind of recorded lecture, slides, etc. You basically teach yourself on the material using only the textbook. If you miss a quiz he is NOT understanding. If you do decide to take him beware, if you don't complete the final BRD, you'll fail even if you did ALL the rest

reviews.subject: PSYC305L (Psychology)
reviews.review: Do yourself a favor and do NOT take him. He does not provide any lectures or explanations on how to do assignments. Baker also gives everyone different instructions so its confusing and ends up affecting our grades. He is a horrible instructor and either needs to leave CSUF or not teach this course ever again. Just dont take him, trust me.

reviews.subject: PSY319 (Psychology)
reviews.review: DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS ONLINE. he provides no notes, study guide or feedback. every week you do a reading and take a quiz and then have to take 2 exams with no help from him whatsoever. u are doing 100% of the work alone with no help from him.

reviews.subject: PSYC101 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Very easy class. Semester consists of reading one book (he gives you a few options to choose from) and weekly reading quizzes. If you read the assigned reading, the quizzes are super easy. For the book, you need to read the assigned chapters and write short summaries. That is the whole semester- it's super easy if you do your part. Just read LOL

reviews.subject: PSY101 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Doing this class online was easy because all we did were readings that are assigned online. The readings are fairly simple and there is quiz for each reading you do and if you understand it, it is easy. He also requires you to read a book and do a 2-page summary and commentary paper for each section that is due. Overall the class is easy.

reviews.subject: HIST433A (History)
reviews.review: Dr. McLain was a great and caring professor. He pushes his students because he wants you to be a better writer. There were 3 exams, 2 book responses, 1 film response, and a primary source analysis. Tests are fill in the blank and short answer; no word bank, so if you don't study, you will not succeed. Do the work, get feedback, and you will pass.

reviews.subject: HIST311 (History)
reviews.review:
I tried to get the WWII class for a long time and finally did. WOW. 

Two book responses, four lecture based tests that cover a LOT of info. Be forewarned-take careful notes and study or the test will SUCK. Very passionate about history, amazing lectures. Bonus, easy on the eyes.

My history professors have all been great so far, but def my fave.

reviews.subject: HIST311 (History)
reviews.review: Dr. Mclain was a joy to learn from. Extreme passion for WWII made lectures fascinating. Very knowledgable on topic, even the lesser-known histories. Occasionally rants but still very funny.  Succeeding in class means efficiently studying material. Study groups helpful. Everyone needs to take this class. In fact, take Mclain every chance you get.

reviews.subject: HIST110B (History)
reviews.review: As a history major, I found this class very enjoyable! I took this course online/asynchronous; there were 6 tests and a short 1.5 minimum page essay for a book he assigned to read. You have to watch many lecture videos for the test, so make sure you space them out and take good notes, but they were interesting overall. Def recommend!

reviews.subject: HIS110B (History)
reviews.review: 6 Tests and online lectures on them. Watch the lectures and take good notes and you will pass no problem. Pretty funny and cool guy.

reviews.subject: 110B (History)
reviews.review: This was my last option since classes filled up...and honestly very unsatisfied with the grading. There are 6 Tests. That is it. You are graded based off these 6 tests. I studied but this was not the issue, the thing for these tests was the issue!!! Not even a minute per question at least. I had to rush through a few tests.

reviews.subject: ART101 (University Studies)
reviews.review: Lectures can feel long. Easy to catch up if class is missed, lectures posted before zooms.

reviews.subject: ART101 (University Studies)
reviews.review: Idk what everyone is saying but let's be for real she is passive aggressive because half of y'all cheat and don't do your work, and think she can't see you Using Ai. Im not glazing but fr she literally has 3 exams which are easy and to project which are easier, amazing teacher and a easy glass to take for extra GE'S

reviews.subject: ART300 (University Studies)
reviews.review: Everyone is so dramatic. Yes, sometimes she can come across as passive aggressive but it comes from the right place. She just wants everyone to stay on topic and focus so that you dont fall behind. She is always willing to help.

reviews.subject: ART101 (University Studies)
reviews.review: I have an A currently, super easy, the professor is just really rude sometimes for no reason; super easy class, for credits, do i,t and just move on with your life.

reviews.subject: 300 (University Studies)
reviews.review: Her class is easy, but she is so passive-aggressive. She makes a huge fuss over cameras on Zoom as if it automatically means you aren't paying attention. She called out a student in front of the class for taking notes when she thought he was distracted. I feel like she thinks we are beneath her.

reviews.subject: 300 (University Studies)
reviews.review: she is mean and strict over really silly things such as having your camera on and not eating while on zoom, also she explained the assignments in a very complicated way

reviews.subject: PHIL325 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: I really wanted to like this professor because of the positive reviews, but the class felt disorganized at times. The syllabus was provided late into the semester, there were frequent pop quizzes, and class time was occasionally lost to technical difficulties. The exams were also challenging given the large amount of material to review.

reviews.subject: PHIL349 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: Coplan was honestly the best professor I've ever had and made me commit to minoring in philosophy, she is so deeply passionate and kind. She gives amazing feedback on exams, which is truly worth the wait for her grading. She is a little disorganized, but always fair about it if you have any concerns. She is knowledgeable & truly inspirational!!!!

reviews.subject: PHILOSOPHY325 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: Amy is a passionate philosophy teacher, but her lectures lack clear structure and rarely use PowerPoint, relying mostly on verbal discussion. She often goes off-topic with politics and celebrity stories. Final grades aren't posted yet, and the final exam is very heavy, covering the entire semester.

reviews.subject: PHIL325 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: Excellent professor with incredible amounts of knowledge on the subject she teaches. The lecture's are entertaining and does amazing job stressing the importance of our teachings in our personal lives. She offers a lot of extra credit and is incredibly friendly. Definitely planning on taking her again!

reviews.subject: PHIL325 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: Amazing professor, though she can get sidetracked very easily. She is very passionate about philosophy, and she reflects that in her lectures. She does ask for a few readings and films throughout the semester, but they aren't very hard, and she cares more that you've tried than if you've gotten things 100% correct.

reviews.subject: PHIL325 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: i feel i expected too much out of this class. shes very disorganized with the canvas it's already week 5 into the semester and she hasn't even posted the syllabus. talks about some interesting topics but it doesn't help when her module section is so unorganized with random films/reading packets. funny professor but would rather not take her again

reviews.subject: 351 (Marketing)
reviews.review: Only now 5 years after graduation can I look back and realize how much I learned from Dr. Broyles.  Not only did I learn about marketing, I also learned about how to do marketing in my job today.  Sad he retired.

reviews.subject: MARKETING351 (Marketing)
reviews.review: Tough grader. Great slides and discussions. Difficult team project. Great teacher who cares about students.

reviews.subject: MARKETING351 (Marketing)
reviews.review: Broyles assigns a difficult team project, and his grading is tough. Get started early on that project or your grade will take a big hit. He does understand Marketing and cares about students.

reviews.subject: MKGT351 (Marketing)
reviews.review: Boring lectures. Extremely unprofessional, goes off topic all the time. Not very nice to guests. Drags on after class time is over.

reviews.subject: MARKE351 (Marketing)
reviews.review: Broyles is a tough grader. He didn't go over the group project much but graded it awfully hard, which was a thing the whole class agreed on. He is kind and teaches well but does grade hard. Everything on the test is based on things he discussed in class; therefore, you will not pass if you don't show up. Overall he is great but makes you work.

reviews.subject: MARKETING351 (Marketing)
reviews.review: Don't waste your money on a textbook because he does not use one. Exam are based on class discussions. Miss class and you likely won't pass.

reviews.subject: PSYCH391 (Psychology)
reviews.review: My online experience wasn't great. He shows a paper with notes to the camera on zoom. Points are only based on 3 exams. No assignments. I asked for extra credit and he declined. I have test anxiety so if you do too, I wouldn't recommend this class. (He seems like a great person, just unwilling to change his teaching style to benefit students).

reviews.subject: PSYC101 (Psychology)
reviews.review: i loved this class! make sure to write down his notes and remember his examples bc some are used in the exams (which are a little difficult). it didn't take him long to respond to emails, and he was very understanding when i asked for extensions on a few exams. he's also a very funny and engaging guy, would definitely take one of his classes again!

reviews.subject: PSYC391 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Bowman's online course is out of only 300 points  3 exams. There is no building your grade and if you do poorly on one exam, there is A LOT of pressure on the next. His exams are multiple choice/essay questions so you must be VERY detailed to get points. He does not use Zoom, he's super old school and records himself with a camera, hard to read.

reviews.subject: PSYC391 (Psychology)
reviews.review: He's an AMAZING professor! Lectures are funny & packed with great info. Take notes & there is no way you'll fail, he drops hints on what will be on the exam. I didn't use the book & still passed with 85%+ on all exams. Though your grade depends on only 3 exams & no EC, so if you do not have time to watch the lecture (2x/week) find a different prof.

reviews.subject: PSYC391 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Bowman is such a funny professor. Only 4 tests and NO papers. Lectures were asynchronous. Tests are very easy, multiple choice and short answers. Have to study the work to get a good grade. Overall very easy professor.

reviews.subject: PSYC391 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Prof. Bowman is really nice but his tests are challenging. He sends you a prerecorded lecture 2 times a week, are available for up to 2 weeks then are deleted. Grade is only based on 3 exams and there are no study guides and he doesn't tell you what will be on the test. About 38 MC and 3 short answer questions with only 1hr 20 mins to take it. :(

reviews.subject: FIN320 (Finance)
reviews.review: Lots of pratice questions that he emphasizes one which is more than you think but he does have a heavy accent thats kinda hard to understand so you really need to pay attention he sometimes talks away from the mic and doesn't speak loud enough as if he doesn't care if the class gets it or not.

reviews.subject: FINANCE320 (Finance)
reviews.review: Uses claude for the whole course.. not very helpful but its a pretty easy class

reviews.subject: FIN320 (Finance)
reviews.review: Very straightforward-even gives you an excel sheet to calculate your final grade. Lectures are a bit dry but the slides tell you everything you need to know for the exams. Attendance is flexible, but make sure to add attendance on the app, attendance is solely based on that. Allows cheat sheets. Success in this class is based on your own effort.

reviews.subject: FIN320 (Finance)
reviews.review: He genuinely wants you to succeed. Drops lowest quiz score and lowest homework score. Pay attention and show up to class and you will pass just fine. He's very understanding and passionate about the subject

reviews.subject: FIN320 (Finance)
reviews.review: He was a great professor and very knowledgeable. Always willing to help. Math is just hard for me, so I got a B-, which is better than what I thought I was going to get. I truly enjoyed learning about finance. Grading is based on quizzes and exams. No homework. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!

reviews.subject: FIN320 (Finance)
reviews.review: I really enjoyed Professor Akbulut's class.  I learned a lot and the material was really interesting.  He's a very generous grader and really wants his students to do well.  I would absolutely take him again if I have the chance.  Great professor!

reviews.subject: 150A (Mathematics)
reviews.review: For our class he wasn't a tough grader but the math was still hard. Most of the information he covers over lecture are relevent towards his exams. ALSO this class is Exam heavy so you should be ready to really study. Overall you need to put in the effort to pass this class but it's not impossible.

reviews.subject: 150B (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Great Prof, but his lectures can be abit boring and long sometimes. He gives all hw on webassign and can easily be ChapGPTed, though I wouldnt rec using AI for hw. The tests he gives are easier than the HW. If you can do the hw then you will ace the tests. He is a very tough grader so show ALL work on the tests. 3 tests and 1 final(combo of tests)

reviews.subject: 150A (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Tests make up most of your grade and he doesn't do quizzes. His homework can be tough, but the test questions are easier than the homework. His lectures are done on a whiteboard which means that he will sometimes block your view. He is more lenient on the final test as it is cumulative. Figure out how he wants the questions answered on the test!!!

reviews.subject: 150A (Mathematics)
reviews.review: He is a great Professor, and the better the professor the more respect they demand. He has rules and any interference will get you publicly scolded. I've sent him multiple apology emails for different incidents (I am not a normally bad student). His class is hard. But so is every Calculus class. You will need to study, 4 hours a week for me.

reviews.subject: 150A (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Class had 3 tests and 1 final exam that made up over 80% of the grade, with hw the rest. He is good at explaining concepts but goes fast sometimes. He gives one piece of homework for each part of the chapters covered in class. The tests were easier than the homework, but for sure take time with hw to do better on tests. Study old tests for final.

reviews.subject: CSC150B (Mathematics)
reviews.review: This professor has a specific teaching style that can be challenging. Lectures move quickly, and tests are graded strictly. However, engaging with the textbook and using study tools like Unstuck study can help you succeed. Overall, a manageable but demanding course.

reviews.subject: KNES191A (Kinesiology)
reviews.review: This professor is a great and inspirational lecturer, but her anatomy course can be quite difficult. Still, I would recommend. However, her co-leadership with Munoz is flawed hampered with sever miscommunication. She seems nice but can be very condemning. Awesome and hilarious, but lacks good leader skills and needs to focus on communication.

reviews.subject: KNES191A (Kinesiology)
reviews.review: the course material itself is difficult, but Barr is a great lecturer and is obviously passionate about what she teaches. but, she can be judgmental about questions asked in class. there are only a few exams in both lecture and lab, but the lecture exams are harder and impact your grade the most. a textbook is required but i got by without one.

reviews.subject: KNES349 (Kinesiology)
reviews.review: Don't listen to 1.0 grader on Barr. She's a wonderfully eccentric professor that has a sense of humor that can bother you if you're very sensitive, provides her own cheap textbook that's very well written, willing to break down any tough lecture/concepts if you ask, her exams/quizzes are exactly what she goes over. She's the best person for stats.

reviews.subject: KNES191A (Kinesiology)
reviews.review: Consists of 4 exams (all mc) and 4 lab practicals. Lab is easy, mainly memorization. TBH the lectures put me to sleep. Dr. Barr has a tendency to go off on a tangent and move through things really quickly. Didn't know what was happening half the time. Best thing to do is study ahead of time and ask any questions during lectures. Good luck.

reviews.subject: KNES349 (Kinesiology)
reviews.review: Professor Barr's class is a valuable one - her engaging lectures, clear explanations, and helpful resources like the course manual make it quite manageable. Unstuckstudy was a game-changer for my study prep too.

reviews.subject: 191A (Kinesiology)
reviews.review: This course is difficult. There's a lecture and lab, but don't worry the lab material is REALLY EASY. Dr. Barr lecture is quite difficult, so studying is a must weekly. She says extra credit on tests, but it's ridiculous because if you get them wrong it goes against you. The study guide sometimes don't help, but good luck.

reviews.subject: Phys227 (Physics)
reviews.review: Probably the best professor I've ever had, and as long as you study the homework, the quizzes and exams are pretty easy to pass. He's super funny, caring, and an amazing lecturer; you understand everything perfectly. If you're wondering whether to take him or the other profs, from what I've heard, they're a nightmare, so he's an easy choice.

reviews.subject: PHYS225 (Physics)
reviews.review: AMAZING professor, DIFFICULT class. Dubuque is a SAINT. Accessible outside of class, nothing to purchase, and VERY PASSIONATE about physics. Grades everything on time, and will give you full credit even if your final answer is wrong if the work is right. If you need to take physics, TAKE DUBUQUE AT ALL COSTS.

reviews.subject: PHYS225 (Physics)
reviews.review: Mr. Dubuque is a great professor. He has very engaging lectures and covers all material that will be on the tests. His grading is fair where the only thing he cares about is using the right method. He also curves a small amount. Overall, great class if you show up and pay attention. There is no required textbook or participation.

reviews.subject: 211 (Physics)
reviews.review: Great Proffesor! His practice problems are exactly like the exams. He does not assign homework, but recommends doing the practice problems for 30 minutes a week. There are pop quizzes, but he tells you the possible quiz dates on the syllabus. Your grade is only based on the quizzes and exams, so you have to really understand each topic.

reviews.subject: 211 (Physics)
reviews.review: Professor Dubuque is gives such great lectures, and the classes and demos in class are super funny. I loved every moment of this class. If you do the problem set and pay attention during lectures you should be good for the class

reviews.subject: PHYS211 (Physics)
reviews.review: No homework to cushion you grade. Pop quizzes are 6-10 minutes long and is a memorization game. Not a fan of Mike and the way his class is structured. I like his teaching style but as a person he can come off as callous.

reviews.subject: COMM110 (Human Communication Studies)
reviews.review: Showing up to class is a must, he takes roll. Not too bad of an instructor. Can ramble off sometimes but overall a good professor and you leave the class ready to give a presentation.

reviews.subject: SPCH130 (Human Communication Studies)
reviews.review: Tough grader but enjoyable class.

reviews.subject: HCOM100 (Human Communication Studies)
reviews.review: Cool teacher that tries to make the class as interesting as possible. Straight forward with grading on speeches. Midterm and final exam are purely based on the textbook/notes, (mainly textbook) so the book is necessary. Overall solid choice for a professor.

reviews.subject: SPCH130 (Human Communication Studies)
reviews.review: Was a cool teacher. Grades well. Very understanding!

reviews.subject: COMM20 (Human Communication Studies)
reviews.review: He does not give a lot homework

reviews.subject: HCOM100 (Human Communication Studies)
reviews.review: Great teacher with excellent PowerPoints and lessons. However, there are few opportunities to raise your grade. Speeches are tough with harsh grading.

reviews.subject: PSY341 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Awesome professor, so sorry that she has retired. Best professor at CSUF!

reviews.subject: PSY341 (Psychology)
reviews.review: I would not recommend. Her exams look like she did not proofread them. I am not sure If I will be tested on actual facts or things she makes up.

reviews.subject: PSYCH341 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Her quizzes and exams are full of grammatical errors. It shows how much time she puts into making her exams. Her questions as you read them are hard to interpret. She uses too many "scenarios" where you decipher what approach she's talking about. The "lectures" if thats what you want to call them don't correlate with her exams. You're on your own.

reviews.subject: PSYC341 (Psychology)
reviews.review: I do not recommend taking this professor's online classes, especially if you have a restrictive schedule like I do. I take online classes because I have 2 jobs and I need to be able to do coursework on the time that I do have, but her many assignments, quizzes and exams are always due at 5 PM, rather than at midnight like most professors.

reviews.subject: PSYC101 (Psychology)
reviews.review: I enjoyed her class so much! She engages the class and makes material more fun. Her class wasn't the easiest as her exams were tough even though all M/C. You must read the book to do well on exams on not rely only on PPT slides. HW is easy, but you must be present in class to get the info from her. The paper was easy and she gives you 2 attempts.

reviews.subject: PSYCH1 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Professor Ake was a joy, although I was expecting another professor, I got her instead and she was great! Her lectures consisted of power points, which are easy to follow % you can print them to be able to write side notes on them. There are a couple papers, but are! Her tests are extremely difficult, but if you go to class, you'll get a good grade

reviews.subject: BUAD360 (Accounting)
reviews.review: Professor Tarantino is awesome! She really cares about her students and brings in a variety of guest speakers. Two of those guest speakers actually helped people get careers in their companies. She lectures well and I wish I could take more classes with her. Just make sure to study and stay on top of the work and you will be fine!

reviews.subject: BUAD360 (Accounting)
reviews.review: 4 exams, 10 quizzes that were once a week, 3 extra credit opportunities. Come to class because participation points matter at the end of the semester. For the exams, review all PP slides and the study guide she gives. Pay attention to calculation problems she does in class; it's not the same in the book and she puts her examples on the exams.

reviews.subject: BUAD360 (Accounting)
reviews.review: If a different teacher ever teaches this class take them instead. She didn't really seem to care about our class and it was obvious she had too much on her plate. Use the study guide for the exams. Covers a few things from the PP in class very generally but wants very specific answers for the exams. 4 exams, 10 quizzes, participation, etc.

reviews.subject: BUAD360 (Accounting)
