reviews.review: This class was a challenge. Class is out of 300 pts. 2 Exams (50 pts each) and 1 cumulative final (100 pts).  There are weekly quizzes, so do well on those since they add up. YOU MUST READ THE BOOK AND REVIEW THE PPT SLIDES TO DO WELL ON EXAMS & QUIZZES! Tests are a mix of MC, T/F, computation, definition, and fill in blank. She does curve exams!

reviews.subject: ACC201B (Accounting)
reviews.review: The class itself is pretty difficult but she curves the exams and the homework is easy. Be prepared to read the book and study every week because there is a quiz every week. Professor Kim wants her students to succeed and brings in real world examples to try to make the class more interesting. Take her!

reviews.subject: ACCT201B (Accounting)
reviews.review: Prof Kim is one of your best choices for 201B! Quiz every class, 4 tests, 2 writing assign's, easy online HW, and that common final! NO CASE STUDIES! She curved almost every exam! Her tests were a little hard and on the tricky side. All MC and a few computational problems. I plan on taking her for BUAD 360 for the E&TM program in Fall semester.

reviews.subject: BIO360 (Biological Sciences)
reviews.review: Chill prof (asynch class so go figure). Responds to emails in a timely and professional matter. No midterms/finals, just quizzes/knowledge checks. KCs have a weird error where even one wrong answer on a matching/multiple answer question marks entire thing wrong; she + her TA go back, give partial credit (EPIC). A LOT of info, but it's a bio class.

reviews.subject: BIOL101L (Biological Sciences)
reviews.review: Definitely recommend this month-long winter GE class. Easy professor, manageable assignments, lots of mini group work during 5 Zoom meets, no final, easy quizzes. Starts on time, cameras optional, Zoom wrap-ups help with quizzes. Stay on top of work for a good grade. 5/5!!

reviews.subject: BIOL101L (Biological Sciences)
reviews.review: I don't understand all the negative reviews here; Professor Henderson was great. Her course was very organized, and despite some activities being time consuming, none of the work was actually difficult. She doesn't require any books or course materials, which is an added bonus.

reviews.subject: BIO360 (Biological Sciences)
reviews.review: SUPER easy UD GE compared to how I thought it would be (COMM major here). About 2 weekly quizzes and a semester long grp prjct which wasn't bad at all. For a bio class, it was very easy to complete. Also, the textbook is well written and easy to follow, plus there are short lecture videos that cover most of what you need to know. Highly recommend.

reviews.subject: BIO101 (Biological Sciences)
reviews.review: Incredibly difficult. Why do I get my writing assignment back 2 months after the due date? She is not worth taking.

reviews.subject: BIO101 (Biological Sciences)
reviews.review: The amount of work she gives for an online GE is insane. Her quizzes are hard. I am a good student, and I study, yet I still find myself having trouble. This is one of the reasons I don't like biology because of it being affiliated with tough teachers who give everything online with no lecture videos. My major courses aren't even this tough!

reviews.subject: ANTH344 (Anthropology)
reviews.review: 10000000/10. Would definitely take this professor again in the future. Actually looked forward to attending class. Highly recommend !

reviews.subject: ANTH322 (Anthropology)
reviews.review: Took this class not expecting much but it ended up being my favorite class. Professor Rose always gave us about 15 minutes at the start to discuss almost anything then moved into the lecture. The lectures were never boring because he actively involved students, and the exams were laid back and easy to pass if you paid attention and did the reading.

reviews.subject: ANTH322 (Anthropology)
reviews.review: one of the best classes i've taken at csuf. the professor is funny and really encourages conversation/critical thinking. i genuinely looked forward to attending (which is good bc he gives points for showing up). would highly recommend him !!

reviews.subject: ANTH344 (Anthropology)
reviews.review: Great professor. If most of the class participates, he skips homework assignments. Overall, great class and the topics are interesting. Want an easy grade? Take this class!!!

reviews.subject: ANTH322 (Anthropology)
reviews.review: Great professor! He is hilarious and passionate about teaching. This is my second class with Brandon and I loved both. 100/10 made science fun

reviews.subject: ANTH344 (Anthropology)
reviews.review: A hard attendance policy of only 2 missed classes, 5% deduction after that. No homework, but no canvas. I found he was rude despite trying to seem cool. Also, was citing FOX News and outdated sources for the majority of class.

reviews.subject: 361 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Super nice and easy going. Very easy to approach and ask questions and wants to see all of her students succeed. Great professor.

reviews.subject: PSYC361 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Great Professor! She is very caring, organized, and gives clear criteria for what she expects us to do on each assignment. She is strict about grammar and the quality of the essay, but if you follow her guidelines, you'll get good grades. There are 4 exams throughout the semester. The study guides she provided were super helpful. Easy A, fun class.

reviews.subject: PSY361 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Highly recommend this professor, she helped me understand the material and is very caring about students. She was open to students sharing their experiences and provided a safe environment. Her assignments were easy, just do the work and study and you will pass!

reviews.subject: PSY110 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Dr. Lisa is an inspiring professor. Her engaging lectures and manageable workload make this class a joy. Unstuck AI was a huge help for exam prep. Highly recommend taking her in-person if possible.

reviews.subject: PSYC110 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Dr. Weisman is exactly the person you want to take for PSYC110. Her class was enjoyable, and her lectures were fun. She truly cares about you as a student and will listen if you are struggling in anyway.

reviews.subject: PSYC110 (Psychology)
reviews.review: super caring prof with an army of TAs that are itching to help u. attendance is not required but u have to buy her textbook and since its hers u cant find it for free. weekly homework through her textbook website. exams are in person based on in class lectures so if u pay attention they r easy.has a couple papers as well but provides great feedback

reviews.subject: ENG301 (English)
reviews.review: Cool dude I would say. He does get pretty political but he does not care if you write in opposition of his views (he encourages it). He knows his stuff and will inspire you to write. Only complaint I have is the consistency of his classes. Sometimes he would end super early or cancel last minute. To be fair he was pretty sick this semester.

reviews.subject: ENG301 (English)
reviews.review: Prof. Bonca is very passionate about english and writing. He actually cares about his students and wants them to become better writers as well. On top of that he is a great speaker and provides great feedback for every paper. Would take another class from him again if it aligned with my major.

reviews.subject: ENG301 (English)
reviews.review: Professor NEVER uses Canvas, everything is turned in via printed papers & doesn't input grades throughout the semester. Attendance isn't mandatory but you must show up to participate in edit groups & to submit papers. Only assignments are filling out an online journal throughout the semester & writing 5 tedious papers that you need to peer review.

reviews.subject: 222 (English)
reviews.review: He's pretty scattered-brained and is also a very difficult grader--get ready to read and write a ton.  The class is basically all lectures that aren't that interesting. I'd try someone else!

reviews.subject: 463 (English)
reviews.review: An amazing lecturer, I loved showing up to class. A lot of reading but great novels. Around 10 books in total at the pace of one book per week. Fair grader, very challenging class! Prof. Bonca will make you think critically about every novel. The final is harrddddd, so don't forget to read read read!! Only downside is you can't make up journals

reviews.subject: 200 (English)
reviews.review: Lecture heavy class. Only communication for out of class is email. The daily journal entries are tough, if missed, you can't make them up. Difficult grader on essay papers. Passionate about what he talks about, but didn't get a single grade in the grade book until three weeks before the class ended (it was the midterm). For an A, just go to class.

reviews.subject: PHIL106 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: Very easy professor, super chill and is always there to help you out when you are struggling. Easy A

reviews.subject: PHIL106 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: Very passionate about what he teaches! Not too many professors are like this. He is always there to help you out when you need it and wants you to pass his class. All you need to do is pay attention, take notes, and you'll pass.

reviews.subject: PHIL106 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: okay... take a diff professor if possible

reviews.subject: PHIL106 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: Professor Rowley tries too hard to be funny, which gets awkward fast. His class is heavily test-based with harsh grading, limited study materials, and unclear explanations at times. Definitely not an easy GE, and he can be very nitpicky over small details.

reviews.subject: PHIL106 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: So much homework, like 30-50 problem sets. Sometimes wouldn't explain things clearly when you asked a straightforward question. A lot of memorization for a GE class based on stuff youll never use again.

reviews.subject: MATH110 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: It's the first week of school and I'm already disliking this teacher, we actually had work due before we even had our first zoom class and she wasn't willing to extend the assignments at first. She also is bad at responding emails. She does not care about you or your grade she doesn't trust canvas grading so you don't know your grade in her class…

reviews.subject: MATH-170B (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Lowkey the hardest thing about Converse's class is the homework since the majority is on Harris Learning Solutions and its so easy to forget the deadlines. Her lectures are really informative and she is very willing to answer any of your doubts so go to them!! You have 2 midterms + 1 cumulative final. For 170B, she's great!

reviews.subject: MATH110 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Professor Converse was one of my favorites by far. While math may not be the easiest to learn she does the most to help her students understand. For exams she provides study guides that make preparing for the exam so much easier. Provides extra credit on exams. Overall super sweet and caring, would definitely recommend.

reviews.subject: MATH-170B (Mathematics)
reviews.review:
I took her 170B class in Fall 2024 - let me tell you something, she is definitely one of the BEST math professors I've had in a very long time. This class is one of the reasons why I wanted to do a math minor. 

Love Dr. Converse to pieces. Highly recommend.

reviews.subject: MATH110 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Professor Converse is a pretty bad teacher. The lessons themselves weren't difficult to understand but she somehow made it so confusing. You will have to take time after class to reteach yourself everything. You will have to pay for online homework/textbook. Only 4 in person exams and 1 final. I recommend you choose someone else to make it easy.

reviews.subject: 170b (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Very nice prof, a lot of homework, but the tests are very easy as she gives out a study guide which is the test just with different numbers a day before the exam. As long as you do that, you will receive 100%. She is very nice in class and is very energetic, which wakes me up even when I'm sleepy.

reviews.subject: POSC100 (Political Science)
reviews.review: He is a very tough grader. Even though you try your best on your assignment, with his revised comments and recommendations, he only gives you 50% of the grade, 50% of the grade for that assignment was the highest score among students in the class. If you want someone who could actually help you, this professor is definitely not the one.

reviews.subject: POSC100 (Political Science)
reviews.review: Professor Spitzer was a pretty cool teacher. Long heavy lectures, but worth it and necessary for midterms/finals. HW given in Inquizitive, where the textbooks are as well but pretty expensive - maybe $60? - so be prepared for that. Pretty laid-back guy until people kept being disrespectful of the class; don't be one of them! Anyway, cool class. :)

reviews.subject: POSC100 (Political Science)
reviews.review: Professor Scott had us study for 2 or 3 midterms on top of a Town hall Meeting project which consisted of an EXTRA research paper other classes didn't have to do. PLUS a required online textbook+homework AND was very lecture heavy. So much for a level 100 class. I would avoid taking.

reviews.subject: POSC100 (Political Science)
reviews.review: Professor Spitzer is a great professor. Be prepared to read if you're taking him in the summer, but it's honestly not that bad if you just put in the work. Not a tough grader, just put some effort into your papers. Quizzes can be taken until you pass with 100%. Quizzes are weekly but easy!

reviews.subject: POSC100 (Political Science)
reviews.review: Below mediocre teacher. The lectures are terrible/long and added nothing to my education. The short essay tests are harshly graded and you're given no feedback. The Inquizitive/Norton ecosystem is riddled with technical issues and very annoying/unfair. He puts everything on the study guide and it's all from the book - Easy A, but I learned nothing.

reviews.subject: POL100 (Political Science)
reviews.review: Honestly, the class is very easy. People are just lazy and do not put in the work. We had a group project partner for the town hall meeting that never showed up or did any of the work. Professor Spitzer worked with our group. Exams are very easy if you pay attention and take notes

reviews.subject: MKT370 (Marketing)
reviews.review: He gave really enjoyable lectures and opened up discussion amongst the class (by volunteer). There was a good amount of group work, but enough students per team that it didn't feel like too much. Moderate amount of work, but nothing very difficult

reviews.subject: MKTG370 (Marketing)
reviews.review: Don't rely on Canvas calendars and to-do list to see what's due. Discussions are often due at 5 PM instead of 11:59 PM so this professor isn't for those who have work. Lectures and such are organized and easy to digest with study programs like Quizlet. Quizzes were straightforward. You just need to understand the content and not memorize it.

reviews.subject: MTKG370 (Marketing)
reviews.review: Only quizzes no exams, discussions, one simulation done throughout the semester, and group projects. Very straightforward. He does give feedback on assignments.

reviews.subject: 351 (Marketing)
reviews.review: Avoid this professor - they don't seem to care much about students passing. Try using unstuckstudy and other study resources to get through this class if you must take it.

reviews.subject: MKTG370 (Marketing)
reviews.review: Pretty easy class, mostly group work and only 4 quizzes. If you attend class and read lectures in canvas, you'll be fine. He does talk a lot in class but the content isn't hard to understand.

reviews.subject: MKTG370 (Marketing)
reviews.review: He is a solid professor, not the best, but not the worst. Lots of group work, so if you don't have a good group, it will be hard—no exams and quizzes, weekly projects, and other little assignments to help your grade. He is a good choice, out minimal effort and you can pass the class.

reviews.subject: PSY101 (Psychology)
reviews.review: He had detailed lectures and was always thorough. A lot of what you need to know to pass the class is in the book. He talks about sex too much and gets off topic from lectures sometimes. If you have this professor, make sure youre ready to read the entire book! Tests are very tough. He says up front that many students dont pass his class.

reviews.subject: PSY101 (Psychology)
reviews.review: IF YOU CAN'T STUDY TO SAVE YOUR LIFE THIS CLASS WILL BE DIFFICULT. However, if you take the time to study, show up to class, and memorize the vocab you should do pretty good. The class isn't hard, but his lectures are long but very informational. He loves to talk about sex, and drugs in his lectures, so it was pretty enjoyable. Good luck!

reviews.subject: PSY101 (Psychology)
reviews.review: This class is way too difficult to be a G.E. Lectures are very long and boring, he uses the full time to the very last second. Also, his exams are almost impossible to pass... I spent days studying and still failed. Do not take this class!!

reviews.subject: PSY101 (Psychology)
reviews.review: He's a great professor! The level he teaches would be like those teachers from AP classes. You need to read the chapters because some stuff is briefly mentioned during lecture if he doesn't have time. Although attendance isn't mandatory, it's helpful. Some things he says in class WILL be in the tests. MUST study and read!!!!!

reviews.subject: PSY101 (Psychology)
reviews.review: MUST read the psych book to do well in exams, lots of things he does not cover. He puts questions on the exams that you would only know if you show up to class, really specific things he mentions. Nice guy, easy to talk to, humorous from time to time. Lectures are slow.

reviews.subject: ISDS361B (Business)
reviews.review: Dont even bother taking this professor. He is really hard to understand, and I mean it. The course structure is hard to follow. The homework on cengage just doesnt make sense. Nevetheless, if you really put a ton of hours in outside of class, then maybe you get a high grade. If youre taking 6 or even 5 class, or have work, dont take him.

reviews.subject: 361B (Business)
reviews.review: Not very good at communicating, takes forever to respond to emails. Class structure is bad, Cengage was not linked with Canvas like almost all classes ever, meaning you have to go onto the Cengage website to see if you have homework. Course material is pretty understandable, but definitely recommend taking another professor.

reviews.subject: ISDS361B (Business)
reviews.review: You have to put alot of time outside of class to understand how to do the calculations. He can be difficult to understand. 3 exams worth most of your grade. He does offer plenty of extra credit so I would suggest to do all of them.

reviews.subject: ISDS361B (Business)
reviews.review: Professor has a heavy accent!!! In addition his lecture structure is very poor!!!! Homework is very difficult and time consuming. Take this class with another professor!!!!

reviews.subject: ISDS361B (Business)
reviews.review: This class is very challenging, but using unstuck AI alongside the textbook and practice problems can really help. The professor's accent makes lectures difficult, so attending class and asking questions is a must to pass.

reviews.subject: ISDS361B (Business)
reviews.review: I don't think its the prof that's hard, but the class in general is very very difficult. Offers lots of material to help you learn. I would recommend watching the YouTube videos rather than his lectures. Homework, quiz and extra credit for each chapter. 3 exams, allowed to have a cheat sheet, power points and excel when taking exams

reviews.subject: BIO362 (Biological Sciences)
reviews.review: The tests are hard and they will make you doubt yourself. You need to put in the time to secure your own knowledge and mastery of the material. Darryl had his office hours multiple times during the week. I recommend going to his office hours and at least listening to other students' questions since his classes cover much of the same material

reviews.subject: BIOL191B (Biological Sciences)
reviews.review: I really liked Darryl! His tests were very confusing, though! This class made some people have to drop out of the nursing program, so if you're a nursing major, get ready to study! My advice is to use his lecture outlines as a study guide and read all of the recommended readings in the textbook! Go to his office hours!! he likes visitors :)

reviews.subject: BIO210 (Biological Sciences)
reviews.review: I am generally decent with anatomy but upon taking this class, almost everything made no sense. No powerpoints, homework, or attendance for participation. He just explains concepts with real life situations, not really explaining what everything means. His tests are really confusing. After taking the class, a lot of my classmates failed his class.

reviews.subject: BIOL361 (Biological Sciences)
reviews.review: As someone w/ many years at CSUF under their belt I will say this. Anatomy isnt easy, hence why its covered in med school. The workload is very demanding. But since smith is an anatomist, he communicates the subject very well. Physiology isn't his thing, which is why he has a rep of being tough. But this class is doable with enough dedication.

reviews.subject: BIOL210 (Biological Sciences)
reviews.review: Professor Smith was the only professor available to take the course, so I just placed into the class without thinking much. The class grade consist of mainly 3 exams. Each exam is 100 points and 30 points for participation. He talks about his life or scenarios that could relate to anatomy and the rest is lecture. There's barely any power points..

reviews.subject: BIO362 (Biological Sciences)
reviews.review: He seriously is a terrible professor. Exams are nothing like what he lectures on. He is not approachable at all. Do not take. You will regret it.

reviews.subject: PSY302 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Graded of discussion posts and replies, essay (with rewrite), and two exams. The initial discussion post is due at 12pm Wednesday, and the two replies are due Friday at 12pm. Exams and discussions are based on the book. Overall, easy class but lots of reading.

reviews.subject: PSY302 (Psychology)
reviews.review: I really enjoyed this class. It took on a new perspective of learning and memory. There are discussion posts each week. Opens Fri, initial post due Wed (12pm), and 2 responses due Fri (12pm). One midterm and one final. One final essay that you get to rewrite. Need to go to lecture since there are no lecture slides posted.

reviews.subject: 306 (Psychology)
reviews.review: A chill class with interesting material. The professor is helpful in office hours, and the TAs are great. unstuck ai was a lifesaver for prep.

reviews.subject: PSY302 (Psychology)
reviews.review: One of the most chill professors I have ever had. I don't know if this semester was a fluke or anything, but it was literally the easiest class I had. Weekly discussion posts based on the book (which I found online for free), Midterm, Final exam, and term paper. Term paper is a free A as it allows a resubmission after correcting it from feedback.

reviews.subject: 304L (Psychology)
reviews.review: Great lectures. He made the materials  easy to understand, pretty straightforward on tests.

reviews.subject: PSY302 (Psychology)
reviews.review: This class was an independent learning course. There were weekly discussions; they opened Fri. afternoon and they would be due on Wed. at noon. His TA's were very helpful. The discussion posts were 20pts ea, and if you turned it in late 10pts were deducted, which is a lot of pts. We only had one exam and a paper. This class isn't too bad.

reviews.subject: PSYC351 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Such an easy professor I have taken her twice for social psyc and psyc of human sex. Suupperrr easy to do great in!

reviews.subject: PSY312 (Psychology)
reviews.review: if you're a psyc major, TAKE HER. her grading criteria is clear and wants to make things as easy as possible for her students and herself. you MUST attend class, as she does not use titanium or powerpoints. everything said in class will be on your exam. overall, great professor, although lecture can be a drag. 4 exams, 75 pts, 1 ppr, 20 pts.

reviews.subject: PSYC312 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Professor Keesling was great! Her class was very interesting and she is hilarious! Only thing is the room was kinda big and it was difficult to hear her at times, other than that only 4 exams and 1 paper. You do not have to buy the book her exams are literally based off her lectures! (do not skip class her lectures are crucial for exams)

reviews.subject: PSYCH312 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Professor Keesling made this class very interesting and easy to understand. The class consisted of four exams which she tells you the majority of the answers and things to know on it if you show up to the lecture before the test. There was also one paper, 2 pages max on a movie about sex. Definitely take this class with her!

reviews.subject: PSYC317 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Dr. Keesling is an amazing professor who is an expert in the field. Her class consisted of 4 non cumulative exams and one paper that she basically formats for us and all you do is fill in the blanks. She is old school, so no PPTs or online work, it is all written on the board so don't miss class, she is so hilarious though you wont want to miss.

reviews.subject: PSYCH312 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Dr. Keesling is a "Meh" teacher. The class is conducted by (4) 75 Q's including the Final (all tests are non-cumulative) & an "easy" 2 pg paper. Emphasize on "easy" bc if you do the preliminary paper it is, but if you choose not to you will most likely get a C due to her being a hard grader. Pls, do it since every point matters & no extra credit...

reviews.subject: AMST324 (Women's Studies)
reviews.review: She was a good teacher and was eager about what she taught. Lectures were fun and engaging, but when it came to exams, she was very strict. She would only give us 3 days to write a whole 8-10 page essay on a topic she chose, and we had to use 8 scholarly sources. That's not enough time; also, she would always assume we used AI to get it done.

reviews.subject: AMST345 (Women's Studies)
reviews.review: fully online, she has a tough rubric and multiple texts for assignments. hard deadlines but she does provide a lot of feedback or tell you where you missed points. class itself is pretty fun and nuanced (not just history based) so a lot of it is graded on your conceptual understanding which is also better imo. fairly decent class

reviews.subject: AMST345 (Women's Studies)
reviews.review: This professor sent this whole class into a spiral. She was EXTERMLY strict when it came to AI and making sure nobody use it. Make sure you try hard when it comes to writing she grades hard, but she does care and sees effort. Theres a lot of video and discussion posts.

reviews.subject: AMST324 (Women's Studies)
reviews.review: If you're looking for a class to breeze through... this isn't a class for you. Content is interesting, and she makes the learning fun and understandable. BUT Each week there's 3-4 readings, and the Midterm/Final essays are extremely intense. she gives less than 2 days to write a 10 page paper that you don't know the instructions for until it opens.

reviews.subject: AMST345 (Women's Studies)
reviews.review: Her class is super easy if you actually listen to her. Weekly participation, 2 short-answer exams, and 3 papers, in which you can write without sticking to a specific format or having to cite, and she literally says "write the way you speak, it's more fun and I know you're not using AI." Everyone hating lowkey might be slow lol.

reviews.subject: AMST324 (Women's Studies)
reviews.review: For a GE class, this was wayyy too much. Grading was EXTREMELY harsh, not enough time for quizzes/exams, super long time waiting for scores, LOTS of reading, minimal feedback, and always accused class of using AI. Would not take again :(

reviews.subject: BUAD201 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: all semester he was rude and dismissive. he snapped at students for simple things and made me dread coming to class. he was a harsh grader and talks down on you. he loves the power play and that he is in control. very much be nice or don't do well. the class itself was easy but I feel like it would be better if I took it with another professor

reviews.subject: BAUD201 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: very monotone lack of passion obviously doesn't wanna be there , opiniated grading, to do well u must write/think like him. you will write simulated email scenarios but don't take them lightly he grades harshly you must accustomed to his liking since he can get pretty sasssy, hard to please, should be last resort choice

reviews.subject: BAUD201 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: i was rather judgmental with my consensus on Mr. Axtell after the first day as his impression left a bleak impression via my amygdala... However, after the semester, my impression on him has changed! would i take him again? prolly not but he and his class are very straightforward. Listen up listen LISTEN to his instructions, & youll do fine

reviews.subject: BAUD201 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: Honestly not a bad professor. Just pay attention and be aware of what he puts on his slides. They are simple and straight to the point but the information covered is what will help you pass your three exams and final. Class is mostly working with others doing a small class assignment. Lastly, there is a group project in which is important.

reviews.subject: BAUD201 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: The class itself is pretty easy, but hes a tough grader and lacks actual feedback on tests. He is super sarcastic and can be rude sometimes. Theres one group project towards the end of the semester. A bunch of small group work during throughout the semester. 3 exams one final but it isn't cumulative.

reviews.subject: BAUD201 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: Just avoid this class when you ask questions he will use his own class teachings instead of helping you, always has very specific instructions but also vague at the same time because if you meet them there will be other random finite things found to take points off. Just save yourself the time and stress from this G.E class that's utterly useless.

reviews.subject: POSC321 (Political Science)
reviews.review: Professor Ting is a great lecturer who breaks down complex topics. The 3 exams are tough, but his study guides are extremely helpful. Using unstuck AI for practice really boosted my understanding of the material.

reviews.subject: 321 (Political Science)
reviews.review: amazing professor, the class is very easy to pass if you simply attend. The class is just based off 3  exams, but he goes thru everything slowly until everyone gets it. He is so patient and does not try tricking you. would 10/10 recommend

reviews.subject: 321 (Political Science)
reviews.review: Professor Ting is the best professor i've had at CSUF! He is an amazing and caring professor who made me feel very confident in my work and motivated me. Your grade is based on exams, but he provides study guides and sets clear expectations on how to pass. Attendance is not mandatory but recommend as the material will be on tests.

reviews.subject: POSC321 (Political Science)
reviews.review: His lectures can be hard to follow along with, but he is not here to trick his students. His study guides match the tests and he goes over them thoroughly. He only grades on three tests but we didn't have a final.

reviews.subject: POSC321 (Political Science)
reviews.review: Professor Ting is a very kind person and wants his students to succeed. Attendance is not mandatory but in order to do well on the 3 exams it is important to show up and take notes. As long as you do that the class is a breeze even though the material is mathematically orientated.

reviews.subject: POSC321 (Political Science)
reviews.review: Although attendance is not required, please make sure to go as it deals with math. The professor is flexible and you can always ask him questions. He has a great teaching style and you will feel like a safe environment. There are only exams and an extra credit to help with the final exam.

reviews.subject: BUAD301 (Education)
reviews.review: Prof Yasger has the ability to teach a lot to her students but wastes tons of time being late or calling students names. There's lots of extra credit through quizzes but mostly everyone in the class failed or barely passed every assignment because her grading is insane, even when you do exactly what she told you to do. Do not recommend.

reviews.subject: CAS300 (Education)
reviews.review: Sue's a sweet, TALKATIVE, and very sarcastic teacher. She gives spelling, grammar, and proofreading quizzes every class period (super easy if you're good at those) and you can rewrite the ones you missed to gain full points. However, she is ALWAYS late, talks for 90% of the class about her cats and its VERY specific about writing. Easy A if you go.

reviews.subject: BUAD301 (Education)
reviews.review: Don't let her easy funny demeanor fool you. Make sure you do well in her weekly quizzes and earn those extra credit as it will save you. Her papers are extremely hard (no content) just her grading style is super subjective. She is funny and always misses her lectures but when she's there, funny as heck.

reviews.subject: CAS300 (Education)
reviews.review: She's a tough grader, no doubt. She allows extra credit and redos for your quizzes which will help you overall. Do the papers she assigns AS DIRECTED because she will call you out! Overall, I liked her class and she's a great professor. I would recommend her to anyone!

reviews.subject: CAS300 (Education)
reviews.review: Sue is a great professor. Probably my favorite of all time. She cares about what happens to you, but she'll tell it like it is. Her extra credit is super easy, so DO IT ALL. She pretty much goes over everything with you in class too. EASY A+

reviews.subject: CAS300 (Education)
reviews.review: Took her class in fall 2018. She is a tough grader!!!! The extra credit she offers can really help your grade. She does not mind telling you everything that is wrong with your papers/assignments; she can be brutal about it!

reviews.subject: 3DDESIGN (Fine Arts)
reviews.review: I ended with a B+ on canvas after the final. He input my grade as a D- because he didnt like how I pushed back on his suggestion for one of the projects. Was required to take the class again with a different professor. Completely different experience. If you can avoid his class, do it. I looked into him. His own son hates him. Very unhappy person.

reviews.subject: ART104 (Fine Arts)
reviews.review: Literally, you'll pass if you bug him about every little thing you're confused about. TALK. The structure is this: he gives you the requirements & examples, and then you follow. He doesn't grade a lot, so talk with him about reworks if needed.

reviews.subject: ART104 (Fine Arts)
reviews.review: Listen very closely to the advice he gives you and other students. They're essential to getting a passing grade. It's not just advice to make your work look nicer, but a clear gudeline on getting an A. Be prepared to spend money on supplies and talk to him **every day** to make sure you're doing well. He's chill tho I enojoyed the class lots.

reviews.subject: ART104 (Fine Arts)
reviews.review: The key to passing: build a relationship with him. He walks around to answer questions, offers chances for resubmission and e.c. if unsatisfied w/grade, and gives strong critique. If your work, even if not a masterpiece, reflects improvement thru use of his critique, you should be fine grade-wise. Also study rock songs from the 80s- trust.

reviews.subject: ART104 (Fine Arts)
reviews.review: Not an easy class but if you show up to class and do your project you will do just fine. Don't be afraid to ask him questions, thats the best way to get a good grade.

reviews.subject: 3DART (Fine Arts)
reviews.review: you can only miss 3 classes if more then letter grade down no matter circumstances  which is unfortunate since many were sick reasons

reviews.subject: PSYC331 (Psychology)
reviews.review: I am so happy that I chose Professor Huft! He's a really talented lecturer, and everything he shares in lectures really helps with discussion videos and tests. I often struggle taking good notes from lectures, but his lectures were so clear & interesting that the notes helped me on the test. He was caring, and test questions were direct.

reviews.subject: PSYC110 (Psychology)
reviews.review: I was expecting this class to be TOUGH but i loved watching is lectures and each lecture had a lot of enthusiasm and energy put into it so it wasn't boring to watch and learn. His quizzes are pretty straight forward. The only reason i ended with a C is because my papers weren't written that well but that's on me. He is a very encouraging professor!

reviews.subject: PSYC331 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Professor Huft's PSYC331 class is straightforward and engaging. Discussions, quizzes, and papers make up the grading, but he provides helpful feedback and extra credit opportunities. unstuck study was a great study tool alongside the lectures. Overall, an enjoyable class!

reviews.subject: PSYC110 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Great professor! Workload easy to manage and learned a lot. You can tell he wants his students to succeed. Two papers which were graded a bit intensely but other than that amazing course and professor! Take his class

reviews.subject: PSYC331 (Psychology)
reviews.review: He is very kind and cares about his students doing well in course, his lectures are short but engaging and gets to the point. Turn in all assignments on time and you will do well. Only con would be his TAs since they seem to grade differently and be strict at times.

reviews.subject: PSYC331 (Psychology)
reviews.review: great professor. the class is straightforward, discussions every week, a couple quizzes and then some easy-ish papers. would recommend!

reviews.subject: MKTG353 (Marketing)
reviews.review: A lot of the time, I had no clue what was going on, and it felt like the class was pretty unstructured. At one point, I honestly hoped I wouldn't pass so I could drop her class

reviews.subject: MKTG353 (Marketing)
reviews.review: Professor Atwong's class is a mixed bag - the lectures can be dry, but her genuine care for students shines through. While the exams are challenging, using study tools like unstuck ai helped me stay on top of the material. Overall, a tough but rewarding experience.

reviews.subject: MKTG353 (Marketing)
reviews.review: She's nice as a person, but I hated her class. Her lectures were so boring and felt pointless to come to class for, everything is on Canvas. Worst final I've ever had!! Basically everyone failed. It wasn't on anything we had been taught and even the study guide was not helpful at all. You should still be able to pass, but it's going to be torture.

reviews.subject: MARKETING353 (Marketing)
reviews.review: terrible professor, useless content. tests have nothing to do with the assingments you do, its a whole new set of assignments that its based on. no lectures or books or anything to learn from. i literally dont know why or how shes allowed to teach to students who pay $3700+ to be here to learn

reviews.subject: MARKETING353 (Marketing)
reviews.review: Almost zero direction of the course- no explanation of assignments or how they relate to the class. Hardly any lectures and exams do not relate to any given material whatsoever. Not helpful with emails, if you get a response. I would 100% avoid if you can.

reviews.subject: MARKETING353 (Marketing)
reviews.review: Final exam will destroy you. She does not teach at all. Please do not take her! She should not be a professor.

reviews.subject: 201 (Child & Adolescent Studies)
reviews.review: Fantastic professor! Cares for her students and is super understanding and helpful! Although make sure you upload the correct assignments, or else she won't let you resubmit. Gives extra credit if you turn your work in on time. Average 2-4 assignments a week.

reviews.subject: CAS201 (Child & Adolescent Studies)
reviews.review: Class was organized and workload was decent.  Late work accepted, but extra cred if you submit on time.  However, even though the class was ASYNCH, she still required at least 3-4 zoom meetings to meet "professor engagement credit."  If you are not able to attend these meetings, you have to write a reflection paper about the Zoom recording.

reviews.subject: CAS201 (Child & Adolescent Studies)
reviews.review: This was supposed to be the easiest class for me this semester but ended up being the worst ! She gives soooo much work and grades really hard. I would NOT take her class again ! If you don't want to be doing homework and readings for hours don't take this class.

reviews.subject: CAS312 (Child & Adolescent Studies)
reviews.review: TAKE!! She provides good feedback and as long as you follow the rubric, you will pass! There are no papers or midterm/final, just one project that we work on all semester (5 parts) and submit on last day of class. She splits the class into two week increments, each consisting of interactive lessons, assignments, and one part of the project.

reviews.subject: CAS312 (Child & Adolescent Studies)
reviews.review: This professor crushed my spirits, no lie... while she does have two-week increments, she crams three weeks' worth of work in two weeks. The applied project sucks. There are 5 parts. I hated every second of it. Very picky of grammar. When you ask for help, she doesn't even look over it, says it's good, and then gives you a bad grade.

reviews.subject: CAS312 (Child & Adolescent Studies)
reviews.review: Lots of group projects throughout the semester, but theyre fun. Lots of HW but its due every 2 weeks. She gives good advice on projects and assignments during office hours. Shes very sweet and knowledgeable. The only thing I didnt like was her office hours were held on Sunday nights since we had to do instructor engagements as part of our grade

reviews.subject: GEO329 (Geography)
reviews.review: Very awesome and knowledgeable professor, I only took this class for my GE's but was pleasantly surprised by how much I enjoyed it. It's pretty easy for the most part other than spatials which can be challenging but if you need help just reach out to him. Exams are all online and taken at home which is nice too. Overall just a great guy

reviews.subject: GEO329 (Geography)
reviews.review: I didn't think I would find learning about geography and cities so interesting, but McCabe makes lectures entertaining. If you take notes during the lectures, you will pass the tests. As long as you read every direction carefully on assignments, they are straightforward. I would highly recommend taking this class.

reviews.subject: GEOG110 (Geography)
reviews.review: Everything was mainly online, besides our final, which was a group presentation. I would not say the work was hard, but you should definitely pay attention to the instructions and ask for help if you need to. Spatial was the most time-consuming, so I would NOT procrastinate on that, but overall he has but interesting lectures!

reviews.subject: GEO329 (Geography)
reviews.review: You will struggle at first however that's all part of the experience! Genuinely loved his lecture and overall a great professor! Go to his office hours for help!

reviews.subject: GEOG110 (Geography)
reviews.review: Professor Mccabe was a great professor! I had him for a morning class but he was super entertaining with lectures. all quizzes are online and they are open notes. everything is based off lecture. his assignments and spatial can be a bit more difficult and he is specific with grading, but if you try its very easy!

reviews.subject: GEOG110 (Geography)
reviews.review: Professor McCabe is the man! The lectures are informative and he can be very funny. Homework is doable, with the spatials taking some time to understand. Quizzes/midterms were online. Fun group presentation at the end, with the hardest assignment being a research paper. You can definitely pass this class, and he always has office hours! Take him!

reviews.subject: AMST101 (History)
reviews.review: Very few things graded, 1 essay, 2 midterms, and the final. Books are not required but they def help (esp on the essay where I think you need to cite one of the books). Lectures are mainly him reading off slides but he does go in decent detail of the content (and he's pretty funny). 100% recommend showing up to his exam reviews, super helpful.

reviews.subject: AMST201 (History)
reviews.review: Very simple structure to the class. The class is 90% lecture, 5% reviewing for exams, 5% actual exams. Only 4 exams that truly impact your grade so be prepared! Lectures are full of notes and very helpful. Although lectures can get boring, he's quite funny and paces around a lot. Overall fun class

reviews.subject: AMST201 (History)
reviews.review: 4 things to get grades but they're all very impactful. NEED to attend class or else you won't know the content. I bs the essay so I didn't get tm credit (like duh), but I did pass all my tests with a 21/25. Final I actually got the highest grade LOL I was surprised. Yeah just study hella, get the notes. Book needed but I never used it sooo yeah.

reviews.subject: AMEST201 (History)
reviews.review: Very kind professor and enthusiastic as well, his lectures had humor and he is very understanding. He graded 4 things. an essay, two midterms and a final. His grading criteria is understandable, attendance is not mandatory but I suggest you attend.

reviews.subject: AMST201 (History)
reviews.review: Professor Baxter provides engaging lectures, and his use of study resources like review sessions and pre-released test questions makes the class manageable. The workload is reasonable, with papers and exams being the main focus. Unstuck AI could be a helpful tool for organizing and reinforcing the course material.

reviews.subject: AMEST201 (History)
reviews.review: Class is very lecture heavy, but you can tell Professor Baxter is very passionate about it. I only showed up for review days and test days, and still got a B+! He is very clear what will be on the tests so you can easily pass this class !

reviews.subject: ACCT301B (Accounting)
reviews.review: Got a C- on the first test, but ended with an A for the course. To those who complain about the tests,  I would say, go back and REWRITE (yes, rewrite, not review)  your notes! If anyone can fully understand the notes, then an A is guaranteed!  I have to admit that Dr. Lu is easier than Dr. Hirsch. However,  Hirsch is way better than Foote!

reviews.subject: ACCT301A (Accounting)
reviews.review: This professor is old school. No PP, no homework. His lectures are worthless because he makes it very difficult to follow. Very unclear and highly unorganized. His tests are very close to the examples he gives but you REALLY need to study them. The book helps, A LOT. He curves. A LOT. I got a B, I don't know how, but I still don't recommend him!

reviews.subject: 301B (Accounting)
reviews.review: The school is screwing students over every semester by keeping this guy, i guarantee it, he teaches with no sense of direction, not a smooth flow, easily lost in lectures, cause his writing teaching ways are SUPER BAD, the ALPHA and OMEGA of BAD, i feel bad for students that have no choice but to pick a professor and have to end up with this guy..

reviews.subject: 301B (Accounting)
reviews.review: The grading scale is wrong, no way he has 3.3, glenn hatton and hung lu have lower ratings than him and they were AWESOME professors, i dont know how he has such a high grading when 80% of comments are bad, doesnt make sense, unless this site taking bribes from the school to fill in those spots with this guy cause no one wants to take him

reviews.subject: 301B (Accounting)
reviews.review: HOW CAN HE HAVE SUCH A HIGH GRADE ON THIS WEBSITE!! THAT IS A LIE!! STRAIGHT UP! if you dont believe me, just know that this semester he was bad, notes are bad, writes horribly, spaces out, talks alot bout useless stuff then runs through problems without explaining... not to be rude, but he should do the students a favor and retire, dude cant teach

reviews.subject: COMM300 (Communications)
reviews.review: For any of the forums saying that he isn't a tough graded, I think they're just being too nice. The final exam dropped from an A to a C because the questions were just so confusing! He can also drop you a letter grade for more than two misspelled words on an essay. If you need this for a G.E skip it. I wouldn't recommend his class.

reviews.subject: COM300 (Communications)
reviews.review: HE'S A TOUGH GRADER! I went from a 95% to a 75% on a 10-page paper off THREE MISSPELLED WORDS. He marks you down half a letter grade for each word spelled wrong and it doesn't say in his syllabus. His forums are practically credit or no-credit. If you turn in late or forget a reply, expect a 0. Don't buy his book, get it on Kindle Unlimited.

reviews.subject: COMM300 (Communications)
reviews.review: Tests are almost impossible to complete. Super tough grader. Not that specific with stuff but then docks you for everything possible. Highly dont recommend, especially if your goal is to pass.

reviews.subject: COM300 (Communications)
reviews.review: Great online class! Weekly discussions online with other students. Pretty easy to complete ahead of time. 2 papers in total. Not a tough grader. Test are heavily on the book. Pretty cool how he created it but expensive.

reviews.subject: COM300 (Communications)
reviews.review: Professor Lester is a very interesting professor. I took his online class for Comm 300 Visual Communications. He posts all the discussion forums ahead of time so I knocked those out early. He makes you purchase his book and write papers from them. If you don't agree with his book in your papers, he'll literally roast your work.

reviews.subject: COMM300 (Communications)
reviews.review: Professor Lester can be vague in his instruction, but offers A LOT of extra credit throughout his online class, and also lets you submit your papers ahead of time for review before grading. His online exams are not as hard as you would think either (only 25 questions, with no time limit). This was my first online class, and I would take him again.

reviews.subject: 325B (Education)
reviews.review: Great professor. Ive taken him multiple times and each time was the same lectures with powerpoints but he goes over them in depth.

reviews.subject: 325B (Education)
reviews.review: to explain a bit, I think it was an easy class if you do the work and stay on top of things.  It's not a class you can blow off and still pass.

reviews.subject: 490T (Education)
reviews.review: super small class---only about 7 of us in the class.  That was nice, but you can't hide.

reviews.subject: 340 (Education)
reviews.review: Big class, checked off GE reqs for me, but I enjoyed it.

reviews.subject: 490T (Education)
reviews.review: Good mix of assignments. Kept it interesting

reviews.subject: HIST180 (History)
reviews.review: Great teacher who clearly knew the material inside and out—almost like he was reading it from memory. Lectures were engaging and easy to take notes from. That said, some test questions felt like curveballs not covered directly in lecture. EXTRA CREDIT EXTRA CREDIT EXTRA CREDIT HELPS. He had some for going to Nixon Library. Great experience ngl.

reviews.subject: HIST110A (History)
reviews.review: Overall, his class is pretty decent as long as you watch the video and take some notes during his class. Since I did an online, he provided small study guides, but they weren't that helpful cause it's just the topic name you should study, and you have your midterm, and a paper that's 5-7 pages long at the end of the semester, and then a final.

reviews.subject: 110A (History)
reviews.review: I have never done so much work for a 100 level course. This class is perfect for history majors, but terrible for those that are not. He grades the exams heavily and does not tell you what you did wrong. He does not post on canvas and emails you the videos, assignments, and announcements which you can miss if you have lots of emails.

reviews.subject: HISTORY170B (History)
reviews.review: Please don't take this class if you want an easy G.E. You are graded only by exams and one paper. Lectures have no slides so you must follow along with his voice and take notes. There are two exams, one midterm, one final paper, and one final. The final is to write one page long five essays within two hours with pen and paper.

reviews.subject: HIST180 (History)
reviews.review: Professor Chrissanthos' lectures can feel long, but he's engaging and responds quickly to emails. Use Unstuck study and the textbook to prepare - the exams are tough but doable with effort.

reviews.subject: HIST110 (History)
reviews.review: He's very lecture heavy, has super long lecture videos. No slides or visual aid which can suck if you are a visual learner. There aren't any assignments, you get graded based on the exams (multiple choice+short-answer). 2 exams, 1 midterm, 1 final, and a term paper. Paper requires physical copy and a digital. Changed final review sheet last minute.

reviews.subject: DOESITMATTER (Physics)
reviews.review: As a Physics professor, he is mean as hell. However I'm a smart dude and I got an A in his class. He's tough. He's mean. Take another professor if you can.

reviews.subject: 225 (Physics)
reviews.review: the problem with this man is he DON"T LISTEN TO STUDENTS, so many times that I think this man is just here for paycheck. People tried to talk to him, but he just does not listen to his students. Never have I had such a bad experience with a professor.

reviews.subject: 225 (Physics)
reviews.review: Actaullly hate this man, this man is literally one of the worst teacher in CSUB, if you have him drop it. anyone that think this boomer is a better than a 1 rating is either cheating in his class, or you're insane

reviews.subject: PHYS225 (Physics)
reviews.review: READ THIS REVIEW!Not enough room to write, 1 cant teach 2 doesn't post assignments like quizzes until the night they are due 3 doesn't answer emails for 1+ weeks. 4 doesn't answer questions just says no time for questions infront of the whole class 5 AND I QUOTE "im going to have office hours today as well...i don't really don't want to"-09/24/2021

reviews.subject: PHYS225 (Physics)
reviews.review: Currently taking for credit, but most of what I learned was from Youtube or the textbook. His lectures don't help with anything, he mostly rambles and takes one class period going over one problem. His notes aren't organized at all. The bright side is that he doesn't have midterms, only mini-exams (one question), quizzes (one question),and homework

reviews.subject: PHYS225 (Physics)
reviews.review: Overall just a horrible lecturer and doesnt let us ask questions. Youll be teaching yourself. Take another professor

reviews.subject: EGME421 (Mechanical Engineering)
reviews.review: Was instructed "don't glaze" but I genuinely only have positive things to say about Osman's teaching style. He's great at connecting with his students and fostering a sense of comradery among his class. He's straight-forward, reasonable, and often asks for feedback regarding the clarity and pacing of his lectures.

reviews.subject: EGME421 (Mechanical Engineering)
reviews.review: he did an amazing job teaching Machine Design, especially considering it was his first time teaching the course. He explained difficult concepts in a way that made them much easier to understand and always made an effort to help students succeed. The class was challenging, but he was clear, patient, and very supportive throughout the semester.

reviews.subject: EGME421 (Mechanical Engineering)
reviews.review: This was his first time teaching EGME 421, so it was not very organized. His lectures were good, it would've been helpful if he posted the empty notes before lectures because it's hard to keep up. Exams were pretty fair, we explained as a class why some questions did not feel fair and he understood. One group project but not bad. I'd take him again

reviews.subject: EGME421 (Mechanical Engineering)
reviews.review: Overall, a good professor and good at answering and clarifying any questions. Very understanding and reasonable. Homework problems weren't much like what we went over in class. Exams though were heavily based on homework problems and in-class examples.

reviews.subject: EGME421 (Mechanical Engineering)
reviews.review: Great dude, but it was his first time teaching EGME 421 so it was confusing at fir

reviews.subject: EGME421 (Mechanical Engineering)
reviews.review: Professor Ahmed Osman is really cool professor, and the class atmosphere was always good. I wish we did a few more examples, but overall, it was a great experience. There were a lot of jokes made during class, not too much homework, and the class only had two tests and a project.

reviews.subject: AMST345 (American Studies)
reviews.review: Professor is very engaging and passionate in his lectures. Your grade consists of 3 blue book exams and participation. You get a flashcard to use on exams. The material was very impactful and he made it fun to learn. Make sure to stay on top of the readings, it's a lot. Highly recommend taking his class if you get the chance!!

reviews.subject: AMST345 (American Studies)
reviews.review: If you get the chance to take from Professor Loftin, do it! His lectures were so engaging & always a highlight for me every single week. He truly made it fun to learn. Be sure to attend class since him taking attendance is always at random. Only graded on 3 bluebooks & participation so do the readings/attend class, you'll be fine. Highly recommend!

reviews.subject: AMST345 (American Studies)
reviews.review: Great class genuinely a fun professor and I would definitely take again!

reviews.subject: AMST345 (American Studies)
reviews.review: Attendance is mandatory, but Professor Loftin is a very enthusiastic and engaging lecturer. The course is also only graded by attendance/participation, midterms, and the final. It is also quite reading heavy but a notecard can be brought to exams.

reviews.subject: AMST345 (American Studies)
reviews.review: Professor Loftin was a good professor overall. Note that ATTENDANCE IS PART OF YOUR GRADE. He will pass out an attendance sheet at the beginning to each class and keep track of your attendance and put towards your final grade. The class was graded only a few things, (3 bluebooks; including final). If you tend to skip lots of class, I would avoid.

reviews.subject: AMST300 (American Studies)
reviews.review: Took this class for extra credits and it was a little more work than I expected. For exams it was essays using only the readings from the school library he gave us. There were 6 essays total and discussion posts. Was kind of nit picky with the essays but most got 80-90%. Pretty interesting topics in this class. Not as laid back as I hoped for

reviews.subject: ECON201HYB (Economics)
reviews.review: Hybrid course. Online lectures and in-class assignments. She tries her best to make it engaging, but it usually is just awkward. She goes at a fast pace and expects everyone to keep up. Weekly lectures and quizzes, two exams. Beware, she uses Kahoot as a warm-up (and grades them)! I'd take another prof if you don't do well online.

reviews.subject: ECON315 (Economics)
reviews.review: Several assignments due every week (short lecture videos/homework/quiz). This class is difficult as is, but she offers what she can to help. Practice exams provided for each midterm and honestly as long as you do well on them you will pass the actual one. Offers a lot of extra credit, make sure you take it it will help your grade a LOT.

reviews.subject: ECON315 (Economics)
reviews.review: Course is generally difficult and abstract, so read the textbook. A lot of little short-ish vids to watch with question at the end to solve (u can retake it as many times as u want). Hw and Quiz is on mcgraw, can be easy or difficult depending on chapter. Gives you practice exams that have a few questions that appear on the actual exam. She's nice

reviews.subject: ECON315 (Economics)
reviews.review: take this professor if you want to pass and don't care for the subject. i did not pay attention to lectures and grinded the practice exam and got B's on all exams. the extra credit also boosts ur grade a lot. you can pass this class as long as you put some effort in it

reviews.subject: ECON315 (Economics)
reviews.review: Absolutely horrible. Lectures contain basic algebraic and definition errors. Explanations are cursory at best. If you take this teacher, rely on the book and learn from YouTube. Advice: Don't hate on Econ - hate the teacher.

reviews.subject: 315 (Economics)
reviews.review: I get that this is hard concepts, but she talks to you as if you are already a master in economics. Id stay away from her, especially her online course.

reviews.subject: HESC426 (Science)
reviews.review: Such a relaxing class (health and spirituality 426) I'm actually class of 2024 I'm writing this  in 2026 because I had such fond memories! Her class really was beneficial to my growth

reviews.subject: PUBH101 (Science)
reviews.review: Easiest and kindest professor. This class was fairly easy as most of the information was common knowledge. You have one quiz and one discussion post every week. These were both super easy and it was overall a very chill class. I would 100% recommended her to anyone looking for an easy and chill class to get credits!

reviews.subject: HESC400 (Science)
reviews.review: Don't know what my final grade will be, but the final dropped my grade 7%, it was very difficult and she only gives you 30 minutes for 30 questions. A good number of the questions are not even on the study guide or in her lectures. Heavy emphasis on the group project. Other than that, she is caring and is accessible outside of class.

reviews.subject: PUBH101 (Science)
reviews.review: I honestly came into this class thinking I was just doing it for credit. However I learned a lot through this class and was really interested in our lectures even though they were online. Not a hard class, but definitely learned a lot and left the class feeling inspired to work on my health.

reviews.subject: PUBH101 (Science)
reviews.review: 1 to 2 chapters every week, plus watching/listening to a lecture.15-minute quiz for 15 questions at the end of each week, true/false or multiple choice; based off the chapters more than the lectures though. Professor is pretty accessible. Overall, this course was alright, just your typical health class. Just do the work and it's a simple A/B.

reviews.subject: PUBH426 (Science)
reviews.review: This was supposed to be one of those Easy A classes that was stress free with light work. However, youre graded by a few items and papers. The final was no joke. It was 60 min with 60 questions that were super hard.

reviews.subject: SOCI351 (Sociology)
reviews.review: Easy class, he gives you plenty of time to finish the McGraw Hill assignments, which take forever btw so don't fall behind and do it last minute, exams are proctored but not too bad if you pay attention to the reading and McGraw questions. Take him.

reviews.subject: SOC351 (Sociology)
reviews.review: This is a low effort class where professor lets McGrawhill do his job. He goes over 5 slides per lecture and claims he cannot cover all in class. Mainly talks about personal stories and thinks out loud. Take this class if you want to self teach. Format is as if online yet attendance is mandatory. Come to waste time and gas for participation grade

reviews.subject: SOC341 (Sociology)
reviews.review: he loves to talk & get debatable. often led to barely talking about the lessons so be prepared to teach yourself chapters. homework on McGraw hill & tests were usually 60 questions. says he only takes attendance 3x during the semester but proceeded to take it everyday. all exams were taken at home besides the final exam was in person.

reviews.subject: SOC101 (Sociology)
reviews.review: His lectures are quite interesting though long. We used Mcgrawl hill for the very few assignments and the quizzes weren't too hard. Attendance is graded so show up

reviews.subject: SOC101 (Sociology)
reviews.review: Professor Banda is very engaging with students during class. His lectures are very informative and the course work is more than fair. The class hosts a great learning environment, setting students up for successful and knowledgable futures in sociology.

reviews.subject: SOC101 (Sociology)
reviews.review: Lectures can be hit-or-miss, but Banda's engaging personality makes up for it. Assignments are straightforward, and the textbook is helpful for staying on top of the material. unstuck ai was a game-changer for my study prep.

reviews.subject: PHIL105 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: goes off the subject and talks about random stuff and stories that take 90% of the class, he mostly don't agree with the textbook,you can't really study for this class,his grading seem really inconsistent without a clear criteria, grades are curved, but wouldn't recomend him by any means,not good and  disorganized professor.

reviews.subject: PHIL105 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: This professor is disorganized and difficult to learn from. Lectures often go off-topic with political tangents unrelated to the course. Grades are not displayed at any point, so you won't know your standing until the end of the semester. Grading also feels inconsistent and not always based on clear, consistent criteria.

reviews.subject: PHIL105 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: He lectures heavy and he's loud, he was grading based on what he believed was the right answer.

reviews.subject: PHIL325 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: I did not enjoy Professor Galloway's class. Every class was just reading off slides + long lectures. Your grade relies on 3 exams, which are in-class essays. Attendance is not mandatory, but the exams are based on what he talks about in lectures and the slides will not help by themselves.

reviews.subject: PHIL105 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: Overall nice guy but does not know how to lecture whatsoever, attempts to lecture but ends up rambling and just telling stories, making it confusing on when to take notes. Only graded by weekly quizzes, and the final. Huge curve at the end because nobody does good on the quizzes nor the final. Taking this class is like playing Russian roulette.

reviews.subject: PHIL100 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: He makes a lot of sexual jokes like a lot. It's a little uncomfortable especially if you are a female but the work is easy.

reviews.subject: 201A (Art)
reviews.review: if you need an art credit without wanting to do an actual art class !! very lecture heavy, textbook recommended but you can just find it online. goes over tests in class and curves it very generously, random (1 or 2) extra credit opportunities! if ur struggling just go to her, she will help. not as bad as people wanna complain about

reviews.subject: ART300 (Art)
reviews.review: This was a great class, and the professor gave assignments and lectures that really help with professional development. Expect to work with others, and try not to miss a meeting. Professor is helpful and respectful, and individually talks to everyone. Make sure to ask questions, she will help you as much as possible.

reviews.subject: 300 (Art)
reviews.review: She's a great instructor and wants to see you pass, however it felt like she was in a bad mood for the majority of the semester and was quite rude to myself and some of the other students. Aside from that, she's quite clear on what she's looking for and if you're able to type well, you'll do fine. I wouldn't take her again though.

reviews.subject: 201A (Art)
reviews.review: Just go to class it's lecture heavy, she's very clear about what's on the final and each test for that matter, AND CURVES IT, always extra credit points on every test.

reviews.subject: 201A (Art)
reviews.review: Potts was amazing. If you put in the effort, she will meet you half way. She went over every flash card I made and told me what to add. She is very flexible with due dates, and will even let you take exams a week later with her if you have scheduling issues. Overall, very kind and cares about students. But, very lecture heavy, can't miss class.

reviews.subject: 201A (Art)
reviews.review: All she does is lecture and talk at you for 75 minutes with no slides and only pictures of the art pieces. and then tells you to make flashcards of what she said and memorize it. When she assigns homework, which is not often, it doesn't pertain to any of the material. No ways to apply the material to actually learn it.

reviews.subject: PSYC101 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Okay kids, what youve all failed to realize is the quizzes and homework arent graded. This entire class is based on exams and a single research assignment. The exams are based entirely on his lectures. I realized this halfway through the class and got an A+ despite not doing any hw. Ty Birnbaum for filtering out brainlet psych majors with math

reviews.subject: PSYC101 (Psychology)
reviews.review: DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!! Waste of time, most of the class got an F including me and I really tried to pass it but his grading is so confusing and he doesnt update the grades so you can see how you are doing in class.

reviews.subject: PSYC101 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Wish i could leave a -5 review. Acts like his class is your only one and gives about 10 assignments a week including HW videos/readings that have nothing to do with the class. Tests are completely irrelevant from the lectures and HW he gives yet your grade depends on them. Boring and literally useless lectures. He'll make you HATE psyc. DONT TAKE

reviews.subject: PSY101 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Bottom line: This class is hard, but not impossible. Really, if you read and do the homework youll be fine. However, there is homework every class. On average the homework takes about 1 .5 - 2 hours to finish. Hes funny (if you like dry humor). I never studied, but I did the homework, paid attention in lecture, and passed.

reviews.subject: PSCH101 (Psychology)
reviews.review: If i didnt take AP psychology I wouldve have never understood the material taught in class. There is a quiz everyday that you dont get back, homework everyday including videos that are up to 40min long, and unnecessary reading. Your grade is determined by the midterm and final and both cover absolutely nothing you learn in class.

reviews.subject: PSYCH101 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Theres too much terrible things to say about this class but take my advice and DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS AVOID AT ALL COSTS. I have taken a psych 101 class before in high school and this aint it chief. HE WAS ALLLL stats and confusing lectures, and just no no no no. Funny guy, boring lectures. Avoid at all costs. Made me wanna switch my major lol

reviews.subject: MATH130 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Hesitant? Don't be! Taking Professor Nguyen's class was one of the best experiences I've had. I took her class in person and she is very approachable, kind, and helpful. Attendance is important because calculus in general builds upon itself. Overall she often makes jokes to lighten the mood during challenging material. I highly recommend her!!

reviews.subject: MATH130 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: She is very nice and a lenient grader. Sometimes it's hard to keep up with lectures because of her accent and handwriting. She gives a lot of work (~10 page review front and back+cengage). However the reviews do help for the exams. You need to take notes for that class and put in effort but overall not so bad. If you stay on top of it you'll pass.

reviews.subject: MATH135 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: She is terrible do not take her trust

reviews.subject: MATH135 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: She is a very nice teacher, don't get me wrong. To pass the class, I suggest people pay attention and take notes. She is unreliable, especially when asking questions, and she sometimes prefers the TA to answer the question. The grading is very understandable, and the next incoming students always make sure to do the video notes.

reviews.subject: MATH135 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Handwriting is impossible to read especially with her very strong accent, and hard to follow along.

reviews.subject: MATH135 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Study guide is VERY similar to exams. I studied those over and over again and consistently got 90+ on my exams. You will be teaching yourself. Cengage homework is nothing like exams. Need to review algebra concepts to succeed in the class. It's hard but if you put in the effort you will pass.

reviews.subject: GEO329 (Geography)
reviews.review: Took her course in Fall 2025 and she was a very sweet and kind professor. Most of the work was reading a textbook passage and talk about the main points and give your opinion in class. There was a group project that basically consisted of the same thing. Your final was writing about how walkable your city is. Show up and participate, you pass.

reviews.subject: GEO329 (Geography)
reviews.review: Fairly easy class with repetitive assignments. Professor is kind and helpful. Lectures can be boring, but you can breeze through with little effort. Unstuck study was a great study tool alongside the textbook.

reviews.subject: GEO329 (Geography)
reviews.review: The subject itself is pretty boring but that's not her fault. The class was super easy tbh I don't even think she reads our assignments she just checks for completion and gives you 100%. Assignments were soooooooooooo repetitive but also super easy. Take her class if you just need credit for gen ed.

reviews.subject: GEOG371 (Geography)
reviews.review: Easy class and friendly professor, if you introduce yourself she'll remember you and give you breaks if you take her other classes. Cares about making the class fun, and her assignments arent too challenging.

reviews.subject: GEO332 (Geography)
reviews.review: Absolutely sweet and caring professor. I would definitely say attendance matters but she doesn't take attendance. I didn't use the textbook but if you really want a good grade I would get it online. TAKE NOTES! There are a few assignments, but she's an easy grader. There are 3 exams which I thought was the hardest part of this course.

reviews.subject: GEOG329 (Geography)
reviews.review: She is an absolute angel! She has weekly discussions where we shift all the tables and discuss the latest chapter based off of our written observations and discussion questions. If you are afraid to speak during class I maybe would take her online. But she would bring us treats occasionally and take us on field trips around campus. Love her!!

reviews.subject: PHIL100 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: Loved Loved Loved this class. Amazing professor and definitely is passionate about what he teaches. Didn't know what I was getting myself into in philosophy, but he made it very enjoyable. His grading is very straightforward and an overall easy class. Would definitely recommend to anyone!

reviews.subject: PHIL100 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: The grading is straight forward it consists of 2 papers 3 tests and 1 presentation which are all worth 20 points, He drops the lowest score out of those 6 and that is your grade. The class difficulty was average for a 100 class and the professor is cool and has some corny philosophy jokes. There is a lot of reading though so make sure to not slack.

reviews.subject: 101 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: Super lecture-heavy, meaning you are better off going every day because he doesn't upload the PowerPoint or topics he does in class. Attend every class and write in-depth notes (just write what points/examples he explains). Assigned readings can be replaced with YouTube summaries. My class wasn't talkative at all so my best advice is to talk!

reviews.subject: PHIL300 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: Often showed up late to his own class, did not take full opportunity of time spent in class and was often factually incorrect with examples he used. Class is graded by very few items, just two papers and three tests with a makeup presentation. Can tell he's knowledgeable, just struggled to make the class enjoyable and the material understood.

reviews.subject: PHIL300 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: Interesting and manageable class. Assigned books, but lectures were enough. Applied knowledge to write three papers. Only needed to study for three exams. Opportunity to replace exam by doing presentation. Lectures began with review from previous class and continued with new content. Professor available for additional questions and help.

reviews.subject: PHIL300 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: Really nice professor; passionate about his teachings. NOT an easy A. Attendance is needed to pass b/c  he does not post slides or lectures. Class notes needed for papers and exams. Only take class if mandatory. Don't get me wrong, the professor is really sweet and good at his job. It's not easy to keep up with once you fall behind.

reviews.subject: ISDS415 (Information Systems)
reviews.review: As someone who is experiencing firsthand what it's like working in marketing and technology, this class will be very helpful in your career. Yes, there will be difficulties and he is a tough grader. He is very accommodating but don't assume everything will be fixed, effort is expected. Also don't be surprised if he responds late.

reviews.subject: 361B (Information Systems)
reviews.review: This class is really advanced excel and none of the information will ever come up in business. You need to memorize the excel formulas and how to work out the problem while being watched. He is not helpful at all and hard to understand. Really expensive textbook you will never use because all the hw assignments are through the book site.

reviews.subject: 361B (Information Systems)
reviews.review: DONT TAKE THIS CLASS - GRADE changes constantly!!!! was 94% and dropped to 68%.

reviews.subject: ISDS361B (Information Systems)
reviews.review: DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR IF YOU CAN AVOID IT. Worst professor at CSUF.  Exams don't match lectures & there's no clear grading rubric. He never responds to emails, refuses to explain grades & unfairly deducts points. Many students, including myself, have struggled due to his lack of instruction & engagement. If you want to save your GPA, avoid!

reviews.subject: ISDS361B (Information Systems)
reviews.review: Attn: CSUF Professor Bhaskar consistently fails students unfairly. I have met with my classmates also in the course who are having the same issue. He doesn't respond to emails, won't explain grading, and wrongly deducts points claiming work isn't shown when it is—I have proof. Clearly disengaged and uninterested in teaching or supporting students.

reviews.subject: ISDS361B (Information Systems)
