reviews.review: Horrible professor that doesn't respond to questions and emails Extremely tough grader that refuses to show you what you got wrong to understand how they determined the grade. $300 Cengage materials to do HW. Only class I didn't pass in my 3.5 yrs at CSUF. AVOID!

reviews.subject: 201BUSWRIT (Business Administration)
reviews.review: If you want to learn, i highly suggest to take any other professor but her. No matter how hard you work, she will keep you at same grade

reviews.subject: BAUD201 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: I would not recomend her at all. I didnt learn anything from her. She is a hard grader though. an example is she helped me on an assignment, and she still gave me a low grade.

reviews.subject: BAUD201 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: Personally, I would NOT take her at all. Avoid her!!! The only way to pass, is to take the course again. Do NOT do this to yourself

reviews.subject: BAUD201 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: She teaches crystal clear but her grading is overwhelming. When i took her she gave out 2 B'S/ 2c's and the rest didn't pass. Many of my fellow classmates didn't like her either

reviews.subject: BAUD201 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: You will r egret taking her. She grades super hard, and even if she helps, she will find a lot of negativity on your assignments

reviews.subject: BUAD501 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: She is very tedious to pass her class. I would never ever recommend her to anyone to take for any class in general

reviews.subject: MGMT-440 (Business)
reviews.review: Good and fun professor, assigns a lot of "small" assignments last minute and is heavy on group work, I had about 4 different group assignments for this class.

reviews.subject: MGMT-440 (Business)
reviews.review: She is a really good professsor but gives lots of homework and quizess but it does help your grade. She makes you take a reading quiz before reading the chapters, but overall he is very lenient and and understanding professor. Love her!

reviews.subject: MGMT-440 (Business)
reviews.review: Professor Lim reviewed the course structure with students at the beginning of the semester, which made expectations very clear. Attendance was not required, but being in class helped with extra credit and understanding lectures. Tests were challenging, though curves were offered when needed.

reviews.subject: MGMT-440 (Business)
reviews.review: Professor Lim lets students help create the syllabus at the start of the semester, so expectations are clear from day one. Attendance was optional, but attending class helped with extra credit and staying up to date. Exams and quizzes were difficult, but she did offer curves and wanted students to succeed.

reviews.subject: MGMT-440 (Business)
reviews.review: Professor Lim was very caring; she let the students create this syllabus, so everything was clear for us. Although attendance wasn't mandatory, it was helpful in exams and for group projects. Her quizzes and tests are difficult, but she curves and ensures you get the best grade you can receive. You just have to apply yourself in her class.

reviews.subject: MGMT-440 (Business)
reviews.review: Quizzes and exams are tough but overall it is a great course.

reviews.subject: CPLT315 (English)
reviews.review: Professor Blaine was awesome! Super funny. There is a lot of reading, analyzing, and comparing texts, but overall he grades pretty easy. Grades slowly but gives awesome feedback.

reviews.subject: CPLT (English)
reviews.review: Lots of reading, he's very excited about the material and loves explaining the readings. Attendance matters, you can only miss 3 classes before it affects your grade. Very few assignments, we had 1 paper, the midterm and the final. He took a long time to post grades, but a he's very fair grader.

reviews.subject: CPLT312 (English)
reviews.review: This is my second class with professor Blaine, even though my major is Accounting, I took two of his classes to fulfil GE requirement. He is great! Clear expectations. Humorous and interesting lectures. You will have to read material, but it was not boring (myth from CPLT 315 and bible stories CPLT 312). Attend, even if not ready! Highly recommend!

reviews.subject: ENG316 (English)
reviews.review: Blaine is a good professor: very knowledgeable, thoughtful, and laid back. While the class can get a little boring, pay attention to what he says, because it helps a lot in knowing what to write and better understanding the plays. Two essays & one final exam, but he's a considerate grader who really cares about what students have to say.

reviews.subject: CPLT315 (English)
reviews.review: His lectures were very long but he gives a small break. We had about two homework assignments, midterm and final. He is very funny and cares for his students.

reviews.subject: CPLT315 (English)
reviews.review: Professor Blaine is clearly incredibly knowledgeable in his field and is an absolute wealth of knowledge. That being said, he is very boring. Monotone and long are what i would describe his lectures as. Its not uncommon to find yourself falling asleep. The subject matter of the class itself is interesting but he just doesn't make it interesting.

reviews.subject: ENGL301 (English)
reviews.review: he is such a harsh grader, but will mark you down on things you ALREADY GOT APPROVED BY HIM. he is nice, but also extremely condescending and gives vague feedback. good luck

reviews.subject: ENG100 (English)
reviews.review: I really enjoyed the feedback he gives on papers and he's always willing to help you if your struggling with writing and point you in the right direction. While he is a tough grader, if you need insight or help don't be afraid to go see him during office hours because he will help you to achieve a better grade.

reviews.subject: ENG101 (English)
reviews.review: He's a tough grader and his classes are boring and doesn't really help with your papers.

reviews.subject: 301 (English)
reviews.review: He's kind of sassy if he doesn't like you so just make sure to participate or he will call you out. 4 essays and 2 journal entrys, the essays get progressively harder and longer he requires a long in prompt but you can scrape by with a C+

reviews.subject: ENG101 (English)
reviews.review: He gives you 4 Essays for the whole semester which you'd think is good for homework but if you mess up on any one of them that's basically your whole grade, which he grades incredibly harsh on. I don't know anyone in the class over a C. He's fun in discussion and with his lectures when you participate but the grading is super demeaning.

reviews.subject: ENGL301 (English)
reviews.review: Please do yourself a favor and DO NOT take college writing 2 at IVC with this professor. I have never heard of a teacher giving THREE books to read for a writing class, let alone when you have to write a 22 page research paper. The study guides/paper guides make no sense and you will be more confused than anything. He's a fun professor, but just no

reviews.subject: AMST301 (American Studies)
reviews.review: I recommend not taking this class online, just because of the workload. I think I would have done better in-person.

reviews.subject: AMST301 (American Studies)
reviews.review: Online class was very well organized. But she did require a good amount of work. Each week we had an online lecture, a movie, and discussion board that was due. Had 3 exams. Each exam consisted of 2 essay questions. She's a pretty tough grader and makes you work for it. Lots of critical thinking/analysis questions, they weren't easy questions.

reviews.subject: AMST300 (American Studies)
reviews.review: Professor Linkletter is a good teacher but she is a tough grader and you have to work hard on all of her papers in order to get a good grade. She is a very interesting teacher and encourages group discussions but she has a lot of homework. Her test are two essay questions and they are very difficult. Good teacher but definitely a lot of work.

reviews.subject: AMST201 (American Studies)
reviews.review: Awesome professor, would take this class again. she made all of the topics super interesting and easy to understand (and she's funny). Her grading is fair, although there is a lot of writing it is all pretty easy to do. As long as you take good notes you should get at least a B in class

reviews.subject: AMST201 (American Studies)
reviews.review: The professor was really good at explaining the material and she did require you to read, but its not overly excessive. She was particularly in grading, but she is VERY understanding with any problems. Her exams are take home. Overall I would take the course again.

reviews.subject: AMS301 (American Studies)
reviews.review: Professor Linkletter is a pretty good Professor just make sure that you do not do your exams (essays) last minute because she grades hard on them.

reviews.subject: 340 (Business)
reviews.review: The course material was very digestible over the course of a 6-week class. Everything was well structured. I would recommend people to take her for this class

reviews.subject: MGMT340 (Business)
reviews.review: The class was straightforward. The class was completely asynchronous, consisting of pre-recorded lectures, reading the book, discussion posts, and a few proctored exams. Very doable and fairly easy to complete, even as a summer course.

reviews.subject: MGMT340 (Business)
reviews.review: Summer 1 month class - She was a really kind professor and the class overall wasn't too bad. You do have to read a lot, but the materials weren't all too hard to understand. The exams were a bit challenging due to them being scenario based, but they were very fair and doable. She did grade the group project hard tho, as the highest grade was 80%.

reviews.subject: MGMT340 (Business)
reviews.review: Caring Prof but her lectures and going to class was a complete waste of time. Textbook is not required but HIGHLY RECOMMENDED YOU WILL FAIL WITHOUT THE TEXTBOOK!!!!! I read the textbook every week and never came to class or watched her lectures and still passed with nearly A's on each exam. One group project and weekly quiz on canvas that is easy.

reviews.subject: MGMT340 (Business)
reviews.review: Professor Sadri is an amazing person, but her teaching leaves much to be desired. Her video lectures are very interesting to me, yet the quizzes and exams cover more information that she doesn't touch on in her lecture vids. Tough grader on the Group Project (a 2-4 pages Case Study), and provided very vague instruction on how to complete it.

reviews.subject: MGMT340 (Business)
reviews.review:
Lecture: around 30-40 mins/week
2 exams, 1 project. Weekly quizzes of 10 questions. 
Powerpoint Slides are just outlined with very limited information. You will need to read textbook or google search the important topics. You can't fully rely on presentation decks. 
Instruction on the project is very limited and unclear, and a tough grader on it.

reviews.subject: ISDS361B (Information Systems)
reviews.review: His class consists of a couple hw assignments (cengage for $250), 2 exams, and weekly quizzes. His TA's taught the entirety of the course, but the work and quizzes were easy and manageable. Allowed for a cheat sheet every quiz and 5 sheets for an exam. Helpful and responsive, honestly a good professor to take! If you can go for his online courses.

reviews.subject: ISDS361B (Information Systems)
reviews.review: Don't let the limited class time fool you-this class requires hours of individual study. Study week by week or you are cooked like me!

reviews.subject: ISDS361B (Information Systems)
reviews.review: Professor Huang was amazing. He always made himself available to ask questions and get help if needed. Quizzes are simple and based on homework and slides. Mid-term and final were identical to the practice exams that he gives extra credit for. He's a great guy who wants you to do well.

reviews.subject: ISDS361B (Information Systems)
reviews.review: One of the best Professors at CSUF. Prof.Huang was patient and provided all the tools neccessary to pass his class. If you want an A, attend his lectures and do the excel problems with him. 6 HW, 2 exams (includes Final). No surprises. Straight forward. Take his class, you'll have fun!

reviews.subject: ISDS361B (Information Systems)
reviews.review: Honestly one of the best professors I have had yet! This could easily be a diabolical class, but he makes it so easy to understand and helps reinforce it by having you do in order to make sure you know it. He gives plenty of opportunities for extra credit, especially if you just show up to all his lectures. Take him! You wont regret it!

reviews.subject: ISDS361B (Information Systems)
reviews.review: Practice exams are exactly like the real ones. The class includes 7 quizzes, 2 exams & homework. He's very generous with extra credit & makes it easy to get a high grade if you stay on top of things. The exams, especially the final, are tough so study hard. He posts lecture videos, extends deadlines when needed & is very supportive. BEST PROF EVER!

reviews.subject: AGNG425 (Sociology)
reviews.review: Outstanding educator. It's very obvious that she wants her students to succeed, but you do have to put in *some* effort

reviews.subject: AGNG425 (Sociology)
reviews.review: Aging studies adv writing with professor Wong. We never got feedback for any of our writing, and we were expected to read two textbooks. This didn't feel like a writing class, as it felt like we were teaching ourself the content. Wong is a very understanding person, and is very flexible. Students told her the workload was too much, and she adjusted

reviews.subject: AGNG425 (Sociology)
reviews.review: Took agng363 with her. She's very caring and sweet.

reviews.subject: AGNG425 (Sociology)
reviews.review: I took aging studies advanced writing with her. We never got feedback for our writing. I don't feel that she taught us about writing. We mostly only learned about older people.

reviews.subject: AGNG425 (Sociology)
reviews.review: Good material, she provided books. Writing assignments were kinda hard for me and I am a writer. But I like that she grades by A, B, C etc. no plus or minus. I liked the class and she was flexible if you communicate with her. Accessibility outside of class too. Overall cool class just turn everything in even if it's late.

reviews.subject: AGNG425 (Sociology)
reviews.review: Truthfully the course was interesting and materials were great. Teacher was nice but I didn't like that she takes forever to grade.

reviews.subject: COM346 (Communications)
reviews.review: It was an online class. There are weekly quizzes so if you don't do well on them, it'll affect your grade.

reviews.subject: COM346 (Communications)
reviews.review: Read EVERYTHING on his canvas because he will not hesitate to fail you (0%) if you happen to miss something crucial like preferred citing format. Tough grader on papers. He had quizzes due 12:15am Monday on Labor Day and Thanksgiving break which are very forgettable and will wreck your grade. Just be very cautious & pay attention.

reviews.subject: COMM449 (Communications)
reviews.review: I've taken Puente before, and his other classes are fine, but don't take this one. All you do is a bunch of case studies (PESTLE/SWOT) every week, where he basically shits on ur work with his feedback. I think the other Capstone class actually gains real experience in the Newport Film Festival. Wish I had taken that. Time-consuming work.

reviews.subject: COM346 (Communications)
reviews.review: Cultivated a great class environment where everyone felt comfortable talking and was a very knowledgeable and fun lecturer on top of it. He assigns a lot of long quizzes outside of class but if you take good notes and balance your time wisely you should be fine. His two papers he assigns are also very time consuming but not super hard either.

reviews.subject: COMM449 (Communications)
reviews.review: I recommend avoid taking COMM 449 with Professor Puente if possible. Most of the stuff he teaches is very similar to what he teaches in COMM 346 and he grades very harshly on the case studies. He will give you little to no helpful feedback on what you need to improve on the case studies; sometimes he will add his own harsh comments to your work.

reviews.subject: COMM346 (Communications)
reviews.review: Puente's course is organized excellently. His lectures are well-paced, and he explains the topics very well. Attendance is mandatory because he doesn't post the slides on Canvas, so if that will be hard for you, don't take him. His quizzes and tests are similar, very easy. The two papers we have to write are also not bad.

reviews.subject: EC335 (Economics)
reviews.review: Professor is very good but strict. He was always available for office hours and that helped me a lot. He is very knowledgeable. He really explains well and takes time to write extensively on the board. Good class!

reviews.subject: EC335 (Economics)
reviews.review: This was a challenging course for me. His quizzes are open book so try to take advantage of them. He did curved the grades which helped me to pass. Economics is difficult but he did well to explain things. Do not skip class and make sure you go to review sessions especially.

reviews.subject: ECON320 (Economics)
reviews.review: One of the most challenging classes for me. He tried to make things simple.  He explains things well and is available to help during office hours. The exams repeat some questions from quizzes. Pay attention and take good notes when he reviews for exams.

reviews.subject: ECON320 (Economics)
reviews.review: Challenging class but he does a good job to breakdown the concepts. He was helpful in office hours. Review sessions are really great for essay questions especially. Good professor.

reviews.subject: ECON320 (Economics)
reviews.review: Econ isn't an easy subject, but he tried to simplify it as much as he could. I don't think he was the best at explaining concepts. There are three 20 question quizzes that are open note, two midterms, and a final. You can choose to use notes for the midterms and final, but the max grade you can get is a C. Homework assignments due end of semester.

reviews.subject: ECON320 (Economics)
reviews.review: His class was challenging but he always highlighted what we needed to know. He gives an option for open-notes exams but you cannot get higher than C if you choose that, but you must still learn the material to pass. Professor did well to simply things as much as possible especially with the math. There are quizzes, online homework and exams.

reviews.subject: 101 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Pretty cool when he was alive... RIP the homie Doug

reviews.subject: PSYC101 (Psychology)
reviews.review: The online course only had 4 open-note exams (with over 50% of the questions provided before the test to find answers in advance) and a mandatory extra credit paper. It's clear that Navarick has a passion for psychology, as he's been in the field for nearly 50 years, but he is not tech savvy. Lectures were slow, monotone, and difficult to follow.

reviews.subject: PSCY302 (Psychology)
reviews.review: I only took the class because I did not have another option. Thank God for study guides. His study guides are what saved my grades. Otherwise, I would have totally failed this class. I was actually excited to learn about learning and memory, but he lost me in first week. He is actually so nice in person but his teaching style was not for me at all.

reviews.subject: 302 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Took this professor for Psych 302 online in the spring, and as all the other ratings say, he is by far the worst. His lectures are confusing and he often drones on, mixing up information. Only 2 tests and an essay, yet he is a very tough grader. I didn't even bother showing up, yet I passed by working with others and by looking up the information.

reviews.subject: PSCY302 (Psychology)
reviews.review: With love I say, PLEASE DO NOT take his courses unless you are ready to teach yourself. He provides all of his slides, but they're very difficult to follow at first. NOT tech savvy. Exams are straightforward only a few questions from the book. I did not read the textbook nor did I attend class. I did spend hours in the library

reviews.subject: PSCY302 (Psychology)
reviews.review: He is a horrible professor in my opinion. Our whole class has basically failed the first exam but he wont make any adjustments. We asked for a litte more time for the next exam and he absolutely refused. There has been internet issues for the first 4 weeks of class and he was less than willing to help us with that. Just overall terrible and mean.

reviews.subject: 301B (Accounting)
reviews.review: at least for my experience this wasnt that hard. If you ask he will review whatever question you have. Pretty much as long as you read the book and do the homework the midterm/final are like some problems and he just changes numbers. exams are only 10 problems and ppl would even get just 3 right even though problems were similar to the book.

reviews.subject: ACCT301B (Accounting)
reviews.review: He does not teach his students since he expects everyone to know the material already. It seems he like seeing his students struggle since he offers no explanation for material. You will have to self teach the entire course for yourself so its not worth it. Please find another professor if you care about actually learning something.

reviews.subject: ACCT301B (Accounting)
reviews.review: Avoid this professor at all costs. I have always received a B or higher in ACCT classes. Most accounting professors teach, but this one does not. He is basically one of the students. Instead of teaching, he makes you print out study guides from Wiley and then forces you to self teach. No explanations, worst professor, good luck if you get him.

reviews.subject: ACCT301B (Accounting)
reviews.review: Rather than teaching the material during lectures, he asks students to answer questions without teaching anything. He expects you to know and if one student gets the answer correct he moves on without going over it. Your grade in the class is based on the midterm and the final. Hardest class I have ever taken.

reviews.subject: ACCT301B (Accounting)
reviews.review: Waste of your tuition. Students pay elsewhere for your education. This teacher is a bit narcissistic and enjoys watching his students fail. Its a 40% pass rate of all students. Does not teach, is lazy and should have retired years ago.

reviews.subject: ACCT301B (Accounting)
reviews.review: As previous reviews already mention, He does not teach. He continues to say this class is "not a spectator sport", but spectates himself and imposes his job onto his students. He reads the question, then asks what the answer is, then a student answers, he then asks how they got it. The answers are provided but not explained or calculated by him.

reviews.subject: ECON330 (Economics)
reviews.review: DO NOT BUY THE BOOK. His tests are based off of his PowerPoints. Go to class to listen to the lectures. He's very helpful and will answer any questions you have about the different economic systems. One decent economic paper that you can write on any country and subject. Most of your grade is based on the tests so be sure to study! No homework.

reviews.subject: ECON330 (Economics)
reviews.review: He is nice, but not exactly clear or knowledgeable. He claims redistribution as altruism but fails to suggest how theft through state force is not morally altruistic. He gives biased &outdated examples, like not recognizing that Sweden has actually been privatizing public services. For an economics class, I just expected more.

reviews.subject: ECON330 (Economics)
reviews.review: Very interesting class! MUST ATTEND class! Don't miss out on easy points. DO NOT buy that $100+ book. Everything you need to know is smashed into powerpts (which are very overwhelming to read).  MUST MEMORIZE powerpts in order to do well on exams. One TERM PAPER with no page limitations. Answer exams Q's carefully! It's tricky!

reviews.subject: ECON330 (Economics)
reviews.review: His tests are incredibly hard, he will expect you to know and recite in detail extremely specific points from his power points. You will never use the book in this class just study his PowerPoint and pay attention in his review sessions. He is extremely helpful in office hours any concept you dont know he can find a way to explain it.

reviews.subject: ECON330 (Economics)
reviews.review: 2 midterms (15% each), 1 final (40%), 1 essay(20%) and participation(10%) to sum up your total grade.  1st is all MC and 2nd is all T/F. True, he does include some previous exam questions on the final and that can help to an extent, but that doesn't mean the final will be easy. 50 MC and 5 essay questions; totaling 100 points. Not an easy class.

reviews.subject: ECON330 (Economics)
reviews.review: Boring class. Takes attendance every class (15% of grade). There are 2 midterms (1st multiple choice, 2nd only TF), 1 final (Multiple choice & essay questions). Gives study guide. Work on the study guide while he teach. STUDY IT! Don't underestimate the exams. There's also one easy paper you need to turn in. No Homework and don't buy the book!

reviews.subject: ENG301 (English)
reviews.review: She is one of the best teachers I have ever had!  Definitely memorable after 10 years.  I still think of her methods and rules almost daily, though I am not a writer.  She really got us to understand the difference between good and bad writing!

reviews.subject: ENGL301 (English)
reviews.review: I had Prof Cappeluti over ten years ago for two classes (English 301 and Creative Writing).  I learned a ton in the class and really liked her.  She works you hard but she really helps you improve as a writer and critical thinker.  She was a really nice person as well.

reviews.subject: ENG301 (English)
reviews.review: I have to admit she helped me write better, but her way of writing a paper is very structured. There's no other way, but her way of writing. She made a lot of people feel dumb in class. She is just not a good teacher. I would suggest taking someone else and hope that "staff" is another teacher!

reviews.subject: ENGL101 (English)
reviews.review: You REALLY need to get on her good side. She is a very hard grader, English has always been my best subject, I never got anything below an A before, and in her class I received a C. The essays were difficult to write, mainly because the prompt was confusing, she doesn't explain them well. Just stay on her good side and hope for the best.

reviews.subject: ENG101 (English)
reviews.review: I did not enjoy coming to class at all and she is a very hard grader. Avoid her at all cost!

reviews.subject: ENGLE101 (English)
reviews.review: Very Very Hard grading. She is a nice person and you will likely write much better after the class but your grade will be reduced far below what you want. Meanwhile, she is very strict about attendance and having the boring textbook.

reviews.subject: MATH125 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Mr Shah is super passionate about math and is more than willing to help you.  office hours were super helpful too.  If you have a decent understanding of algebra and can keep up with weekly homework, you'll be good. 10 quizzes, 4 exams, 1 final. 3 lowest quizzes dropped and lowest exam score replaced with final exam score

reviews.subject: MATH115 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Professor Shah is AMAZING! He is kind, helpful, and clearly passionate about teaching. I previously failed Math 115, but with him I feel much more confident. His review sessions before tests and quizzes are super helpful. I highly recommend his class, especially if you struggle with math!

reviews.subject: MATH135 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: He was hands down the best professor I have had. I failed Math 135 originally and took this course with Kenny in the summer to redeem myself. He was so caring and passionate about his craft that this course was something I enjoyed. He was such a great support system, and I HIGHLY recommend taking him for your success in this course.

reviews.subject: MATH125 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: This professor is still to this date, one of the best professors I have ever had at cal state fullerton. Simply to put it into perspective this man will guide you through the course you take even though you may not like it at first, he assists in helping you succeed. Kenny is the man.

reviews.subject: MATH130 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: If I had taken this summer calculus course with a different professor, I would have FAILED. Thank the heavens I was put in Professor Shah's class. Not only is he an expert in his field, he projects kindness and patience to all his students. I am forever grateful.

reviews.subject: MATH130 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: The GOAT. The best professor, you put in the time and the effort you'll succeed.

reviews.subject: SOCI410 (Sociology)
reviews.review: Professor provides amazing feedback and her lectures are very clear and concise. She is communicative, and the homework assignments are doable. All the material is there and is helpful to complete assignments. Overall, I recommend and suggest you take her!

reviews.subject: SOC341 (Sociology)
reviews.review: If you're trying to fill the GE requirement this class with this teacher is definitely a good option. She is nice and her canvas set up like you have to go through everything you can't skip it because there's like locks. The assignments overall are pretty easy she replies quickly. The biggest project, which is like making a blog not that hard.

reviews.subject: SOC351 (Sociology)
reviews.review:
This professor is great and provides a TON of resources and gives a lot of time for weekly assignments (they're also very easy).

She does have a few exams that need to be taken on a lockdown browser, but don't let that sway you the exams are still very easy.

reviews.subject: SOC351 (Sociology)
reviews.review: Professor Esguerra is one of the best sociology teachers at CSUF. I'm taking her online, and her lectures are easy to stay engaged with because they're interesting & not too long. She actually knows how to set up her Canvas, plus you can tell she cares and puts a lot of time into her job. Her modules actually teach you as you go. Take her!

reviews.subject: SOC354 (Sociology)
reviews.review: Professor Esguerra did a great job at working with students of all walks of life and introducing us to a sociological look at gender, sex, and society. There was a project due by the end of the class, but she pieced it together for us. By the time it was due, we had a strong foundation and the tools to create and post the required blog projects.

reviews.subject: SOC308 (Sociology)
reviews.review: The class was a great introductory class to the Online Sociology completion program. Professor Esguerra did a great job at introducing us to the writing style expected of the class, and throughout the semester, we pieced together a large project for a completed Research Proposal due by the last week of class. Would retake this teacher.

reviews.subject: MGMT339 (Management)
reviews.review: Don't recommend online class- just prerecorded lectures. As a person, he's great. I think he'd be much better in person. Online is a quiz every week and 3 in person tests. Not too much material to go off of, but tests aren't that hard. Pretty easy class overall, and very personable. Given the choice, would choose in person w/him, not online again.

reviews.subject: MGMT339 (Management)
reviews.review: Don't take him online.  His lectures were recorded from before Covid and they are incredibly stale.  You will have to end up reading the slides/PowerPoints on your own since that is all he does in the videos, just very monotonously.  Find an in-person prof, this is the only class I'm not getting an A in this semester, and I learned nothing all sem.

reviews.subject: MGMT339 (Management)
reviews.review: One of the best professor I've had at CSUF. Course has online quizzes and in-person tests. Neither of them are too difficult. I would take this professor again for sure.

reviews.subject: MGMT339 (Management)
reviews.review: Took him online and passed. His class is setup in a way for you to complete the lessons on your own all online, weekly quizzes. 10 questions timed. Pre-recorded lectures. One paper, and 3 exams. Final is not cumulative exams are taken in person on campus. He did apply a curve at the end of the semester. Would take him again.

reviews.subject: MGMT339 (Management)
reviews.review: Overall tests I find confusing since what I read in the book and lectures didn't match up with what was being tested on. He tries his best to help by offering us ways to study, which I appreciate. Only met him once throughout the semester so I can't say much about personality. If you aren't great at heavy lectures then this class isn't for you.

reviews.subject: MGMT339 (Management)
reviews.review: boring and only saw him once (first meeting) 3 exams-100points each, closed everything weekly quizzes (easy) - (not proctored) one small, easy paper doesn't help students pass the class even if few points away (even if it's .5%). just study and you should pass, don't expect him to change ur grade in anyway.

reviews.subject: PSYCH351 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Okada is super easy when grading papers and essay questions on exams. He understands that not everyone is an English major, or upper division Psych major. No quizzes, just exams. Each exam is usually 50 multiple choice, 2 short answers, and based off his lectures. He even said save yourself money and not get the textbook. He wants you to pass.

reviews.subject: PSYCH201 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Professor Okada is an amazing teacher. If you go to his office hours to get your exercises checked he will help you. He will help you understand the information better if you take the time to see him. He has 4 exams along with homework but your notes help you solve the homework problems. I recommend him! Take him!

reviews.subject: PSYC201 (Psychology)
reviews.review: One of my favorite classes from the year. Some concepts were a little difficult to understand, but Prof. Okada was always very constructive and helpful after class and during office hours. He drops the lowest test score and gives lots of extra credit opportunities in the end of the year. Wish he taught more stats classes tbh

reviews.subject: PSYC201 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Professor Okada is a really cool guy. His lecture is somehow confusing, his joke is dry but he did give opportunities to students that are hard-working and try to get improve. Self-study a lot and make sure you check homework with him during his office hours. Homework is really important because it takes up to 43%.

reviews.subject: PSYC201 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Closed book concept exams were hard! He drops one of your lowest grades. Allows a cheat sheet for open book section of the exam. Homework is 40% of your grade so do it and get it corrected at his office hours before turning it in so you get full points! HW is very similar to open book exam. Gives extra credit problems on the last two homeworks.

reviews.subject: BUAD301 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: Extremely tough grading. If you're expecting an easy pass, don't take this class. Lectures are boring, especially for a class that is almost 3 hours long. Expectations for students are insanely high.

reviews.subject: BUAD301 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: Absolutely wonderful professor. This was my one class I looked forward to attending, despite the 3 hour length. Dr. Rizkallah has clear guidelines to do well in the class, and rewards good writing. If you want substantial feedback, a bit of fun in class, and an interesting course lecture, then take this class!

reviews.subject: BAUD301 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: Professor Rizkallah was great and she really cares about her students. It's hard to get an A in this class but tbh I did the bare minimum and passed with a B+. The most annoying part was the group project and a 3 page essay, her grading isn't as harsh as I expected tho. Her exams are rlly easy too and don't need studying beforehand.

reviews.subject: BUAD501A (Business Administration)
reviews.review: Very straightforward class. Pass or fail assignemnts, but you do have to pass certain ones to guarantee your success. Show up to class, and listen to her feedback for writing assignments.

reviews.subject: BUAD501A (Business Administration)
reviews.review: Really straightforward course. It's pass or fail ten assignments. Certain ones you have to pass in order to pass the class. Two papers with really good feedback and a mini textbook to read about case analysis presentation. Highly recommend! She's here's to help you in anyway she can.

reviews.subject: BUAD501 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: Rizkallah's class is challenging but rewarding. Make sure to follow instructions closely and get ready to put in the work. The group project is key - pick your team wisely! Unstuck AI was super helpful for my study prep.

reviews.subject: CTVA300 (Film)
reviews.review: Honestly the most uncaring professor I've ever had. He doesn't answer questions, makes you feel stupid for asking, and the unclear project directions force you to teach yourself everything. Some required films feel unnecessary and uncomfortable. It's disappointing that this class is holding me back because the professor doesn't care or help.

reviews.subject: 300 (Film)
reviews.review: Professor Davis runs a tough but rewarding course. While the workload is heavy, engaging with the material and using study aids like unstuckstudy can lead to great learning outcomes. Attend class, do the readings, and you'll get a lot out of this class.

reviews.subject: CTVA300 (Film)
reviews.review: He made us do 6 quizzes, 3 of them are about the movies he assigned and 3 others are about notes and short clips. They are all multiple choices, and taken online but you have to be on Zoom call with camera on and screenshare the enntire time. The Zoom call is recorded by him (to use against you if u got caught cheating or being suspected by him)..

reviews.subject: CTVA300 (Film)
reviews.review: Professor from hell that doesn't care about teaching his students and expects professional-level work out of them. He constantly talks badly about his students' performance, which is more of a reflection of him as an educator than of his students. His work is manageable, but his personality is not. Too nit-picky, will leave you feeling horrible.

reviews.subject: 300 (Film)
reviews.review: Not fully online,meet on zoom for test with camera on mandatory no excuses not even medical or work. For a film class there is no room for creativity only what he wants and believes to be right. Feedback is not helpful. Test are very specific. He specifically said he will not support his students with any rental equipment, he denied us the option.

reviews.subject: ECON310 (Economics)
reviews.review: She's one of those professors that proudly announces her fail rates at the start of the semester. The first exam average was probably somewhere near 50%. When most people are consistently FAILING her exams, it's a reflection of the professor. She knows the material is hard but doesn't even care to try and engage the class. Horrible.

reviews.subject: ECON202 (Economics)
reviews.review: Lectures are boring which isn't new. 3 midterms, 3 papers, homework every week, and a final. Homework is a waste of time to be honest. She curves at the end of the semester and told us average on midterms is a 65% - TRUE. As long as you do okay on all the pop quizzes (at least once a week), do homework, and show up, you'll pass WITHOUT the curve.

reviews.subject: ECON310 (Economics)
reviews.review: Cares more about covering lectures on schedule than bothering to slow down to make sure we understand. Expects you to take tests on ch's she barely covered bc she ran out of time. I've noticed class rarely asks questions bc her responses are very cynical. Doesn't acknowledge that consistent 60% exam scores is an issue on her end. Stubborn grader.

reviews.subject: ECON315 (Economics)
reviews.review: She does not provide any study guides. She gives good lectures. I recommend showing up to class because everything she teaches in class is on the test.

reviews.subject: ECON315 (Economics)
reviews.review: Go to every class and copy word for word her notes. There three midterms and a final, she drops lowest midterm. Her midterms are 1/3 definitions which she expects to be copied directly from her notes. She's not worth arguing with about anything related to your grade, she is extremely stubborn and her most annoying line is "It is what it is."

reviews.subject: HIST310 (Social Science)
reviews.review: Now I know why the college refused to let us know she was the professor until the first day, because if we knew who she was we would NOT have signed up for this course. She makes nothing clear, but demands SO much from students. She makes you take screenshots of what you're quoting and if you don't cite EVERY SINGLE SOURCE she mentions, you fail.

reviews.subject: HIST300B (Social Science)
reviews.review: Dr Essington is a very particular/peculiar person, and she's willing to call out people. Personally, I had no issues with her since I showed up every day and tried my hardest; however, some people may have had different experiences. Her class was challenging, but if you stay on top of things, it's not that bad.

reviews.subject: HIST377 (Social Science)
reviews.review: She does way too much, adding far too many steps for a simple five page essay. She takes short cuts at the expense of students, her syllabus was filled with wrong dates, her textbooks not coming on time but still making us do the work etc. Also made a girl cry because she sent a link to the textbook so we could complete our work, not cool bro.

reviews.subject: HIST310 (Social Science)
reviews.review: WORST experience of my life. Her essays are pure citations, doesn't matter how good your essay is just how many citations. Not only that you need to include screenshots of ur citations at the end of ur essay. You have to include a screenshot of every page used, every reference made.cause the 40 citations weren't enough

reviews.subject: 170B (Social Science)
reviews.review: guranteed she does not ready your essay and gives you low scores while the class is essay heavy

reviews.subject: HIST180 (Social Science)
reviews.review: Worst professor, TRUST ME. She will falsely accuse you of plagiarism, and she'll literally harass you. This has been a very emotionally distressing experience for me. would never recommend it at all. Also, keep in mind that this is an introductory-level type of class.  Workload: No midterm, no final, it was literally all essays/quizzes.

reviews.subject: COM407 (Communications)
reviews.review: If you take COM 407, then you should absolutely take Belmas. She is very nice and helpful. The materials in class are hard, but she makes them easy that you can study and understand. Quiz every week but as long as you read her powerpoint, you are easily get 9/10, or even 10/10. Tests are harder, especially the final one, so spending time to review the materials then you will be fine. She offers lots of extra credits. Best teacher ever!!!

reviews.subject: COMM407 (Communications)
reviews.review: I took Comm Law as a hybrid class in the Fall. I was intimidated by counselors' warnings about this "tough" class but Belmas made it one of my favorite classes! She is so passionate and charismatic, making her teaching style fun and interesting. Did not use the textbook at all. Utilize her website and online lectures before the aaq's!

reviews.subject: COMM407 (Communications)
reviews.review: Belmas was an excellent professor! If you go to her lectures and watch all her powerpoints, they're wonderful and essential for your exams. Her quizzes are easy, the exams are a bit tougher. However, she is such an enthusiastic and passionate person, that it makes learning  the cases and laws so much easier. I def. recommend taking her if you can.

reviews.subject: COMM407 (Communications)
reviews.review: BELMAS IS GREAT!!  Took Communications Law as a hybrid class with her. Not an easy A class ;Attendance is highly encouraged for a good grade! Never used the textbook; if you watch her online lectures before each class and pay attention, you'll do fine. Few extra credit opportunities.  Belmas is extremely helpful and easygoing. I Recommend for sure!

reviews.subject: COMM407 (Communications)
reviews.review: Dr. Belmas is amazing! Comm law is difficult and not super interesting, but she made it so much easier and interesting. All the exams, except the final, are online, so I had all my notes out in front of me. She gives all the notes online which helps so much. Love love love!! take her!

reviews.subject: COMM407 (Communications)
reviews.review: Dr. Belmas is very animated when she teaches and that rubs off on all the students. Comm law is far from the most fun subject but she does very well with what she teaches and is very knowledgeable about it. This isn't an easy class but you should get at least a B if you put in the time and effort.

reviews.subject: ACCT201A (Accounting)
reviews.review: I will never forget Professor Li because I learned everything I know or remember from him.  I've used all that he has taught me time and time again.  I can still hear that southern accent repeating and repeating the same thing over and over again.  Thanks Professor Li.  You made me get my monies worth from CSUF

reviews.subject: ACCT201A (Accounting)
reviews.review: It was a very hard class. But, I have to admit that Prof. Li was one of the best teachers that I have ever had... no matter what other people say... he motivated his students to not only memorize stuff but actually LEARN :)People don't like him, because they wanted him to pass them without putting any efforts... Wish you the best Prof. Li

reviews.subject: ACCT201A (Accounting)
reviews.review: Probably the hardest class I have taken. But all his toughness paid off in the end when I studied. You need to show up, take notes, and study. Very possible to pass. He's retired though so nothing more to say.

reviews.subject: ACCT201A (Accounting)
reviews.review: ACCT 201A - Financial Accounting.  Not much to say anymore, he retired at the end of Fall 09 semester.  He is tough but he just wants every one to be as good an accountant as he is.  He doesn't deserve all the criticism from other commenters.  Do the reading, there are no shortcuts in accounting (and life).  Enjoy retirement Prof. Li.

reviews.subject: ACCT201A (Accounting)
reviews.review: It is possible to pass his class. You have to read and study. I'd recommend him though, I like his style. Everybody who is complaining sounds lazy.

reviews.subject: ACCT201A (Accounting)
reviews.review: Thinks he is the biggest BA in the world...will constantly hear him say "Read your notes ladies and gentlemen." Makes you feel dumb when asking questions...Don't take him if your trying to keep your GPA up...

reviews.subject: ANTH304 (Anthropology)
reviews.review: Class isn't done yet, but the class itself is as easy as it can be. There's not much homework or assignments. There's chapter highlights at the end of each unit with a quiz. He does do attendance, but sometimes he doesn't. There is also a short essay to do, and it isn't difficult. Super super easy A to get for one of your GEs.

reviews.subject: ANTH304 (Anthropology)
reviews.review: Mr. Canins class was pretty easy, attendance isn't really mandatory just send him an email in advance. Solid GE, he does get political here and there which honestly I have no issue with. Solid professor, and interesting anthro class. Take him!

reviews.subject: 481 (Anthropology)
reviews.review: Very jovial guy. Has a talent to link any conversation to anthropological concepts. Amazing general knowledge of just about any subject.

reviews.subject: ANTH305 (Anthropology)
reviews.review: This class was pretty easy in a great way, I enjoyed the assignments. Professor Canin cares about his students. Has one extra credit opportunity, but other than that pretty straight forward with what he expects as far as grades go. I would take him again.

reviews.subject: ANTH100 (Anthropology)
reviews.review: Amazing professor that genuinely cares about his students!

reviews.subject: ANTH305 (Anthropology)
reviews.review: Chill class and super easy! Highly recommend.

reviews.subject: ENG101 (English)
reviews.review: He doesn't put anything on Canvas. If you don't show up you won't pass. You have to print almost every class, sometimes he makes you print out assignments multiple times. You have to calculate your grade yourself and you won't know your grade till the end of the semester.

reviews.subject: ENG101 (English)
reviews.review: Solid teacher, handwriting is a mess though, uses paper packets sold at the TitanShop, class materials weren't too difficult, mandatory participation but ends classes early on most days, uses no technology.

reviews.subject: ENG101 (English)
reviews.review: Final grade is based on numbered assignments you keep track of over the semester. A little all over the place but very chill and approachable. Grading is a little strict but just stick the outline he gives and you will succeed. Ends class early often so just show up and do your part, ez A (must buy $45 txtbk he wrote himself)

reviews.subject: ENGL101 (English)
reviews.review: Honestly the only thing that made his class kind of hard is he didn't use canvas at all. Which made it kind of hard to keep track of your grade and assignments. The work he assigned was pretty easy but honestly it was hard to understand what he wanted us to understand sometimes.

reviews.subject: ENGL101 (English)
reviews.review: He's pretty chill, on essays and assignments, he is super strict with grading, however, before turning in those essays he will give the best feedback, if you actually take his feedback you'll get an A on the paper. Its a lot of work and you got to show up but for the most part it's super easy work that a 5th grader could pass the class.

reviews.subject: ENGL101 (English)
reviews.review: Took English 101. One of, if not the best professor I've ever had. Teaches things in a digestible and easy way, gives great feedback and keeps class entertaining. Lots of writing but that's expected for an English class. Does have a strict attendance policy but I never felt any urge to not go to class.

reviews.subject: ECON202 (Economics)
reviews.review: I've taken three classes with Prof. Gurtovoy, 1 in person and 2 online. He's a great dude and really cares to help out. I would suggest taking him in person, however the online work can be helpful as well as long as it is taken seriously. Really appreciated my time with him.

reviews.subject: ECON202 (Economics)
reviews.review: Too much of a workload and terrible lecture materials.

reviews.subject: ECON310 (Economics)
reviews.review: Homework is very reasonable and all due the day of the test. Lectures were quite good, he knows his stuff. He doesn't demand total mastery of the material he just expects a fair amount of understanding. Tests are multiple choice but the final has a written section. Takes a while to respond to emails, but overall good professor.

reviews.subject: ECON1 (Economics)
reviews.review: I highly recommend Professor Jason. He was really caring and willing to help me get through his classes. If you don't care, they don't care. There is a lot of homework, but if you are sure to do it all, you show up for class, and try your best you will pass his class. I took him for both lower levels Macro and Micro econ, and would take again.

reviews.subject: ECON1 (Economics)
reviews.review: Too much work for any class, took it online and the work load was more than my other classes combined. Online and textbook assignments required which took around a couple hours each to complete; repetitive and pointless.

reviews.subject: FIN303 (Economics)
reviews.review: The professor did not care about students at all, went over the material very fast letting the students do most of the job on their own. He posted sample tests and solved them in the class but the actual tests were heavier. LOTS OF ONLINE HW AND QUIZZES. Final was super hard (bc of mass shooting threat on Campus was online and not multiple choice)

reviews.subject: HCOM100 (Human Communication Studies)
reviews.review: BEST PROFESSOR EVER!! he is the sweetest and will teach you a lot of great life lessons you can apply to your life. Enjoyed taking this class, 100/10 recommend him to anyone interested in taking hcom101

reviews.subject: HCOM100 (Human Communication Studies)
reviews.review: He is actually really inspirational and he gives good life lessons. However, his exams are very hard and do not follow what e taught during the semester, so you kind of just need to hope for the best and try to read the textbook (even though I got nothing out of the book that I actually used on an exam).

reviews.subject: HCOM100 (Human Communication Studies)
reviews.review: Jack is a great professor who cares about his students and teaches through his life experiences and truly wants to see his students succeed. He will talk with you about anything and help you through everything.

reviews.subject: HCOM235 (Human Communication Studies)
reviews.review: Jack's an amazing professor! He has a great sense of humor. His lectures get sidetracked often, but I'm not complaining, because he shares his interesting and comedic life stories. He is caring of his students. His tests are difficult, not going to lie, but the class is passable if you turn in ALL of your work and put in effort. Highly Recommend!!

reviews.subject: HCOM100 (Human Communication Studies)
reviews.review: Jack is honestly the best professor I have ever taken, and I have taken a lot! He inspired me to do what I want in life, he taught me how to build healthy relationships, and he helped grow my confidence. His lectures are funny and easy to follow, tests aren't too hard, and has clear expectations for speeches. Take his class! I strongly recommend.

reviews.subject: HCOM235 (Human Communication Studies)
reviews.review: Jack was by far the greatest professor I've had. He's funny & his lessons are always relatable. Regardless of how difficult the material was, he always finds ways that he compared to real life scenarios that made it easier to understand. I wish Jack taught more classes because he always makes going to class enjoyable. TAKE HIM IF YOU'RE ABLE TO!!!

reviews.subject: COMM351 (Communications)
reviews.review: Short lectures, but honestly, not much feedback or instruction to help with assignments. He also gave inconsistent feedback. I would ask him for clarification on an assignment, and it would contradict what he wrote on Canvas or said in lecture, so make sure you email him to confirm. Good luck

reviews.subject: COMM351 (Communications)
reviews.review: Lectures are very short over Zoom--at most 45 minutes, but usually 30. Assignments are usually done in Word or Photoshop/Canva. No exams or quizzes. You basically get to build a copywriting portfolio. Ask for clarification if you need it. Use your best grammar skills, and you should be good in this class!

reviews.subject: COMM351 (Communications)
reviews.review: The best professor in the COMM dept, I take him every chance I can from 1st-4th year. Super easy going guy,clear on what he wants (just follow the rubric),usually low effort class but u learn alot because he has us do projects/assignments every week. If you ever doubt ur work, email him, he is responsive and nice about it. Just try and you'll pass.

reviews.subject: COMM351 (Communications)
reviews.review: Nice guy, easy assignments especially is you have canva. I did the weekly assignment (1) in 10-20 min same day of and got full credit. Lectures are kinda long and repetitive but super easy to follow. Overall easy class!

reviews.subject: COMM451 (Communications)
reviews.review: I do not know what are these previous comments talks about? Literally, the best professor in the college of communications. As an international student who lives in U.S., Professor Evanow has been the biggest inspiration to me. He always points out lifelong valuable lessons from his over 25+ of professional career. Every class is a blessing.

reviews.subject: COMM351 (Communications)
reviews.review: Weekly projects with little to no instruction. When you email him, he seems annoyed. Allows one redo on the project at the end of the semester, but don't count on it significantly raising your grade. Wouldn'

reviews.subject: ANTH101 (Anthropology)
reviews.review: If you have attention issues you do not take the class. Attendance is mandatory and it is always a lecture the entire class time. She does not allow you to take notes on the lectures with technology or with paper and pen. This class was dreadful.

reviews.subject: ANTH101 (Anthropology)
reviews.review: I don't get the hate tbh.There are 3 essays that are worth a big chunk of ur grade.Ppl say she isn't understanding about the essay deadlines-but she makes it VERY clear in the syllabus of her policies so can't rlly blame her since she literally tells u in advance.She is a strict grader but if u go to office hrs she'll help u get an A on the essay

reviews.subject: ANTH101 (Anthropology)
reviews.review: Easy class if you can put in the effort to complete 3 different 1.3k+ word formal research essays in one semester. Very tough grader on essays and final group project. Weekly quizzes are easy points, it goes along with the textbook, answers are available online as well. Very boring lectures almost every class, no device usage allowed during class.

reviews.subject: ANTH101 (Anthropology)
reviews.review: Professor Commitante expects way too much out of an 100 level class. She acts like everyone is majoring in anthropology, most of us are just there for a GE. Attendance is mandatory, three essays that are VERY harshly graded and super time consuming, no tests. The final is a group project, but good luck, she wanted to give everyone 5 to 6/10.

reviews.subject: ANTH101 (Anthropology)
reviews.review: You have 3 papers that are mandatory. If you do not write one of the papers, you fail. That being said, the quizzes are easy A's, and attendance is easy. Anybody who fails this class just doesn't listen to her. Take it, it's easy.

reviews.subject: ANTH101 (Anthropology)
reviews.review: Absolutely would not recommend this class if you are not an anthropology major. The class consists of three essays, which are insanely difficult seeing as you have to use sources from google scholar, meaning you cannot understand anything because they are extremely scientific. She is also a harsh grader when it comes to essays, rarely giving A's.

reviews.subject: ECON315 (Economics)
reviews.review: Great professor with a lots of care for his students. His class is synchronous and questions are answered at any point. Literally in the middle of a lecture, you can ask him a question and is beyond nice to answer. Lectures are recorded and sheet is allowed during in-class exams. Can get challenging but don't be afraid to ask. Study guides given!

reviews.subject: ECON315 (Economics)
reviews.review: He's nice and enjoys the subject matter. Unfortunately, it's pretty obvious that he has no clear direction in how he wants to teach the class. He tried something new by spreading the content between the textbook and his own personal book. This was confusing as some of the content contradicts to what the other book was stating. Do not recommend.

reviews.subject: ECON315 (Economics)
reviews.review: Very dry subject, presented dryly. Not a bad guy, pretty generous with grades. I left every test feeling horrible, but got a A's and Bs. 25/36 is a B. Overall B in the class. He wrote the book and created the powerpoint, so attendance isn't necessary because his book is exactly what he says in class. Super boring, but I'd take again. Easy B

reviews.subject: ECON515 (Economics)
reviews.review: He does not teach this micro-econ class the usual way. Class if very conceptual and he does apply the concepts to current and past events and gets you to think outside the box. Read the materials and record his lectures and DO review daily. For me, I had to discuss the concepts with the professor and classmates to make sure I understood the concept

reviews.subject: ECON315 (Economics)
reviews.review: class is 3 tests and 1 final. Allows you to skip 1 test and take the average of the two tests that you do take. Professor teaches based off his own textbook, so it is important to read the textbook. Go to lectures to hear his examples as they are usually on the test. Tough grader but easy to pass with some effort.

reviews.subject: ECON515 (Economics)
reviews.review: Michaels is a very good lecturer. He provides plenty of examples to drive his points home. the class has 3 exams & 1 final - nothing else. understand his examples and go to class - he always mentions extra things that you could include in exams that will drive your points up. he's helpful & willing to listen if there are problems.

reviews.subject: 370 (Business)
reviews.review: extremely extremely unorganized. this class is a busy persons nightmare, if you are not constantly checking his word document for his course outline you will never know when assignments are due. i strongly advise to find another online class.

reviews.subject: FIN370 (Business)
reviews.review: The professor himself is pretty confusing. He has you buy 2 different programs for the class, Breakout Learning and Pearson, for homework. It was more busy work than actual content. He grades easily, but his assignments were tedious. A big downside for me was that the quizzes and exams were only open during the weekends.

reviews.subject: FIN370 (Business)
reviews.review: Honestly, one of the best finance professors I've had. I was shocked that some people struggled because he makes everything so straightforward. I took him for FIN 370, FIN 371, and FIN 375, and all the exams and quizzes are online on Canvas outside of class. He keeps things simple with a few easy worksheets; you'll pass with no problem.

reviews.subject: FIN371 (Business)
reviews.review: Decent professor. All quizzes & exams were online for the weekend & bases them around his textbook, so it's required to buy it. Only a few homework assignments. Course is heavily graded on 1 final group project due at the end. Not very tech savvy & had to rely on in-person lectures / his textbook to learn.

reviews.subject: FIN370 (Business)
reviews.review: *FIN 570* Don't know where to begin. I wouldn't recommend taking professor Greco. The amount of tedious weekly homework, quizzes, lectures/reading was ridiculous. It was so much that retaining anything significant became a problem. On top of that, there was passive-aggressive communication from the professor via email which didn't help. Don't do it

reviews.subject: FIN370 (Business)
reviews.review: Would not recommend this professor. He assigns long weekly online homework with multiple parts per question that take at minimum a few hours to do. This tedious online homework did not help at all with the weekly quizzes and the three exams also. Only his in-person lectures and prerecorded lectures help, if you take notes. His final is cumulative.

reviews.subject: BIO300 (Biological Sciences)
reviews.review: This class is very easy. The professor provides all lecture slides and study guides, making quizzes doable. Not much homework. There are projects you can choose from that you will need to total up to 50 points and are due at the end of the semester, giving plenty of time. The only downside is the professor's personality. Can be rude and weird.

reviews.subject: BIO300 (Biological Sciences)
reviews.review: Professor is very blunt and has backhanded comments towards students. Assignments are mostly not explained well, she's very wordy. Prepared to get a whole story in class. Not a simple easy class, this feels like a major course. Yeah, avoid this course. Please and thank you. Prayers for whoever ends up taking her.

reviews.subject: BIO453 (Biological Sciences)
reviews.review: Tricky exams, but worth attending lectures to pass. Unstuck study was a lifesaver for exam prep - definitely recommend using it alongside the textbook.

reviews.subject: BIO453 (Biological Sciences)
reviews.review: She's interesting when she does teach, she goes off on tangents. She however isn't very nice to her students. She embarrassed me a few times when I had her last semester and I wanted to cry because she made me feel stupid. She wondered why our class was quiet but I feel like students were honestly scared to sometimes because she embarrassed them.

reviews.subject: BIO453 (Biological Sciences)
reviews.review: She is pretty rude to her students but an easy class if you just show up

reviews.subject: BIO300 (Biological Sciences)
reviews.review: The info is interesting. maybe its the way she teaches it ... but it is.. but the test are. ridiculous.  Your grade is based on the weekly quizzes. They will really drain you. Defiantly take notes of exactly what she says. the test are based of her verbal. Trick/confusing questions. assignments are ok. its just the tests

reviews.subject: CJ300 (Criminal Justice)
reviews.review: Not an easy teacher by an stretch of the imagination. But if you put the effort in, you will get a decent grade. I think a lot of the people on here complaining were just lazy students that didnt read their textbook or show up to class.

reviews.subject: CJ345 (Criminal Justice)
reviews.review: There is always quizzes at the beginning of class. He calls on people randomly. Miss class? He'll call you out the next class on it. Very tough exams, he makes it so there is many generic right answers but he's very nit picky about dates and certain cases. Would not recommend, you won't pass unless you study the book word for word.

reviews.subject: CRJU345 (Criminal Justice)
reviews.review: This is professor needs some anger management classes. He is very hot headed. Yells at the students in class for very minor things. Doesn't even teach you much; you basically teach yourself by reading the book. Make sure you read every little thing in the book because it is fair game. No powerpoints. Would never take again.

reviews.subject: CJ345 (Criminal Justice)
reviews.review: DON'T take his class, really full of himself and can't teach for anything. He claims he has a PHD, but I am pretty sure he got it from a technical institute. Guy needs to get fired, the only reason he has his job is prob cuz of tenure. A carrot can teach better than this guy lol. Textbook is required and tests r strictly off the book.

reviews.subject: CJ300 (Criminal Justice)
reviews.review: Kevin Meehan is tough but fair. You HAVE to read the book. I advise make bullet notes the chapter before he goes over it, so you have questions ready. He gives out handouts sometimes, so important to attend plus pop quizzes. He has a tendency to go on tangents. It was my first criminal justice class and he made it easy to understand.

reviews.subject: CRJU300 (Criminal Justice)
reviews.review: Kevin Meehan tells you exactly what he expects from you and it's up to you to earn your grade. You HAVE to read the textbook and all handouts he gives you before you attend the class. If you don't, you won't be ready for the pop quizzes or lectures. I enjoyed this class, but I read the textbook  so that probably has something to do with it.

reviews.subject: ART101 (Fine Arts)
reviews.review: Taking Art 101 with her is so easy! Follow her instructions, do all your assignments, come to every class and pay attention you will pass! She gives you all the Q/A you need for the exam. I thought it was drawing class but not bad art history! Def recommend!

reviews.subject: ART101 (Fine Arts)
reviews.review: High recommend for easy A!! Gives all info needed to pass exams. Makes class interesting. Do assignments, come to class, attend review sessions.

reviews.subject: ART101 (Fine Arts)
reviews.review: She is a really good teacher and knows what she is talking about. She always has a lesson prepared and is there before class starts. Do the homework assignments because they are really easy. Show up to class and take notes and do the study guides and you will get A. Highly recommend!

reviews.subject: ART101 (Fine Arts)
reviews.review: Pat is a great teacher! :D She really gave me an interest in art when i thought i would hate it.  She is fun, makes the class easy if you pay attention to her lectures and always willing to help you if you ask in the right ways.  She is really approachable and makes the class interesting. Take her! :)

reviews.subject: ART101 (Fine Arts)
reviews.review: I enjoyed taking this class, especially with Pat. She is a really nice professor who loves what she teaches and she does a very good job at doing it! She gives you a review before tests and they help A LOT. Gives extra credit.. I recommend anyone to take her!

reviews.subject: ART101 (Fine Arts)
reviews.review: Seriously an awesome teacher. Really loves what she teaches and her review before exams is literally the exam word for word.

reviews.subject: PHIL100 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: He wasn't BAD but he was not close to GOOD. Grade is based off 2 essays and 2 tests. Very, very boring, so if you couldn't care less for Phil like me, then don't take it. So far, I have an A but haven't finished the semester, so grading isn't that harsh. If this is just another GE for you, don't take it.

reviews.subject: PHIL101 (Philosophy)
reviews.review:
Honestly you should not get anything lower than a B. Any negative reviews on his TEACHING specifically are from
people who struggle with writing and memorizing information.  if you are fine with those you will pass the class.  Do not skip lectures unless you have a friend in the class with notes.  he's harsh with participation and can be demeaning.

reviews.subject: PHIL105 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: Class wasn't bad, nor was it good. Very nitpicky about the answers you give on assignments and exams. Lectures were extremely long, so be prepared to take notes as there are three quizzes, a midterm, and a cumulative final.

reviews.subject: PHIL106 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: He loves what he teaches, however, if you do not understand it right away, he doesn't really seem to understand why because to him it makes a lot of sense, and can be harsh if you don't get something right. Attendance is not mandatory but he gives so many opportunities for extra credit, so show up. Only 4 homework assignments and 2 exams.

reviews.subject: PHIL105 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: Great professor. If you expect to get out early or hope he cancels class, that wont ever happen. He provides pdf of textbook. Easy lectures snd notes. Can make some funny jokes here and there. Do your work and youll be good. Also for big tests, be sure to REMEMBER EVERYTHING. Very old school, takes notes on board, paper tests/quizzes. All free hand

reviews.subject: PHIL101 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: This teacher made me hope that I got hit on my walk here, This teacher talks fast, he's not nice or a very easy person to go to for help and is very specific about everything in class and doesn't explain things well, he explains it in a way that he'll understand and not in a way that you would, you dont take notes, just does examples, keep away!!

reviews.subject: MKTG351 (Marketing)
reviews.review: This class was quite easy. He's a lenient grader, the assignments are easy, but it can be very boring imo, there's weekly pre-recorded lectures. He is very picky about answers on the exam, and AI will NOT benefit you in this class. You have to study, study, study. Good luck!

reviews.subject: MGMT351 (Marketing)
reviews.review: Boring and outdated. Multiple long lectures each week, each typically over hour. You have to take detailed notes on EVERYTHING he says for studying, because he asks the most specific questions on exams and quizzes. Note layouts are vague but the actual lectures go on and on about random stuff that he will for sure asks on exam. Don't take lol.

reviews.subject: MARKETING489 (Marketing)
reviews.review: Terrible professor. Yes he will help if you reach out but he has very unclear directions and so far everything he has said in class has been different on canvas and his syllabus. It takes him multiple emails to understand and answer singular questions. He's helpful, but wouldn't need to be if he just organized his class correctly.

reviews.subject: MARKETING489 (Marketing)
reviews.review: Lebard is one of the best professors I've had during my time at CSUF. The class was a bit unclear at first, but just ask him and he's willing to help! If you're really into marketing and want to learn, take him. He is very knowledgable and brings in years of experience. Attendance is mandatory and you primarily work in a team.

reviews.subject: MKT489 (Marketing)
reviews.review: Prof Lebard is the sweetest old man!! Class is made up of around 10 assignments, 2 group projects, and a couple quizzes. The quizzes are so easy because theyre online and open note, get your answers directly from the notes NOT CHATGPT. Assignments are easy and group projects are easy just be organized. Would recommend!

reviews.subject: MKTG351 (Marketing)
reviews.review: Way too old to be teaching marketing. Lectures are from covid, outdated, and glitch. Every student realized quickly that the most random stuff would be on the quiz/test so you had to write down every word he said and because he drones on its hours worth of notes. Said if we buy this book we get extra credit so he must make money off it.

reviews.subject: HIST310 (History)
reviews.review: I took this over the summer. You will be assigned 20 assignments weekly that are all locked by a pass code that you have to decipher through his lecture videos, some spanning over 20 mins long. Each of them contain at least one letter for the passcode. Find another class if you can.

reviews.subject: HISTORY (History)
reviews.review: Do not bother taking 380B on legal american history unless you want to waste your time looking for passwords in videos for half of your day because one letter is off. The class itself would be interesting, if it was not locked behind walls that have the most narrowing openings to get to the next task. Save yourself the effort choose any other class

reviews.subject: HIST180 (History)
reviews.review: This class requires a lot of writing, so it's not an easy GE. The professor can be a tough grader, but using resources like unstuck AI can help with study prep. Worth it if you're interested in the subject.

reviews.subject: HIST180 (History)
reviews.review: First, I want to preface that I can tell this professor is passionate on what he is teaching. My biggest issue here is the amount of work. I had to take a week off from work to do the assignments! Over 120 of them and all of this is due in 11 days. Its too much! If you want to do a condensed course please have it to at least the 5 weeks. Torture!

reviews.subject: 310 (History)
reviews.review: I enjoyed his lectures and the readings but it is way too much work to do in a short amount of time. He had a one week grace period which was very sweet and respectful to the students time but he did not respect it the last week and he said he changed the syllabus day of and closed the class early, making it so many could not finish the modules.

reviews.subject: HIST386B (History)
reviews.review:
Online Hist 380C: -Assigns way too much work (hours and hours of recorded lectures with hidden passwords) 
-tries to confuse you with semantics on quizzes
-does not care about workload of students taking 15 units
-Tells you to follow a structured plan but that plan doesnt leave enough time for final
-worst decision of my semester and I love history

reviews.subject: ART201A (Art)
reviews.review: Only images and no captions during lectures. Notes aren't posted online.

reviews.subject: ART201A (Art)
reviews.review: Easy to follow lectures. Teaches the right amount of info to help you understand the general concepts, ideas, etc., seen in the artwork of a given time frame/civilization. Take good notes and study; tests are in-person and multiple choice. As a professor, he's kind and speaks a little quietly, and gets passionate about things like politics.

reviews.subject: ART201A (Art)
reviews.review: One of the most skilled and knowledgeable professors I've ever gotten to take. He's so genuinely passionate about the subject he teaches it makes it so easy to enjoy listening to his lectures. Highly recommended

reviews.subject: ART201A (Art)
reviews.review: Overall, he was very chill and straightforward. The lecture is very lecture-heavy, and it's essential to take notes because he only shows images of the artwork. Graded on three exams and two writing assignments. Highly recommend studying for the exams and attending exam day reviews. The questions were simple, but the list to memorize was a lot.

reviews.subject: ART201A (Art)
reviews.review: Prof does have a monotone voice however it isn't as bad as people say. Very clear on what's going to be on the exam and even points it out a couple times while lecturing. Go to his review days if you wanna be certain on what to study for. Only downside is that he has no text on slides so it's a bit challenging to follow. But overall great prof.

reviews.subject: ART201A (Art)
reviews.review: lectures for whole class, only shows images so make sure to listen for notes, easy class as long as you write good notes and make sure to study for exams, professor has quiet voice so pay attention

reviews.subject: ECO332 (Economics)
reviews.review: 70% of your grade is based on the midterm and final. Her lectures are confusing and easy to get lost in since she goes on tangents often. It is almost better to learn the material on your own since the lectures don't do much. It took forever to get grades back as well. On the brightside, she does curve grades and there is practically no homework.

reviews.subject: ECON320 (Economics)
reviews.review: Very rude when it comes to questions, tough graderVery rude when it comes to questions, tough graderVery rude when it comes to questions, tough graderVery rude when it comes to questions, tough graderVery rude when it comes to questions, tough graderVery rude when it comes to questions, tough grader

reviews.subject: ECON202 (Economics)
reviews.review: The class isn't difficult if you use her practice test which give you a free A if you study them. Her accent can make it difficult to understand her, but you eventually get used to it, but if you don't you can self-teach yourself using her slides. Also, there's not many assignments, but your grade HEAVILY realizes on tests (MCQ) and a five pager

reviews.subject: ECON202 (Economics)
reviews.review: Taught myself most of the information in this class and barely passed. Material isn't very difficult but her way of explaining it is. Practice exams are very VERY similar to exams which helps.

reviews.subject: ECON332 (Economics)
