reviews.review: Very rude when it comes to questions, tough grader, goes off on tangents about fun facts often, and when grading and critiquing work she doesn't actually tell you what was done incorrectly, and once again she'd not nice, nor helpful when asked questions so that won't help you either, good luck.

reviews.subject: ECON332 (Economics)
reviews.review: There's no homework, your grade is based on a couple presentations, a few exams, and that's all, so you must perform well on them. Her lectures aren't very important to attend, she talks about "fun facts" and stuff not actually on the exams a lot. On the bright side, she does provide a study guide at the beginning of the semester to study.

reviews.subject: WGST100 (Women's Studies)
reviews.review: Writing assignments are strictly graded, no use of opinion and interpretation of the many readings is allowed. While difficult at first, you'll learn critical thinking and analysis. Very rewarding when completed and is a very interesting topic. Take this class if you're genuinely interested in the topic it'll be rewarding and you'll learn a lot!!

reviews.subject: WGST100 (Women's Studies)
reviews.review: Easy asynch course - just a few reading responses based on lectures, which are usually very long. Final is a 1000-word essay on what specifically you learned throughout the semester. Extra credit offered where you make a "final lecture". Her grading sometimes said I wasn't specific enough to the lectures when I'm sure I was. Cool professor though.

reviews.subject: WGST100 (Women's Studies)
reviews.review: The class is challenging, with strict grading and unclear feedback. However, using study tools like unstuck AI alongside the required readings and videos can help navigate the course. The professor's inflexibility makes it a tough but rewarding experience.

reviews.subject: WGST100 (Women's Studies)
reviews.review: The toughest task was staying on top of the reading, beware that the online asynchronous class is extremely lecture heavy and a lot of documents to read. The topic itself is interesting and it consists of 4 reading responses (200 words), midterm, and a final. Just follow her instructions and you'll get a perfect score and get complimented like me.

reviews.subject: WGST100 (Women's Studies)
reviews.review: Taking this class is kinda funny bc you'll struggle so much and try so hard to get a good grade on your transcripts. But once you see it there you realize that none of it was worth it. Do yourself a favor and take a different professor.

reviews.subject: WGST100 (Women's Studies)
reviews.review: i wanted to like this class and if it helps, i did learn a few things but overall i had such a hard time trying to appease her requirements. shes a very strict grader and wont give you clear feedback. i would say to take someone else.

reviews.subject: CHEM301A (Chemistry)
reviews.review: If your hesitant, just take her. I think she was great and she has side videos to watch that are very good but dont get behind but honestly I think she made this class very very passable and I learned a lot. I would take her again if I could. Exams are hard but no impossible by any means.

reviews.subject: CHEM301A (Chemistry)
reviews.review: The lecture videos were great and self-explanatory. She puts a lot of effort into her lectures on Zoom. But lots of homework and it is required. Exams are challenging and based on Homework. Very caring. Takes time to explain.

reviews.subject: CHEM100 (Chemistry)
reviews.review: This class is asynch, but there are required Friday meetings when it's exam time. Everything is in the lecture and the worksheets/ practice exams are almost identical. I didn't have a problem in this class, but it did take a bit of time. She also curves and she's very understanding! Not a lot of people did well on the final and she curved it HARD

reviews.subject: CHEM100 (Chemistry)
reviews.review: Classes is require for exams. You can go to Friday sessions, it isnt required; she postes her lecture videos which explain the material thoroughly. Since it was online this semester she uses proctorial for exams. She doesnt answer emails, but she sends announcements consistently on titanium. I would take her again.

reviews.subject: CHEM301A (Chemistry)
reviews.review: Dr. Sathianathan is such a caring and thoughtful professor. COVID and online learning has definitely made it more difficult for her, but she always did her best to encourage her students to participate and ask questions. She was also incredibly understanding with giving students more opportunities to raise their grades.

reviews.subject: CHEM100 (Chemistry)
reviews.review: Claimed that it was an asynchronous course but if you don't attend the Friday zooms you won't have any idea of what is going on in the class. She doesn't answer emails and wouldn't make accommodations for tests even when given legit excuses. I would avoid at all costs if possible.

reviews.subject: PHYS101 (Physics)
reviews.review: Attendance werent mandatory. He gives out hw but just for practice, isnt graded.  This semester he drop everyones individual lowest midterm. Exams were okay, you take it at given time and email him your paper before the due time. Not proctored or anything, very simple.

reviews.subject: PHYS101 (Physics)
reviews.review: He is a nice guy but this class was online due to covid and he really struggled with the technology aspect. There were always issues with the zoom links and he doesnt post your grades online so it was hard to know how I was doing.

reviews.subject: PHYS226 (Physics)
reviews.review: This is one of the easiest Physics professors I've ever had! There are three midterms that you get to use a cheat sheet on and he tells you what each question on the exam is going to be! He did have a hard time transiting over to online, but overall this class is pretty easy.

reviews.subject: PHY101 (Physics)
reviews.review: He is super nice and very passionate about what he teaches. During lecture, he repeats the information several times to make sure students understand. There are 3 midterms, a final, and two papers. During the exams, we are able to have a 3x5 index card to fill with information. He drops the lowest midterm. The papers are super easy.

reviews.subject: PHYS101 (Physics)
reviews.review: Pretty straightforward and easy class, three midterms and the final, with your lowest midterm score dropped, and two easy papers. Copy and study the slides from the lecture and skim through the work and you'll do well. Only downside is that lectures can be a little boring sometimes, other than that hes a really good professor

reviews.subject: PHYS212 (Physics)
reviews.review: He is a really nice guy and is super enthusiastic about physics! His lectures can drag on and be a little boring. But if you study the lecture notes and do the homework you should be fine. His final was a little tricky and different compared to the other exams during the semester. But if you get an A in the final then you can get an A in the class.

reviews.subject: ACCT201 (Accounting)
reviews.review: He is great knows the material and gives examples that relate to the real world his test are hard but the problem solving section really helps since he kinda tells you what the probs

reviews.subject: ACT201A (Accounting)
reviews.review: I taught myself everything. He did nothing for me. He really shouldn't be a teacher. He does not teach, presents horrible tricky test on a subject matter that he doesn't teach, and penalizes you for almost everything. He's annoying and arrogant (although has no reason to be). I've only had to retake one class my whole college career...

reviews.subject: ACCT201B (Accounting)
reviews.review: He is a nice and funny teacher. He tries his best to make the concepts understandable. It was a tough class but it prepared me for the final which is departmental and hard. You have to study constantly for the weekly pop quizzes. The tests can be difficult so make sure to do the homework problems knowingly and you'll do fine.

reviews.subject: ACCT201A (Accounting)
reviews.review: stay far away.  he comes across as a bit brazen and arrogant.  there would be moments in his class where i would not understand any of his examples or what he was talking about in relation to accting.  he has this attitude of "cmon' dontcha' get it?  what's wrong with ya'"?

reviews.subject: ACCT201A (Accounting)
reviews.review: I didn't enjoy his class. He's very tricky on his quizzes and tests. He wasn't very helpful when I went to his office hours. Take Burnstein! He's much better.

reviews.subject: ACCT201B (Accounting)
reviews.review: Doesn't check attendance per se, but has an unannounced quiz every couple of chapters. You fail if you're not present. He's a nice guy and is usually there during office hours. Subject is hard but easier than 201A. Tedious homework collected but you can just copy it off of blackboard. Uses powerpoint. I got a C.

reviews.subject: PSY202 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Shenanigans. This guy reads off slides and they're not even his own.  You will never meet a professor less inclined to do actual work.  Professor is a strong word. His publications are also a joke - some are basically blog posts. Don't take this guy. How bad were things that CSUF even hired him?

reviews.subject: PSYC202 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Res. methods is a tough class with  lots of work, but Dr. Es. walks us through everything. Go to his office hours for homework assignments and he'll do them with you. That's how I got an A. He really wants his students to do well. But it is a tough class.

reviews.subject: PSY202 (Psychology)
reviews.review: There's many lab and homework assignments so go to Dr. Es.'s office hours. He walked me through every assignment. He's hilarious in lecture and there's no text. So make sure to study slides for exams. I've learned a lot in this class.

reviews.subject: PSYC202 (Psychology)
reviews.review: He was good it was just the amount of work he assigned. He said the assignments would take only 10-15 minutes, trust they DONT. But if you really needed help you would walk you through everything and get you to understand the topic clearly. Doesn't take roll but I would recommend showing up because the what is on the lectures is on the test

reviews.subject: PSY202 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Wouldn't recommend at all. Not a good teacher, reads directly off his slides which aren't even helpful for the exams. His homework takes forever to do and I don't feel like I benefit from any of it. Literally taught myself everything so far this semester.

reviews.subject: PSY202 (Psychology)
reviews.review: There is a ton of work in this class, get ready for it. I went to Dr. Es.'s office hours and worked through all assignments, and got an A. He really cares that we understand the material, and his lectures are entertaining, funny. I learned a ton in this class and now I am breezing through PSYC 300.

reviews.subject: ECON201 (Economics)
reviews.review: Chill guy. Read the textbook it will make sense with his PowerPoints. I mean tests weren't bad. Very generous guy and respect him for that. Kind of gives off the Mr small vibe from amazing world of gumball. talk to him it wont be bad.

reviews.subject: ECON515 (Economics)
reviews.review: Easiest Econ professor at CSUF. Smart, passionate, humble, and very fair.

reviews.subject: ECON417 (Economics)
reviews.review:
Shows up, reads from a PowerPoint non stop, does not engage students, writes gibberish on the board at 100 miles an hour, and calls it a day. 

Horrible communication skills, does not help you in any way, and he does not respond to your emails. As lazy and unprofessional as they come. Avoid this person. He's an instructor, not a professor.

reviews.subject: ECON201 (Economics)
reviews.review: His passion for economics is very admirable. Easy class, a lot of common sense stuff. Make sure to read syllabus thoroughly and get PointSolutions set up before the first class. All HW & assignments are easy to get full credit on. Final is accumulative and in person, the other midterms are online. Very convenient class I recommend for anyone.

reviews.subject: ECON201 (Economics)
reviews.review: Professor Howard's ECON201 class is a straightforward introductory economics course. The lectures can be a bit dry, but he's knowledgeable and willing to help. The workload is manageable - 3 online midterms, an in-person final, and some homework. Unstuckstudy was a lifesaver for exam prep.

reviews.subject: ECON202 (Economics)
reviews.review: He was a straight forward guy, he was nice when I asked questions after class so don't be afraid to ask questions. Everything is online except for the final, the participation was online as well. Super easy to pass just have to study and know what your doing.

reviews.subject: ART101 (Art)
reviews.review: This class was easy, but it's easy to fall behind and skip lectures, but don't do it. Very caring and nice professor with great communication and clear deadlines. If you need to take art 101 this is a very light professor. There are a few physical and online art projects.

reviews.subject: ART101 (Art)
reviews.review: Anyone taking art just for the credit, Prof. Nguyen is great! She is very passionate and always willing to help students understand. It's very lecture heavy and be ready to take notes or photos because they can go fast. Lots of discussion posts and exams are open note/textbook.

reviews.subject: ART201B (Art)
reviews.review: Prof is fine but the way she formats her notes is confusing. Tends not to highlight actual info that is needed on exam, slides have way too much info, and unfortunately her lectures don't add anything new. Exams are open-note (I recommend copying exact text on slides on google doc to find info easy). Course wasn't hard but didn't learn much.

reviews.subject: ART201B (Art)
reviews.review: Couldn't get used to her lectures. Her explanations are boring, and I think that's unfortunate because a lot of art history is really interesting to me. The way she presents her info on the slides can feel overly complicated. I recommend looking at other sources on the side to study. Make sure to take really thorough notes; exams are open note.

reviews.subject: ART101 (Art)
reviews.review: amazing prof, great lectures, super caring and chill

reviews.subject: ART101 (Art)
reviews.review: DONT TAKE THIS COURSE AT NIGHT. i was falling asleep because it was simply a lecture with boring slides and a quiet voice

reviews.subject: 120A (Chemistry)
reviews.review: if u just want an easy A dont take. i suck at chem but she actually helped me learn and understand what im doing. the way she answers questions is direct, instead of going in circles. shes fair and unbiased, i didnt feel intimidated asking questions. she gives a lot of chances for credit so its not hard to pass, but you have to put in the work too.

reviews.subject: CHEM200 (Chemistry)
reviews.review: I honestly liked her teaching style. Very traditional, no nonsense. If you're looking for a professor to entertain you because of your short attention span from TikTok, this is not your professor. She is straight to the point, does a lot of practice problems in class so you get it down, and no extra fluff added. Pay attention and study.

reviews.subject: CHEM200 (Chemistry)
reviews.review: Honestly, as long as you pay attention, you will be okay. Sometimes in class, I didn't understand some concepts because in general chemistry is a hard subject, but self-teaching myself came in clutch. Study guides have way more than she actually puts on the exam, PRACTICE PROBLEMS is the key to passing.

reviews.subject: CHEM200 (Chemistry)
reviews.review: reads off the slides and is dismissive of questions. class is passable if you self-study and teach yourself most of the material. lectures were fast-paced, and most exam material is based on solving problems, but she goes over them in class. study guides contain more info than what the exams test, which was a bit frustrating. overall an ok class

reviews.subject: CHEM123 (Chemistry)
reviews.review: Mostly lectures and online homework after class, but you will need to put in the effort outside of class if you want to pass. She does her best to keep students engaged, but this is still a difficult subject. I recommend taking notes (which are available on canvas) prior to class and annotating them during her lectures.

reviews.subject: CHEM123 (Chemistry)
reviews.review: bro idk what everybody was on about but she goes really slow in lectures & there's an attendance sheet. she also sometimes she pushes back homework like week 1 hw was due on week 5?? 60% is passing and can study by slides and ytvids alone to pass. also occasionally hints exam questions + answers in class. bare minimum and memorization you can pass

reviews.subject: BIOL101 (Biology)
reviews.review: This class is great for biology majors on non majors. There isn't too much work, just enough so you could learn. I didn't like how her graders never gave feedback on the concept maps, it was really hard to get a 5/5 in the beginning and it really affected our grades. I wish she gave examples for concept maps so that we could know how to get a 5.

reviews.subject: BIO101 (Biology)
reviews.review: An extremely hard and inconsistent grader with unclear rubrics. Will not elaborate on the rubric when asked, and does not provide any feedback, requested or not.

reviews.subject: BIO (Biology)
reviews.review: Didn't learn anything. She cancelled class very often but students lost points if THEY didn't show up. Barely got any assignments and when we did she didn't like giving full credit.

reviews.subject: BIO101 (Biology)
reviews.review: Dr. Rosa is an amazing biology professor; she made this class fun. I never liked anything to do with science or physics, but she made it fun, and the assignments were fun as well. Two writing assignments are fairly easy, in my opinion. It's mostly note-taking, but it's a great class!

reviews.subject: BIO101 (Biology)
reviews.review: Overall, it was an easy class, but she's a tough grader. A lot of people were constantly frustrated with their scores. When you asked about it, there usually wasn't much feedback. There were two writing assignments, but if you did well on the first, the second was optional.

reviews.subject: BIO (Biology)
reviews.review: Took her bio 453 class she was really nice and understanding. Rarely any homework and usually you have time to complete them in class because they're super easy, just a couple group projects and a paper at the end of the semester.

reviews.subject: POSC100 (Political Science)
reviews.review: I thought she was cool in the beginning but later was very dismissive of others and would only look at things from a close-minded perspective. She would say offensive things and had the mentality that bc of her age she was correct. Was very easy if you can get over the crazy stuff she says.

reviews.subject: POSC100 (Political Science)
reviews.review: My favorite teacher this year. Lectures are interesting and her views on the outside world are honestly eye opening. She knows a lot of people in CA legislature which gives her lots of credibility. Appreciates when you participate, and hates when people skip class. I looked forward to attending every week!

reviews.subject: POL100 (Political Science)
reviews.review: Craziest teacher I've ever had but her class was insanely easy, only 3 exams and 1 paper. She makes you go to a city council meeting for the paper but she grades fairly easily. Make sure to take good notes and study!

reviews.subject: POSC300 (Political Science)
reviews.review: While the course was interesting and caused many to think about money and politics, her views and condescending attitude about being older and therefore smarter were irritating. Especially when dismissing views due to her experiences.

reviews.subject: POSC100 (Political Science)
reviews.review: Mrs. Jimeno's ridiculousness during her lectures is what kept the class engaging and less boring, which was genius considering she kept everyone waking by giving out these passive-aggressive responses on our papers and when everyone started talking about her, it was a thrilling experience for us students!

reviews.subject: POSC100 (Political Science)
reviews.review: She is an okay Professor the work itself is very doable. You have 1 paper and 3 exams which are all fairly easy as long as you prepare. Her lectures are pretty pointless she rambles about random things.

reviews.subject: HIST300B (History)
reviews.review: This woman needs an intervention. She brags about no one ever getting an A in her class ever. This shows she is dismissive of her students and sees them as enemies and not pupils. If her objective is to torture people into not pursuing history, she should change careers. Her pedagogy is a joke.

reviews.subject: HIS180 (History)
reviews.review: This class was harder than it should've been. The only thing that counts for your grade are 6 exams, which were kind of hard. There's a lot of reading and you need to use Inquizitive. The lectures were long, but the professor tried to make it fun.

reviews.subject: HIS180 (History)
reviews.review: The course I took History 180 online was easy! Do the online work which takes a bit of time but it is easy as well. You have to purchase the online textbook and it helps all the answers are there. You take an exam after each section, I believe in total there were 8. I was a bit skeptical taking this course, but I'm glad I did.

reviews.subject: HIST190 (History)
reviews.review: Her tests are difficult and specific to the lecture, you have to do the reading. Her syllabus says tests are out of 100 but she gives you a 'bonus question' for 5 points. EXCEPT, she makes the tests out of 105 instead so its POINTLESS. Her syllabus says she doesnt do plus/minus grading but my entore class got graded with plus/minuses. Unfair prof

reviews.subject: HIST190 (History)
reviews.review: Rude and misunderstanding professor. She is the worst! Avoid her at all costs!!!

reviews.subject: HIST190 (History)
reviews.review: Horrible professor!!! Especially because there is no sympathy towards students when it is because of students tuition that she gets paid. At least be more clear about grading!

reviews.subject: ACC307 (Accounting)
reviews.review: He doesn't cover book material and has a lot of MCQ/Quiz on it, so self studying is key to passing. However, I think his Excel teachings are resume worthy and probably the best things I've learned within my 3 years of college. There were 22 A's, 48 B's, 50 C's, and 9 F's. I got an A through his exam curves and self study. He's retired now.

reviews.subject: ACCT307 (Accounting)
reviews.review: DO NOT TAKE HIM! DOES NOT USE THE BOOK HOWEVER HE TESTS ON YHE BOOK!

reviews.subject: ACCT307 (Accounting)
reviews.review: He is a really bad professor. A majority of the exam are on material that he never talked about. People say that it will be worth it, do not believe and save yourself the stress.

reviews.subject: ACC307 (Accounting)
reviews.review: I felt that his class was intimidating at first but as the semester went along, it wasn't that bad. Quizzes were based on textbook which he never covered in class. The heaviest part was the Excel Project on the second half of semester and as you started it as early as possible, you could finish on time. I learned a lot about Excel in his class.

reviews.subject: ACC307 (Accounting)
reviews.review: About 15 quizzes based off textbook. Midterm/final based off textbook and Excel. Project given after midterm that takes 40+ hours to complete, if you want an A. Definitely a tough class; however, I will say that I'm practically an Excel god now. I got an 88% in the class. Quizzes/tests use from text bank. Wont answer a question unless its SPECIFIC

reviews.subject: ACCT307 (Accounting)
reviews.review: Took this class to master excel. thought i could handle his personality. I was biting my tongue every time he spoke to me. i was actually scared to go to that class every week.. he made it so miserable. I currently have an A in that class and im struggling... I feel bad for the other students. I would NOT recommend him.

reviews.subject: MGMT340 (Management)
reviews.review: Extremely hard to study for tests, Group hw every week, final group project, both very easy. Mumbles through lectures only attend for attendance grade. Bad teacher but easy to pass the class. Find sample quizlets online, exams are conceptual based but the class lectures aren't.

reviews.subject: MGMT449 (Management)
reviews.review: Mr. Alamir was fantastic to have in class. He really cares about your overall performance and wants you to succeed. It's very important to attend classes

reviews.subject: MGMT340 (Management)
reviews.review: Professor Iyad is a helpful and supportive instructor who genuinely wants his students to succeed. He is approachable, willing to answer questions, and provides guidance when needed. The class grade is mainly based on exams, so it's important to focus heavily on preparing for them. His exams can be challenging, but studying the study guide helps

reviews.subject: MGMT340 (Management)
reviews.review: The class was amazing! Professor Alamir energy, passion, and genuine care for students made every lecture engaging and inspiring. The real-world examples and the supportive classroom atmosphere truly changed how I think about leadership and teamwork. I highly recommend this professor and am very thankful for this experience

reviews.subject: MGMT340 (Management)
reviews.review: Dr. Iyad is an amazing professor he actually cares for his students success.  MGMT 340 is a boring class but he made it interesting by making the class engage in class discussions.  The exams were pretty hard just make sure you do well on the quizzes and if you have any questions feel free to reach out to him since he is more than willing to help.

reviews.subject: MGMT340 (Management)
reviews.review: Great professor who explains Organizational Behavior concepts clearly and keeps the class engaging. The real-world examples and class discussions really helped deepen my understanding, and the learning environment was always supportive and respectful

reviews.subject: ENG462 (English)
reviews.review: I actually took this professor when I was in grad school around 2012 and 2013. He was one of the best professors I've ever had, and I still talk about how intelligent and funny he is. He inspired me a lot during my time at Cal State Fullerton. He's just wonderful.

reviews.subject: 300 (English)
reviews.review: What a great professor I would take him 100% again hes so nice and understanding!

reviews.subject: ENGL200 (English)
reviews.review: Prof. Ruiz was really chill and is passionate about what he teaches. Attendance wasn't mandatory, but there were pop quizzes on random days that you couldn't make up another day; they were what mainly impacted ur grade.

reviews.subject: 300 (English)
reviews.review: You definitely need the textbook as all discussion posts and the final paper due at the end of the semester have to do with it. But Velasco is the best, work is manageable, and he is very understanding. Lectures are good and insightful but he does frequently cut them off. I highly recommend him though to everyone, he's so nice and just the best.

reviews.subject: 300 (English)
reviews.review: By far the funniest professor I've ever had. There is one big 10 page essay for the final which he gives you the whole semester to do, and you must submit two rough drafts of it over the course of the semester. He gives pop quizzes that are only one question each and are very easy. Overall he is a very funny professor with fairly easy coursework.

reviews.subject: ENG300 (English)
reviews.review:
Inspirational, very helpful, he's a blast to just talk to if needed. 

While admittedly there's a lot less learning interacting in the classroom than one might expect (which is part of why his classes are easy), if you were to ask for help/tutoring, you will get more than what you would expect and then some. He knows is stuff and is very kind.

reviews.subject: CJ340 (Criminal Justice)
reviews.review: Professor Koo is a straightforward instructor who has much passion for the subjects they teach. Be prepared to listen and communicate. This class is lecture heavy and group discussion heavy. Very little homework. Test's make up most of the grade. Professor will explain further if asked but may not give you the answer you're looking for. Think wise.

reviews.subject: CJ340 (Criminal Justice)
reviews.review: 99% lectures and way too fast paced, lectures consist of her weird humor and briefly covering each subject for a few minutes before moving on. Office hours arent of much help either, seems more interested in boosting her ego than helping students understand the material. Save ur time and money

reviews.subject: CJ340 (Criminal Justice)
reviews.review: Extremely fast paced and 2 lecture and exam heavy Important topic that make up a big portion of ur grade are covered for few minutes and never revisited so ur basically teaching urself everything. She constantly makes weird jokes and overshares about her personal life instead of actually teaching. Do urself a favor and dont take her class

reviews.subject: CJ340 (Criminal Justice)
reviews.review: You need to go to class and pay attention, I found them straight forward but make sure you study. She can make some jokes that some may or may not like but overall, just a straightforward get to the point person. Slideshows make sense if you study them enough.

reviews.subject: CJ385 (Criminal Justice)
reviews.review: she seems chill but be warned she isn't. she makes weird jokes and gets rly off topic. it's true she grades heavy on participation but i still got a low B in that category even when i did participate nearly every class period. super tough grader wouldn't recommend this professor to anyone

reviews.subject: CJ385 (Criminal Justice)
reviews.review: at first she may seem chill/easy, she lectures off of slides and goes off on tangents about her personal life and doesn't give much homework. the catch is that the class is discussion heavy and if you're on the introverted side good luck, participation is based off on much you speak in the class. her tests also hard if you dont study/go to class

reviews.subject: FIN320 (Finance)
reviews.review: She goes over exams review which is super helpful. Hw was light, 3 exams total. Her instructions are very clear, just make sure you show up and pay attention.

reviews.subject: FIN320 (Finance)
reviews.review: the greatest online professor i've had! it can be a challenging course, but she does everything she can to help you succeed in the course. quizzes are given using Proctorio. the final is cumulative (decided by the department), but she does what she can to prepare you. her lectures are very thorough and example heavy.

reviews.subject: FIN320 (Finance)
reviews.review: Super sweet and responsive professor. Her 3 proctored exams are super similar to practice ones and she allows a cheat sheet. Review them and you'll do fine. Weekly homework is easy and on pearson. Lecture videos are easy to follow and helpful. Keep up with the modules and you'll pass with no problem! Great professor and I would def recommend!

reviews.subject: FIN320 (Finance)
reviews.review: Overall, pretty easy class, but don't fall behind. Exams are pretty similar to the study guides besides the final. homework is super easy. Everyone says beware final but it's not that hard if you're able to understand the conceptual parts of the lectures and not just calculations. She is very organized. 3 exams, 1 final (commutative).

reviews.subject: FIN320 (Finance)
reviews.review: She was honestly an amazing professor! Her lectures were super easy to follow if you pay attention. Everything is activity based and she goes through every material super thoroughly. She's great at answering questions, and she does a great job doing everything step by step. The exams are basically everything we learn in class, make sure you study!!

reviews.subject: FIN320 (Finance)
reviews.review: She was a very great professor. Lectures were good and homework was easy.

reviews.subject: MGMT339 (Management)
reviews.review: Just follow the instructions, and you'll do amazing. I did the bare minimum and got such a great grade. Looking back, years after graduation, he really was an amazing teacher who prepared me for work.

reviews.subject: MGMT339 (Management)
reviews.review: Quizzes and exams are fully online (proctor) and open in 2 days with 2 attempts and a time limit. Homework every week but open book/notes and no timing. The extra credits will save you so make sure to do it. It bumps up 4% of your FINAL GRADE. I would recommend only if this class is online.

reviews.subject: MGMT339 (Management)
reviews.review: Yes, he can be rude and snap at students but only when they ask dumb questions. Class was fully online and exams could be taken anytime during a 2 day window. To be honest, I did not study at all for the exams and still passed the class because of the 4% extra credit and 2% curve. If you can get passed his attitude, I highly recommend.

reviews.subject: MGT339 (Management)
reviews.review: Good prof. to take if you have a life outside of school. Hybrid class allowed two days to take exams. Exam heavy and under some ridicules time limits like 40Q 40Mins. Extra credit saved my grade. Im not the strongest student and managed a B. Make sure you do your homework as it was %30 of grade.

reviews.subject: MGMT339 (Management)
reviews.review:
Let me just list out why you should avoid this professor:
Pros: Give you the textbook for free
Cons:
-Does not respond to questions of any form
-Rude and will tell you to figure it out yourself
-NO curve
-Late to class every day
-Changes schedule to suit his own work schedule
-NO office hours
List goes on, avoid if you can!

reviews.subject: MGT339 (Management)
reviews.review: He is an amazing proffesor. His class was very organized. I highly recommend him. If he teaches 340 I will for sure be with him.

reviews.subject: ISD361B (Information Systems)
reviews.review: I never took his class but I heard William Lau is not a good professor and he's mostly expecting homework. I recommend you to take a different instructor to improve your grades.

reviews.subject: ISDS361B (Information Systems)
reviews.review: Dr. Lau knows statistics from A to Z. He does not take attendance because he knows that if you do not show up you will not pass the class. His class is hard, but he teaches you straight up statistics and doesnt beat around the bush with useless information. His semester project is tricky. Show up to class and do all of the homework.

reviews.subject: ISDS361B (Information Systems)
reviews.review: Water guns, ice cream and pina coladas. Prof. Lau can have a temper at times, but he's not that bad of a guy. Do the homework, take lecture notes, and don't skip class. He has a forgiveness policy for his final where if you get an A = A in class, B = B in class...etc. He knows his stuff, just do all the things mentioned and you'll do well.

reviews.subject: ISDS361B (Information Systems)
reviews.review: Water guns, ice cream and pina coladas. Prof. Lau can have a temper at times, but he's not that bad of a guy. Do the homework, take lecture notes, and don't skip class. He has a forgive policy for his final where if you get an A = A in class, B = B in class...etc. He knows his stuff, just do all the things mentioned and you'll do well.

reviews.subject: ISDS361B (Information Systems)
reviews.review: He give you everything you need to know for the exams. And is very good at explaining the material. Those student that gave him a bad rating probably didn't put any effort into the class. It is actually a pretty simple class to pass this class Just show up and pay attention. 1 Quiz, 2 Midterms, a Project, and a Final. Definitely recommend Lau.

reviews.subject: ISDS361B (Information Systems)
reviews.review: He is pretty straightforward with his teaching! He uses a lecture note packet that is way more simplified than using the text book. Review strictly his lecture notes for quizzes/test/project, and you'll pass. However, the final is TRICKY! Watch out! If you decide to take this teacher and pass, it was well worth it!

reviews.subject: SOC371 (Sociology)
reviews.review: Very good prof. Just put in the effort to get a good grade.  The class is clear and the prof. makes everything reasonable.

reviews.subject: SOC410 (Sociology)
reviews.review: Prof. makes things clear and assignments are reasonable.  An A is attainable, just be on top of everything.

reviews.subject: SOCI308 (Sociology)
reviews.review: Took this during the summer. Made us write a paper a week with a rough draft and final draft. Had to peer edit a couple papers for credit. Let you write about anything you wanted. Easy prompts. You need the book for the tests he gives on the reading. Do the reading its for the test. However, the reading was insightful.

reviews.subject: SOC410 (Sociology)
reviews.review: I took him online and it was great he made theory easy. If you watch the lectures every week and you understand them then there is no reason you should get lower than an A. He gave a lot of extra credit points as well.

reviews.subject: SOCIO410 (Sociology)
reviews.review: Everyone on here will say that he is an easy teacher and I wholeheartedly agree hence the A+ I just received. Take this class 100% don't even think about not doing it, and do it in person too. Here's the catch if the class doesn't talk you'll hate his class and if you have an opinion, you'll hate the class too because he will discredit you. Be wary

reviews.subject: SOC410 (Sociology)
reviews.review: Professor Emery is the only teacher you should take for Soc 410. I took this class online and he made theories so approachable. There is lots of extra credit and plenty of work to get a decent grade in the class. Show interest and try. You will do great.

reviews.subject: FIN517 (Finance)
reviews.review: This class has a midterm (25%), final (45%), and project (30%). She provides in-person and pre-recorded lectures, with all materials available from week 1. Exams are open-book/note and similar to the practice reviews. Calculations follow lecture examples, so study her methods and practice problems.

reviews.subject: FIN320 (Finance)
reviews.review: graded only on pearson hw and tests. no group work and there were online prerecorded lectures. overall super chill if you just study

reviews.subject: FIN517 (Finance)
reviews.review: Pre-recorded lectures were helpful. In-person lectures were a waste of time because the professor talks about her personal life. Finance may not be hard, but the professor's complex way of presenting it led me to dislike it. It seems that she likes the status of being a professor but either is unaware or doesn't care about her teaching style.

reviews.subject: FIN321 (Finance)
reviews.review: Took FIN 321 Online. Ghosh provides short lecture videos to break up the material and made it easy to digest. Only a 12 Q midterm, 25 Q final and group paper is your grade. Takes a long time to post the midterm grade, never posted the final or project grades, just turned in final grades so had to wait and see what you received. Open book/note exam

reviews.subject: FIN321 (Finance)
reviews.review: Your entire grade is a group project starting at the very end of the semester, peer evaluation for that project, and two exams. The first exam (30% of your grade) is only 12 questions and the project (25%) is just answering 3 questions so it is intimidating. Be prepared for Proctorio on exams with all features.

reviews.subject: FIN321 (Finance)
reviews.review: No homework is required for this course. There is one midterm, a group paper, and the final. If you bomb the midterm, you better make sure you get a good group and ace the final. Had no idea what my grade was going to be until grades were turned in since 65% of your grade rides in the last two weeks. If you aren't self disciplined, look elsewhere.

reviews.subject: CHEM120A (Chemistry)
reviews.review: Wouldn't recommend taking her. She clearly wants students to learn, but her teaching style just isn't effective for most. Quizzes are tough with little prep or guidance. You'll spend hours on a complex topic and be tested almost immediately. She also skims over slides that make up most of the exam and focuses more on less relevant material.

reviews.subject: CHEM115 (Chemistry)
reviews.review: This is like high school chemistry, so nothing too surprising. As long as you are on top of your assignments and study the material you should be fine. However, she has frequent quizzes (one almost every week) and exams are weighed heavily.

reviews.subject: CHEM115 (Chemistry)
reviews.review: Avoid this chemistry course if possible. Professor Overstreet is kind, but is a tough grader. Only one student passed, who had already passed AP Chemistry. To succeed, attend office hours or seek tutoring, as lectures, materials, and exams are heavily weighted.

reviews.subject: CHEM115 (Chemistry)
reviews.review: Having retaken Chem 115, I can confidently say Professor Overstreet should be avoided if possible. Her lectures are quite difficult to follow sometimes, especially if you lack prior chemistry experience. She is very test-heavy, gives sizable amounts of homework, and can be a bit insensitive to her students.

reviews.subject: CHEM115 (Chemistry)
reviews.review: Cathie Overstreet's class is challenging, but engaging if you put in the work. Lots of quizzes and assignments, but she offers extra credit. unstuck AI was a big help for study prep.

reviews.subject: CHEM115 (Chemistry)
reviews.review: Harsh grader who often doesn't thoroughly explain the content. Often favors her morning classes and the students who sit in the front or who have a high grade in her class. Do any extra credit when offered will help your grade in the long run. She will encourage you to go to tutoring. Seems nice at first but she clickbaits you.

reviews.subject: AIS230 (History)
reviews.review: AIS 410- Amazing teacher, and extremely interesting lectures. I took this class from 7:30-10:20, and he was able to keep us engaged and participating. Usually a very simple quiz each class.

reviews.subject: HIST180 (History)
reviews.review: He is a cool guy, but not a great prof. He starts the semester with presentation slides, but he ends up just reading from his notes. It is hard to follow along. Reading the book is mandatory but not as important as his notes. He is not a good communicator. If class is cancelled, he will just post his sloppy notes online.

reviews.subject: HIS110B (History)
reviews.review: One of the better history professors. Dr Tippeconnic is a super nice guy and was easy to get a hold of. He will work with you and was helpful when I missed a few classes. He lectures the entire time however he makes the material interesting. I would take him again.

reviews.subject: HIST180 (History)
reviews.review: He is a nice professor, but lecture is heavy. Class grade consists of 3 exams. Take notes on everything he says and memorize everything!! That is the only way you'll pass.

reviews.subject: HIST180 (History)
reviews.review: This class was very disorganized. The PowerPoints were inconsistent and it had very less assignments which created more stress for me. This class is based on tests.

reviews.subject: AIS230 (History)
reviews.review: He is very disorganized and your grade will not be displayed until the final weeks of class. Does not answer emails and hard to get in contact when not in campus. There are a couple of writing assignments, the midterm, and the final. Very lecture intense, no study guide and he will test you on ANYTHING learned from the lectures But he is a nice guy

reviews.subject: WGST360 (Women's Studies)
reviews.review: Professor Davis deserves a raise! Her class was outstanding and truly inspirational, expanding my perspective. Attendance is key for her insightful free-write assignments. Though she had some understandable cancellations, I wish I'd known her more. Take her classes—you won't regret it!

reviews.subject: WGST360 (Women's Studies)
reviews.review: Professor Davis is so sweet! When class meets, discussion is great and she is so caring and funny. Unfortunately, class is frequently canceled so for me personally it was hard to keep track of what was happening in class because we weren't meeting. Depends a lot on your learning style, but she really is so sweet :)

reviews.subject: WGST100 (Women's Studies)
reviews.review: This class is pretty straightforward with a sweet, caring professor. The readings are manageable, mostly graphic novels, and unstuckstudy was super helpful for prepping the quizzes. Definitely an easy GE to knock out.

reviews.subject: WGST100 (Women's Studies)
reviews.review: Provides very good feedback and grades fairly! The grading consists of very few assignments and I appreciate that all the assignments had set dates at the start of the semester and were very organized. This course is so easy and great for procrastinators. No pointless busy work and no exams.

reviews.subject: WGST205 (Women's Studies)
reviews.review: Hybrid class, few in-person meetings. Attendance is not mandatory. Canceled meetings often, but it was communicated early. The few assignments were creative projects with a super lenient grading scale. Class concepts were insightful. The readings were intimidating but not too bad; you could get away with skimming. Easy class, would recommend!

reviews.subject: WGST205 (Women's Studies)
reviews.review: She is amazing, one of the easiest classes I've ever taken. Take her for the easy A. She is also understanding and caring.

reviews.subject: ENG101 (English)
reviews.review: Professor Yoo made me remember how much I used to love writing. His writing prompts are very interesting, and his lectures really help you excel in your writing skills. Very clear feedback and will help you when asked. Highly recommend taking his class!

reviews.subject: ENGL101 (English)
reviews.review: The professor is great! There's a lot of in-class participation during the start of each unit, but it may be enjoyable for you. He is pretty strict about essay critiques, so make sure you finish drafts by the due date and show up to class on time.

reviews.subject: ENGL301 (English)
reviews.review: English has never been my thing but Professor Yoo made this class go by really fast. There arent too many professors ive had that were passionate about their work but I can truly say that Professor Yoo was one of them. His classes were always really engaging and I was always able to reach him easily for help on anything!

reviews.subject: ENGL101 (English)
reviews.review: I enjoyed Professor Yoos' class more than I anticipated! His lectures are incredibly informative and provide clear answers. Enjoyed how patient and caring he was with all his students. Attendance is mandatory, so I recommend attending, as it's part of your grade. Additionally, regular attendance helps you understand the lectures more effectively.

reviews.subject: ENGL101 (English)
reviews.review: Professor Yoo actually explains the material well and is very welcoming. I never felt afraid or nervous to speak with him. The workload is very manageable, and he gives over a month to complete 4 essays. Attendance does matter; it is a part of your grade. He is a fair grader. I was always excited to attend this class. Peer reviews are important!

reviews.subject: ENG301 (English)
reviews.review: Such a chill guy, he is reasonable in his request, and if you just talk to him, he's so understanding and willing to give extensions if needed

reviews.subject: LBST401 (Education)
reviews.review: i have taken him twice and he never disappoints, king is so chill and easy. 3 exams (cheat sheet allowed), for the writing portion of the exam he makes it a take home sometimes or tells you what they are going to be about. gives study guide and goes over it. he leaves you prepared.

reviews.subject: LBST300 (Education)
reviews.review: Reading heavy class. However, you can get away with not reading. He does not use canvas, nor does he use PowerPoints to lecture. All he does is talk. If you don't read, just take notes of everything he says. Take home exams. No homework, only reading. You only know your grade when he gives back exams. Great guy though, pretty funny sometimes.

reviews.subject: LBST401 (Education)
reviews.review: Professor Maine is such a cool dude and probably one of the easiest/ best professors I've had at CSUF. There's three exams (two short answers and multiple choice) and a presentation at the end of the semester. He is such a lenient grader and cancels class pretty often. Lectures can be long but the easiness of the class makes up for it.

reviews.subject: LBST300 (Education)
reviews.review: This has been one of my favorite professors. He made the class very enjoyable/engaging, wanted to see students do well. A few required texts all can be found for free online. Homework assignments will help with the exams. if you show up and pay attention you will be able to do well in the class. One final presentation on any liberal studies topic.

reviews.subject: LBST300 (Education)
reviews.review: Take him. Had few assignments, but we did have a book to read every month or so, and would get one easy quiz on what we read. Lectures would be on the chapters for that week. Super easy going guy, readings and lectures were interesting and quizzes weren't hard. No midterm or final, just quiz on what we had to read. Readings were interesting too

reviews.subject: LBST401 (Education)
reviews.review: Outstanding professor and interestings topics from the readings! 2 in person essay questions exams, group presentation, a final paper, and a few quizzes here and there. Show up because he explains the topics from the books thoroughly and he is literally the kindest/passionate professor out there.

reviews.subject: ECON412 (Economics)
reviews.review: Great professor. Passionate about what he teaches and course isnt that difficult if you actually study. He gives good life lessons as well and really caring about the students and their grades.

reviews.subject: ECON412 (Economics)
reviews.review: Wish he taught all my econ courses. The transition to online was tough on many classes, but this class felt as if it was in person. He writes the notes down as he goes rather than using power point. Weekly quizzes can be a bit tough, but if you review notes for the week it's an easy A. Very understanding with deadlines and extensions.

reviews.subject: ECON412 (Economics)
reviews.review: Prof. Gill is the fairest and most caring professor I've had. Even with decades of teaching and expertise, he was willing to learn and adjust to our class--even admitting one of the tests was too hard and gave us another chance. He respects students which is why he's so respected and loved in return. Go to class! Lectures/notes are key to success.

reviews.subject: ECON412 (Economics)
reviews.review: Prof Gill is by far my favorite and the best Econ Prof I've ever taken. He is extremely passionate about economics and he makes sure all of his students understand the material. Don't be afraid to ask questions, he is more than happy to help. If I could take all of my econ courses with Gill, I would. Quizzes are weekly and reflect his notes. Study.

reviews.subject: ECO201 (Economics)
reviews.review: He is hands down the best professor I've come across in my two+ years here at CSUF. Super caring and extremely helpful. I loved going to class because he had amazing lectures and was very kind. Always available for office hours and homework was extra credit! I thought the class itself was easy as long as you showed up and took notes.

reviews.subject: ECO201 (Economics)
reviews.review: Graded by two exams, one final, two papers, and five quizzes. Professor knows a lot about economics and is quick to answer emails. Homework is extra credit and really boosts your grade at the end. Study guides provided for exams. He updates grades weekly after quizzes and exams. Totally recommend him!

reviews.subject: DAN301 (Dance)
reviews.review: Easy to raise GPA Show up to class do some work and get stamped or signed from her It's like taking a high school course You have to buy her $90 book in order to the homework, reading and test. There was no test or final Your graded on all class work that she stamps and sings so you have to be there for an easy A Did i mention no test and 1 paper

reviews.subject: DANCE301 (Dance)
reviews.review: If you want an A.. this is a great class to take. It satisfies a few categories and is super easy. Your grade is strictly based on showing up and doing the busy in-class work. That's it. Crappy that you're forced to buy her book brand new.. but you'll get an A if you just show up. Seriously.  I got like 110% I think.

reviews.subject: DANCE301 (Dance)
reviews.review: This is a very easy class. She gives so much busy work and partner work. All the work felt very repetitive. You turn in like 3 large packets from the CD in the textbook, pages from textbook, and classwork done in class. She is not very friendly. Go to class and be proactive in your work and you'll pass with an A.

reviews.subject: DANC301 (Dance)
reviews.review: Busy work! As long as you show up to class, do the work, take notes, do the pullouts. You will pass. Dancing for extra credit is fun, every one usually participates. This is an easy grade! We did not have a test and no body questioned it. Saved me the stress in my last semester! If you don't show up, you don't get credit for assignment she signs.

reviews.subject: DNCE301 (Dance)
reviews.review: Kindergarten type work and movies every class, awhile being treated like a kindergartner by the anal Kara cross! Easy A as long as you show up and  buy a NEW copy of the hundred dollar textbook she published that you'll only use half of the semester... Changes  itinerary often with unclear notices.  Easy EXPENSIVE 'A'  Choose a different g.e

reviews.subject: DANC301 (Dance)
reviews.review: Kara is hands down the worst professor I've had at CSUF.  She wrote her own text book and your success in the class is contingent on BUYING a NEW copy of her textbook.  On top of that, you'll actually use the textbook for 2 units.  The course was unorganized and I learned maybe 5 things about dance.  Otherwise it's just a horrible history class

reviews.subject: ECON335 (Economics)
reviews.review: Best professor for this subject!!! Took him over the summer and just show up and do you work and you will be fine.

reviews.subject: ECON315 (Economics)
reviews.review: Three exams that are all fill-in and based on the math problems / math packets he has the class do in-class. Exams are always scheduled right after the class finishes the chapter sections for a specific Exam. Best method to pass is to get familiar with the math problems (practice until you're comfortable). No HW or projects.

reviews.subject: ECON310 (Economics)
reviews.review: Professor Fleissig was my favorite professor from my Fall 2025 semester! His lectures were straightforward, and we got note packets + practice problems every chapter. No phones are allowed out during the lecture, and honestly, that helped me lock in way more. Exams are pretty brief and straightforward! I thoroughly enjoyed this class!!

reviews.subject: ECON315 (Economics)
reviews.review: Entire class is based on three exams. Full lecture can only be obtained if you actually attend class. At the end of each chapter, he provides practice problems which he goes through step-by-step. Exams are quite harder than practice problems, but really tests how well you understood the concept. Always willing to help, great professor.

reviews.subject: 315 (Economics)
reviews.review: The exam review covered key concepts, but the examples used in class relied on "nice" numbers that didn't match the exam's complexity. With no homework or quizzes, you're left to self-study. The professor doesn't work through problems, just uses pre-broken-down slides, and repeats himself if asked for help, making it hard to grasp the material.

reviews.subject: ECON315 (Economics)
reviews.review: No homework and no projects. There are only two midterms and one non-cumulative final. Lectures are easy to understand, but the notes are mostly filled in. I recommend attending all lectures, what he teaches shows up on the exams almost exactly. Study the extra practice problems. Exams are all open-ended, not m.c., just like the in-class problems.

reviews.subject: ISDS351 (Information Systems)
reviews.review: Not a teacher. This is a class where you do every thing yourself. No support, no video tutorials, nothing. The professor is also very harsh and critical to the very fine details, so you need not not only teach yourself, you must be perfect in your execution.

reviews.subject: ISDS351 (Information Systems)
reviews.review: he is honestly a very chill, caring but cool prof! no mandatory attendance. 4 individual assignments that are on excel and project. he also gave us hella extensions but you can still turn in the assignments if you really needed help past the deadline. one group project that is not super hard though we did not end up presenting it

reviews.subject: ISDS309 (Information Systems)
reviews.review: He's a solid professor, his lectures for being almost 3 hours long aren't too bad to sit through and he can be entertaining in the way he explains things at times. He expects you to be very detail oriented and that will matter a lot for the tests. One group project and homework can be very time consuming.

reviews.subject: ISDS309 (Information Systems)
reviews.review:
PROS: he will train you to be the most detailed oriented person ever, because nothing is ever enough to him.
CONS: NO CHEATSHEET FOR ANY EXAMS, AND A TOUGH GRADER. I BAWLED MY EYES OUT AFTER EVERY EXAM. eventhough 3 or 4 questions are directly from the text book

reviews.subject: ISDS351 (Information Systems)
reviews.review: no this professor is not it I would NOT take him again I am currently fighting for my life to try and pass this class, it is heavy based on exams but he gives no prep for them and the exams are completely different then the lectures

reviews.subject: ISDS309 (Information Systems)
reviews.review: This teacher goes over the lecture quickly.  He teaches three classes usually Monday-Wednesday for one day.  He knows what he is talking about but he is not good to teach other how to do it.  Its suppose to be an introduction class but he teaches like you should know programming.  We started with 35 students and ended up with 19 in the end.

reviews.subject: CHEM100 (Chemistry)
reviews.review: This class is pretty easy as long as you stay on top of the few assignments and the two short essays. The exams are also manageable and come directly from the lectures. The midterm questions are very similar to what appears on the final.

reviews.subject: CHEM105 (Chemistry)
reviews.review: AMAZING PROFESSOR. Quizzes can be hard if you don't remember ur notes. He doesn't walk around; he just stays in the front of the class, so that can help. His lectures are amazing in detail and will help you when u ask a question. He is very understanding and communicates very well. I would take his classes over and over again to get an easy A.

reviews.subject: CHEM100 (Chemistry)
reviews.review: This chemistry class was great and super easy to get through. The quizzes every week were not that hard. Only one paper was given at the beginning of the semester, and it was due in April, which was super simple. He graded quickly, making staying on top of things easier. The class was organized, and the professor was nice and helpful!

reviews.subject: CHEM100 (Chemistry)
reviews.review: This is one of the easiest classes I have taken here. There were only a few assignments throughout the semester, and one big research essay. The essay was given in January, and we had until the middle of April to turn it in - super doable.

reviews.subject: CHEM100 (Chemistry)
reviews.review: Really easy class, and a great professor!  This was an async class, but he responded quickly and was very kind. The class is easy, but there are quizzes every week, but they're not that bad. There is one paper due, but it's super easy. Easy class overall!

reviews.subject: CHEM100 (Chemistry)
reviews.review: Chem with Prof. Byrne was a breeze! The class is well-structured, and he's super communicative. Quizzes and assignments are straightforward - just stay on top of them. unstuck AI was a lifesaver for test prep!

reviews.subject: POSC525 (Public Administration)
reviews.review: Great class and learned a lot.  Professor Stone really makes his class welcoming for people of all backgrounds.

reviews.subject: POSC309 (Public Administration)
reviews.review: Professor Stone's POSC309 is an engaging online course with manageable assignments. The quizzes and papers are doable, and office hours are super helpful. unstuck ai was a great study tool too. Definitely recommend taking this class.

reviews.subject: CRJU320 (Public Administration)
reviews.review: Lots of short prerecorded lectures that match up with the quizzes.  Really easy way to finish an elective.

reviews.subject: POSC320 (Public Administration)
reviews.review: Took this course asynchronous over winter session last year.  Was very easy and to the point.  Short multiple choice quizzes for every topic, final exam that was just like the quizzes, one short paper.  About the best you could ask for a winter course on a boring topic.

reviews.subject: CJRU320 (Public Administration)
reviews.review: Quizzes and exam are all multiple choice and very easy.  One paper that is more work, but no big deal.  If you go to office hours he basically helps you write it.  Great class to take during winter session and knock out an elective.

reviews.subject: POSC571 (Public Administration)
reviews.review: He was very considerate and flexible about my situation.  The grading seemed very fair and he provided a lot of helpful feedback.  I learned a lot too.

reviews.subject: PHIL323 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: I loved Professor Calarco's sense of humor. He gives long, but insightful lectures that demonstrated his passion for Existentialism. We had no hw, but I do wish we had group discussions about the material. With that being said, definitely read, show up, & take lots of notes as your grade depends on the midterm, final, (both have essay q's) & EC

reviews.subject: PHIL291 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: dont take this class if u dont show some interest in philosophy. many people don't show up for class/find themselves bored or do something else during lectures. its kind of understandable bc the entire class' just lecture but he's a damn good prof and knows what he's talking about. he's respectful and answers any questions. requires some effort.

reviews.subject: PHIL291 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: He's so good at teaching, and he can crack jokes. The entire class is basically just lecture but it's not boring if you show some interest in what the class will be about, plus he explains the material very well. there are readings, but you can skip em and just attend class, and it's more than enough for the 2 tests. he gives good study guides dw.

reviews.subject: PHIL323 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: Professor Calarco makes lectures engaging and ensures students understand the material. Tests are straightforward and grading is fair. Attendance is mandatory, but the workload is manageable. unstuck study was a great study tool alongside the course materials.

reviews.subject: PHIL323 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: Oh my gosh, he's AMAZING! His lectures are so entertaining, and the subject is interesting. He goes quickly during the lectures, though. Attendance isn't mandatory, but highly recommended so you don't fall behind when studying. This class requires thinking outside the box, but he's a very easy grader on exams. I would definitely take him again!

reviews.subject: PHIL323 (Philosophy)
reviews.review: Super chill professor, always cracked jokes and had fun. He is very knowledgeable about everything he teaches and is super lenient. His lectures just went through passages of books and analyzed them. Besides that, we only had a midterm and a final exam. Super easy on both, however, they are essay questions, so you do have to know the material.

reviews.subject: RLST351 (Comparative Religion)
reviews.review: He is super sweet I recommend, he actually cares about his students! DEF need to be on track or u won't do good, Its alot of work tbh each week, nothing u can't handle, but def need to take at least 3 hours out of the day to do his weekly work!!!! rlly sweet and caring proff! recomend!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.subject: RLST375 (Comparative Religion)
reviews.review: Wonderful professor! One of my favorite online courses that I took throughout the last few semesters. Canvas was incredibly organized and clean, and was always ready to communicate with his students. The material was interesting every week, and the lecture videos were engaging. Professor Levesque's passion for teaching RLST 375 was noticeable :)

reviews.subject: RLST201 (Comparative Religion)
reviews.review: Best professor ever! instructions are CLEAR as day. Seriously, so responsive and engaging!

reviews.subject: RLST375 (Comparative Religion)
reviews.review: As long as you complete the assignments, you'll be fine. He has good videos that explain everything clearly, and you can tell he enjoys the subject. The weekly assignment can sometimes feel long, but it always follows the same structure. He responds quickly to any questions and is very supportive if students need help.

reviews.subject: RLST375 (Comparative Religion)
reviews.review: Really straightforward and organized canvas page. Simple lectures that I found pretty interesting, and his notes are pretty much a fill-in-the-blank kind of situation. He's really caring, and is one of the easiest classes I've had.

reviews.subject: RLST201 (Comparative Religion)
reviews.review: Just an all around great professor and class.  Canvas is extremely organized and straightforward.  Just the right amount of work required and no subjective or nitpicky grading.  Every week was a workbook for a couple videos and readings, sometimes a discussion board, and a quiz, plus two exams over the semester.

reviews.subject: POSC300 (Political Science)
reviews.review: Enjoyed my time with this class. The class had two textbook required for the class. One being only a few chapters. His lectures are more discussions but important as its mainly textbook review. An interview project done online or in person, two exams. He's monotone but helpful, my favorite was the in-person interviews that discussed with the class.

reviews.subject: POSC100 (Political Science)
reviews.review: Took his online political science class. If you can tolerate inquisitive, it's an easy A

reviews.subject: POSC100 (Political Science)
reviews.review: There was multiple classes that we looked at the same slide for an hour and half and he just yapped the entire time. He talks too fast and his lectures and the textbook are completely different

reviews.subject: POSC300 (Political Science)
reviews.review: I really enjoyed Professor Berg's class! The class may seem intimidating, but it really isn't. Your grade relies solely on 2 exams and 1 project. Exams are straight questions from lectures + Quizlet helps a lot and the project will be way easier if you contact government officials ASAP when the semester begins. Would take again!

reviews.subject: POSC300 (Political Science)
reviews.review: Really nice, understanding, and is a quick grader. Grade based only on midterm, final, and a 3 part project throughout the semester. Textbook is important, but are worth the read for exams.

reviews.subject: POSC300 (Political Science)
reviews.review: This class is reliant on self-studying, as his lecture slides aren't engaging nor accessible. Rely on the textbooks (there's two, one of which won't even be used until later), as his tests are based on them. Your grade is based on those & an interview project. Put some time aside to study... don't recommend if you are taking a lot of classes.

reviews.subject: COMM370 (Communications)
reviews.review: Professor Fellow was a pretty good teacher. 1 paper at the end of the term, 3 exams, weekly quizzes, weekly lectures. My only complaints are that he's doesn't respond to emails and his textbook is way too long. Each chapter is very dry and boring. Other than that, he was pretty good.

reviews.subject: COMM407 (Communications)
reviews.review: From my experience with Fellow, I recommend taking another professor. The class was easy but he obviously has a difficult teaching style. The material was clear but his grading was not. From my experience as a COMM major, I believe there are more understanding and less difficult profs at CSUF. Fellow can be unprofessional which affects his grading.

reviews.subject: COMM426 (Communications)
reviews.review: His tests are directly out of the book (suggest you get it through Kindle) yet I had to email him several times because his quiz answers didn't match with the text (he only corrected himself maybe twice). Lectures are fifteen minutes of stiff regurgitation of the book, you won't need to watch them. Vocal about his beliefs in his assignment comments

reviews.subject: COMM410 (Communications)
reviews.review: Professor Fellow is the worst professor Ive ever had. He is extremely disrespectful and inconsiderate of his students. Feedback I received on my final project was him saying that COVID is an excuse for students missing assignments (Although I was missing 0 assignments). He also decided the give me a 0 on a quiz I originally got 4/7. Dont take him

reviews.subject: COMM370 (Communications)
reviews.review: This class is mostly just weekly lectures and readings which isnt too hard. All the quizzes and tests were online so as long as you had the book you could get a decent score. Only one paper and its fairly easy with clear criteria. Super generous with rounding and curving.

reviews.subject: COMM370 (Communications)
reviews.review: This professor was one of the second worst I had taken at CSUF. He would require that students watch his weekly lecture videos and take weekly quizzes. He is a tough grader so if you don't do well on quizzes then expect a drop in your grade. He doesn't even allow you to check on your answers once you finished. He is a hard professor so be prepared!

reviews.subject: MATH110 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Professor retired after taking him. Spring 2019. Overall pretty easy for a math class. Quizzes every other week. Online homework and modules that you have to pay 100 dollars or more for. Sometimes hes a bit annoying because he treats you like one of his kids. He gets mad if you dont take notes or dont engage in his lecture. He know everyones names!

reviews.subject: MATH110 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: He is one of the sweetest, most caring professors Ive ever had in my life. He wants everyone to pass his class truly, and will do everything in his power to make you understand the material.

reviews.subject: MATH10S (Mathematics)
reviews.review: I had him as a math lab class which was super easy. He is such a kind and warm soul. He would call us "children of heaven" which was so pure. He genuinely wants all students to do well and will make sure everyone understands the content. He also puts the effort to learn your name.

reviews.subject: MASS110 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Professor Fahmi is caring but I personally did not like how he taught. He had notes already made that you can print and just reads off from them. quizzes every Friday sometimes he would tell you what it is based off sometimes he wouldn't. final is cumulative and homework is online. also a project at the end of the semester. you have to show up.

reviews.subject: MATH110 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: He is such a caring teacher and he wants to make sure you understand the lecture. He might lecture slow at times but the math is simple. As long as you pay attention the math exams are very easy so make sure you go to class. You have to pay in order to do the homework through WebAssign so make sure you don't buy the textbook, buy the access code.

reviews.subject: MATH110 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: This was is kind of rough because it's a little difficult to understand him. He really wants everyone to pass though so he gets upset when he feels people aren't listening. If you're able to teach yourself some concepts, you'll be fine

reviews.subject: FIN320 (Finance)
reviews.review: MyLab is the best resource to understanding how to answer questions, it really helps for homework & to prepare for exams. Although the professors lectures aren't necessary to pass the class or the most helpful, he gives you the resources to be self-sufficient to pass. He gives two attempts on midterms when you score below the class average.

reviews.subject: FIN320 (Finance)
reviews.review: Lectures are like pulling teeth, he mumbles, doesn't go through examples, and lectures are long. He stops mid sentence to mumble to himself, and forgets where he is, very concerning. MyLab hw was more helpful than going to lectures. Exams are more concept heavy than math.

reviews.subject: FIN320 (Finance)
reviews.review: His videos were rather dry and somewhat helped. MyLab used for homework was more helpful with the step by step examples. Unlimited attempts on quizzes and hw. Midterms are unprotected, but final is proctored via zoom live. Final is taken on a Saturday. Would take again online, but his class is more for self learners

reviews.subject: FIN320 (Finance)
reviews.review: I took his course online ..   All the midterms, quizzes and hw  were online except for the final. The final  is online but it is proctored by zoom live . Most of the assignments are easy on mylab. There are a few lessons that are hard, but the mylab is very helpful.   I took fiance last year in person and it was very hard. He made is easy.

reviews.subject: FIN320 (Finance)
reviews.review: Do not take if you actually want to learn. All assignments are on Mylab, including exams. Only the final is proctored, and it is very difficult. Make sure to understand how to each problem. Study guide he gave for the final was not helpful. Don't rely on it. You'll probably have to teach yourself everything cause lectures didn't help.

reviews.subject: FIN320 (Finance)
reviews.review: This professor does not add anything  insightful to his “lectures” he essentially just mumbles the entire class and has long pauses to check his nails or something. It's almost comical how bad his class is. I don't recommend if you want to actually learn something.

reviews.subject: ENG462 (English)
reviews.review: Pretty straightforward class. Weekly journals and readings with 3 projects total. Hollis is very caring and understanding, and makes class discussions very engaging. Class mainly consists of about 70% discussing the reading, so you will get more out of the class if you do the readings. If you haven't taken a class with professor hollis, you should!

reviews.subject: ENGL495 (English)
reviews.review: Erin has to be one of my favorite professors at CSUF. She's super funny, caring, respectful, & brings great energy to class every time. Although we had a lot of readings, she's intentional w her subjects, & brings diversity to her class. She has a creative project, which are really fun, & a paper. She's a pretty easy grader, but does expect effort!

reviews.subject: 212 (English)
reviews.review: I've taken other courses with her and I loved them. There is no exams, three projects. Easy grader and there's no rubric. She lets you be as creative as possible. She's very funny and she isn't tough on grades. You are guaranteed an A if you do the assignments. Def recommend her for any class of hers.

reviews.subject: 212 (English)
reviews.review: Professor Hollis is great! She actually cares about what she is teaching and makes class fun and entertaining. Never made anyone feel dumb about sharing their thoughts. Class just has reading, a weekly journal, and 3 projects that arent too bad. Would definitely take again

reviews.subject: ENG466 (English)
reviews.review: A super easy class with a passionate yet polarizing professor. Just show up, complete basic assignments, and you're guaranteed an A. unstuck ai and a free online poetry archive make this class a breeze.

reviews.subject: ENG301 (English)
reviews.review: Dr. Hollis is amazing! I took her winter 2024 ENGL 301 class and it was a two week intersession course, so it was really fast paced. However, she made it very doable and was there to support us throughout the whole semester. She is very acommodating and kind. I would recommend her class to anyone thinking of taking this course! :)

reviews.subject: MGMT340 (Management)
reviews.review: Lusk's class is a mixed bag - lectures can drag, but her study material and quizlets are quite helpful. Unstuck AI was a lifesaver for exam prep. Tough exams, but doable with dedication.

reviews.subject: 340 (Management)
reviews.review: Didn't learn anything I didn't know already. Be careful if you hand in any assignments early, the criteria and guidance for the assignment changed right up to the deadline and left me redrafting assignments frequently. Didn't get a good grade but also didn't get any indication as to what was done wrong, the only feedback was positive.

reviews.subject: MGMT307 (Management)
reviews.review: I've never seen so inspirational lectures before. It felt like ted talks each time, motivating , inspiring, growing.

reviews.subject: MGMT340 (Management)
reviews.review: I don't think she teaches the material in a particularly memorable way. Her group project is a skit that you and 6 other people perform and she opted out of teaching for the last 3 weeks so we could work on our skit and present them instead of teaching. Not the worst professor but far from good.

reviews.subject: MGMT340 (Management)
reviews.review: 1 group project as final. Few assignments but weigh heavy on your grade. Took her class Tues 7-945pm, often times she would only lecture for an hour & dismiss class. Study material & know concepts, tests are concept heavy & questions are based off scenarios. exam reviews werent too helpful as test material was 80% different than what is on review.

reviews.subject: MGMT340 (Management)
reviews.review: Exams were mostly scenario-based and rarely matched the in-class lectures, attendance was mandatory, one group skit project, professor went off-topic on many occasions during lectures. professor herself was very nice and quite funny sometimes but her exams were unbelievably difficult. class average for final exam was an F.

reviews.subject: BUAD301 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: This is the kind of teacher I had hoped for when I first signed up for college. He is amazingly intrigued and care so much about your success beyond the classroom. I would highly recommend him to anyone who wants to take their education to the next level

reviews.subject: BUAD301 (Business Administration)
