reviews.review: While he is funny or tries to be, his only answer to any question is to read the rubric. Someone asks him a question about the assignment, refer to the rubric. Why did I get this grade, look at the rubric.

reviews.subject: BUAD301 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: Nobody better than this guy. He was exciting, inspiring, hard working and cared about us outside of class. He wasn't just in it for the paycheck like most professors at this school. He gave his time willingly and helped me in so many ways with my real life and business goals. Highly, highly recommend

reviews.subject: BUAD301 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: 2 GROUP PROJECTS, 5 CASES AND A WHOLE LOT OF INSPIRING SPEECHES. THE REAL DEAL. AMAZING TEACHER.

reviews.subject: BUAD301 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: Hands down the best prof in the entire CSU system. I learned more from Nez in one lecture than I ever did from any other Business Prof I took. More than anything he actually gives a darn about you. Thank you Nez!!!!

reviews.subject: BUAD301 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: He will help you discover YOUR SUPERPOWER and put them into proper knowledge that you can use in your life. If you are looking for exceptional experience Professor Nez is the person you need. I highly recommend Professor Nez

reviews.subject: ENG101 (English)
reviews.review: Hes and alright teacher. As long as you fallow his type of writing style then you will be fine. He doesn't allow any different types of writing besides his own. If you don't do it his way you get an F. Has a packet that's cheap so you don't need a book. I wouldn't take him again if i had the option.

reviews.subject: ENGL101 (English)
reviews.review: He is only "easy" if you follow EXACTLY the format he tells you to do. If not, it will be reflected in your grade. Good thing is, instead of a textbook, you just have to buy his packet which is used everyday in class. If you pay attention, take good notes, and actually work on your essay, you'll be fine.

reviews.subject: ENG101 (English)
reviews.review: This prof is easy. Just do what he tells you, and follow directions and you should pass with no problems!

reviews.subject: ENG101 (English)
reviews.review: Okay here's an honest review. His class is not an easy A you actually have to work hard, and go to his office hours and show that you care in order to get an A. However, after taking this class my writing improve a lot. So if your looking for an easy A don't take but if you want to learn something then take this class.

reviews.subject: ENGL101 (English)
reviews.review: Singer is simple, do as he says and correct the changes he recommends and you are good. He barely gives out quizes which dont count against you (they are easy EXTRA CREDIT) and writing center is EXTRA CREDIT. Essays are the entire course. he gives PLENTY of time to complete the essays. TAKE him. He is somtimes funny and his books helps ALOT!

reviews.subject: BAUD201 (Business)
reviews.review: Definitely a hard grader who does not give the best feedback. The majority of her lectures were a complete waste of time. She does not do the best job of explaining the content, I learned more from the online assignments. If taking this course with her is your last option, I'd say just take the class. Otherwise, I'd look for a better professor.

reviews.subject: BAUD201 (Business)
reviews.review: She takes attendance every class and this counts towards your participation grade. She is extremely tough grader, but you don't get your assignments back until like a month later and it's hard to understand how to improve through her feedback. She does teach the class well though. You don't need the textbook, the access code includes digital copy.

reviews.subject: BAUD201 (Business)
reviews.review: She is by far the hardest grading professor at CSUF. Her grading method is very unclear. Oftentimes doesn't know how to pronounce words/names. Her lectures are super long and super boring. Get ready for a long semester.

reviews.subject: BUAD201 (Business)
reviews.review: She is an extremely tough grader, and does not give clear instructions. Attendance is mandatory, and her lectures or unbearable. AVOID THIS CLASS AT ALL COSTS!

reviews.subject: BUAD201 (Business)
reviews.review: She's an okay professor, not the best but not the worst. Her grading style is unclear but she gives good feedback on graded essays. Online code is needed, aplia sucks.  You need to work in groups a few times during class and one major group project. Her teaching style is boring and she gets very touchy about people using their phones

reviews.subject: ACCT506 (Business)
reviews.review: Not a teacher. Do not have a clear thought, even though she insists she has. Very bad attitude towards students, especially in office hours or when you ask her questions after class. Be prepared to repeat saying your answers in class even though everyone else has clearly heard your words. Grading is based on her wired thoughts, no logic.

reviews.subject: PSYC302 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Very Hard class. Do not take. Rude. Late work not permitted, lectures will be deleted by date, hard grader, participation MATTERS, get ready to read a lot and hand write everything.

reviews.subject: PSYC305 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Extremely strict regarding deadlines. Zero flexibility in this course. The grading policy is harsh, and an automatic '0' for being late, regardless of the quality of work, feels punitive rather than educational. Take this class only if you are perfectly capable of managing a heavy workload without any room for error.

reviews.subject: 302L (Psychology)
reviews.review: The roughest class I have ever taken. I'm only on week 5-6, and half the class is either failing or going to fail at the rate we are going. We're graded super harshly, and every small mistake you make will cost you a letter grade on your assignments. Save yourself from the pain and suffering, and choose someone else or a different class.

reviews.subject: PSY305 (Psychology)
reviews.review: If you're not religious then pick a religion and pray.

reviews.subject: 302L (Psychology)
reviews.review: The absolute worst “professor” will fail you as retaliation so don't waste your money on her class!!

reviews.subject: MATH130 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Prof pham was amazing, I wish all professors were just like him, he made calc feel easy and his class was always funny and engaging and I looked forward to his class !

reviews.subject: MATH135 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Awesome guy is super entertaining and makes a hard class much easier. Lectures are fun and he is funny. I would love to take him again. I strongly recommend.

reviews.subject: MATH120 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: He has a strong accent, but was still able to understand what he was trying to present. He gives out a good amount of assignments and projects, but he is always willing to extend the due date and let you complete late work with no point deduction. He's super funny and is very caring.

reviews.subject: MATH135 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Light accent but explains things in a slow, demonstrative way which makes it easy to follow and understand. Math is super subjective when it comes to difficulty, but his teaching style of practicing examples over and over make it easier even if you're not great at math.

reviews.subject: MATH115 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Professor Pham is the best! He makes the material easy to understand and is always willing to help. While the exams can be challenging, using unstuck AI alongside the textbook really helps with study prep. Definitely take this class if you can.

reviews.subject: MATH120 (Mathematics)
reviews.review:
Pros: He's funny, and every class there's an in-class worksheet but he does it with the whole class, takes late work & extends the due date for any assignment 
Cons: 3 tests total a little hard if u don't study, had to purchase $65 zybook to complete assignments, every 2 weeks there's a group video presentation but only the professor can see it.

reviews.subject: MATH170B (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Linear Algebra with this professor was very stressful because of the huge amount of material and very little guidance on what to focus on for exams. There are no study guides or narrowed down review topics, so the expectation is basically to study every lecture for the final. No cheat sheet, no curve, and a lot of memorization.

reviews.subject: MATH170A (Mathematics)
reviews.review: He made an announcement himself that effort didn't matter. Don't ask for additional extra credit, curves, and bumps. The entire class is designed for a student to fail. If you take him, maybe reconsider. I don't know how his rating is so high. expect to have a quiz everytime you have his class, 2 quizzes a week. Save yourself the headache.

reviews.subject: MATH170A (Mathematics)
reviews.review: If you decide take any courses specifically math170a with him, avoid him at all cost. Expect to have a quiz in every class meetings, meaning 2 quizzes per week. No, buffs, curves and extra credits, so don't ask for it, or he'll get mad. He even admitted in the course announcement that effort doesn't matter for the class, which makes no sense.

reviews.subject: MATH170B (Mathematics)
reviews.review: I dont know how he has good reviews when his class is incredibly unforgiving. Only exams/ quizzes make up your grade, homework is optional which means there's no buffer for bad scores. He drops 3 quizzes but he gives a quiz almost every class meeting. Grades super harshly, no cheatsheets allowed on tests, and he doesn't give study guides either.

reviews.subject: MATH170A (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Great professor. Has notes you can print or download, which is game-changing. Lectures well, talks at a normal pace, and he teaches well. Homework isn't bad and reflects your notes. Most exams have extra credit. One of my favorite math profs here. Made understanding concepts easy. Also, GRADES FAST, expect to see your homework and exam scores soon.

reviews.subject: MATH170A (Mathematics)
reviews.review: He said “ Grades are based on academic performance, not on effort. Do not ask for additional extra credit.  Do not ask for a curve.  Do not ask for a grade bump up at the end of the semester.  It is your responsibility to earn enough points to get your desired class grade.” He is a tough grader and goes through lecture too fast. He is nice tho.

reviews.subject: ISD361A (Information Science)
reviews.review: Grade is mostly made up of three tests which aren't too difficult. Does have homework assignments and a final project, although he grades very leniently on those, and they only make up 15% of your grade. If you have a basic understanding of Excel and analytics, class is cake. Also posts recorded lectures, which is awesome.

reviews.subject: ISDS361A (Information Science)
reviews.review: Overall is pretty good professor. Tests were taken through Canvas with Proctorio that was open 6-10am. 3 HWs each due before the midterms. Project is 10% of grade. Excel first 5 wks of class with an exam (5% of grade, 10 total with excel hw). Hw was 6%, Exam 1 was 25%, Exam 2 was 26% and Final was 28%.

reviews.subject: IDSD361B (Information Science)
reviews.review: Please work together. Class is synchronous but he records lectures and does not take attendance. Class will be easy if you ask for help

reviews.subject: 361A (Information Science)
reviews.review: Nice guy, but extremely boring lectures and goes through material rather quickly. Would only take this class if it was online and the lectures were recorded.

reviews.subject: ISDS361B (Information Science)
reviews.review: I took ISDS361B TWICE AND FAILED WITH TWO DIFFERENT PROFESSORS. THEY REALLY DIDN'T TEACH WELL. WHEN I TOOK PROFESSOR NIMER ALL I HAD TO DO IS TAKE NOTES IN HIS LECTURE (WHICH WERE SUPER CLEAR), I GOT AN EASY A. I WILL HIGHLY RECOMMEND HIM, SINCE THIS CLASS IS VERY CHALLENGING IF YOU TAKE THE WRONG PROFESSOR.

reviews.subject: 361A (Information Science)
reviews.review: Review below: he does let you have a "cheat sheet". He is very fair with the amount of work he assigns and it was a blessing. Also, I had no problem asking him to elaborate when I'm confused because he always ask if anyone has questions. In addition, almost everyone I know, like this Professor and wanted to take him for next level. I would!

reviews.subject: SOC351 (Sociology)
reviews.review: I had her for Soc 351 online and honestly she's the most difficult Professor you can possibly take online. She's not very clear with her assignments and does not update your grade throughout the semester. She took forever to submit my final grade. Will not take her class again!

reviews.subject: SOC443 (Sociology)
reviews.review: Given that it was a 400 level class, it was a pretty tough class. There were too many articles to read (most of them were boring) and the exams were hard. She is also a tough grader so you really have to take into consideration of her feedbacks. I worked really hard for my B-!

reviews.subject: SOCI351 (Sociology)
reviews.review: I would not take her ever again. I dont think i really learned anything. She made such an interesting subject boring. Her online tests are super hard and is very tough grader on her discussion posts. Sometimes i would not even know why i was getting points taken off. Only good thing is she responds to emails. Lots of reading.

reviews.subject: SOC351 (Sociology)
reviews.review: I took her online under the name Edythe Walker. For me she was a super tough online course teacher. She demands a lot of work from you, but gets back to emails at a fair time.

reviews.subject: SOC351 (Sociology)
reviews.review: She's probably the worst sociology professor I've had. Her lectures are dull. For a family class there is not much discussion about the material or lectures other than the articles she assigns. She's pretty rude and does not care about your success in the class.

reviews.subject: SOCI351 (Sociology)
reviews.review: DONT TAKE HER!! She is the worst professor I've ever had at Fullerton. She's so rude and disrespectful, when you ask her questions she just snaps at you. Her lectures are all repetitive and she ignores questions. Super hard grader. By far the worst class and professor at Fullerton.

reviews.subject: CTVA102 (Cinema & Television Arts)
reviews.review: Easy class if you get a transcript of the Q&As. You don't need to buy the book. The professor gives the class lots of good content and I liked 75% of the movies but I wish he scheduled the extra credit screenings on different days when more people could go.

reviews.subject: CVTA102 (Cinema & Television Arts)
reviews.review: The only class I actually looked forward to every week to see what the reveals would be. Professor Dillion does a great job of bringing in guests and cover lots of material to highlight about movie making.

reviews.subject: MLANG301 (Cinema & Television Arts)
reviews.review: Professor Dillion is a tough grader but he gives good feedback and he is flexible about deadlines. He lets us decide the best day to turn in final drafts. He is very strict about using AI for essays. Overall a good class.

reviews.subject: CTVA349 (Cinema & Television Arts)
reviews.review: Prof Dillon is brutally honest with his feedback but he knows his stuff and is helpful. The class is on bad movies and you have to defend a bad movie for the first essay and then criticize a good movie for the second essay, with one of them being a video essay. Lots of presentation requirements. The movies are hilarious and BAD.

reviews.subject: CVTA102 (Cinema & Television Arts)
reviews.review:
He wouldn't let me be a TA, but it's fine :(
Great class, lots of good guest speakers.

reviews.subject: CTVA102 (Cinema & Television Arts)
reviews.review: I highly recommend Prof Dillon and 102 is the best class in CTVA. He knows half of Hollywood and brings in all kinds of guests to keep things entertaining and interesting. Won't name any names, but other CTVA professors could learn from his showmanship. Exams are hard though so take good notes and don't skip the readings.

reviews.subject: CTVA372 (Radio, TV & Film)
reviews.review: I did not enjoy being in this class and I think the professor deserves her reputation for lacking compassion.

reviews.subject: CTVA372 (Radio, TV & Film)
reviews.review: Professor Monty is very passionate, but she very much lacks people skills. In a classroom full of adults, she feels the need to call out someone for leaving her class early or for having a silly question. I also don't appreciate how you can lose participation. If you are incorrect this is a place to learn, not a place to be frowned upon.

reviews.subject: CTVA301 (Radio, TV & Film)
reviews.review: Monti as a professor knows a lot, you can tell she is very passionate about film.  But her class was really strange to me, no canvas allowed so you never know your grade.  If you have to answer questions for participation points but if you get it wrong you lose participation.  She also will call students out a lot in class. She was my first C grade

reviews.subject: CTVA301 (Radio, TV & Film)
reviews.review: I understand why she has a lot of 1 stars because her teaching style is not for everyone. You also have to work hard to get a good grade. However, her class really grew on me overtime and was the standout for that semester. I grew an appreciation for film and you can tell she's really passionate and knowledgable about it.

reviews.subject: CTVA301 (Radio, TV & Film)
reviews.review: She would always brag that everything she says is correct and that you shouldn't trust any sources but herself, claiming that everything on the Internet is AI. She also deducts your participation points when she thinks you gave the wrong answer in class. Along with the complicated tests and random pop quizzes, please avoid this class at all costs!

reviews.subject: CTVA301 (Radio, TV & Film)
reviews.review: Monti is a pretty good professor who knows her stuff, and I really enjoyed the class. Honestly, I don't understand why everybody is hating on her. She can say some out-of-pocket things but is also really funny, and aside from the 3 pop quizzes (which you can usually predict), which gave me a little anxiety, I looked forward to the class.

reviews.subject: HIST360 (History)
reviews.review: Weekly padlets thst were “graded” weekly. She would provide a grade but no feedback, later to find out that this meant she thought you used Ai. My writing got worse trying to filter out words that she might think are “above me level”. Ended the semester with a mass email to our class apologizing for failing us as a professor. This actually happened

reviews.subject: HIST360 (History)
reviews.review: Weekly readings, lectures, discussion boards, and essay assignments. Knowledgeable about the subject, but has a strange obsession with AI, and frequently accuses others of using it, which made many paranoid.

reviews.subject: 110A (History)
reviews.review: Dr. Tran is an amazing professor. I enjoyed the lectures and readings that we did. However, I would say this class is tough. You have to put in a lot of work if you want a good grade. She is very passionate about teaching.

reviews.subject: HIST490T (History)
reviews.review: Great professor and deserved chair of the history department. In a class where she was there to mentor and guide her students to write their final papers, she did that and more. I think most people that attended class and did the weekly work can attest that Dr. Tran's tough grading helped them in some capacity write a better paper in the end.

reviews.subject: HIST110A (History)
reviews.review: Took this during summer session. Everything is set up very clearly and is organized so you can easily access what you need. Emails you at the start of the week to tell you what to do for the week, and sends another email on the due date to remind you of the stuff due. All the info is there for you.

reviews.subject: HIST300A (History)
reviews.review: She is a gem of a human and you can tell she genuinely cares about your success. I wasn't prepared for the amount of work that needed to be put into this class. Multiple readings due a week, two essays (midterm and final), and a presentation (final). Things are overexplained and vague all at once... didn't match my learning style.

reviews.subject: CHEM120A (Chemistry)
reviews.review: Dr. Gonzalez is really nice, but is condescending when asked simple questions. Quizzes every friday and 4 midterms, 1 acs exam, 1 final. Does group activity every week, so you meet your classmates and you can ask questions if needed. drops two quizzes and 1 exam. I genuinely enjoyed her class but her teaching style definitely isn't for everyone.

reviews.subject: CHEM120A (Chemistry)
reviews.review: Professor is very rude and mean-spirited. Would get upset when people would ask questions and would take forever on a few concepts during class. She'll put material we barely covered in exams, overall avoid this professor if you can.

reviews.subject: 120A (Chemistry)
reviews.review: You benefit going in with a basic chemistry background but getting a solid B without it is managable. She assigns a lot of worksheets but grades them easy. The exams cover the material from her lectures. The most difficult part is her style of teaching- it fits some not others. You can always go to her office hours for help-she's pretty accessible.

reviews.subject: CHEM120A (Chemistry)
reviews.review: Avoid please, unless you have a good chemistry background from AP Chemistry and or have a well-developed idea about chemistry. Please save yourself time and effort and avoid this person. I couldn't have passed unless without my Chemgroup mates and chill Lab professor.

reviews.subject: CHEM120A (Chemistry)
reviews.review: This is not an easy subject to learn and this professor makes it even more confusing with her teaching style. She was not very helpful and is rather rude when answering questions. I often left her office hour sessions feeling discouraged and more confused than I was before I came in.

reviews.subject: CHEM120A (Chemistry)
reviews.review: Honestly, I would not have survived this class if it wasn't for the AP Chemistry course I took in high school. Group study sessions and groupmates are the way to go; they will help you with your lab reports and together can study for her exams. She does weekly quizzes and collects GE (homework assignments). Harsh person to interact with.

reviews.subject: HES101 (Health Science)
reviews.review: Professor Abbott is a great professor. The class is not difficult to pass but you must show up to class in order to get a good grade. The exams are heavy on lecture material because there are examples that she includes that were mentioned in class.

reviews.subject: HESC101 (Health Science)
reviews.review: 3 tests and 2 projects. The tests are based solely off her lectures so if you don't take notes you won't pass and she doesn't use powerpoints. She made the tests way more difficult than they had to be and then she doesn't use the + or - system. I finished with 79% but got a C. Don't take this class!! It ruined my semester GPA. Take anyone else!!

reviews.subject: HESC101 (Health Science)
reviews.review: DO NOT TAKE unless you're fine with a 50 question scantron where HALF of it is True/False. 3 exams(2 midterms 1 final). All points are weighed equally. 1 Project point  1 exam point. Extremy specific questions in TRUE/FALSE. Gets off topic and rants, yet says that everything covered in the class is on the test.  WOULD NOT TAKE AGAIN.

reviews.subject: HESC101 (Health Science)
reviews.review: She is very nice and funny at times. Just make sure you go to class so you won't miss the notes because all the test are based on the notes that she gives you. Overall, a nice and easy class.

reviews.subject: HESC101 (Health Science)
reviews.review: Such a GREAT teacher! Everything is lecture based, so make sure you attend class. But on the plus side, you do NOT have to waste your money buying the book :) She is HILARIOUS and makes class fun to attend! Easy tests as long as you take great notes.

reviews.subject: HESC101 (Health Science)
reviews.review: Great attitude about class and life. She gets injured a lot and climbs mountains and is knowledgeable about things. Very clear and uses good visual aids. Don't need book if you come to class. Not a hard class at all, recommend!!!

reviews.subject: BUAD301 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: She is a terribly sporadic grader, never staying true to her feedback;  no matter how many times you alter your writing to fit her criteria, she will degrade your work. I walked away learning nothing from this class, because she made me, and everyone around me feel as if we had no idea what she wanted. My suggestion is to avoid this "teacher".

reviews.subject: BUAD301 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: She is terriable and not grade students fairly. Likewise, she would u a bunch of the work, such as project(food drive) ask u to deliver the foods to Orange Country Rescue Mission despite how far u live from Orange. I swear to the GOD, u will fail this class even u have done all the work through the whole semester, unless you are excellent in busine

reviews.subject: BUAD301 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: She is an absolutly HORRIBLE instructor.  She grades using a check-, check, check+ system, and you never know what grade you have in the class.  She graded me down on my project because I have a visible tattoo.  I am currently fighting to get her reprimended through the academic senate.

reviews.subject: BUAD301 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: I signed up for this class and it said staff. When her name was up I saw the reviews and said how bad could she be? THEY DONT LIE. DO NOT TAKE HER. She is a very unfair grader, unclear as to what she want from you, when she wants it, and also what she wants for the main project changed half-way through the class. Drop the class or lower your GPA!!!

reviews.subject: BUS301B (Business Administration)
reviews.review: Take her meaning that u r ready to fail the class unless u r excellent in writing. Pls, pls Don take her pls...

reviews.subject: BUS301 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: The material was easy and comprehensible. Grade based on homework, tests, attendance, and big project. However, the class was difficult because she is very disorganized and unclear. Assignment are not clearly explained. Due dates on all assignments are unclear. The class starts off okay but quickly gets disorganized. Horrible teacher avoid her!

reviews.subject: LBST100 (Liberal Studies)
reviews.review: Attendance is extremely important since there are weekly in-class assignments that cannot be made up outside of class. He does not cancel class, so expect to meet consistently. The workload includes one weekly in-class assignment, a group project, and a final essay. As long as you stay on top of your work and show up, it is an easy A.

reviews.subject: LBST100 (Liberal Studies)
reviews.review: Every lecture is very confusing. He will call on you randomly. Every week you read a long article on the topic. The only example he uses is AI. If you tell your opinion he wont let you finish your thoughts. He can be very rude. He's even asked if a student was even aware if they were in class right now. Lacked appropriateness and respect.

reviews.subject: LBST100 (Liberal Studies)
reviews.review: This professor does not answer his emails and has confusing weekly assignments that feels like a quiz with usually 2-5 typing questions with a minimum of 150 words each. Calls on people a lot and argues against u or interprets u when ur answering his question to yap about his opinion.

reviews.subject: LBST100 (Liberal Studies)
reviews.review: You will be called on. In every class, he goes against your points every time. it doesnt matter if it was a good point.

reviews.subject: LS100 (Liberal Studies)
reviews.review: doesn't really listen to students in discussions. suggested students should sell their face/body to AI girlfriend companies. said we were ableist for disliking AI because its the only way autistic people could make friends. said AI was more similar to autistic people than nuerotypical  people are. made me very uncomfortable

reviews.subject: LBST301 (Liberal Studies)
reviews.review: This guy is just bad im sorry.  Boring Lectures as per usual but part of what makes liberal studies great is discussions.  This guy doesn't let you speak and steers you towards his direction EVERY SINGLE TIME.  You can't even talk for like 10 seconds before he interupts you and yaps about some BS which makes it seem so disrespectful.  Awful class

reviews.subject: 361 (Physical Ed)
reviews.review: Forces participation with other students to an uncomfortable degrees, expensive mandatory book which he uses to flip the classroom, does not have respect for students who are not similar to himself (athletic, extroverted), and picks clear favorites. Always runs class late as well, clearly full of himself.

reviews.subject: 361 (Physical Ed)
reviews.review: I have never felt the need to rate a professor... The study guides didn't match the quizzes or tests. The class was only of quizzes and tests, so be prepared to teach yourself from the textbook. He regularly takes down course materials before the quizzes and tests are due. No projects/ assignments, so I didn't learn how to apply the material irl.

reviews.subject: KNES361 (Physical Ed)
reviews.review: he's alright but he's just out to get everyone and calling the dean under any suspicion of cheating etc.

reviews.subject: 361 (Physical Ed)
reviews.review: Do not take this professor. His exams and quizzes don't even follow his own study guides. His lectures are just reading off slides with no expansion or effort. You basically have to teach yourself. Save yourself the stress and take any other professor.

reviews.subject: KNES360 (Physical Ed)
reviews.review: He gets off on humiliating his students, making them stand in front of the class, throwing a tennis ball at them to make sure they are paying attention, he'll ask you over and over if you know the names of every single person in your class and chastise you if you don't. Easy to pass but this professor made me dread coming to class every day.

reviews.subject: 361 (Physical Ed)
reviews.review: He is actually a caring prof if you go to his office hours. The current reviews for him may be daunting, but as someone who is not strong in this subject I passed with a B+ because I went to his office hours. His homework is on the exams, just different numbers are used. You need to pay attention and do the work, and you'll be fine. You have to try

reviews.subject: ART103A (Art)
reviews.review: Very very good instructor knowledgeable give good feedback and care about student

reviews.subject: ART103 (Art)
reviews.review: Definitely knows what he's talking about, but he has no respect for the class time or students time. He will show up 20 minutes late with no prior warning, constantly, changes in-person classes to zoom. He doesn't teach technical skills that the class description describes. Avoid if you are looking for strict curriculum and skill-building.

reviews.subject: ART103 (Art)
reviews.review: This teacher is seriously amazing. The way he thinks about art is like so fascinating. He nice and kind and makes you feel welcome. He has three big projects and that's it. Class isn't mandatory after he explain the projects. He likes to give students time to work on the projects he assigns. He wants everyone to do their very best.

reviews.subject: 2DDESIGN (Art)
reviews.review: Amazing professor. The type of art professor who cared and lifted you up rather than only tearing you down. Expressed creative expressions rather than focusing too much on technicalities. He definitely ignited my motivation to do art again.

reviews.subject: 2DDESIGN (Art)
reviews.review: This course was so fun and a really great option if you need to fulfill an art credit. Professor Biel was awesome and a really great teacher for this class. Attendance isn't mandatory - while working on projects you can do it at home, no required materials for the course, and super fun/interesting project prompts. I would recommend this class!

reviews.subject: ART103 (Art)
reviews.review: While Professor Biel is a caring professor, the amount of times he was late to class/or outright moved class to zoom sucked. He gives great feedback, wants to see his students succeed, but my time was wasted more often than not because of his lack of punctuality. 3 projects, Class NEVER goes the full time, so do not build your schedule around it

reviews.subject: AMST345 (American Studies)
reviews.review: (Spring 2025) This class took more time than I expected. You must watch all lectures & participate in 5 discussion boards total. The midterm includes defining key terms & a short essay. There's also an interview assignment, & the final essay requires at least 8 pgs. I dont really recommend this class if ur not an AMST major, but the prof is cool

reviews.subject: AMST101 (American Studies)
reviews.review: Participation and attendance based off viewing lecture videos (around an hour) + discussion posts. Don't need to do all the posts, but need to view all the lectures for for attendance. Very clear about assignment/grading guidelines. Grades are just 2 papers + midterm and final paper + attendance/participation. Gives EC. Easy class, good professor.

reviews.subject: AMST101 (American Studies)
reviews.review: She doesn't grade very hard just get to the point. Discussion posts weekly for attendance (mandatory). Always gave good feedback on every essay. She has an extra credit that WILL boost your grade if you do bad on essays/exams.

reviews.subject: AMST101 (American Studies)
reviews.review: The readings are a lot- anywhere from 10-20 pages, and you have 2 or 3 PDFs given per week. The midterm and finals require you to watch and read all of them, so jump to the assignment pages for those tests and be selective on what you need to read if you don't have time to do all that work. Take notes, the class is super informative so enjoy it.

reviews.subject: AMST101 (American Studies)
reviews.review: This class was super interesting. There are a few writing assignments spread out through the semester but they aren't that bad. The midterm and final both are 3 written prompts, one essay prompt (500 words) and 2 short answers.

reviews.subject: 474 (Psychology)
reviews.review: I honestly took this class because it was the only online level 400 class, but Dr. Williams gives a ridiculous amount of work. Also, she will not accept any late work or extensions so be wary of that. As long as you just submit everything on time, you will be fine. Just stay on top of her assignments.

reviews.subject: PSYC474 (Psychology)
reviews.review: DO NOT take her if you actually want to learn. Excessive amount of hw for very little points, random due dates in the middle of each week, no posted lectures, required textbook that costs money, inconsistent/unfair grading, feedback borders on cruel, etc.

reviews.subject: 474 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Very unorganized, even though it's pretty chill and laid back, her grading criteria is unclear and she is unresponsive to emails.

reviews.subject: 474 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Do not take Dr. Williams. She is unclear in her rubrics, she posts assignments literally on the due date, and the class is overall very unorganized. Even attending office hours doesn't help. I would avoid her if you can.

reviews.subject: PSYC101 (Psychology)
reviews.review: She is a sweetheart and I would take her again. Emailing her and going to office hours was very easy and she was super helpful. The tests are very application-based but are gone over during lecture.

reviews.subject: 474 (Psychology)
reviews.review: ⚠️DO NOT TAKE HER⚠️ I gave her the benefit of the doubt, but the bad reviews are true. She's unresponsive, grades harshly (always 1 point off), and the class is disorganized. She rarely replies-VERY SELECTIVE, locks the gradebook all semester, and still hasn't posted final grades. Avoid if you can.

reviews.subject: BIO101L (Biology)
reviews.review: I did a weird hybrid lab thing, and she will never let you retake things. I had mold in my apartment and had to move out and deal with it all week and she wouldn't let me retake an assignment. Also the labs she designs are not helpful

reviews.subject: BIO101 (Biology)
reviews.review: Definitely not GE class level more like a bio major class. Exams are 10x harder than practice exams and there is usually more than 50 questions on exams most of which are long word problems. She says to take notes on the lecture videos but it doesn't help because the exam questions are worded so differently that it doesn't matter anyways.

reviews.subject: BIO101L (Biology)
reviews.review: To be honest, there's too much work and complicated assignments just this class to be 1 unit.. It's not even the real professor teaching it, it's her T/A that's teaching it and she's still a student as well so its kind of seems like she's just doing what she's told, no offense to her though, she was chill. Get the workbook it is necessary to pass.

reviews.subject: BIO101L (Biology)
reviews.review: Very strict with policies and little flexibility for working or commuting students. Online format is hard to navigate, and practice exams don't match actual exams. Clearer communication and better alignment between study materials and tests would improve the overall experience.

reviews.subject: BIO101 (Biology)
reviews.review: Never again. The workload was COMPLETELY unreasonable for a general education class and felt more like a major-level course. Spent more time on assignments than I should for a GE class. Canvas was extremely hard to navigate, and communication was often passive-aggressive. Way too time-consuming for a GE. Would NOT recommend.

reviews.subject: BIO101 (Biology)
reviews.review: about 8 hours of work every module, a quiz every 2 weeks. she treats this class as if its a masters course and not a basic 101 GE most of us took because we needed it for general credit. somehow chaffee managed to make me hate one of the subjects i was absolutely fascinated with. also, if you think you can cheat, you can't. its all stuff she made.

reviews.subject: KINESIOLOGY352 (Kinesiology)
reviews.review: Amazing professor.  Knows his subjects well. Organized, prepared, great energy. Makes the class engaging, easy to follow, you leave feeling a lot better than when you came in.  Always looked forward to the next class.  Very understanding, explains concepts clearly & gives great feedback.. Makes class engaging and easy to follow. Highly recommend!

reviews.subject: KINESIOLOGY352 (Kinesiology)
reviews.review: I loved this class.  It was the best class in my 4.5 years at Fullerton.  Wished I saved all the notes and handouts - I could sure use them now.  I was asked to teach some exercise classes where I live because some neighbors told them I was a kinesiology major.  That degree is starting to pay off!!

reviews.subject: KNES352 (Kinesiology)
reviews.review: One of the best exercise classes I've taken at CSUF. Professor Ken really knows his stuff and makes the material engaging. The workouts were fun, and I found Unstuckstudy helpful for studying. Definitely recommend this class if you're interested in exercise instruction.

reviews.subject: KNES352 (Kinesiology)
reviews.review: This is my last semester and I'm just discovering this professor now?  Why didn't I know about him my first year- I would have taken all his classes.  I think the best professor I've had.  So many great things about his class. If you want to teach exercise you shouldn't miss this course.  Learned a lot for work and learned a lot about myself.

reviews.subject: KINESIOLOGY352 (Kinesiology)
reviews.review: Love the different workouts we do each week.  This class rocks.  Wouldn't change a thing.  So happy I took this class.  Thank you for making this class so fun and for loving what you do!!

reviews.subject: KINESIOLOGY352 (Kinesiology)
reviews.review: A lot different than I thought it would be.  That's a good thing.  First half of class is lecture, then we workout. Each week is a different workout, so a lot of variety.  I thought we'd do the same thing each week. Lots of homework, but it's easy, and the assignments are useful and actually fun sometimes.  More classes should be like this one.

reviews.subject: ECON201 (Economics)
reviews.review: Her lectures were alright and she does emphasize aspects that are important for us to know which were a bit helpful. In all, I would say if you take good notes and really understand the concepts from mainly the assignments and powerpoints, youll do well on the exams. The tests are only hard if you don't put the effort to truly learn the material.

reviews.subject: ECON201A (Economics)
reviews.review: She administers tests later in the evening and I think it can be very difficult for example I have a quiz due tomorrow and it opens at 8 pm. She can be helpful if you show up during office hours.

reviews.subject: ECON201 (Economics)
reviews.review: Terrible! Worst prof at CSUF! Do not take!! She needs to be fired! Rude, incompassionate, disrespectful! She does not care about her students at all and wants to make their lives miserable. honestly, she is the worst professor I have ever had. I have never met someone in my entire life who is this rude and insensitive. Tests are super hard!

reviews.subject: ECON201 (Economics)
reviews.review: This was my most boring class. Lots of homework and she's pretty passive aggressive when someone asks a question at all. Overall it wasn't that bad and I would take this professor again. Definitely seen worse since virtual learning.

reviews.subject: ECON201 (Economics)
reviews.review: This professor is really hard to get to, she reads her powerpoints and only explains her own terms during the last 15 minutes, quizzes are easy it gets hard on midterms. She expects you to know more than what she actually teaches.

reviews.subject: ECON201 (Economics)
reviews.review: Professor can seem quite rude, but is not too bad. Lectures can be heavy but this class was not difficult. A fair amount of assignments were given which helped boost your grade. Not too many tests and they were also fair. There is only one paper. I definitely recommend this class if you do not want to stress out.

reviews.subject: ECON202 (Economics)
reviews.review: A very nice professor, but the lectures are very difficult to follow as she goes through slides very quickly. The assignments are easy, but the tests can be difficult even though you are allowed 1 sheet of notes. All in all, not the most organized class, but very passible. Do all the assignments, read the textbook, and you will pass no problem.

reviews.subject: ECON202 (Economics)
reviews.review: Fazeli is very passionate about ECON and kind, although I noticed that got in the way of her teaching. I still learned quite a bit, but her lectures weren't very organized and went on tangents. I've never seen a grading rubric like hers and it's confusing and hard to understand. She didn't answer questions clearly. Graded with no explanation.

reviews.subject: ECON202 (Economics)
reviews.review: Professor Fazeli isnt bad, just very disorganized in method and thought which can make things confusing. There are lots of assignments which makes the class easier to pass but her teaching method isnt linear just kinda all over the place jumping from one idea to the next. Also doesnt understand the troubles of technology so dont have bad wifi.

reviews.subject: ECON202 (Economics)
reviews.review: Nice professor but is horrible at grading! Always made mistakes in grading and most students would complain about having to fix it. Would assign several quizzes per week (4) including multiple chapters of homework, would also assign things last minute. You dont know your grade until the very END and most of my class was left with wrong grades!

reviews.subject: ECON202 (Economics)
reviews.review: Amazingly kind professor! She really wants her students to pass and will adjust assignments/exams based off the needs of the class. Great powerpoints! Lots of homework/ assignments, but dont slack on those! they count towards your overall exam grade & could really boost your score up if you did bad.

reviews.subject: ECON202 (Economics)
reviews.review: Professor Fazeli cares deeply about her students. After most of the lectures, she asks for a reflection of a something difficult to understand and how she could help. Although she does assign a lot of homework assignments, most are easy to complete. The tests can be hard, but if you attend class this is a very easy, passable class.

reviews.subject: BUAD201 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: She is such a sweetheart!! She is extremely nice and helpful! Always positive. Go to her office hours if you don't understand a topic. Group project which isn't too bad.  I recommend her.

reviews.subject: BUAD201 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: She was very helpful when someone had a question, and was very welcoming during office hours.  She talks fast, but she gives the slides from which she lectures, so it's easy to go back if you missed something.

reviews.subject: BUAD201 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: Somewhat of an easy class, just make sure to pick your group wisely.  Other than that, practice makes perfect when it comes to writing I suppose. I was going to take her for BUAD301.

reviews.subject: BUAD201 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: Great teacher as well as an interesting topic. She is very clear on exactly how your exams should look. There are 3 written exams, one group project on a company, online homework and a final exam that needs to be passed with a C to pass the class. Highly recommend Breta!f

reviews.subject: BUAD201 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: Great teacher that is always willing to help her students. Overall one of the best professors I have had.

reviews.subject: BUAD201 (Business Administration)
reviews.review: This course is tough, but she is more than willing to help if you ask for it. Do the practice exams and you'll do fine. She explains step by step how to write a professional business memo/letter and what things to avoid. For the group project, make sure you use proper APA format and follow the rubric closely for the oral presentation.

reviews.subject: ISDS361B (Information Science)
reviews.review: Dr. Sherif passed away last week.  May he rest in peace.

reviews.subject: ISDS361B (Information Science)
reviews.review: If you want to pass with a C take his class. If you want anything higher take another professor or maybe out of luck you can get an A. He doesn't lecture he likes to go on rants. Hes a silly guy but if you want an A or B try to take someone else. His grading style is very random. I think he passes everyone and decides randomly who gets an A or B.

reviews.subject: B361 (Information Science)
reviews.review: Even though i earned an A in the class. I really thought it was just by luck. On the exams, it doesnt matter if you get the right answer but what he looks for are little details on your work. Majority of the class had to use the internet to help solve some problems since he didnt even cover them in class for the exams.

reviews.subject: ISDS361B (Information Science)
reviews.review: So if youre looking to pass, he is the prof.  If your looking to learn and get an A, look elsewhere. Though he is funny and entertaining, he does not teach and you have to teach yourself or go to his office.  It is very hard to pay attention to him cause he goes off on random tangents.  Hes kind of crazy but hes funny

reviews.subject: ISDS361B (Information Science)
reviews.review: He doesn't fail anyone, doesn't use the book, and you don't do anything worth any points till the last week of school. Make sure to take really good notes on everything and be ready for anything in this class: He will test you on things he didn't even cover in class. He is crazy and his class can be really easy, use the internet during tests.

reviews.subject: ISDS361B (Information Science)
reviews.review: Lectures are a waste of time. Sherif picks on students that did well in 361A to present 361B points. He doesn't know how to use Excel (or computers in general) very well. He doesn't follow his syllabus; he doesn't assign homework; he doesn't use the book(/s); he doesn't prepare you for the exams; he doesn't challenge you academically.

reviews.subject: POSC309 (Political Science)
reviews.review: Three tests and a paper determine your grade. Tests are somewhat hard but if you study the night prior and really take his study guides seriously, you will do fine. Very laid back professor and always willing to help. Trivia questions are part of grades and you will only get them if you attend class.

reviews.subject: POSC309 (Political Science)
reviews.review: A brilliant proffessor, makes the topic interesting through class discussions. Although powerpoints would help in preparation for exams. His trivia questions are not hard if you pay attention in class. He is a very nice and understaning professor. The study guides he provides for exams are very helpful so long as you study well! Take him.

reviews.subject: POSC408 (Political Science)
reviews.review: The class was alright. He's a passionate professor for L.A. politics and works in the L.A. City Hall. There is a 12 page paper, 3 exams, and a field trip to L.A. City Hall. Attendance not mandatory but recommended. His exams are somewhat difficult I also recommend reading or at least skimming the books he assigned.

reviews.subject: POSC309 (Political Science)
reviews.review: Very good teacher, knows what he is talking about but can be a bit one-sided at times. I really enjoyed the class but the tests were very challenging for me (also very long!) with tricky trivia questions which should be considered extra credit. Overall, interesting class but must attend class and do some reading to get an A

reviews.subject: POLPOL (Political Science)
reviews.review: He is actually a great professor first time around I struggled with his course but took a different class with him once you learn his style its easy do read all material and all your notes for test other than that hes fun

reviews.subject: CAS474 (Child Development)
reviews.review: I was enrolled in her class but glad I dropped before semester started. Passive aggressive even in emails.

reviews.subject: CAS315 (Child Development)
reviews.review: I found it to be a manageable class there was a quiz every week but there was a practice quiz with the exact questions. I enjoyed the class even though sometimes the reading was a lot. I took this class as an elective and found it fairly easy I never feared failing this class.

reviews.subject: CAS474 (Child Development)
reviews.review: Hard Grader. There is no way to track how you're doing in this course. She grades whenever she feels like it. Then she has an Insane amount of work, Interactive lectures, discussion board, text assignment every week. Plus, projects along the way and fieldwork. Run away, take the class another semester it is not worth it.

reviews.subject: CAS370 (Child Development)
reviews.review: The class was pretty simple and I honestly liked the interactive lessons. I didn't reach out to her much, but she graded pretty fairly. She gives out lots of extra credits throughout the semester which I appreciated and sometimes curves tests.

reviews.subject: CAS474 (Child Development)
reviews.review: I did not enjoy this professor. Assignments were not very clear and the layout of the class was confusing.

reviews.subject: CAS370 (Child Development)
reviews.review: The topic of the course isn't hard. Still, the professor doesn't respond to emails, provides instructions and texts with tons of errors, creates unclear instructions, and then grades the assignments 2 - 3 weeks later with very passive-aggressive comments. Pick another Professor. Someone in admin should check on her teaching credibility.

reviews.subject: ISDS442 (Information Systems)
reviews.review: This course had a lot of communication challenges. Lectures were hard to follow and assignment instructions were not always very clear. The structure of the course made it difficult at times to understand exactly what was expected for assignments. Do not expect help.

reviews.subject: ISDS442 (Information Systems)
reviews.review: A lot to say about Dr. K, but I will say that he knows the material... he just chooses not to be very helpful when you ask for help. Here's the strat that brought me from F's on the first two hws to getting 100s on my exams: 1.) watch lectures at 1.5x speed. 2.) attempt hw. ask AI for help, not to solve.  3.) use hw checks as checks.

reviews.subject: ISDS442 (Information Systems)
reviews.review: The professor is pretty chill and very quick to respond to emails. However, this is not an easy class. I suggest being in a class Discord to help each other, because homework can be tricky. 7 homework assignments, 2 midterms, 1 final. Exams are open note, but if you study the homework in depth, you'll be just fine.

reviews.subject: ISDS442 (Information Systems)
reviews.review: This class was so stressful! The video lectures are somewhat similar to the hw but not enough to get a passing grade. Mind you, he's a tough grader and the hw is worth 60 points each. He does not do extra credit or allow hw due date extension. The exams are similar to hw but not enough to get a passing grade.

reviews.subject: ISDS555 (Information Systems)

reviews.subject: CHEM301B (Chemistry)

reviews.subject: CHEM301A (Chemistry)

reviews.subject: BUAD301 (Business)

reviews.subject: BUAD301 (Business)

reviews.subject: BUAD301 (Business)
reviews.review: This class was difficult, but he brings the writer out of everybody.

reviews.subject: BUAD301 (Business)

reviews.subject: BUAD301 (Business)

reviews.subject: BUAD301 (Business)

reviews.subject: COG305 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Dr. IBG was a very sweet lady for the most part. She gives a manageable amount of inquizitives and readings. The hardest part were the 2 in-person exams. You just have to really study and keep up with the material.

reviews.subject: COG305 (Psychology)
reviews.review: There is a lot of learning to do. My advice is to attend office hours to clarify anything confusing in text. There are two in-person exams and one optional exam to replace a low grade exam. The material assigned is different from what is found online. I think that is good. I learned a few new things.

reviews.subject: COG305 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Super fast pace, a lot of reading, and heavy topics. I am used to deal with that, but what I did not appreciate was that there was no support at all. No lectures, just all the directions on Canvas and fast curve quizzes and exams. The worst part ... the professor seemed obsessed with students cheating in the class. No encouragement at all.

reviews.subject: PSY305 (Psychology)
reviews.review: For our first exam, the professor left and had the TA run everything. During the second exam, she stayed but talked and made it hard to focus. She rarely responded to emails, and when she did, her tone was often condescending and passive-aggressive. Grading took forever. Overall, not a supportive or respectful learning environment.

reviews.subject: COGLAB (Psychology)
reviews.review:
Dr. IBG is very knowledgeable and caring; however, her class is unorganized. The canvas page was so overwhelmed with information that things become hard to find.

Be prepared for awkward silence if no one answers her in class question during lecture.

Its a 2 unit class with 4 lab reports, a presentation, multiple quizzes, and class work.

reviews.subject: ECON202 (Economics)
reviews.review: If you attend class and take notes, the exams should make sense. I also attended office hours and that helped a lot. We have two papers, four exams, and homework for every chapter. However, she drops the lowest exams score. The homework is a little harder than exams but class notes will help you the most on exams.

reviews.subject: ECON202 (Economics)
reviews.review: She's a tough grader. She's very strict with students meeting deadlines, yet she herself doesn't meet the grading schedule she promises. When you reach out for questions, her replies sound like you're bothering her. She says attendance is mandatory but only took roll like twice randomly. Final is cumulative.

reviews.subject: ECON202 (Economics)
reviews.review: There are too many lectures that are hard to follow because they are insanely boring. I also needed a good grade on a paper so I worked hard on it compared to my first one which wasn't very good, ended up giving me a C on something I genuinely think should have gotten an A when on my first paper that wasn't as good I almost got an A.

reviews.subject: ECON202 (Economics)
reviews.review: Professor Bhattacharya as a person is absolutely wonderful and lovely. However, her class genuinely make me want to kill myself /srs. I cannot for the life memorize anything in this class and it's taken a genuine toll on my mental health.

reviews.subject: AA (Economics)
reviews.review: Professor Bhattacharya is such a sweet professor. She truly cares and wants all students to pass. Econ is not my favorite subject but she made the lectures very easy and entertaining. She gives out study guides that tells you the exact concepts that are going to be on the exam. She has review days and is very accommodating to students. Take her!

reviews.subject: ECON201 (Economics)

reviews.subject: ENG302 (English)

reviews.subject: 99 (English)

reviews.subject: ENG301 (English)

reviews.subject: ENG301 (English)

reviews.subject: ENG101 (English)

reviews.subject: 310A (Criminal Justice)
reviews.review: Dery's teaching style is a mixture of Will Ferrell and Socrates, fantastic professor. The class material is covered in a manner that is memorable and super applicable for anyone going into a criminal justice profession.

reviews.subject: CJ485 (Criminal Justice)
reviews.review: Online Covid Review: Does curve his exams, no extra credit, does record his lectures, and post them. Remember the rules/facts of each case as most of the material on the test is from his lectures and barely from the book. I suggest to not stack this class with your other hard classes as this class can take a lot out of you.

reviews.subject: CJ485 (Criminal Justice)
reviews.review: Professor Dery is okay. His classes are very lecture heavy. Theres 3 exams, with each exam increases the information you must know. So - be PREPARED to know everything he says because theres no study guide. Also, test questions are tricky. Its sort of difficult to retain everything he says but he expects it. Timed exams/no rechecking answers.

reviews.subject: CRJU485 (Criminal Justice)
reviews.review: Professor Dery is a great teacher but his classes are pretty hard. 3 Exams only but there is A LOT of information to process and he's very picky on his essay questions. If you miss a single word or don't know the law verbatim you will lose A LOT of points.

reviews.subject: 310A (Criminal Justice)
reviews.review: Grades are based off of 3 exams, 50 points each. Every class is a new lecture, most of the time very interesting but does come across dull subjects. He does grade on a curve which is great. There is a lot of reading so good luck.

reviews.subject: CRJU310A (Criminal Justice)
reviews.review: Dery is an amazing professor! his lectures are very interesting. grade is based on 3 exams 50 pts each half mc & half write in. he was great with transitioning to online during spring, gave us one big powerpoint for the sem. you have to read his book bc there's questions on the exam from the book. word of advice is just to take diligent notes

reviews.subject: MATH150B (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Makes Calc 2 more difficult than it needs to be. He teaches mainly by reading off of slideshows and then does example problems. He doesn't really explain the material and just assumes that you know it. The homework is assigned a few days/week in advance so thats cool. 2 Midterms and a Final. Take if you're fine with self learning, he's just okay.

reviews.subject: MATH150B (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Not bad overall. Calc 2 is hard in general but he offers lots of practice and extra credit for each test. Gives homework every week that is for points (I would recommend doing them). For some reason he ditched the last week of school before finals. He does care so if your unsure just ask questions and He'll try his best to help you.

reviews.subject: CAL150B (Mathematics)
reviews.review: He makes the class so difficult for no reason, constantly calls out students for not knowing 'basic algebra'. about half the class dropped and he blames the students for not studying, which is partially true, but he does assign an insane amount of homework that stacks up when youre taking multiple classes. If you have to take him then study all day

reviews.subject: MATH412 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: He is nice and cares a lot. Tests are worth a lot. Lots of group HW. Content is so interesting, but the way it was presented was boring: he just reads lecture notes which you are provided previously; this makes going class (especially at 8 AM) unmotivating

reviews.subject: MATH150A (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Make sure to review basic algebra before taking this course, as you'll be using it a lot. His exam review questions are extremely helpful, be sure you fully understand them before each test. In my opinion, he's one of the best professors out there!

reviews.subject: CAL150B (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Very knowledgeable and able to teach in a way that you understand. Answers any question. Make sure that you work on the review problems to be ready for his tests. I'm expecting to get at least an A- in this course.

reviews.subject: ENG101 (English)
reviews.review: a very humble prof, show up to class and be present is all she asks, tough grader on essays

reviews.subject: ENG301 (English)

reviews.subject: ENG301 (English)
reviews.review: Mrs. M was amazing. She assigns 4 essays which may sound like a lot, but it is actually easy if you come to class and follow the outlines that she gives. reviews.subject: ENG301 (English)

Most weeks had 6+ plus assignments due, including quizzes, discussion posts, essays, etc. Every paper you write will be peer reviewed until the final draft and then she grades hard.

reviews.subject: ENG301 (English)
reviews.review: She's nice but very focused on participation. Even if she cancels class, she expects you to use that time for coursework. If you miss a class, she expects you to attend office hours. The class is easy but has a lot of work: 3 essays, 1 annotated bib, annotated readings, quizzes, and a required meeting with a writing tutor.

reviews.subject: ENG101 (English)
reviews.review: She is an amazing professor she is caring and emails back quickly, her lectures were easy to comprehend. Ask a lot of questions, sometimes the criteria for essays can get confusing. 4 essays overall with practice tests on the online textbook. Don't miss more than 4 classes, work hard and ask questions; overall amazing class with a great professor.

reviews.subject: BIO103 (Biology)
reviews.review: I am currently writing this review while doing her homework. You have about 6-7 pages worth of notes that you must take by Thursday in order to complete the weekly knowledge checks. You're paying to watch Amoeba sisters and read free articles but are tested harshly. Exams are hard and has three parts (25 mins for 20 MCQ). Textbook is dense.

reviews.subject: BIO101 (Biology)
reviews.review: This class makes me feel as if I'm a Biology major and there is an excessive amount of work to be done. She is harsh grader and she takes a long time just to grade assignments even from the beginning of the semester. Wouldn't recommend this professor if you want a easier class.

reviews.subject: BIOL101 (Biology)
reviews.review: Does not put the students first, highlights flaws and not strengths of students, is not on the students side, makes environment scary and not fun for learning, incorporated videos not created by her then created questions not inspired by them

reviews.subject: BIO101 (Biology)
reviews.review: This professor uses a flipped classroom method which was confusing at first. You have watch these prerecorded lessons that could take up to 30 to 50 mins and you have to answer questions along with it. There is no final exam. You have to do each assignment with your assigned group.

reviews.subject: BIO101 (Biology)
reviews.review: You will never know your grade in this class because she takes forever to do it. Her assessments are impossible unless you spend hours reading prerecorded lectures that only biology majors would understand. The class setup was also confusing in the beginning, as well, missing one integrity quiz took a big 5% chunk off my grade the rest of the year.

reviews.subject: BIO101 (Biology)
reviews.review: This professor literally dox'd points off because one of my group mates couldn't access the google doc for a GROUP ASSIGNMENT like it literally a group assignment.. reviews.subject: HCOM100 (Human Communication)
reviews.review: 1 hour zoom lecture per week. Not that many assignments. He's chill. Recommend, if you want a easy class.

reviews.subject: HCOM100 (Human Communication)
reviews.review: He is very chill, but exams are difficult. You will have to study and be ready to pay attention to his lectures. You have to understand the materials to answer the exam questions. 50 questions all m.c. There will be a quick write each week, but not worth many points. 1 midterm, 1 final exam, 1 paper, 1 project.

reviews.subject: HCOM100 (Human Communication)
reviews.review: I enjoyed the class content and the lectures and power point chapters, the teacher helped me understand the activities and also was open to answering questions and for other students to share during lectures. If you want you can also turn in assignments directly or also ask for feedback or rough drafts for the bigger activities which helped me.

reviews.subject: HCOM100 (Human Communication)
reviews.review: One assignment a week should take no more than 15 minutes. zoom class once a week to go over units  (optional). multiple choice exams online. turned in assignment late on accident hes very understanding good person.

reviews.subject: HCOM100 (Human Communication)
reviews.review: Lots of the ideas in the class and textbook are about everyday life, the text is pretty easy to follow and the lecture and powerpoints had good examples and stories . For assignments you can write about how the chapter and how your relationships or school life relates to the ideas in the class. Teacher was caring and explained class info well.

reviews.subject: HCOM100 (Human Communication)
reviews.review: Super nice and caring teacher, his lectures are interesting but the point of the class is boring. Only one assignment due at the end of each week for his zoom class, and he's always open to questions and is overall understanding. Lectures are mandatory to join as they're not recorded, but it's max an hour and it's honestly a really easy class.

reviews.subject: ISDA361A (Information Systems)
reviews.review: Very nice professor with good lectures. Do the homework and you'll find the exams to be easy

reviews.subject: ISDS361A (Information Systems)
reviews.review: Professor Kapoor uses an old-school lecture style and goes through concepts and calculations slowly so the class can understand. The class consisted of a few homework assignments, an Excel exam, 2 midterms, a final, and a project. 1-page sheets were allowed. Attendance isn't mandatory but recommended. Good grade as long as you review well.

reviews.subject: ISDS361A (Information Systems)
reviews.review: Notes are written out every class, and he go over examples clearly. Excel is taught through videos and there is a test on it. Not many homework assignments, 4 exams. Very clear professor, textbook access is needed for assignments.

reviews.subject: ISDA361A (Information Systems)
reviews.review: Dr. Kapoor is a good and caring professor. Attendance is not mandatory, but going to class helps he goes over many examples. You are allowed a cheat sheet on exams, and the exams are not difficult, but they make up most of the grade, so studying is highly recommended. There is one project divided into two phases, and it is really easy.

reviews.subject: ISDS361A (Information Systems)
reviews.review: Professor Kapoor's lectures are helpful in understanding the material, but sometimes there are lags or pauses because they are Zoom meetings. The study guides and practice problems he posts are helpful in studying for the exams. The project (Phase 1 and Phase 2) is somewhat time-consuming so start early if you can.

reviews.subject: ISDS361A (Information Systems)
reviews.review: Few assignments graded easily, two midterms w/ a project. Professor does lecture old-school style but most of the times we were stuck lecturing the same example for more than two class sessions so class can be redudant. Material isn't too hard, barely any extra credit offered. He claims he can't be easily angered but is sometimes passive-agressive.

reviews.subject: ENGL316 (English)
reviews.review: Overall very easy class but long lectures and a tough grader when it comes to essays.

reviews.subject: ENG316SHAKES (English)
reviews.review: Dr. Stanton is SUPER passionate about shakespeare. Gives loads of information on each play, however it is heavily lecture based and almost no student interaction. reviews.subject: ENG316SHAKES (English)
reviews.review: Professor Stanton's class is very good and easy to get a good grade in! She's very kind and lenient too

reviews.subject: ENG317 (English)
reviews.review: Dr.Stanton is so passionate about her teachings and she really helps her students understand the information. Fair graders and very kind.

reviews.subject: ENG316 (English)
reviews.review:
If passion was a woman, Kay Stanton would be her name. 

She knows so much about Shakespeare and his works that it's unbelievable. Her passion and love for the subject is contagious, and I left learning many things about Shakespeare. 

Also, in my experience, you don't need a physical book so long as it tells you the act, section, and line #.

reviews.subject: 317 (English)
reviews.review: I didnt read much of the text and still ended the class with an A - she is very nice

reviews.subject: PSY371 (Psychology)
reviews.review: He is such a fun and funny guy but as a professors his exams are really hard and you need to study everyday which I did not and got a C in the class.

reviews.subject: PSYC371 (Psychology)

reviews.subject: PSYC371 (Psychology)

reviews.subject: PSYC371 (Psychology)
reviews.review: By far the BEST prof at CSUF. Highly rec taking this class no matter your major. He is an evo psychologist, so he's very well versed in the subject, making lectures super interesting. He's so funny and does a great job making everyone feel engaged. Attendance is important since exams include info from class lectures outside of just powerpoints.

reviews.subject: PSYC312 (Psychology)
reviews.review: He was a nice professor. However, for his exams, he would choose random things he said in a lecture instead of based off of his PowerPoints. The night before the last day of class, I rewatched all his lectures to make sure I had all the  info down and still received a bad exam grade. He didn't really give a lot of opportunities to raise your grade.

reviews.subject: PSY371 (Psychology)
reviews.review:
By far the best professor I've had. His lectures are interesting, he's super funny, and he makes you want to show up and learn.

reviews.subject: SOC357 (Sociology)
reviews.review: She doesn't give too many assignments but is a tough grader. Wouldn't take again. She always asked for a deeper analysis on my work that completed the prompt. Easy class just tough to analyze deeper simple things like she wanted/complete word count.

reviews.subject: SOCI101 (Sociology)
reviews.review: This was an easy class with either an exam or discussion post every week. Take her for an easy A, just keep up with the assignments and make sure to get the textbook so you can cite it.

reviews.subject: SOC101 (Sociology)
reviews.review: i mean she is a good professor easy for soci 101 yeah if you take soci 101 I'll recommend to the other level class i don't know lol.

reviews.subject: SOC357 (Sociology)

If you do more than minimal effort, you will get a good grade in this class.

reviews.subject: SOCI357 (Sociology)
reviews.review: Avoid this professor—two essays based on dull documentaries, vague essay prompts, and strict grading. You'll likely need to pay for a textbook just for four discussion boards. She's nitpicky on grammar, slow to respond to emails, and offers little support. Take this class with someone else if possible.

reviews.subject: SOC357 (Sociology)
reviews.review: Professor Kim is by far one of the worst professors I have had at Cal State Fullerton. She never responds to emails and she takes forever to grade assignments. If you get two points deducted from a discussion board your grade will heavily decrease. DO NOT TAKE HER. Take another elective.

reviews.subject: 301A (Accounting)
reviews.review: Very straightforward professor. Reasonable expectations and explains expectations thoroughly. He doesn't overcomplicate accounting concepts, making them easier to understand. He's always open to questions and wants to help you learn. I highly recommend taking him, especially for upper-division accounting. One cheat sheet allowed for all exams.

reviews.subject: ACC301A (Accounting)
reviews.review: I previously took this class with professor Farzana. I was able to understand the material more with professor Hung Lu. I'm taking this class for summer and it is based on 4 exams only. Attendance is not mandatory he records his lectures. You will learn about LIFO,FIFO, Journal Entries, Adjusting entries (Interest,Prepaid,Depreciation), and TVM.

reviews.subject: ACCT301B (Accounting)
reviews.review: I took him for both 301A & B. He curved a lot less for 301B than 301A, even though the content is more difficult. HW and attendance aren't required. He records his lectures so you can miss them and still catch up. Class is very exam heavy. There's also a writing project at the end of the semester. For final grade, I got an A- but it curved to an A

reviews.subject: ACCT301A (Accounting)
reviews.review: The exams are based on doing the HW several times. HW is not graded. He also goes very quickly through content. Sometimes 1 lecture per chapter. He curves a decent amount every exam (5-10 points). There's also a writing project to help boost the grade, but it seems unnecessary. I got a B+ but he curved the final grade to an A-.

reviews.subject: 301A (Accounting)
reviews.review:
If you are looking to being overworked just so he can curve .02%, then take him.

Other than that please avoid this class. I would not recommend it. Studied so much for nothing. 

He does not reply to inquiries about accommodations for disability either.

reviews.subject: ACCT301A (Accounting)
reviews.review: AVOID AT ALL COSTS. Professor does not prepare you for exams and adjusts syllabus homework last minute before exams. He DOES NOT curve enough to pass. Wasted potential on wrong professor. TAKE ANOTHER PROFESSOR

reviews.subject: MGMT446 (Law)
reviews.review: Super chill dude. Attendance is said to be graded but my class wasn't. I showed up to class only a handful of times, but when I did he was very clear in explaining cases. I didn't go to class and I taught myself, but I would go if I had him again. Passes mostly everyone, as long as you try. Would strongly recommend him.

reviews.subject: MGMT246 (Law)
reviews.review: Prof Atzeff was very nice and aware his class material was boring. He jokes around and gives examples of his own cases when teaching. The class was tough, but he curves VERY generously. He doesn't explain the curve or reflect it on Canvas, so it's difficult to know where you stand. In my class, 73%+ was an A. Sends a new curve after each exam.

reviews.subject: MGMT246 (Law)

reviews.subject: MGMT246 (Law)
reviews.review: Intense lecturer which gets his point across well but may make it hard to remember details. Grade curve is insane, with most of the class failing by the final and most people passing despite low final grades. Get ready to read and do a lot of work and studying if you don't want to pray for the unknown curve, definitely too hard as a side class.

reviews.subject: MGMT246 (Law)
reviews.review: He is pretty chill, but i felt dumb when I went to his office hour bc it felt like he talked down on me when I asked about going over a quiz. He uses his own outlines from the textbook, but I would still get the textbook incase. No hw but graded on 3 exams and a few quizzes, curves very nice tho. I went from a F to B+ from his final curve.

reviews.subject: MGMT246 (Law)
reviews.review: Professor Atzeff is extremely knowledgable, he is very passionate about law and teaching the class. If law is something you're interested in, he is for sure the professor to take.

reviews.subject: HIST110A (History)
reviews.review: The course was overall easy, but the tests were hard. He lets you drop one exam score and for his final he has review lectures outside of class and gives all the answers. He is very sarcastic in lectures and makes fun of religion

reviews.subject: HIS110A (History)
reviews.review: Very sarcastic professor that can be a tad annoying if youre not use to it. Lecture heavy, attendance required, 3 pages summary per chapter (22 ish chapters total), and book required. reviews.subject: HIS110A (History)
reviews.review: Homework assignments are easy but long and tedious (3 page summaries). Must attend class and lecture heavy. Three midterms and you drop the lowest one. There is one cumulative final. reviews.subject: HIS110A (History)
reviews.review: Funniest professor ever. Easy A, don't even need to take notes. You do have to write summaries for all the chapters but those are so easy it didn't really matter. Gives extra credit. reviews.subject: HIST110A (History)
reviews.review: DO NOT take Mr. Reemes' class if you don't like to write. Homework is graded and is a 3-page chapter summary for each chapter (2 per week). Textbook is a must. reviews.subject: HIST110A (History)
reviews.review: He is easy if you study enough. Attendance is mandatory (sign-up sheet). Extra credit on tests. Don't have to take notes. Summary hw is annoying. Drops lowest midterm. reviews.subject: ENGL301 (English)

reviews.subject: ENG101 (English)

reviews.subject: ENGL301 (English)

reviews.subject: ENG101 (English)
reviews.review: Nice lady and easy class, but too laidback. She didn't care about teaching and I learned nothing. There were a lot of misunderstandings about zoom classes/conferences. reviews.subject: ENG101 (English)

reviews.subject: ENG101 (English)

reviews.subject: COMM361 (Communications)

reviews.subject: COMM425 (Communications)

reviews.subject: COMM468 (Communications)
