reviews.subject: COMM468 (Communications)
reviews.review: You have discussion papers due every other week, and then quizzes every other week. The class is very straight to the point and heavily discussion based. reviews.subject: COMM425 (Communications)
reviews.review: Excellent prof, though she may be regarded as boring; coffee is a great a tool to have to stay awake during class. reviews.subject: COM425 (Communications)

reviews.subject: MATH370 (Mathematics)

reviews.subject: MATH135 (Mathematics)

reviews.subject: MATH370 (Mathematics)

reviews.subject: MATH130 (Mathematics)

reviews.subject: MATH135 (Mathematics)

reviews.subject: MATH130 (Mathematics)

reviews.review: Such a great professor! The readings are made available to you and you need to participate but its a great lecture class.

reviews.subject: 302A (Education)
reviews.review: Super chill async class. Zoom lectures are posted and you have 2 weeks to go over them. There were a couple essays, each 3-4 pages, not too bad. With my lack of attendance, no textbook, and rare note taking, I still got a B-84%. Just take notes and go to lectures, it'll make your life easier! Professor is also so funny.

reviews.subject: HCOM100 (Human Communication Studies)
reviews.review: Took her HCOM100 class online and she was a great professor and got to know the students well, despite it being online. Grading is alright but a little harsh and unorganized at some points. Overall, I don't recommend taking her classes at all, I communicated a situation with her and still received harsh grading despite my situation being serious!

reviews.subject: HCOM100 (Human Communication Studies)
reviews.review: Prepare for long exams for finals and midterms where you willing be using the full time-slot to answer every question. While the questions aren't extensively hard, they are excessively long and complicated for no apparent reason. Beyond that the speeches are straight forward as long as you manage your time. She is extremely eccentric and has engery

reviews.subject: HCOM100 (Human Communication Studies)
reviews.review: This professor is super wholesome, and is such a ball of sunshine. However, when it comes to being an instructor the points of staying organized, having a clear sense of assignments to be graded, helpful material(that actually goes with the final) is a off. Her organization was the part that made it super difficult to stay on task in her class!

reviews.subject: HCOM102 (Human Communication Studies)
reviews.review: professor frye is hands down one of my favorite professors ever. she is so caring and she really wants the best for every single student she has. she encourages you and actually believes in the quality of you and your work. her class is amazing and i felt like i really learned a lot. prof frye gave me confidence. i recommend the class

reviews.subject: HCOM102 (Human Communication Studies)
reviews.review: My favorite professor Ive had so far! Shes very caring and understanding. She truly wants to build a relationship with her students. Make sure you participate in class, she will like you better. She loves to hear from her students. Shes a little unorganized with due dates. Overall shes an amazing professor and makes sure you truly understand.

reviews.subject: HCOM235 (Human Communication Studies)
reviews.review: Nise is a great professor but this past semester when I took her, there was a huge problem with organization. She would always assign her assignments but in staggered times. For example, she'll assign hw today that's due in 2 weeks and 2 days later, assign hw that is due in one week and the following week, assign a debate.

reviews.subject: ISDS361A (Information Systems)
reviews.review: Professor Ram's rating does not portray him as it should, his class was very easy and straightforward. Fully online class accessed through Zoom. Attendance was not mandatory but he gives out extra credit opportunities for simply being on Zoom. Homework takes less than an hour and gives weeks to submit. One paper at the end of semester.

reviews.subject: ISDS361A (Information Systems)
reviews.review: The people that don't do well in this class and don't like this professor are just wrong. He gave us almost 10% of our grade solely from extra credit. He cold calls us in class, but that's to make sure we are paying attention because this class is apparently hard. Thank to this professor, it was much easier than it should have been. I'd take again.

reviews.subject: ISDS361A (Information Systems)
reviews.review: He honestly was not a bad professor. He gives extra credit for attending class, even pushed back the exam when we asked. Go to his lectures and take good notes. For exams, review your notes and take practice exams/problems. It's a hard class in general, so you have to put the effort in but it's not as terrible as the other reviews say.

reviews.subject: 361A (Information Systems)
reviews.review: Please, for the life of you, don't take Ram even if he is your only option. He doesn't even teach the class; he just sits there and reads his lecture slides. Then, when he tries to do the work on Excel, he gets it wrong. He is confusing and doesn't even know his own instructions. about 40% of the class did the wrong final essay, he blamed us.

reviews.subject: 361A (Information Systems)
reviews.review: Nothing about him is good. Toke his zoom class and was struggling on the most basic feature. Switched to another ISDS teacher who knew what she was teaching. Singhania responds to emails very late or never. I went to his office hours so I can get a response quicker and he called Canvas support for help on WiFi connection issue.

reviews.subject: 361A (Information Systems)
reviews.review: This was apparently his first ever online course. Beware of taking him in the future, as he borrows his lectures from other professors and has zero idea (or just doesn't care) about how to operate the class. I'm typically an A student who just managed to scrap by with a C. You've been warned!!

reviews.subject: HIST326 (History)
reviews.review: Was excited to learn the history of magic & witchcraft, but this class made it very difficult to enjoy any of it. So many boring readings every week with difficult discussion posts. We wrote so many primary sources which the prompts made it difficult to write 4 pages worth, I always ended up repeating myself. Tough grader for most part.

reviews.subject: HIST326 (History)
reviews.review:
The class is extremely tedious! Homework consisted of discussion posts (must use evidence from textbook & reply to 3 other students),  4 primary source papers & 1 midterm (2 questions) and a final (2 questions) - ALOT of papers, therefore, if you do not like writing papers - this class is not for you :(
Material is interesting though!

reviews.subject: HIST110A (History)
reviews.review: I'm not sure why this class had so much writing required. It had the most work assigned out of all of my classes by far. The assignments themselves weren't actually that hard though, and professor Brunelle gave good feedback on my papers and many of the discussion prompts were actually pretty relevant to today. Overall not bad just time consuming.

reviews.subject: HIST110A (History)
reviews.review: Absolutely horrendous professor. She assigns multiple papers that dont need to be as complicated as she wants them, its as if she enjoys reading hundreds of essays during her free time. The final is two 750 word minimum essays she claims to be made of only 2 questions, but each question is filled with numerous more smaller ones. Shes clueless.

reviews.subject: HIST110A (History)
reviews.review: Weekly papers. The midterm and final are both long essay questions. If you do not like writing, do not take the course. Professor Brunelle does not teach the course, it is flipped learning and asynchronous so if you have any sort of questions you will need to go out of your way to ask them rather than being able to ask them directly.

reviews.subject: ENG101 (English)
reviews.review: Gives assignments back to back. Does not give clear instructions. Constantly changing her mind. Grades participation on how her mood on any given day. Don't buy the book she says, we do nothing with it throughout the semester.

reviews.subject: ENG101 (English)
reviews.review: she expects way too much from her students and doesnt explain anything so we were all lost for every single assignment. she is HORRIBLE and very biased and is literally just here to push her own opinion that GMOs suck and doesnt give you a chance to have a difference of opinion or anything (her sources werent even reliable) worst teacher EVER

reviews.subject: ENG101 (English)
reviews.review: Very unorganized and hard to understand. Didn't really learn anything in her class, since most of the peer reviews were from people who were at a similar skill level as me in terms of writing.

reviews.subject: ENG101 (English)
reviews.review: I just found this whole website that disputes the GMO claims she believes in from this movie she makes you watch for an essay you have to write. Nice lady but her obsession with GMOs is similar to that of those anti-vaccine moms. Also, she is a very unclear teacher who is messily organized which means no one else understands except her.

reviews.subject: ENG101 (English)
reviews.review: goodness Im in this class right now and its terrible! she is so unclear on what she wants from us and is just blatantly rude. I have learned absolutely nothing

reviews.subject: ENG101 (English)
reviews.review: Nice lady however very unorganized. She has several platforms for listing homework and it can get very confusing. She cares too much about GMOs and a majority of the class is focused on them. She stacks her essays back to back.

reviews.subject: HIST110A (History)
reviews.review: Sometimes is slow to answer emails. Easy online class. You do 2 discussion posts online per week. There's some essays, but not hard. I bought the textbook, but barely touched it. You also pick what readings to do online. TIP: Read 1 article, then make both discussion posts for it. 1 post with your opinion, another post responding to someone.

reviews.subject: HIST501 (History)
reviews.review: Weekly readings and three big papers. Not bad for a graduate level class. She's super sweet and can be helpful at times if you stay after class or go to her office hours. Fitch can also be unclear as well, especially when it comes to the specifics in her papers. Overall, enjoyable class! I liked my classmates and their discussions during class.

reviews.subject: HIST110B (History)
reviews.review: She's an extremely sweet lady but her class is just so boring. Mandatory isn't really necessary since it's history and you can basically learn on your own. I don't know if she'll continue, but for us she did the midterm and final online. Good luck! I guess it's an easy class if you listen to the lectures, or read from the book.

reviews.subject: 437B (History)
reviews.review: Dr. Fitch is very easy to follow.  She lectures for part of the class and has group discussion for second half.  We've watched several videos as well.  There are 3 take home papers, no tests at all.  You also need to do a weekly discussion post based on that week's reading.  Pretty easy grader.  I highly recommend her.

reviews.subject: HIST110B (History)
reviews.review: pretty sure I developed ADD because of this class. Please, take a different teacher. super nice buuut, exxtreemely boring. got an A on the midterm and an 88% on the final. which gave me like an 89% in the class...and i got a "B" what a ripoff.  I feel like I wasted my life trying to study for that class.

reviews.subject: HISTORY110B (History)
reviews.review: Teacher very knowledgable, in every aspect of history. She was very fun to interesting to listen to and would answer any question that you had. Go to class and book is basically not needed just listen and take good notes. Got an A in the class

reviews.subject: ENG101 (English)
reviews.review: Shes chill, just a boring class. Random group work. The book is easy to read. You can get a B by writing the essays and going to office hours

reviews.subject: ENG101 (English)
reviews.review: Few if any homework given in this class. Attendance not mandatory but group work is given at random times so you don't want your group to hate you. Keep all your papers because you will need to turn them in altogether when the class ends. Stick to her rules on essays and you will receive a decent grade.

reviews.subject: ENG101 (English)
reviews.review: I took her 4 years ago, and idk how I got a C. I should've done better, but hey, I was a freshman. Anyway, i remember her class as doing a lot of busy work and essay writing while she does her own thing up front. If you can write solid essays and can make her office hours you should at least get a B.

reviews.subject: ENG101 (English)
reviews.review: Easy A class just the professor is boring. BS-ed all my papers the night before and managed an A

reviews.subject: ENGL101 (English)
reviews.review: Okay teacher.  The class is pretty easy and straight forward.  Go to class and listen to what she says.  Very picky with grammer in essays.Textbook is required but youre never quizzed or tested on the material (except for in the essay)  Just listen to what she says and follow directions and you will pass the class easily.  Not the most excited prof

reviews.subject: ENGL101 (English)
reviews.review: Prof. king is super cool and i didnt mind showing up to her class. as long as you write all the essays the way she explains them and her way with the right format  you will pass. there are 4 essays and 2 out of class essays and no tests or final. highly recommended you will not regret it

reviews.subject: HIS110B (History)
reviews.review: Thomas Wong is the WORST professor I've ever had. You will learn absolutely nothing from this class and attendance is mandatory. Save yourself the hassle and don't take him. Homework is in the form of journals and you must do them to pass the class. 1 midterm and 1 final in essay format. Look for the answers online, don't bother reading the book.

reviews.subject: HIST110B (History)
reviews.review: Good luck staying awake in class. He came across as knowledgeable, but his teaching style is so detatched. And be prepared to write, write, then write some more. He loves journals.

reviews.subject: HIST110 (History)
reviews.review: Easy but tooo much writing and reading for hw.... I bs the midterm and i got a B- and got an A on some writning assignment and i didnt do all of the journals so i got a C in the class

reviews.subject: HIST110B (History)
reviews.review: He was the worst prof I have ever had at CSUF. He never taught anything; he would let the textbooks (2 100$ books! what a jerk!) and movies do all the teaching. The journals were time consuming and boring. Not to mention that he practically died in our class and we had to get a new prof for the last 3 weeks... then i actually gained some knowledge!

reviews.subject: HIST110B (History)
reviews.review: He was the worst prof I have ever had at CSUF. He never taught anything; he would let the textbooks (2 100$ books! what a jerk!) and movies do all the teaching. The journals were time consuming and boring. Not to mention that he practically died in our class and we had to get a new prof for the last 3 weeks... then i actually gained some knowledge!

reviews.subject: HIST110A (History)
reviews.review: Very boring class.  Finds a way to relate every subject discussed back to farming rituals of Ancient China.  Only real work done in the class is having to write several journals.  If you keep up on the journals and readings you should be fine.  Trust me, doing 20 journals in 24 hours is the most exhausting experience ever.

reviews.subject: CPSC131 (Computer Science)
reviews.review: im already tired of this class and the nonsense

reviews.subject: CPSC131 (Computer Science)
reviews.review: Reviews do injustice imo. For 131 at least, he was best pick (don't pick mike). Slow lecturer; u'll end up sleepy sometimes. Rigid regarding the setup he wants. Hw 0-3 are easy, 4 gets a bit strict, and 5th is js annoyng. Final is imp. to get perfect score (due to his specifics). Easy if u pay atten. & show up evryday. But his goofy ah smirk man.

reviews.subject: CPSC131 (Computer Science)
reviews.review: This review is for CPSC 335, not 131. The professor is knowledgeable, but the course is very hard to navigate. Grading rubrics and expectations are unclear, and exam questions are often vague. Attendance is extremely low (~15%), likely reflecting widespread confusion. The difficulty comes more from a lack of clarity than from the material itself.

reviews.subject: CPSC131 (Computer Science)
reviews.review: I don't know why his rating is so low. His class is very interesting, he is a good person, and the class atmosphere is very nice; you can really learn something. Especially when you are studying 131, taking his class makes the knowledge memorable. These are foundational things, and there is nothing wrong with learning them. Mandatory attendance.

reviews.subject: CPSC131 (Computer Science)
reviews.review: At the beginning I did not like him but over time he genuinely is a good person. Lectures are straightforward sometimes boring but intriguing there are checkpoints/quiz that are based off the lectures gives good amount of time on homework but can only submit a set amount of times with waiting period, need to print a paper for notes as ur attendance

reviews.subject: CPSC131 (Computer Science)
reviews.review: I don't know why everyone is talking crap about him. He is passionate about Computer Science and he used to work in the industry. The course itself isn't easy, but he teaches really well. I learned a lot from him Fall 2024 for CPSC 131. I do not understand why there is so much bad reviews. He really wants to teach you. Do not take advantage of him!

reviews.subject: ISDS351 (Information Systems)
reviews.review: Pretty decent class if you put baseline effort into the project; you should get at least a B in the class

reviews.subject: ISDS402 (Information Systems)
reviews.review: Avoid this professor if you can. She is a harsh grader and does not give timely responses. She takes a long time to grade and does not give enough support for an online class. The exams consist of a multiple choice and written (coding portion). If you are taking this class, YOU WILL HAVE TO PUT IN A LOT OF WORK and use outside resources.

reviews.subject: ISDS402 (Information Systems)
reviews.review: DO NOT TAKE. Her asynchronous class is not good. She takes FOREVER to grade assignments (over a month to grade something). She tells you to refer to feedback for assignments/ group projects but you have to set up a zoom call just to get that feedback, she doesn't automatically give it to you. Can't turn in anything late. EXAMS ARE SCHEDULED.

reviews.subject: ISDS351 (Information Systems)
reviews.review: She's the least forgiving instructor I've ever had. She has quizzes at the beginning of the course, and she doesn't allow you to take them if you are late. Even if you have documents to prove you were unable to make it on time, she doesn't care. The class content is not very difficult, but she gives very blurry instructions.

reviews.subject: ISDS351 (Information Systems)
reviews.review: Whole class is weighed on a huge group project that has tons of little components, as if this is the only class we have. Also she is extremely rude and gets mad when you ask questions, do not take her.

reviews.subject: ISDS351 (Information Systems)
reviews.review: extremely rude, not specific at all with criteria and guidelines, but gets annoyed when you ask questions and responds rudely. do not take.

reviews.subject: HIST330 (History)
reviews.review: Half the class is going to fail unless he curves all of our grades, if it was just me I would take accountability but his teaching style is not very effective at all and it shows in the test grades

reviews.subject: PSYC408 (History)
reviews.review: definitely DONT recommend. course is lecture heavy w/ small, unreadable texts. avoid if you can.

reviews.subject: PSYC408 (History)
reviews.review: Dr. Smith is super nice and very knowledgeable. He is always willing to talk to you whenever you visit his office hours. He listens to you and gives you great suggestions. His lectures were so interesting. His 400-level courses are not easy, but if you want to learn, you should definitely take him.

reviews.subject: PSYC408 (History)
reviews.review: DON'T TAKE HIM! His slides are written in super tiny little fonts, which is completely impossible for us to read in class. For each exam, he expects us to complete a 4-page essay + 50 multiple-choice questions within 70 min!! Hardest class EVER! I don't know how he can make difficult content even harder for us to learn.

reviews.subject: BIO101 (Biology)
reviews.review: Sweetest person ever. Gives cool grandma vibes and the class pacing is consistent. Highly recommend if you're looking for a lower div science GE class with a professor who is very attentive and supportive to her students!

reviews.subject: BIO101 (Biology)
reviews.review: Great professor in regards to information, participate, it makes class fun.

reviews.subject: BIO101 (Biology)
reviews.review: SHOW UP TO CLASS!!! Most of the things we were graded on were in class assignments. There were other assignments too, but if you show up to class and do the assignments, you will do great. She's really sweet, it's an easy class considering it's bio. She's so passionate and sweet, just show up to class and you'll be fine.

reviews.subject: BIO101 (Biology)
reviews.review: Worst professor possible. Very unclear with her grading, always drifts away from the lesson to talk about her life. Exams are difficult, you must read the book. Do NOT take her

reviews.subject: BIOL151 (Biology)
reviews.review: She is not a very clear professor and her tests are very detail oriented. Her lectures cover the general concepts but never the details which is very important.

reviews.subject: BIO151 (Biology)
reviews.review: Dr Casem is an amazing biology teacher. The assignments she gives will really help you to understand and retain information for her exams. Her lectures are interesting and she is always willing to explain concepts further.

reviews.subject: 311 (Psychology)
reviews.review: If i had a last option this class would be it, she accused half of class to student conduct of AI and half of class didn't pass the class. 4 years at this school & i would say, this professor would have to be the worst I've ever had in my entire life. do yourself a favor and DO NOT TAKE trust me as a psych major she made me wanna drop out !!

reviews.subject: EDPSY311 (Psychology)
reviews.review: So paranoid about AI that she falsely accused most of the class. It's called three perceptions. Asks very basic exam Qs and expects you to get them wrong if you didn't watch the videos, when she also posts readings. In her ramppage against AI she has been grading very harshly. Claims outside material use, when you just built off of what she taught

reviews.subject: PSY311 (Psychology)
reviews.review: This professor wants to give you a bad grade. Do not take this teacher, there are so many other people in my class failing because she just wants to accuse everyone of using AI. Everyone that doesn't use AI just gets bad grades. Find another professor before choosing this one if you can.

reviews.subject: 311 (Psychology)
reviews.review: She deserves a higher rating, the class was a breeze and I learned a lot in it. Exams were some of the most straightforward I've had and overall I enjoyed taking this class.

reviews.subject: EDPSYC (Psychology)
reviews.review: Tough grader, but her lectures are fun and entertaining, actually learned a lot. Attendance is not mandatory, but she does constant in-class activities that are graded, so I recommend you just go to class. If you need help, she won't really directly help you, but she'll set you on the right path. Overall 9/10, would recommend and take again.

reviews.subject: PSY311 (Psychology)
reviews.review: I don't understand the poor reviews, maybe she has improved in recent years? I've had a great experience with this professor. Exams were based on material directly, with just a little effort I feel it is pretty easy and she was very kind.

reviews.subject: PSY351 (Psychology)
reviews.review: very receptive and open to feedback, available outside of class and overall compassionate about the subject she teaches. I really enjoyed this class

reviews.subject: PSY351 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Can go off on tangents quite often but was a very solid professor, gives real world examples and multiple methods of learning material. Very compassionate about her students, I would take again.

reviews.subject: PSYC456 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Lots of research articles as well as in class group article reviews. This professor uses research articles to educate us rather than a textbook. Overall, Beals cares about her students and is passionate about this class. Identity project, two exams, in class essay, article reviews/discussions. attendance is taken randomly so show up!

reviews.subject: PSYC495 (Psychology)
reviews.review: I took this professor's Psyc 495 summer schedule for the Field Placement component of my internship, and I thoroughly enjoyed the experience. She always responds to her emails, and if you have questions or a problem, she addresses them and tries to help as much as possible. I highly recommend this professor.

reviews.subject: PSYC351 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Dr. Beals is so kind and caring! I like how she gives real-life examples of the concepts that we are learning in class, she also shares some of her own stories, which sometimes are funny! This is what makes going to class enjoyable! Not too much work outside of class. 6 multiple-choice quizzes, some discussion posts, and 1 in-class essay. Take her!

reviews.subject: PSYC351 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Amazing professor! This class is easy in my opinion if you put in any effort. Instead of exams, she gives mini quizzes once every ~2 weeks (10 MCQ questions) final is optional& will replace 3 of your lowest quiz grades. attendance is checked on random days so you can miss class if it is not checked. you can tell she really cares about her students

reviews.subject: MATH125 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: You will have a quiz like every week if you have her  Monday, Wednesday and Friday. She is very nice, but assigns lots of homework. . The quizzes and exams is related to the homework as well as the notes in the textbook. The final is focuses more on previous exams, than homework. So review all exams before taking final, as well as the pop quizzes.

reviews.subject: MATH125 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: AVOID, pacing is terrible, extra credit is pathetic only 1 point..., goes through 3-5 sections a day and expects u to master it for the quiz the next day. If you suck at math avoid this class, she complicates everything that yt can teach in 10 minutes she does in 1 hr and 30 min. Tests/quizes are NOTHING like HW problems.

reviews.subject: MATH135 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: pretty similar to an asynchronous class, you teach yourself all the material. homework and review questions by her have no relevance to what is actually on the test / final.

reviews.subject: MATH135 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: I was honestly very worried about taking this class with Professor Syed because of the reviews. However, she was amazing! The people who give her poor ratings are people who clearly hate math or struggle with the concepts learned in the class. All her review assignments are similar to exams. She is always there to help if you need it!

reviews.subject: MATH135 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: L teacher that's all I gotta say

reviews.subject: MATH135 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Easily one of the worst instructors I've had. Not helpful when it comes to explaining problems and tests have questions that come out of left field. Insane.

reviews.subject: ACCT302 (Accounting)
reviews.review: This class was one of the toughest accounting classes Ive taken. I went to SI which helped SO MUCH. Karan spends a lot of time doing problems but doesnt tell you where hes getting the numbers. Do the problems he covers multiple times, read the book, and go to SI. The pop quizzes are tricky, so stay on top of everything. Decent curve at the end

reviews.subject: ACCT302 (Accounting)
reviews.review: Vijay Karan was a pretty solid teacher. He expects you to have read the chapter before coming to class, so he doesn't spend a lot of time actually teaching much. He spends most of the class going over examples from the book. I feel like he did a great job explaining how to do things from the practice problems. The homework helps a lot on the exams.

reviews.subject: ACCT511 (Accounting)
reviews.review: This class is hard and Mr. Karan does NOT make it manageable. He is negligent and could careless if you are not understanding material. He goes SO fast. There were 8 people in the class RE-TAKING it, and the tests are not in the same format as the homework. For case studies he just picks grades out of a hat, you will never get 100%.

reviews.subject: ACCT302 (Accounting)
reviews.review: The class is almost half lecture and half practice problems. He tends to move very fast through the problems and skip some parts of the math; so If you have any questions, ask him when he's still on the topic. Overall enjoyed the class and he is very carrying. Go see him if you are confused on anything and be prepared to work for your grade.

reviews.subject: ACC302 (Accounting)
reviews.review: Not doubt this class is hard, be ready to read before the class, and get familiar with problems that will be done in class. Professor Karan is super knowledgeable on the material, makes exercises easy to understand, and wants you to use your critical thinking. He is preparing students for their career not just to get a good grade.

reviews.subject: ACC302 (Accounting)
reviews.review: Would not recommend. This was by far the hardest class of my college career. He simply does problems from the book the entire class, but doesn't explain where any of the numbers are coming from. No participation from the class because everyone is lost the entire time. I had to teach myself the entire course. Hard quizzes, hard exams, hard hw.

reviews.subject: MGMT340 (Management)
reviews.review: Not really sure why she has a low rating. I'm taking her summer class rn and she's great. Definitely an overcomplicated explanation of organizational behavior but it's interesting. She doesn't grade hard, but we do have a group presentation due before the summer semester ends. Overall, I would take her again.

reviews.subject: MGMT340 (Management)
reviews.review: overcomplicates such a simple topic. put a question related to her personal life on the exam. would avoid if u can

reviews.subject: MGMT340 (Management)
reviews.review: Professor Muse didn't really keep me engaged much during the semester. Her class was a bit of a drag but I got it done regardless. Be prepared to read and memorize a lot of work.

reviews.subject: MGMT432 (Management)
reviews.review: I stopped looking both ways when crossing Nutwood walking to her class in hopes I wouldn't make it. Ask this ginger for help and she hits you with the NPC look like she didn't spend 30 mins lecturing in riddles.

reviews.subject: MGMT340 (Management)
reviews.review: Discussions, quizzes, team report/presentation, 3 exams (2 w/ saqs). Pros: final isn't cumulative with good participation, prof gives feedback, most ppl got As on project. Cons: prof seems reluctant to answer exam questions & gets frustrated at times, classes may be stressful until presentations, exams may be tricky, no extra credit/curve.

reviews.subject: MGMT432 (Management)
reviews.review: Class consists of discussions, group assignments, a group project & 3 exams. Professor Muse is strict w/ cheating, not very clear w/ instructions & can be confusing. Only one study guide is given, short answer ?s are involved & does kahoots for review. Overall, didn't like the class & wished there were more than one professor teaching this course.

reviews.subject: COMM333 (Communications)
reviews.review: Prof King was by far the most thoughtful professor I had this semester. I took her asynchronous online course, and she let us do the material at whatever pace we were comfortable with. She was very understanding of the fact that we have other classes and other things that take up our time. Her grading criteria are pretty straightforward as well.

reviews.subject: COMM333 (Communications)
reviews.review: Honestly, she's not that bad. Weekly quizzes derived from the self-checks with some EnLive assignments, from time to time, plus 3 discussions. All is doable within 2 hours. She opens all the modules, so if you feel like going way ahead and completing the course 6 weeks early, like me, go right ahead. There is no late penalty either.

reviews.subject: COMM333 (Communications)
reviews.review: Quizzes with multiple tries, practice quizzes that help with the quizzes, no exams, and 3 "big" discussion posts. This class seems overwhelming at first, but I swear you get used to it once you figure out how to navigate the readings. Roughly 2-3 hours a week to do the work (videos, skim readings, quizzes). Not a bad class IMO

reviews.subject: COMM333 (Communications)
reviews.review: Idk if I would recommend this class or not. It's not bad, but it's not great. The weekly assignments are tedious for sure, but they're simple enough. I think the content itself can be overwhelming if you're not familiar with academic studies. Get ready to think critically :')

reviews.subject: COMMUNICATIONS (Communications)
reviews.review: By far, the WORST professor I have ever had at CSUF. If you are able to avoid her, I would do so at all costs. The way she teaches is extremely unorganized and erratic. She gives multiple assignments every single week that are tedious and busy work. No breaks or time off, and doesn't give clear instructions. Help yourself and DO NOT take her.

reviews.subject: COM361 (Communications)
reviews.review: i usually complain about how much work professors give, but this was not that much work it is just one discussion post every 2 weeks and the quiz that she gives all the answers to in the self checks the easiest classes i've taken also she ha no due dates and accepts late work for months after everyone giving a bad review is being super dramatic

reviews.subject: BIO405 (Biological Sciences)
reviews.review: Extremely unorganized lectures and back tracks a lot which makes it difficult to understand concepts

reviews.subject: BIOL405 (Biological Sciences)
reviews.review: This class is only taught by her, but basically its a ton of material to sift through. Balanced grading scale, exams are 40% but other assignments you do are like 10% each. Gives a nice study guide that narrows down concepts well, and puts more questions but only grades up to 100%. Finnicky grading, seems like she wants specific answers.

reviews.subject: BIO151 (Biological Sciences)
reviews.review: I had the class online but there was a lot of reading for the class. I had to read multiple chapters before class. Had little homework but required you to ask questions about the chapter which was what we would talk about in class. 2 papers but the latter is optional. Has a final project where you work with partners so make sure you are prepared.

reviews.subject: BIO151 (Biological Sciences)
reviews.review: When I took her class her quizzes were impossible and we were required to read up to 1-3 chapters per week.  She had both short answer and multiple choice quizzes and all had impossible questions that no one understood.  The average in this class was around a C to a B-.  So beware.

reviews.subject: BIOL405 (Biological Sciences)
reviews.review: Tough grader on exams, assignments, and group projects. She provides very little helpful feedback, takes forever to respond back to her emails. Seems to have preferences in class especially when it comes to asking for help on assignments.

reviews.subject: BIOL405 (Biological Sciences)
reviews.review: Dr. M is amazing for 405. The class isn't hard as it is dense. She gives directed readings to keep you sharp. They're not graded, but it is in your best interest to stay on top of them. She allows a cheat sheet front and back for exams. The one downside to her class is she quizzes on a lecture topic before she lectures on it.

reviews.subject: PSY391 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Past reviews no longer apply, his exams were online on a proctor page, heavily focused on articles and worded in odd ways that made it difficult so read carefully. He snapped at our class for asking for help in future exams and study guides. Very lecture heavy, and random summaries in class that are worth points, so attendance is mandatory.

reviews.subject: PSY351 (Psychology)
reviews.review: I took prof baker for social psych and he is the best! his lectures are really good, and he lets you use a notecard for the tests. he is extremely helpful, and genuinely cares for his students. just pay attention in lectures and take good notes and you'll be fine!

reviews.subject: PSY391 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Professor Baker is such an understanding professor.I have to say he is at times a little awkward but it's what makes him funny. He does do heavy lecture no pp slides. Another thing is that he doesn't allow electronics in class for note taking (has a valid excuse). He is very helpful when helping with any assignments and accessible outside of class.

reviews.subject: PSY391 (Psychology)
reviews.review: This professor is not good at all, don't take him i don't know why he has good reviews he is the worst at teaching, no lecture slides and exams are hard he expects too much, also i felt like he was a little bit of a bully towards some students which is so unprofessional for a person who literally teaches Psyc 391 DONT TAKE HIM

reviews.subject: PSY351 (Psychology)
reviews.review: My only issue is his whole no technology rule. honestly literally every other class I have that allows technology for note taking I have a FAR better experience taking notes. I am a faster typer than a writer and it can be tough catching up and you dont wanna be saying can you repeat that after every sentence he says.

reviews.subject: PSY391 (Psychology)
reviews.review: He knows his content well, and will help you if you reach out, he makes the class fair as possible for anyone to achieve! He allows notecards for exam which are very helpful so you don't have to focus on memorizing the actual lectures but actually understand the content and be able to apply it. His teaching strategy one of the best I have ever had

reviews.subject: COG305ONLINE (Psychology)
reviews.review:
Pros: 

Cons:
- mistrusts students
- accuses students of being negligent or cheating
- cumulative final of 88 (!) questions for an online course phrased in a way meant to trick you 
- genuinely the worst class I've ever had

reviews.subject: PSYC305 (Psychology)
reviews.review: avoid this professor! even though this was an online class, the final exam was IN PERSON. his course structure is super disorganized and no one knew their grade the entire semester because he wouldn't upload the percentage on canvas. i don't even know if i'm going to pass this class.

reviews.subject: PSYC415 (Psychology)
reviews.review: I took this during the spring 2025. Someone from my class left a review that expressed the same way I felt about the class. I emailed him about how my grade dropped two letter grades as well because of the exam .It was disappointing since I never missed a class. He would always go on a tangent and disorganized.

reviews.subject: PSYC415 (Psychology)
reviews.review: The professor is extremely disorganized and does not give clear instruction. This semester we were given 2 in class ‘assignments', 2 online quizzes, 2 exams, 1 paper, and 1 group project. The professor did not prepare us for any of it and rushed us at the end. The professor is sweet and all, but he is very disorganized/ doesn't teach the material

reviews.subject: PSYC415 (Psychology)
reviews.review: Literally finished the class and on Canvas i got an A. Then I check TDA and its two letters down based on bs exam that he completely forgot about since we were doing presentations the last minute. Do not take him, he is not a good professor at all ! I don't know how he still has his position, whole class is a mess.

reviews.subject: PSY305 (Psychology)
reviews.review: This professor is completely disorganized, the assignments were difficult to understand, the material is already difficult and the structure of his online class makes the class harder than it needs to be. You do need to put the work and effort in this class, YOU WILL HAVE TO KNOW the material to pass, you can NOT beat around the bush for his exams

reviews.subject: ECON335 (Economics)
reviews.review: This guy was the single most difficult thing I've had to deal with in my college career. Doesn't reply to emails. Answers to questions rarely fully answer questions. Gave new material during final class session. Only allotted 20 minutes to go over the final. Final questions were worded in very confusing format that no one understood.

reviews.subject: ECON335 (Economics)
reviews.review: Great guy. Very nice. Be sure to respond to his questions during lecture. :)

reviews.subject: ECON335 (Economics)
reviews.review: The class is pretty easy, does not use proctorio, and only 1 midterm and final. 1 class report & 1 written assignment. The hw is easy and it is worth a lot. The class is super easy but be careful as his lectures are extremely boring and you will fall asleep.

reviews.subject: ECON335 (Economics)
reviews.review: Currently taking Dr. Duella, next semester will be his last class to teach. 6 homework, 2 exams, and a 2-page writing assignment. Dr. Duella goes into detail (slowly) in his lectures and likes to get students involved by asking questions. Exams are based on slides, homework, and notes during his lecture.

reviews.subject: ECON335 (Economics)
reviews.review: One midterm. One final. A couple of homework assignments. One paper and an easy class report. Gives you a breakdown of the exam as a study guide. Go to the class before the exam and you'll be fine. Lectures can be boring and hard to understand.

reviews.subject: ECON335 (Economics)
reviews.review: Super unorganized. Comes up with examples on the fly and sometimes gets the answer to his own example wrong. Went to his office hours and even one on one he gives vague explanations that make no sense. Had to self teach course. Speech pattern is slow, boring, and will put you to sleep. DO NOT TAKE UNLESS YOU WANT TO STRUGGLE!

reviews.subject: ACCT308 (Accounting)
reviews.review: The lectures barely covered what we needed to know; I learned more from weekly reading than anything he did in class. The tax project we had at the end of the semester was brutal too. He expected us to properly use a tax program to file a 1120 tax form despite having no prior experience dealing with them. Didn't even get a rubric with it either.

reviews.subject: ACCT201A (Accounting)
reviews.review: TAKE HIM! I was so nervous for this class, but he made it so doable. He goes over all the hw and is willing to help you if you get stuck, all u have to do is ask. Not gonna lie, the exams were tough, but review the hw, practice problems, and the book and you should be good. Best accounting professor at CSUF. Its a hard class, but he made it fun!

reviews.subject: ACCT201A (Accounting)
reviews.review: Professor Woodward was my favorite professor by far! Make sure to review the homework and do the practice problems that he provides. It's a difficult class, but he made going to class extremely enjoyable.

reviews.subject: ACCT308 (Accounting)
reviews.review: Prof Woodward was one of the best professors I have had at CSUF so far. Woodward makes the material bearable and clearly communicates his requirements for his class. The exams are very difficult, and there's weekly homework assigned. Go to class, study the material and you'll pass.

reviews.subject: BUSN211 (Accounting)
reviews.review: If it all possible, do NOT take him for accounting. You have been warned. One of the most discouraging classes I have ever taken. He is very difficult to understand when explaining things. The lectures are super hard to follow. I studied for hours on end and went to tons of tutoring a week, but still have to retake it.

reviews.subject: ACC301B (Accounting)
reviews.review: I have never been so disappointed after taking a class at CSUF. Professor Woodwards exams are extremely difficult and he will try his best to trick you. I showed up to every class, turned in every homework assignment, & studied really hard for each exam only to not pass the course. I took away nothing from his lectures- avoid at all costs.

reviews.subject: MGMT246 (Management)
reviews.review: He is a fine professor that knows what he is talking about, but doesn't use any slides in his lectures. He provides study guides for the exams, but you still have to show up to his lectures because he will go more in-depth about the context in the study guides. There are going to 3 exams (2 midterms and 1 non-cumulative final).

reviews.subject: MGMT446 (Management)
reviews.review: Lecture heavy class w/ no slides, so attendance + strong note taking is key. Prof is knowledgeable, funny, and explains concepts clearly. Study guides match exams, but wording is tricky and makes you second guess a lot. Open handwritten note exams help. Grade depends on a few exams + 1 big group project, so your grade can fluctuate a lot.

reviews.subject: MGNT246 (Management)
reviews.review: Sooo many lectures. No homework, but also no posted slides/notes, so open your ears. One index card front and back for exams, but they are your whole grade. Slightly curves by deleting questions from exam that majority got wrong.

reviews.subject: MGMT246 (Management)
reviews.review: Chill professor, make sure you attend class. Exams are based off the terms he talks about in class. 1 index card as a cheat sheet for each exam. 3 exams 33% of your grade 50 questions each. Make sure you study for each exam, he'll give out extra credit during class if you answer a question correctly. He gives great examples, definitely go to class

reviews.subject: MGMT246 (Management)
reviews.review: grades are based on 3 exams only (50 MCQ), each worth 33% of your grade. lectures are just him speaking, no slides or anything, so i recommend attending class (all the stuff he talks about are on study guide/exams). lecture can get boring at times, but he's a funny and chill guy. easy class if you put in the work and study! 1 index card per exam

reviews.subject: MGMT246 (Management)
reviews.review: I took this prof for fall semester '24 and his lectures are all pretty much listening and taking notes. no lecture slides. he tells jokes and enjoys teaching. but when following up on exams, he isn't very willing to help students understand better or elaborate on exam scores. grading is ONLY BASED ON EXAMS SO STUDY!!

reviews.subject: 150B (Mathematics)
reviews.review: I wish I took him the first time I took calc 2. I found the lectures from this professor miles better than my previous professor. I liked his thorough explanations. The tests weren't there to trick you. The written project is an easy grade booster. Be aware the professor is terrible when it comes to responding to emails though.

reviews.subject: MATH125 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: I can see he tries to make the class interesting, which is okay. However, he tends to come to class unprepared with the material, therefore rushing us at the worst times. We spent most of our time doing homework problems, which is nice but left the lecture material to be pushed later. Nice guy, not so good as a professor.

reviews.subject: MATH250A (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Professor Steve was an awesome instructor. Calculus 3 can be a tough class to understand but with him it felt easier. He was a very kind and caring instructor towards his students. Lectures can be long and boring at times. Homework is from the textbook, and quizzes are based on those homework problems. Overall I would recommend taking his class.

reviews.subject: CALCULUS135 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Good man, cares about his students but is often unprepared. I took MATH 150A and he pushed a test back 2 weeks due to this reason. Had me behind all my classmates in my SI class. Gives you a grade but does not explain why and will give you a low participation grade. Would not recommend taking this professor.

reviews.subject: MATH135 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Professor Alemansour cares about his students and wants to see them succeed. He'll know your name/who you are by the second class. Business calculus (calc. in general) is a tough course. Show up to EVERY class, take notes, and do all the homework. Show him that you're trying and you'll pass with a B. Funny guy. *Must have the textbook*

reviews.subject: MATH150A (Mathematics)
reviews.review: his teaching is not perfect but it's good, he likes to help his student, but sometimes he got lost when he starts the lecture and this thing is annoying. he does give extra credit. his grading is great and his exams are simple but he always put that question which most of the students couldn't solve it but after that he usually give us extra point

reviews.subject: MATH338 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: 2 Exams. Biweekly quizzes. 1 Final. Weekly online hw (2 attempts but both scores are averaged out).  Attendance is mandatory. The professor is pretty nice and has a small sense of humor; however it was difficult to understand him due to his accent so I had to self-study with his notes which were pretty useful.

reviews.subject: 338STATS (Mathematics)
reviews.review: This guy has some serious communication problems. In fact he is so hard to communicate with you can't even ask him questions without him thinking your asking about something else. Wish I took someone else...

reviews.subject: MATH338 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Always had a fun time going to professor Saweris class. The class was easy, 5 tests or so, and a bit of quizzes. The course was relatively easier, compared to other mathematics courses, so just show up, pay attention, and you're golden.

reviews.subject: MATH338 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: The best teacher I have ever seen. All his exams , quizzes and homework comes from the notes and lectures.

reviews.subject: MATH338 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Took during 5 week summer session. The professor is very friendly. He does have a bit of an accent but it is not too bad. He uses an online site for hw that also includes the ebook for the course. Fair grader, gives partial credit, easy lab assignments. 2 tests 1 final, 6 quizzes, 7 labs, several hw. If you have taken AP stats you should be fine.

reviews.subject: MATH130 (Mathematics)
reviews.review: Great professor. I dislike math immensely but he made the class fun. He is always very helpful. Come to all the class sessions and do all the online homework. If you pay attention and do the homework you should do pretty well. Hardly ever uses the book though so only buy it if you are serious about doing extra problems from it.

reviews.subject: HIST110A (History)
reviews.review: Pretty hard class but if you really like history and want to learn a lot you should take the class. Prepare to ACTUALLY study for tests although sometimes its hard to decide what is actually going to be on the test. He gives out a study guide and usually does review sessions which help a lot . Besides that, just One easy essay. Grades on curve.

reviews.subject: HIST110A (History)
reviews.review: Attendance is absolutely a must. He doesn't use Titanium so you have to take good notes because his test mostly consists of the things he talks about. Some questions on the tests are from the selections he puts in his lecture outline textbook. He lectures like he is telling a story so it keeps students interested, but STUDY HARD!

reviews.subject: HIST110A (History)
reviews.review: Very old school teaching. read both books he gives you you'll be fine. He loves his students, he will do anything to help you pass. I was failing his class, but he said if we did exceptional on the final he would pass us, hes not big on failing people unless you really dont try at all. He see's your dedication. Lectures are long tho. but interestin

reviews.subject: HIST110A (History)
reviews.review: Dr. Hardy teaches his lectures as if it were a story.  Take really good notes and record lectures if you can't write fast.  There is 2 midterms, a paper, and final.  I could have done better in the class if I did good on the first exam.  Make sure to read his book (need) and the other textbook.  Class is mandatory.

reviews.subject: HIST110A (History)
reviews.review: This class requires a lot of work. I could have done better if I would have scored better on the first exam. There are only 3 exams including the final and 1 paper. He lectures every class. Test are based on lectures. Don't screw up on the first exam! PAY ATTENTION IN CLASS IF YOU WANT TO PASS. TAKE DETAILED NOTES! He is very helpful&passionate!

reviews.subject: HIS110A (History)
reviews.review: Dr. Hardy is a grey professor. He loves history and it shows in his lectures. He is basically telling a story, and in it you will learn about history.

reviews.subject: PUBH350 (Health Science)
reviews.review: A health science professor who tries to actuallly help your health and to learn about nutrition and how certain foods can better your health or make it worse. For example one of the projects is to log all of your food on a website to see what you need to change about your diet and if you need more vitamins and better foods. Also a lot of lectures.

reviews.subject: PUBH349 (Health Science)
reviews.review: She was really great. Super nice and classroom environment was very enjoyable. Lectures were easy to understand. Also took other 349 prof (prof gill) for another class, so both are good.

reviews.subject: PUBH349 (Health Science)
reviews.review: She is very sweet, her lectures are pretty thorough and easy to understand, and the class is overall pretty easy as long as you do the work. Would recommend taking her class for sure.

reviews.subject: PUBH350 (Health Science)
reviews.review: You need to do well on the tests and make sure to start the final project early.

reviews.subject: PUBH400 (Health Science)
reviews.review: Prof. K is an excellent instructor. This course involves a lot of group work, so be ready to take initiative with your group to make sure you do well. If you're having issues with them, speak up early. Getting the grade you want might mean taking a leadership role, but it's very attainable.

reviews.subject: PUBH400 (Health Science)
reviews.review: Great professor for program design! The class is lecture based so showing up to class matters, but she provides a comprehensive outline that includes all the important points of each chapter. She also includes lots of Kahoot games and activities to learn material better. Just ask questions and follow the rubrics and you will pass with flying colors

reviews.subject: SOC101 (Sociology)
reviews.review: Very fun, very understanding, and a very fair course load.

reviews.subject: SOC101 (Sociology)
reviews.review: As a freshman coming into college I was scared of the professors. I gotta say this is by far my favorite professor so far. she grades in a timely manner, she makes so many funny jokes during lecture, and all her tests are on quizlet. easiest weekly readings and not too lecture heavy at all. 100 out of 10 recommend !!!

reviews.subject: SOCI101 (Sociology)
reviews.review: Take her class! I cannot recomend her enough. The way she teacher, her vibe and jokes are so welcoming and make it so easy to grasp info. She gives time to complete her assigmnets and makes sure we have all the info we need. Gets along with students great very easy to go up to for anything.

reviews.subject: SOC101 (Sociology)
reviews.review: Best professor ever! I really loved her class. I found it to be very interesting and fun. Professor Jerue is funny, kind, and professional. She cares about her students. I showed up to every class and I felt like I learned a lot. Her class felt like a safe environment, so I felt comfortable enough to participate in class which I don't normally do.

reviews.subject: SOC101 (Sociology)
reviews.review: I definitely recommend Professor Jerue. She is very sweet and hilarious. She's very easy going about exams and usually gives a week to complete them. She made Sociology very interesting and fun to learn about. Overall, she's a great teacher and everything is very easy if you stay on track. She offers extra credit toward the end of the semester.

reviews.subject: SOC101 (Sociology)
reviews.review: Amazing professor! Now I do not know if it is because she knows all the secrets to Sociology, but she just gets her students. Easy to go up to and talk. Very funny and the work is not bad it is actually very interesting.

reviews.subject: CS131 (Computer Science)
reviews.review:
Terrible professor. Expected students to know information from prerequisites when none was taught. Frequently introduces information that is irrelevant and was never taught in the class. 

Quizzes are on content that was never taught. I would avoid her at all costs.

I would point(er) away at a different teacher

reviews.subject: CS362 (Computer Science)
reviews.review: I had the pleasure to take her for Software Engineering, She is so good at taking time to explain, answer questions, and engage the class. I learned so much about how the software is being build in real world.

reviews.subject: CS362 (Computer Science)
reviews.review: Awesome class, I have used everything I have learned throughout this class at my first job, I am thankful.

reviews.subject: CPSC121 (Computer Science)
reviews.review: Took her for 120 ana 121, she is a good professor, probably one of the best in CS department, she did what she can to make the online classes smooth and easy. She expects you to read the material from the textbooks, labs are based on lectures and book examples, and tests are straightforward.

reviews.subject: CPSC120 (Computer Science)
reviews.review: Best online class I have taken during the pandemic! Her canvas is well-designed and easy to follow. Follow her instruction and its an easy A

reviews.subject: CPSC120 (Computer Science)
reviews.review: If you already know how to program, this class will be a breeze, but for others, it might be a struggle. She doesn't really teach students how to program and her lectures are dry and boring. The only plus side was that her exams were multiple choice with only 1 programming question and fairly easy.

reviews.subject: 233COMM (Communications)
reviews.review: COMM233 (online) the class was asynchronous so you just do everything at your own time & pace. He mainly uploads lectures and readings, but the readings are fairly easy. Grading was only made up of 2 finals & 1 essay (which was also easy). Finals were open note, but you must pay attention to his lecture videos if you want to pass.

reviews.subject: COMM334 (Communications)
reviews.review: COVID-19 update-Unorganized during zoom meetings and on canvas. 80% of your time will be spent in breakout rooms. Not much feedback on your drafts, instead has other confused students go over it. Changes due dates for papers last minute. You never know your grade, doesn't update canvas often.

reviews.subject: COMM334 (Communications)
reviews.review: Professor Brody is super funny and a great teacher! He's always there to help with your writing and provide feedback. He gives 4 essays for the semester but does rough drafts so you can have a lot of help and time for edits. He really cares about his students, he wants you to succeed and better your writing!

reviews.subject: COM233 (Communications)
reviews.review: He seems to care a lot about what he teaches, but he sounds monotoned so he may seem boring to come people. Most of his lectures are online and most of your grade is based of the test he gives but the study guides dont help a lot. He only gives you one research paper to turn in around the end but thats as much homework that youll get.

reviews.subject: COMM233 (Communications)
reviews.review: Hes a kind professor but unclear & very unorganized. His lectures are entertaining but seem to be more of a soapbox. The 2 required books were barely discussed in class & the answers to questions about them in the test were given in class. He messed up the grades in titanium so I had 160% until he finally fixed it so I ended with a B w/out knowing

reviews.subject: COM233 (Communications)
reviews.review: Professor Brody is an ok professor, but he is very unorganized. I went the whole semester thinking i had an A, until the week of finals where i found out i actually had a C because he never updated titanium. Make sure if you take him, keep up with your grades cause he wont.

reviews.subject: ANATOMY (Science)
reviews.review: She was a good professor, literally her tests come straight from her powerpoints. Only catch is you pretty much have to memorize them. Also be warned, she loves to have students color a ridiculous packet I got an A in the class and I just had someone else color it, huge waste of time. Other than that, cool teacher. Lectures are tough but good and you've gotta be always studying. Good luck!

reviews.subject: BIO101 (Science)
reviews.review: she was great! take her and u are sure to pass!!

reviews.subject: BIO101 (Science)
reviews.review: Biology with her was interesting. Viewed lots of videos. Clickers for attendance, quizes, and exams. Homework from time to time, two papers, easy quizes for every topic, exams are fairly easy. She was fun and energetic. I didn't have to try and I got a solid B. Chill class. I recommend if you want an easy and chill class.

reviews.subject: BIOL101 (Science)
reviews.review: Very nice and funny.  She cancelled class llike 5 times during the semester because of meetings or other stuff.  Class isnt that hard, just study key terms and you will do fine!

reviews.subject: BIO101 (Science)
reviews.review: I thought she was very clear with the material that she taught. She made complex information seem more simple and easier to understand. She followed her syllabus perfectly and there was never any confusion. I hated biology prior to this course, but somehow she made it interesting. I liked using clickers because it was never overwhelming taking a te

reviews.subject: BIO101 (Science)
reviews.review: Decent teacher... pretty clear on her lectures and all quizzes/exams are on clickers which are really easy (in other words, all multiple choice!).  I don't really remember her giving out any homework besides the 2 paper reports so the class shouldn't be too tough if you understand the material.

reviews.subject: AMST301 (American Studies)
reviews.review: Tough grader with an unforgiving late policy. Communication style is aggressive and accusatory if you run into any issues. Be sure to watch every video until completion, as there is zero grace for misunderstandings and incomplete viewing of any/all material.

reviews.subject: AMST201 (American Studies)
reviews.review: I enjoyed Professor Covert's online AMST 201 course. His lectures were always interesting; he's very funny and engaging. However, my biggest complaint is that I found his grading quite arbitrary. I personally struggled with his very vague essay prompt. His feedback also wasn't very clear to help improve further essays. Overall, decent class.

reviews.subject: AMST201 (American Studies)
reviews.review: Professor Ortiz is exceptional, thoughtful, charismatic, and very attentive to his students. I would 100% take another class with him. Show up to lectures, prepare in advance for exams, and don't miss assignments since there's very few to build your grade off of.

reviews.subject: AMST301 (American Studies)
reviews.review: Assignment prompts were vague, grading was inconsistent, points were deducted without clear explanations. He'd make passive aggressive comments & accused students of cheating on discussion posts & assignments. Also, having assignments due at 12pm instead of 11:59pm created unnecessary stress for students balancing work and other responsibilities.

reviews.subject: AMST201 (American Studies)
reviews.review: The grading rubric is very unclear, and the discussion post grade comments are vague. Focused more on accusing students of not actually watching the lecture rather than giving useful constructive criticism. Truly a headache.

reviews.subject: AMST201 (American Studies)
reviews.review: I would say he's alright, but very harsh when it comes to grading. His instructions for assignments are never clearly explained his feedbacks are vague. Most of the assignments are based on the lectures he uploads on canvas which he notices whether the student has viewed or not. But even for those, his lecture has no flow for students to understand

reviews.subject: HONR101B (Honors)
reviews.review: Professor Simões is one of the most kind teachers I've ever had who gives so much feedback on your speeches and presentations. The class is pretty easy, with just presenting topics and hardly any homework. He has a lot of passion for what he teaches and is very caring. Would have him as a professor again if I had the chance.

reviews.subject: HON210A (Honors)
reviews.review: 201a* Simoes is one of the best professors at this school. I'm not fond of history but I found myself very entertained with his lectures since he's very passionate about what he teaches, and is great at lecturing while not making it boring. The work and exams are easy if you take notes, but he does tend to go past the designated lecture time.

reviews.subject: HON210A (Honors)
reviews.review: I respect him so much. His class is simple and he explains history well. His exam are just simple match term with definition in which simple flashcard will be useful. Beside two book report which are self explanatory, there is a huge project divided in section. Although it is a bit difficult, he is easy to talk to and will support you all the way.

reviews.subject: HON101A (Honors)
reviews.review: Paulo Simoes is a great professor for Honor 101A. He made the class very fun and enjoyable. He has a lot of lectures and yes some are boring, but he tires his best to make them fun. He's very energetic and nice to all students. There was an 8-page essay due at the end of his class, He also had 2 papers that are a minimum of 3 pages.

reviews.subject: HONR210A (Honors)
reviews.review: The best instructor I ever had. He is incredibly wise, caring, and passionate. I had him twice my 1st yr and went out of my way to take him again my 2nd year. He was outstanding in all three courses. He has 3 exams, all matching terms to definitions. No HW besides an easy term project due in sections. Take him as much as you can. I will miss him.

reviews.subject: HONR210A (Honors)
reviews.review: I took three classes with Dr. Simoes, all very different in nature. He cares about his students, adjusts curriculum to class progress, and is supportive and helpful if you are struggling. He very obviously loves teaching and is very knowledgeable about history, philosophy, and more. If you study for his tests you will score well. Highly recommend.

reviews.subject: 308 (Engineering)
reviews.review: A joke of a professor. He never explains anything and has no notes. He writes all over the textbook in his indecipherable handwriting and retaliated toward several students, docking points without explanation. A group of several students had to walk into the chairs office for him to admit that his own textbook (that he grades from) was wrong.

reviews.subject: 11CE301 (Engineering)
reviews.review: This guy just yaps and yaps on end.

reviews.subject: 11CE301 (Engineering)
reviews.review: He is indeed hilarious, caring, and inspirational but that's it. He talks and talks but doesn't teach. Has a thick accent which doesn't make it better. At some point you get sick of him talking nonsense nonstop. Don't take if u don't have to. Won't learn

reviews.subject: EGCE308 (Engineering)
reviews.review: Dr. Putcha is an excellent teacher. He explains the subject matter so clearly that I don't need to read anything after attending his class. I hope other teachers in the Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering Department at California State University, Fullerton are like him.

reviews.subject: EGCE308 (Engineering)
reviews.review: Very nice professor but his writing is very hard to read, didn't really teach, and his examples weren't very helpful. He FELL asleep during an exam! You will not learn anything!

reviews.subject: AMST201 (American Studies)
reviews.review: took this class asynchronous. professor answers emails really quick. opens modules the beginning of each week. mainly graded on midterm and final, but plenty of extra credit opportunities. there are discussion boards each week that are not mandatory, can help boost your grade. would recommend, but get ready to read and watch lectures

reviews.subject: AMST201 (American Studies)
reviews.review: Jesse is an amazing professor and is very passionate and understanding! Grade is based on Midterm and Final essay. There are plenty Extra credit opportunities... I def procrastinated but he gives you a week to complete the essays.

reviews.subject: AMST318 (American Studies)
reviews.review: i liked the source material a lot and most of it is easy to understand. midterms and finals are easy to do. the power point lectures are awful. they are too long and there is so much to write.

reviews.subject: AMST201 (American Studies)
reviews.review: Your grade is: 50% on one test and the other 50% is your final. No graded homework, quizzes, or anything else; so those 2 tests entirely depend on your grade. There isn't a clear rubric either. The 2 essay tests are long but he gives a whole week to complete them (with a known prompt) so it isn't bad, but there is a lot of weekly reading.

reviews.subject: AMST201 (American Studies)
reviews.review: Grades only the midterm and exam. Several EC opportunities. He assigns a lot of readings but i was able to get an A with only reading some of them. I took this class online due to covid. He posted lectures and study questions for the lecture and readings the sunday before. He is very understanding of our current situation and is very nice.

reviews.subject: AMST318 (American Studies)
reviews.review: Class is not what you expect it to be. Essays: Midterm(40%) Final(60%). Need the books (skim). Need to watch all films. 1/2 of semester revolves around Victorian culture and its fall in the 20s, other 1/2 is the great depression leading to the 50s. Lecture videos are short. Need to know every single little detail. I procrastinated, you should not.

reviews.subject: GEOG100 (Geography)
reviews.review: She's a nice lady, but she was hard to understand with her accent and the tests were hard because some of the topics weren't really covered very well. Not much homework, but you have to show up to class because you can get enough info to get at least a C on a tests. Didn't even know tests were worth 90% of our grade till finals.

reviews.subject: GEO100 (Geography)
reviews.review: Wonderful woman, her stories are interesting and she's really funny. However, this is a class. Not an easy GE if you take her. You won't know your grade at all unless you ask. Her tests don't match up with lectures, making them hard. Long lectures, you MUST pay attention. She doesn't use internet at all, so no Titanium. Write ALL notes. Hard class.

reviews.subject: GEOG100 (Geography)
reviews.review: She pushes personal political opinions on students. She is deaf so she talks really loud and will only acknowledge you if you raise your hand. She often repeats lectures for several classes. Her test only have 75% of the material she covered. She often goes off topic for sometimes as long as 10 minitues. You have Tom take good notes to pass.

reviews.subject: GEOG 100 (Geography)
reviews.review: She is horrible in every way.  Doesn't trust science and spouts nonsense for most of her classes.

reviews.subject: GEOG100 (Geography)
reviews.review: This class was really nice. The material was pretty interesting, and the professor was really enthusiastic about it. I would recommend that you bring a laptoptablet to take notes though because she kinda jumps all over the place, so you end up editing the notes a lot. The tests are pretty tough, so you need to read the textbook chapters.

reviews.subject: GEOG100 (Geography)
reviews.review: Never has office hours. Her lectures are never what is on the tests. You kind of have to know things on your own to be able to pass the tests.

reviews.subject: CPSC120 (Computer Science)
reviews.review: DO NOT TAKE HER IF TAKING 120. She goes pretty fast during lecture, and she does a bad job in explaining concepts. NO MIDTERMS, just QUIZZES on lab days and on the final its open notes, book, and you could use previous programs made during lab. DROP CLASS or SWITCH PROF if you can, or else you will have a hard time in CPSC 121.

reviews.subject: CPSC120 (Computer Science)
reviews.review: I was worried coming into her class because of her scores on here. But I think she is pretty helpful. I don't understand how she gives grades, I got an A when in reality I think I deserve a C, but I'm not complaining. Get tutored! She goes through notes really fast and if you don't ask questions you'll be lost. On final you can use old programs.

reviews.subject: CPSC131 (Computer Science)
reviews.review: I don't like how the professor teaches. Not very clear at all compared to my other cpsc professors, still very possible to get an A in her class but learning wise I did not like her at all

reviews.subject: CPSC121 (Computer Science)
reviews.review: Totally a sub-standard professor. Lecture is a reading from the Powerpoint and she goes quite fast so you might not get down all the notes but at the same time they're not all that helpful. I think I learned more from the book than her. Lab days consists of a quiz and an assignment, which you must do her way or lose points. Drop if possible!

reviews.subject: CPSC121 (Computer Science)
reviews.review: He method of projects/quizzes are absurd! She has no idea of "the best way" to do something in the project. Knowledgable of her material, horrible as a professor...

reviews.subject: CPSC121 (Computer Science)
reviews.review: She's not a terrible teacher, you just have to ask questions and she explains it quite clearly. The lectures are a bit boring because they are power points, but quizes, bonus points, and lab assignments are fairly easy. This class is an easy A if you just show up and do the work

reviews.subject: FIN320 (Finance)
reviews.review: I didn't think this class was as hard as some are saying.  Yes, the tests were difficult but you get to fill up a full sheet of paper with notes for the midterms and 4 sheets for the final.  Get the calculator she recommends because that is what the book has instructions for.  I barely read the book. The lectures and powerpoints were all I needed.

reviews.subject: FIN320 (Finance)
reviews.review: Highly recommend Richert. She has the ability to simplify difficult subjects. If you don?t like the class then Finance is not the concentration for you. If you already have a TI 83 then I wouldn?t buy a financial calculator. You?ll need to Google IRR and NPV to figure out how to do these computations on the TI 83.

reviews.subject: FIN320 (Finance)
reviews.review: I would never recommend her to anyone needing to take FIN 320, she is not helpful, if you ask her a question, it's oh look in the book. She is very hard and you really need to study for her tests.

reviews.subject: FIN320 (Finance)
reviews.review: Im a senior at CSUF & Richert was one of THE worst professors I have ever had.  This woman knows nothing about Finance. Her classes are disorganized. She may seem nice but she honestly does not care about students.  I emailed her 6 times through out the semester & she never replied once. Wont answer questions cuz she doesnt know the right answers!

reviews.subject: FINAN320 (Finance)
reviews.review: if you want to pass the class to graduate...dont take her her tests are hard..she gives a study guide for the final..BUT it is nothing similar to the actuall final itself! there is easier professors, if you just need this class to pass..take someone else!

reviews.subject: FIN320 (Finance)
reviews.review: Don't have to attend class, but do study power points. Get to use lots of cheat sheets, and only 3 exams.  Overall, good class.  Passed with a B, but didn't try hard at all.
